description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

syllabi.outline:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。五專一、二、三年級實施普通班體育正課教學。五專四年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、網球、太極拳、體適能、足球等。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: The teaching goal is to establish students’ healthy lifestyle, sportsmanship, teamwork and exercise habit. In First, Second, and Third grade students are taught many sport skills in the same class. In Fourth grade, we are offering specific sports to the students, like Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Tennis, Tai Chi Chuan, Physical Fitness and martial arts. Students can choose they are interested.

(1)材料試驗：學習金相試片的準備及光學顯微鏡之觀察、材料顯微結構的認識、各種機械性質的試驗。
(2) 固力實驗：
    1. 一般性實驗：樑的撓度試驗、圓桿扭轉實驗
    2. 振動實驗：質量－阻尼－彈簧系統實驗(MCK)、樑之共振頻率實驗、軸之臨界轉速實驗
    3. 應力分析實驗：應變計實驗、光彈性實驗
    4. 動態量測實驗：機械振動性質測定實驗、動平衡實驗、工具機切削力測定實驗。

syllabi.outline: 網路是翻轉新科技的基石, 也是串連智慧生活的關鍵, 更是業界發展不可或缺的核心技術。隨著網路應用的爆發性成長，網路技術和相關標準也不斷加速更新，4G 網路才剛剛普及，5G 就緊接到來，藍牙也跟著改朝換代推出BLE 5.0，更快的無線網路標準也悄悄上市，還直接正名為WiFi 6。面對快速發展更迭的網路標準與技術，本課程將帶領學生從最基礎網路概論，數據通訊一直到最新的5G、IOT與雲端等觀念，讓學生瞭解未來的網路通訊世界。

description.zh: 本課程將介紹模糊邏輯、模糊推論、模糊控制及其應用。滑動模式控制、適應性控制、最佳控制、基因演算法及其相關智慧型控制方法之設計及應用也將在此課程中被探討。此外，藉由一些物理及工程的系統以驗證課程中所介紹之智慧型控制法方之可行性及有效性。
description.en: In this course, fuzzy logic, fuzzy inference, fuzzy control and its application will be introduced. In addition, sliding mode control, adaptive control, genetic algorithm and optimal control will also be explored in this course. Moreover, some engineering and physical models are used to show the feasibility and validity of these intelligent control methods.

description.zh: 本課程介紹有關人工智慧理論與應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的歷史、代理人技術、搜尋法則、智識表達、機器學習及感知與辨識等用電腦解決問題的方法。
description.en: This course provides a broad technical introduction of theory and practice of Artificial Intelligence(AI). The topics include: history of AI, agents, search, knowledge representation, machine learning, and perception and cognition.

syllabi.outline: 人工智慧已在各個領域中影響人類生活，特別是在機器學習與深度學習技術的發展。本課程為人工智慧領域的入門課程，旨在提供學生關於機器學習與深度學習的基本概念，其中包含了資料處理、分類以及迴歸類演算法、捲積神經網路、遞迴神經網路、深度學習於影像辨識的應用、自然語言處理以及生成式AI及其相關演算法介紹(例如:生成對抗網路模型)。課程亦提供Python程式，並運用實例進行實作練習，如:紅酒品質分類、房價預測、鐵道領域之軌道檢測等等。透過理論以及實作的訓練，本課程最終目標則是希望學生能夠將人工智慧技術應用在當前的工程以及工業問題中。

description.zh: 人工智慧、5G行動通訊、雲端運算、區塊鏈、大數據、物聯網、無線區域網路、汽車電子、近場通訊、行動支付、智慧生活等，科技發展日新月異，便利你我的生活，但也助長了新的犯罪手段，專注新興科技的同時，資訊安全更要與時俱進。本課程將著重於資訊安全的基礎知識，以及對於現今通用的各種資訊安全觀念、技術、管理與應用給予整體性的認識，未來可進一步修習相關進階課程。
description.en: The rapid development of science and technology facilitates your life and mine, such as artificial intelligence, 5G mobile communication, cloud computing, blockchain, big data, Internet of Things, wireless local area network, vehicle electronics, near field communication, mobile payment, smart life, etc., but it also encourages new criminal methods. While focusing on emerging technologies, information security must move with the times. This course will focus on the basic knowledge of information security, giving whole understanding of various information security concepts, technologies, management and applications in common use today. In the future, students can further study related advanced courses.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
本課程主要介紹幾何光學與Coherent光學兩部份之基本概念與應用﹐提供機械領域的學生有關光的知識﹐讓機械領域的學生有能力加入機光電技術整合。本課程首先介紹幾何光學﹐幾何光學雖然簡單﹐卻是光學應用最普遍的知識﹐接著進入Coherent光學原理與應用介紹﹐Coherent光學在光量測技術部份佔了非常重要的地位﹐透過本課程的訓練﹐學生將可更順利的進入光學實驗室工作﹐當然﹐本課程也適合其他對光學有興趣的學生來修習。
description.en: The lectures in this course include two main parts, the geometrical and the coherent optics. Due to the future high technology, the optomechatronics, needs the cooperation of knowledge among the optics, the electrics, and the mechanics. This course gives the students of mechanical engineering the chance to participate in this work group. The lecture will first show the students the geometrical optics which is simple but important in the field of optical application. The coherent optics is the main part in this course which occupies the most optical technique of measurement. After the course the students should have the enough knowledge to work in the optical laboratory. Certainly, this course is also useful for all students who are interest in the area of the optics.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹光學之基礎原理，包括光的本質、電磁波及其傳播特性。課程內容涵蓋光線光學與幾何光學，並延伸至波動光學主題，如偏振、干涉與繞射等現象。透過期中報告，學生可統整並深化對理論概念之理解。課程後半段著重於實作實驗，包含光學系統架設與校準、繞射分析以及傅立葉轉換光學成像等內容。最後以雷射相關實驗與期末報告作為總結，使學生能將光學理論應用於實際工程情境中。
This course introduces the fundamental principles of optics, including the nature of light, electromagnetic waves, and wave propagation. It covers ray and geometrical optics, as well as wave optics topics such as polarization, interference, and diffraction. A midterm presentation enables students to consolidate their understanding of theoretical concepts. The second half of the course focuses on hands-on experiments, including optical setup and alignment, diffraction, and Fourier transform-based imaging. The course concludes with laser-related experiments and a final presentation, allowing students to apply optical theories in practical engineering contexts.

This course introduces the fundamental principles and applications of Engineering Statistics. Topics include descriptive statistics, probability theory, random variables and probability distributions, sampling distributions, parameter estimation, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, regression analysis, reliability analysis, and engineering data analytics. Mathematical derivations, problem-solving exercises, and engineering case studies will be used to develop students' understanding of statistical methods. In addition, students will utilize Python for data analysis, statistical simulation, and Monte Carlo methods, culminating in a coding project that applies statistical techniques to real-world engineering problems.

name.zh: 鐵道號誌與行車控制系統
name.en: Railway Signal and Traffic Control System

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由課堂講授與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道號誌系統的內涵。號誌系統是列車運行的控制系統。其功用必需兼顧整個鐵道運輸系統的「安全」、「迅速」、與「經濟」。由於號誌系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與控制等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道號誌系統專家、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊與自動控制等三部分提出號誌系統規劃與評估報告，並邀請鐵道號誌系統專家擔任評審。
description.en: This course is one of the optional courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The goal of this course is, via both in-class lecturing and field-trip visiting, to have participant students realize the contents of Railway Signal System. The signal system is the control system of train operation. To give consideration to safety, rapidness and economy of entire railway transportation system, this system will be required. Since the signal system is the technology including management, communication and automatic control, this course is a joint-lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors for the participant students include experts on railway signal system from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In the student reports, they will demonstrate the railway signal system planning and evaluation report for the management, communication and automatic control.

When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit.  For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.en:
Course Title:Automatic Control Practice
Description:This course is first to introduce the basic concepts of
control systems and the mathematical background, second, state the
transfer function, block diagram and signal  flow graph, third,
discuss the mathematical modeling of control systems and elements, and
forth, describe the time-domain analysis, root locus techniques and
frequency-domain of control systems, and then to measure the character
of control systems, Finally, the design of control system will be
introduced.

syllabi.notes:
此課程結合生物技術與化學工程原理，教授學生微生物、動植物細胞的培養、酵素的提取、反應動力學、生物反應器的操作，以及產品的分離程序等內容。這些知識和技術對於促進人類健康和福祉有著重要的貢獻。

首先，透過學習細胞培養和酵素提取等技術，可以生產出各種醫療用途的生物製劑，如疫苗、抗體藥物、生長因子等。這些生物製劑可用於預防和治療各種疾病，提高人類的健康水平。

其次，生物反應器的設計與操作是生物製藥產業的核心技術之一。藉由優化生物反應器的操作條件，如溫度、pH值、溶氧量等參數，可以提高目標產物的產量和品質，降低生產成本。這不僅有助於降低藥品價格，提高藥物的可近性，也能確保藥品的安全性和有效性，保障病患的用藥權益。

最後，本課程還介紹了抗體在醫學上的應用。單株抗體技術的發展帶來了抗體藥物的蓬勃發展，為癌症、自體疫疾病等難治疾病的治療帶來了新的希望。

總之，「生物化學工程」這門課所傳授的知識和技能，在促進人類健康和福祉方面有著舉足輕重的作用。藉由培養相關領域的專業人才，可以加速生物醫藥產業的發展，為人類健康事業做出貢獻。同時，這些知識也可應用於環境保護、食品工業等領域，為社會的可持續發展提供助力。

syllabi.outline:
本課程為IEET認可之Capstone課程，旨在培養學生統整運用化工相關知識與工具，解決具規模與複雜性的工程問題。學生將依據實務化工流程設計原則，分組執行一個完整的製程開發與模擬專案，並進行系統性規劃、模擬分析、資料彙整與成果呈現，提升其工程實作能力與團隊合作素養。

課程內容涵蓋典型化工程序單元，包括蒸餾、熱交換、攪拌、泵、機械分離等，從質量、能量與動量平衡出發，介紹化工程序設計的基本流程與符號、單元設備選型、管線與儀控配置、經濟評估、以及整廠流程最佳化。

學生需組成3至5人小組，完成一項複雜之工程問題作為專題題目，進行完整的程序設計與模擬分析。題目為當年度台灣化工學會所公布之設計題目。

專案過程中，學生將學習使用 Aspen Plus 進行模擬，並輔以 ChatGPT 作為學習與設計輔助工具，包含：協助搜尋與解讀專業文獻、撰寫與編修技術報告、解釋軟體操作與除錯過程，進而提升解決工程問題的效率與品質。
syllabi.assessment: 本課程依據IEET核心能力評量Rubrics進行，針對八項畢業生核心能力進行全學期持續性評估。評分細節與Rubrics標準將於第一週課堂中詳細說明。

第1週：課程介紹，分組，說明課程研究問題、研究方法、每週彙報方式、報告撰寫規定等。基本工具介紹：Aspen Plus模擬軟體、Web of Science論文查找及閱讀、EndNote管理文獻及報告撰寫等。

第9週：期中彙報、期中預警、檢討計畫執行方法、討論救助方案。
第10週～第13週：組合單元完成基本模擬程序，模擬之除錯和驗證。
第14週～第15週：程序最佳化、熱整合等設計改良、經濟評估。
第16週：期末報告的準備和撰寫。
第17週～第18週：期末口頭報告和討論。

name.en: Optical,Electrical and Magnetic Properties of Materials

description.zh: 簡介、電性質、介電性質 磁性質、光學性質 1.晶格與晶體結構 2.晶格振動 3.材料的能帶結構 4.常溫與低溫的霍爾效應 5.材料的光電效應 6.光、電、磁場對材料的影響
description.en: This course is a special topics of Optical，Electrical and Magnetic Properties of Materials. 1.Outline 2.Electrical Properties 3.Dielectric Properties 4.Magnetic Properties 5.Optical Properties. 1.Lattices and crystal structures 2.Lattice vibration 3.Energy-band structures 4.Hall effect-At room and low temperatures 5.Optoelectronic effects of materials 6.Effects of optical, electric, and magnetic fields on materials

syllabi.outline: 課程主要目標，是要使工程科系，發展出以簡單而合於邏輯的方式分析任何問題，並應用一些為大家熟悉的基本原理加以解答。本課程內容分成光學、電學及磁學三部分在材料上的性質與應用，課程內容將介紹某些依據基本定理而化簡的數學模式，進而分析及設計作用在結構上的各種條件，使同學在選擇或運用材料上有安全與正確的觀念，以便在理論與經驗的配合下，順利地處理材料在工程上所發生的問題。
syllabi.assessment:
1. 根據上課所講授之內容，學期結束前繳交一份專業性書面學習報告
2. 報告繳交時間：請查閱北科學園內資與學校所發送的通知信。
3. 報告請勿抄襲

1. 依照所指示課本範圍(須依據課本內之資料為主，其他參考資料為輔)，自行選出兩項主題做為題目，分別仔細"閱讀"、"理解"及可能之"應用"來做報告。

     原理或推導

      參考資料

此課程為本系大學部之最終統整課程，目的在整合所學基礎與專業課程，依核心能力項目評定成績。學生依志趣選擇統整設計實作專題，以團隊合作與實務演練方式完成實務工程設計或專案，並簡報其成果，強化培養學生專業核心能力使達所訂教育目標以符合實務界之需求。學生可選擇之統整設計實作專題如下:
(1) 結構、材料工程設計實作
(2) 大地工程設計實作
(3) 營建管理設計實作
(4) 生態與防災設計實作
(5) 水資源工程規劃實作
(6) 空間資訊設計實作
description.en:
The course is designed as the one in which all courses in the undergraduate program in the Department of Civil Engineering can be finally integrated. The aim is to help students integrate knowledge learned from the fundamental and advanced courses and to evaluate the performance of students based on the core abilities required in the program. Students can accomplish engineering practice design or project in a form of team work based on their specific interests, and can present their results. This training can strengthen the development of professional knowledge and skills of students to attain the program educational objectives and to meet the needs for engineering practice.
The engineering practice design or project in this course include:
(1) Structural and material engineering practice design or project
(2) Geotechnical engineering practice design or project
(3) Construction management practice design or project
(4) Ecological engineering and disaster prevention practice design

description.zh:
這是一門設計為 "軟硬體合成的電子實習" 課程。對於一個電路的實作程序如下:
(1). 首先使用C/C++來計算和設定，電路的零件值。
(2). 再使用 Spice simulator，對該電路來做諸如 DC operating point、Transient Analysis、AC Analysis、DC Sweep、DC Transfer、Noise、FFT、Spectrum Analysis、等必要的分柝，以證明該電路的規格與可行性。
(3). 將電路佈局、並銲接到實驗板上。
(4). 使用 PC/Analog Discovery Module 對實驗板上的電路來做測試和除錯，並且跟Spice 所獲得的數據來作比較。
本課程的設計除了每週 3 小時的教室講解、示範和討論外，並提供每位同學一個Analog Discovery和實作教材，以供同學課外每週約 8~12 小時的實作之需。全學期約 12 個項目，除了必須完成有關實作外之紙上作業，還有期中及期末測驗，以檢定學習之成效。

name.zh: 科技新創事業與行銷策略
name.en: Technology Innovation Business and Marketing Strategy

description.zh: 本課程的設計，以科技新創事業的發展為目標，品牌的價值最大化為核心，進而設計與執行品牌之行銷方案，分析如何經營新創品牌的價值，與創造出在新創產業中的優勢品牌與品牌資產。結合行銷學的STP模型與SMART Strategy(睿智策略)，對本地與國際市場上的目標顧客，進行系統化的策略性行銷，連結顧客，經營通路上的成員與學習通路之設計，經由團隊合作，建構起良善通路的競爭優勢。本課程的教學模式，採用國立臺北科大經典的黑手工程師訓練模式，強調動手式的 OJT (On Job Training)。課堂上會有大量的實務型動手演練實作，下課後會有一定數量的作業與練習，透過此系統性訓練課程，將使學員(學生)具備微(小)型企業(工作室)的基本商業維運知識與能力。
description.en: The course is designed to target the development of Innovation Vocation, maximize the value of the brand as the core, and then design and implementation of brand marketing programs, analysis of how to operate a new brand value, and create a cultural industry in the advantages of brand and brand equity. To combine with the STP model of marketing and SMART Strategy, the target customers in the international market, the systematic strategic marketing, linking customers, managing the members in the channel and learning the channel design method. Use teamwork spirit to build the competitive advantage in the commercial channel. The teaching mode of the course: using the Taipei Tech classic Practice-Engineer training model, emphasizing the hands-on OJT (On Job Training) method. There will be a large number of hands-on exercises in the classroom, and a number of homework and exercises. After this course, students will have the basic business model knowledge and ability of micro-enterprises.

name.zh: 顧客關係管理與商業智慧
name.en: Customer Relationship Management and Business Intelligence

description.zh: 顧客關係管理主要目的是了解企業與顧客之關係，促使顧客滿意及忠誠回應而產生終身價值，進而提昇企業獲利，其內容包括顧客關係管理的概念與本質、顧客行為、顧客資料探勘、顧客關係管理系統、顧客關係管理專案之規劃與管理、顧客關係管理的績效衡量、顧客關係管理實務研討。商業智慧(Business Intelligence, BI)，是企業利用現代資訊技術收集、管理和分析結構化與非結構化的企業資料與資訊，創造和累積企業知識與見解，以改善企業決策品質與採取有效的企業行動，進而提升企業各方面績效。由基本現場管理(Shop Floor Control)需求談起，然後介紹製造資訊分類與收集技術（包括RFID），也將包括資料庫與資料倉儲觀念，最後介紹BI於顧客關係管理之應用。課堂中也將輔以目前市面上商用BI套裝軟體，並將其專業上相關資訊在此系統上實際應用，體驗BI對企業之重要性。
description.en: The objectives of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) are to study the relationship between corporation and customer, to increase the profit by customer lifetime value through customer satisfaction and royalty. The topics of this course includes concepts and context of CRM, consumer behavior, customer data mining, CRM system, planning and management of CRM projects, performance measurement of CRM. Business intelligence (BI) systems refer to applications and technologies which gather and analyze data about company operations. It then provides a comprehensive correlation of those factors, such as metrics on sales, production, internal operations, and helps managers to make better business decisions. This course focuses on applications of BI in CRM, with the introduction of shop floor control concepts and data collection techniques such as RFID, along with database and data warehouse concepts. Hands-on experience in BI software implementation is also emphasized.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以工業工程與管理領域學生為主要對象，旨在培養學生整合運用商業智慧、顧客關係管理、資料分析及人工智慧技術，解決企業營運與顧客管理問題的能力。課程內容涵蓋顧客資料管理、顧客分群、RFM分析、顧客價值與流失分析、銷售與營運分析、關鍵績效指標設計、商業智慧儀表板建置，以及AI輔助資料分析。學生將學習如何將顧客、銷售與營運資料轉化為具管理價值的資訊與決策建議。課程將運用商業智慧軟體、生成式AI及AI Vibe Coding工具，透過自然語言指令與AI協作，進行資料整理、分析、視覺化、儀表板設計及系統原型開發。並藉由企業案例與專題實作，培養學生的資料分析、AI應用、系統整合及管理決策能力。修習本課程後，學生應能：
一、理解CRM、BI、資料分析與AI在企業管理中的功能及整合應用。
二、運用BI工具、生成式AI及AI Vibe Coding進行資料整理、分析與視覺化。
三、完成顧客分群、RFM、顧客價值、顧客流失及銷售績效分析。
四、整合銷售與營運資料，完成分析型CRM應用或系統原型，並提出具體管理決策建議。

This course is designed primarily for students in industrial engineering and management. It aims to develop students’ ability to integrate Business Intelligence (BI), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), data analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to solve practical problems in business operations and customer management.
The course covers customer data management, customer segmentation, RFM analysis, customer value and churn analysis, sales and operational analysis, key performance indicator design, business intelligence dashboard development, and AI-assisted data analytics. Students will learn how to transform customer, sales, and operational data into meaningful managerial information and actionable decision insights.
The course incorporates business intelligence software, generative AI, and AI Vibe Coding tools. Through natural-language instructions and AI-assisted collaboration, students will conduct data preparation, analysis, visualization, dashboard design, and system prototype development. Enterprise cases and project-based learning will be used to strengthen students’ capabilities in data analysis, AI application, system integration, and managerial decision-making.
Upon completion of the course, students will be able to:
1.Understand the roles and integrated applications of CRM, BI, data analytics, and AI in business management.
2.Apply BI tools, generative AI, and AI Vibe Coding to data preparation, analysis, and visualization.
3.Conduct customer segmentation, RFM, customer value, customer churn, and sales performance analyses, and develop management dashboards.
4.Integrate customer, sales, and operational data to develop an analytical CRM application or system prototype and provide actionable managerial recommendations.

description.zh: 本課程之主要目的介紹深度學習於影像處領域之基本理論、架構及應用，包括: Classifier(CNN、Transformer)、Object detection(Yolo)、Anomaly Detection(EfficientAD、GLASS)、GAN及Image-To-Text(CLIP)相關網路之架構及應用，更藉由專題製作方式讓同學了解現有之類神經網路於工業工程領域內之相關運用。
description.en: The main objective of this course is to introduce the fundamental theories, architectures, and applications of deep learning in the field of computer vision. Topics include classifiers (CNN, Transformer), object detection (YOLO), anomaly detection (EfficientAD, GLASS), GANs, and image-to-text models (CLIP). Through project-based learning, students will also gain an understanding of how existing neural network models are applied in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之主要目的除介紹基本之類神經理論外，更在於運用現有之類神經網路於工業工程領域內之相關運用，將以現有之資料庫實地解決分類、分群、預測、監控等實際問題，使學生能夠了解類神經網路之基礎理論外，更可深入運用此工具。
The objective of this class is to explore the basic theoretical basis and applications of Neural Networks and their applications.  In this course, students will learn how to build deep learning networks and their applications in machine vision areas 

加強程式、邏輯訓練及實作 (PyTorch & python & MVA – prerequisites)

The major topics of networks covered include: 
Block Design: Residual block, SE block, etc.
AD(Anomaly Detection): EfficientAD、PatchCore、Padim
Classifier: CNN (ResNet, DenseNet, EfficientNetv2)
OD (Object Detection): Yolov10 BBox and Instance segmentation、RMDet
Semantic Segmentation: AutoEncoder, UNet
GAN: DCGAN etc.

This course uses a capstone design approach to train students in independent planning, analysis, judgment, organization, synthesis, and innovative thinking, while providing hands-on experience in the complete design process. Students are required to complete a design project either individually or in groups. The final outcomes must be publicly exhibited, and the exhibition format must be submitted in advance for departmental review and approval. In the first semester, the course focuses on topic definition, data collection, analytical investigation, conclusion formulation, concept development, and the submission of preliminary mock-ups. In the second semester, the course covers detailed design development, model making, project publication editing, exhibition setup, and the submission of the final design report, with the aim of cultivating students’ professional design competence.

description.zh: 以專題設計方式，訓練學生獨立企劃、分析、評斷、組織、歸納與創新之思考，並實際演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組或獨自完成一設計主題，設計成果須經公開展示且展覽形式需事前提送系所審核通過。上學期課程以題目界定、資料收集、分析調查、結論定義、構想發展及草模提交等為教學內容，下學期則進行細部設計、模型製作、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容,以培養專業設計之能力。
description.en: Studio in product design for the senior. Students are expected to exhibit a full range of professional competence and facility in designing advanced products and component complexes of broad scope. The design results must be publicly displayed and the exhibition format must be submitted to the department for review and approval. All phases of each project design are brought to a professional level under supervision of the director. This course puts emphasis on presentation techniques, including verbal, visual, and written. A project report is required.

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en:
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

syllabi.outline:
本課程(Thesis Design)以研究式設計(Research Design)為基礎，於設計中對空間、環境、構築進行反思，提出不同之空間想像與落實方案，並積極參與實質空間之運作過程，促進與實務領域之相互參照。

本課程除了做為畢業生的空間技術專業的總體檢，也透過畢業設計中以自由意識主動發現空間機會的具體設計作為，以培養學生未來邁入職場的倫理觀與態度，包含邁向專業實踐應具備的毅力，對空間、環境與社會的關懷與理解力，以及探索空間契機與挖掘技術問題解決方案之能力。課程期盼學生畢業後具備創造美好而正義的空間的能力，朝向空間專業者與行動者。

課程之成果為具備建築或空間意義之設計作品，其格式不限某種既定框架。內容應包含時空脈絡分析、議題探討、設計策略、研究或方法論、特定媒材之設計成果。

由於本課程為四年制建築系的最後一年，整合建築學與建築設計式課程最為關鍵的核心能力，並培養學生自主的建築關照、探索和執行能力，涵蓋 :
1.  指認建築命題、並學習如何透過該命題的研究和探究進行個人建築專業的思辨和論述。	
2.  認識建築物質與非物質之建構邏輯，以及如何發展出回應命題的個人建構建築的邏輯。	
3.  導入相關課程(建築史、建築理論、結構和構造、環境控制、景觀和都市設計等等)的知能，以建築設計整合相關建築學範疇。
4.  具有回應特定命題所需的獨立發展與建構設計過程的能力。

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

description.zh: 實務專題課程為建築專題設計（畢業設計）的輔助課程，分二學期：第一學期為前置課程，主要訓練學生具備獨立思考和建立自主觀點的能力，依教師專長指導學生探討和發展設計議題、收集相關資料和進行案例分析、自訂設計方法與流程、並提出畢業設計的研究方向；第二學期旨在加強學生在建築實務工作各領域的能力，結合設計課程的操作，對特定之實務課題（例如：空間計畫、結構分析、細部設計與大樣圖模、施工圖、機電配置、材料實驗、構築實作、綠建築檢討、CFD模擬、施工管理、法規檢討、BIM模型、競圖報告書、設計方法論、參數演算、動畫製作、專業rendering等項目）進行深入探討並提出專題報告。
description.en: The course works together with Special Topics on Architectural Design (Thesis Design) in two semesters. The first semester is preparatory course which trains students to think independently and establish independent perspective. Teachers of different fields guide students to explore design issues, collect data, have case study, develop design methodology, and propose future direction for thesis design . The second semester aims to enhance students' abilities in practice, such as planning, structural analysis, detail drawing, shop drawing, electrical and mechanical system, materials experiments, tectonic construction, green building evaluation, CFD simulation, construction management, regulatory review, BIM modeling, competition reports, design methodology, parametric algorithms, animation, rendering and so on.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
Microecosystem of City and the Tracing Machine
城市的微生態系與測＿儀

『在生態學中，都市生態系是集約利用土地的生物群系中的生態系功能組。都市生態系是一種結構複雜的生態系，具有由人類創建和維護的高度異質和動態的空間結構。它們包括都市、較小的居民點和工業區，這些區由不同類型的斑塊組成（例如：建築物、鋪面、交通基礎設施、公園和花園、垃圾場）。都市生態系是不完整的生態系，需要從其他生態系輸入大量的物質和能量。與其他自然生態系和人工生態系相比，都市生態系的人口密度很高，它們與不同類型的板塊之間相互作用會產生新的特性，並在生態系組分之間產生複雜的反饋。』

城市是一個不斷在變動的動態空間結構。而一個（或數個）不斷在變動的對象，該如何記錄並加以圖像化使之能夠被閱讀、被分析？如同地震儀可以將觸覺性的震動，透過儀器的紀錄轉化成可視的波形；關於城市的各種感知，我們可以透過什麼樣的工具/儀器加以轉化，成為空間議題的探討？

本學期的專題討論希望以此為出發點，首先挖掘一個動態的城市（微）系統，為它設計一個工具，並試著透過它將觀察到的動態系統加以具現化/可視化。

syllabi.outline:
實務專題課程為建築專題設計（畢業設計）的輔助課程，分二學期：第一學期為前置課程，主要訓練學生具備獨立思考和建立自主觀點的能力，依教師專長指導學生探討和發展設計議題、收集相關資料和進行案例分析、自訂設計方法與流程、並提出畢業設計的研究方向；第二學期旨在加強學生在建築實務工作各領域的能力，結合設計課程的操作，對特定之實務課題（例如：空間計畫、結構分析、細部設計與大樣圖模、施工圖、機電配置、材料實驗、構築實作、綠建築檢討、CFD模擬、施工管理、法規檢討、BIM模型、競圖報告書、設計方法論、參數演算、動畫製作、專業rendering等項目）進行深入探討並提出專題報告。
The course works together with Special Topics on Architectural Design (Thesis Design) in two semesters. The first semester is preparatory course which trains students to think independently and establish independent perspective. Teachers of different fields guide students to explore design issues, collect data, have case study, develop design methodology, and propose future direction for thesis design . The second semester aims to enhance students' abilities in practice, such as planning, structural analysis, detail drawing, shop drawing, electrical and mechanical system, materials experiments, tectonic construction, green building evaluation, CFD simulation, construction management, regulatory review, BIM modeling, competition reports, design methodology, parametric algorithms, animation, rendering and so on.

syllabi.outline:
本課程採用分組教學，以1：5的師生比例就教師之專長指導學生在建築實務工作之各領域進行資料搜集，現場觀摩，對特定之課題提出報告，訓練學生深入的接觸並膫解實際的工作，以培養學生發掘問題，解決問題之執業能力。課程中間之暑假學生必須至事務所或工地現場實習，成果列為成績之一部分。
課程概要：
1 範  疇：建築或景觀之設計理論與實務，同學或可以從哲學、美學、歷史、 社會與文化、生活現象為出發，或藝術如電影、文學、繪畫等媒材與建築空間之類比或隱喻關係。然而，真正的題材存在於極細微且具體的事物（一個人、一個動作、一首歌、一部電影、一件作品、一本書、一幅畫、家（或辦公）中的一方場所、某一個瞬間、某一群人、某一個地方、或某一個念頭….等等）開始。
2 目  的：如漢寶德所說：大學教育在於使成理性的過程，做一個會思考、有想法、具備論述能力的人。
3 方  法：發掘問題、探索、推演邏輯與判斷、歸結，是一種思維與邏輯訓練。
4 知識論建立：文本閱讀、解讀與內（深）化。
5 個人洞察與論述

syllabi.outline:
實務專題課程為建築專題設計（畢業設計）的輔助課程，分二學期：第一學期為前置課程，主要訓練學生具備獨立思考和建立自主觀點的能力，依教師專長指導學生探討和發展設計議題、收集相關資料和進行案例分析、自訂設計方法與流程、並提出畢業設計的研究方向；第二學期旨在加強學生在建築實務工作各領域的能力，結合設計課程的操作，對特定之實務課題（例如：空間計畫、結構分析、細部設計與大樣圖模、施工圖、機電配置、材料實驗、構築實作、綠建築檢討、CFD模擬、施工管理、法規檢討、BIM模型、競圖報告書、設計方法論、參數演算、動畫製作、專業rendering等項目）進行深入探討並提出專題報告。
The course works together with Special Topics on Architectural Design (Thesis Design) in two semesters. The first semester is preparatory course which trains students to think independently and establish independent perspective. Teachers of different fields guide students to explore design issues, collect data, have case study, develop design methodology, and propose future direction for thesis design . The second semester aims to enhance students' abilities in practice, such as planning, structural analysis, detail drawing, shop drawing, electrical and mechanical system, materials experiments, tectonic construction, green building evaluation, CFD simulation, construction management, regulatory review, BIM modeling, competition reports, design methodology, parametric algorithms, animation, rendering and so on.

syllabi.outline:
實務專題課程為建築專題設計（畢業設計）的輔助課程，分二學期：第一學期為前置課程，主要訓練學生具備獨立思考和建立自主觀點的能力，依教師專長指導學生探討和發展設計議題、收集相關資料和進行案例分析、自訂設計方法與流程、並提出畢業設計的研究方向；第二學期旨在加強學生在建築實務工作各領域的能力，結合設計課程的操作，對特定之實務課題（例如：空間計畫、結構分析、細部設計與大樣圖模、施工圖、機電配置、材料實驗、構築實作、綠建築檢討、CFD模擬、施工管理、法規檢討、BIM模型、競圖報告書、設計方法論、參數演算、動畫製作、專業rendering等項目）進行深入探討並提出專題報告。
The course works together with Special Topics on Architectural Design (Thesis Design) in two semesters. The first semester is preparatory course which trains students to think independently and establish independent perspective. Teachers of different fields guide students to explore design issues, collect data, have case study, develop design methodology, and propose future direction for thesis design . The second semester aims to enhance students' abilities in practice, such as planning, structural analysis, detail drawing, shop drawing, electrical and mechanical system, materials experiments, tectonic construction, green building evaluation, CFD simulation, construction management, regulatory review, BIM modeling, competition reports, design methodology, parametric algorithms, animation, rendering and so on.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要以對於當代建築具有啟發性和創新性的經典著作 (包括建築理論、文學、電影、哲學) 為範圍，透過修課者的精讀、研討交流、對話，以窺探形塑當代建築的重要觀念與內涵，並結合與之相對應的建築作品進行作品的閱讀與詮釋。

本課程希望修課者以研究者、創作者和建築學者的三種身份，從(形而下)到非物質面(形而上)的互文關係，且具有相互指涉互為一體的角度來理解、洞察和探索建築，培養建築學上的抽象性思考和創作觀點，並藉此建構建築視野的哲思；另一方面，做為創作型論文的設計方法論的基礎養成。

課程以非授課形式進行，修課者每周進行指定、和延伸性閱讀，於上課時間進行閱讀報告與心得之討論，授課老師進行導讀，並就討論內容提出分析比較與歸納。

透過整學期指定的多重文本閱讀，以具有個人意識的主題進行交叉比較和探討，期望修課者最終能建立個人思辯和申論式的建築書寫。

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

syllabi.assessment:
1.	Attendance 20%
2.	Participation 30%
Each participant needs to prepare a brief introduction to the (non-architectural) social background of one cultural period of time. This will be the tuned in of the class of the day for 20 minutes.
(Week 02) Dutch and Spanish Empires in the 17th Century (relationship with the world)	(Week 02) 17th. C. to 19th. C. China (relationship with the rest of the world)
(Week 04) Japan before 1895 (westernization)	(Week 05) Japanese colonial power in Taiwan and China 
(Week 10) social background in the first half of the 20th-century China	(Week 11) ideology of Chinese origin before and after 1945 (1940s to 1960s in Taiwan)
(Week 12) global modernist architecture esp. after WWII 	(Week 13) Japanese architecture after WWII
(Week 14) global trends of architectural regionalism 	(Week 15) from postmodern architecture to Deconstructivism in the world
3.	Mid-term presentation: proposal for the final report 20%
In the first half of the courses, students have to outline their interests of Taiwanese architecture in specific approaches. They might be architectural styles (ex., Regionalism, modernism, etc.), structural systems, materials (ex., Brick, RC, etc.), particular types of architecture, one or two individual architects, etc. Students should present their plans for their final reports in the mid-term class for about 10 minutes in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and the class instructor for further development to achieve the final report.
4.	Research thesis 30%
One should present his/her research in 10 minutes on 12/24, and submit the thesis by 12/31 12:00 pm to Dr. Wu. The thesis should not be less than 5000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) with clear references of the contents instead of brief presentation format (powerpoint). The final report should present the development and influences from the past to the present (or particular period).

主題：AI 協同延伸議題探索及數據模擬驗證

學習目標： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，運用 AI 工具輔助延伸議題探索及編寫計算程式，完成指定主題之數值計算或系統模擬，並進行物理量/邏輯合理性驗證。

1. 主題選定與 AI 提問設計： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，利用 AI（如 ChatGPT、Claude 、Gemini等）進行延伸議題探索，並構思程式架構。

2. AI 輔助程式撰寫： 指導 AI 產出 Python計算程式（如冷庫負荷、冷媒循環、熱交換器等）。

3. 成果驗證與除錯（Sanity Check & Debugging）： 學生須以課堂所學之基礎理論（如手算基準值、極限條件測試、物理合理性界限）檢核 AI 產出之程式碼與計算結果，並記錄 AI 出錯與修正過程。

● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用(AI-assisted learning and tool application)
extra.內容:
主題：AI 協同延伸議題探索及數據模擬驗證

學習目標： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，運用 AI 工具輔助延伸議題探索及編寫計算程式，完成指定主題之數值計算或系統模擬，並進行物理量/邏輯合理性驗證。

1. 主題選定與 AI 提問設計： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，利用 AI（如 ChatGPT、Claude 、Gemini等）進行延伸議題探索，並構思程式架構。

2. AI 輔助程式撰寫： 指導 AI 產出 Python計算程式（如冷庫負荷、冷媒循環、熱交換器等）。

3. 成果驗證與除錯（Sanity Check & Debugging）： 學生須以課堂所學之基礎理論（如手算基準值、極限條件測試、物理合理性界限）檢核 AI 產出之程式碼與計算結果，並記錄 AI 出錯與修正過程。
extra.學習成果:
在繳交報告時，必須包含以下 5 個核心章節：

1. 問題定義與理論基礎： 說明選擇前 16 週何種概念，以AI進行延伸議題探索及其欲透過程式解決的具體問題。

2. AI 提示工程與程式碼架構： 展現如何下達 Prompt 讓 AI 寫出程式，以及程式的核心演算邏輯。

3. 驗證與除錯紀錄（最重要）：

(1) 基準驗證： 用手算、經典公式或既有文獻數據與程式輸出進行對比。

(2) AI 除錯紀錄： 列出 AI 寫出的 Code 在哪裡出現邏輯漏洞，自己是如何發現並更正的。

4. 分析結果與延伸討論： 呈現程式產出的圖表（如動態趨勢圖、參數敏感度分析），並說明其工程/學理意義。

5. 錄製 3–5 分鐘程式執行與驗證影片： 展示程式運作、關鍵參數修改及結果圖表繪製過程。

description.zh: 本課程著重冷凍系統和空調系統能源的分析，探討構成系統的主要元件－壓縮機、蒸發器和冷凝器的耗能，和各泵、冰水盤管、空調箱及風／水管路系統的能源耗損，進而對整個系統運轉時的效率予以檢討。最後提出各種改善方法，節約能源和減少電力契約容量的技術，以使學生具有節能省電的正確理論觀念和實務技術。
description.en:
This lesson is focused on the energy analyses of refrigeration systems and air-conditioning systems. The operating defects of compressors, evaporators and
condensers are to be investigated. Also the energy consumption's of pumps, fan coils air-handling units and duct/water systems are studied. The over all performance of the entire system is thus discussed. Several methods to improve the shortages and the techniques to energy conservation and electricity demand cut-down will be proposed.
The students should understand correctly the theory of energy conservation and the
technology to improve the systems.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

description.zh: 學生需於第三學年第二學期開始修習「英文實務專題」，於第四學年第一學期期末正式發表成果。本課程旨在發展學生獨立規劃及從事研究的能力，學生可在指導老師的指導下，依個別的需求選擇研究的方向，訂定題目，並獨立完成研究計畫，撰寫報告。 專題研究範圍含： 實驗研究 量調查研究或質調查研究 個案研究 回溯研究 文化比較研究 理論闡述研究
description.en: This course is designed to develop the student's background for planning and conducting research independently. The nature of the project conducted will vary from student to student, but regardless of the genre of the project, it must result in a written research report. The research project must be conducted by the student individually. It is anticipated that the project will result from: an experiment; a descriptive study using quantitative procedures or qualitative procedures; a case study; a historical study; a cross-cultural study; a theory that offers an alternative interpretation to a current theory or model.

description.zh: 本課程旨在訓練學生認識中英影視翻譯實務，著重於介紹電影與電視影集字幕翻譯及電子媒體新聞翻譯。學生除了學習字幕翻譯之斷句、上字幕策略及對話字幕同步特性之外，並認識電子媒體新聞翻譯之產製過程牽涉之新聞準則與翻譯規範。學生了解影視翻譯與其他類型翻譯活動之異同，進而學習如何有效產製符合影視媒體規範的翻譯版本，並透過習作演練與實務接軌。
description.en: This course explores translation of audiovisual content with a special emphasis on movies, TV series and broadcast news media. In addition to subtitling skills and strategies, including segmentation, spotting and subtitle-speech synchronization, students are introduced to journalistic and translational norms in the newsroom. Students learn to identify differences and connections between audiovisual translation and other types of translation and produce consistently and efficiently translated versions fit to screen and broadcast.

description.zh: 本課程延續「中英口譯入門」之內容，引導學生學習中英雙向之商務口譯技巧並認識商務口譯之場域特性與本質。學生持續演練逐步口譯筆記，強化習得之技巧。課程重點在熟練如何在高度時間壓力下，即刻聚焦演說片段的主旨，並透過筆記重啟被動記憶。學生也將進一步認識商務同步口譯技巧,透過本課程，認識商務口譯的認知面向與非語言變數。
description.en: This course builds on Introduction to Chinese-English Interpreting and equips students with skills in business interpreting in both directions. Students continue with practical exercises aimed at reinforcing note-taking skills. The nature and characteristics of business interpreting are introduced. More emphasis is placed upon learning to zero in on the main idea under heavy time pressure and re-activate passive memories with the aid of note-taking. Students also learn essential SI strategies. The course seeks to acquaint students with the cognitive dimensions and extra-linguistic variables with regard to business interpreting.

description.zh: 本課程延續「中英口譯入門」之內容，學生演練雙向語言之積極聆聽、重述、記憶保留、摘要及逐步口譯筆記，強化之前習得之技巧。擴大譯出語演說之議題深度與廣度，口譯片段加長，學生能持續加強分析與歸納綜合訊息的能力。學生進一步認識基礎專業同步口譯，回溯之前習得的口譯技巧，熟悉同步口譯的基本要素，包括重述、專注力分割、一心多用、聽譯時間差、預測及重組等。
description.en: Based on Introduction to Chinese-English Interpreting, students continue with practical exercises aimed at reinforcing skills in active listening, recall and memory retention, gist extraction and note-taking in both directions. Increasing lengths and difficulties of speeches of diverse topics also enables students to strengthen and apply more advanced analytical and synthetic skills. Students continue to brush up on skills obtained previously and learn essential SI strategies, including paraphrasing or re-oralizing, split attention, multitasking, the time lag between interpreter and speaker, anticipation and reformulation.

syllabi.outline:
PLEASE NOTE THAT THE WORKING LANGUAGES OF THIS INTERPRETING TRAINING COURSE ARE ENGLISH AND CHINESE.

本課程延續「中英口譯入門」之內容，上半段學生演練進外語之積極聆聽、記憶保留、摘要及逐步口譯筆記，強化之前習得之技巧。擴大譯出語演說之議題深度與廣度，口譯片段加長，學生能持續加強分析與歸納綜合訊息的能力。下半場學生進一步認識基礎專業同步口譯，回溯之前習得的口譯技巧，熟悉英進中同步口譯的基本要素，包括重述、專注力分割、一心多用、聽譯時間差、預測及重組等。
Based on Introduction to Chinese-English Interpreting, in the first half of the semester, students continue with practical exercises aimed at reinforcing skills in active listening, recall and memory retention, gist extraction and note-taking into their foreign language. Increasing lengths and difficulties of speeches of diverse topics also enables students to strengthen and apply more advanced analytical and synthetic skills. Students continue to brush up on skills obtained previously and in the second half, learn essential SI strategies, including paraphrasing or re-oralizing, split attention, multitasking, the time lag between interpreter and speaker, anticipation and reformulation.

description.zh: 本課程介紹以ARM CPU為核心之嵌入式系統。內容包含：ARM CPU介紹，ARM CPU指令集，ARM 之C 語言工具，ARM 發展環境，Evaluation board 之介紹，Emulator之介紹，ARM 之C 語言程式撰寫及偵錯，Linux核心之介紹，應用Linux為核心之作業系統於ARM之Evaluation board，Linux驅動程式之撰寫及安裝，應用實例之介紹，及期末專題。
description.en: This course covers the following topics: introduction to ARM CPU, instruction set of ARM CPU, C complier of ARM CPU, debugging tools for ARM CPU, functions of the evaluation board, usage of emulator, writing and running C language in the evaluation board, introduction to Linux kernel, porting Linux kernel to the evaluation board, writing and installing the Linux device drivers, examples of applications, and term project.

syllabi.outline:
An embedded system is a computing system designed for a specific function or set of tasks and integrated into a device or product. 
1. Design and implement a basic communication protocol (packet format, length, checksums, error handling, and retransmission strategy).
2. Use an RTOS (such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr) to establish multitasking, synchronization (Semaphore, Queue, Mutex), and time management.
3. Create a userspace program + systemd service + simple network communication (Socket, MQTT, HTTP) on an Embedded Linux platform.
4. Write modular firmware/system services on an MCU or Linux platform, implementing GPIO, timers, UART, I2C, SPI, ADC, and PWM.

description.zh: 網路搜尋已經成為最受歡迎的應用之一. 資訊檢索主要在探討如何有效的在大量文字及多媒體文件中搜尋使用者想要的資訊. 本課程將介紹資訊檢索的基本觀念, 檢索模型, 文字資訊檢索, 檢索結果評估, 索引與搜尋, 以及其他多媒體檢索相關應用
description.en:
With the expansion of the World Wide Web (WWW), Web search has become one of the most popular applications. Information retrieval (IR) is a research field that targets at effectively and efficiently searching information in huge amounts of text and multimedia documents. In this course, we will introduce the basic models, text IR, retrieval evaluation, indexing and searching, and applications for IR.
Outline:
1. Overview of Information Retrieval
2. Modeling
3. Retrieval Evaluation
4. Text IR
5. Query Languages and Operations
6. Indexing and Searching
7. Applications for IR
8. Web Search

syllabi.outline: Web search engine has become one of the necessary tools in modern lives. This course aims at investigating how to index large amount of text documents and search what users need in an effective way. We will introduce the basic concepts of information retrieval, characteristics of documents and languages, various retrieval models, evaluation of retrieval results, indexing and searching, text classification, text clustering, and Web search. In addition to texts, we will also introduce some applications of multimedia retrieval.

description.zh: 本課程旨在希望學生透過畢業製作來增進研究能力、問題解決能力和創新的能力。透過學生自主選擇專題，探究感興趣的問題，接著進行系統性研究，最終以畢業展的形式來呈現其研究成果與創作。學習的歷程會從專題選擇開始，學生自主選擇專題，確定研究方向和問題，然後再去找合適的指導老師。指導老師會協助學生寫研究計劃，包括研究目的、問題、方法、資料收集和分析等。最後再將研究主題以實務創作的方式展現出來。如是轉譯的過程，學生可以學習到獨立思考和解決問題的能力、系統性研究和資料分析的能力、撰寫專題文本的組織能力以及創新和跨領域實作的能力。
description.en: The aim of this course is to enhance students' research, problem-solving, and innovative abilities through their graduation project. By independently choosing a topic of interest and conducting systematic research, students will ultimately present their research findings and creations in the form of a graduation exhibition. The learning process begins with the selection of a topic, where students independently choose a topic, determine the research direction and problem, and then seek an appropriate supervisor. The supervisor will assist students in writing a research plan, including research objectives, questions, methods, data collection, and analysis. Finally, the research topic will be presented through practical creations. Through this process, students will learn independent thinking and problem-solving skills, systematic research and data analysis abilities, organizational skills for writing the project text, as well as innovative and interdisciplinary practical abilities.

description.zh: 公共藝術涉題人文、藝術、空間、社會、設計等領域，本課程藉由介紹台灣及世界各地之公共藝術發展，推廣公共藝術的整體概念，使學子了解公共藝術的重要性，也藉此培養學生的專業知能、人文素養及藝術鑑賞能力。
description.en: The public art involves the humanities, arts, spatial, social, and design fields, this course introduces the development of the public art in Taiwan and the world to promote the whole concept of public art, so that students can understand the importance of the public art, but also to take this training the student's professional knowledge, humanities, and arts appreciation.

name.zh: 網路系統程式開發與安全

description.zh: 隨著金融交易、機器人應用等網路應用快速成長，系統需同時具備高擴展性、可靠性與安全性。為因應此趨勢，本課程培養學生具備從應用層到作業系統核心的程式開發實力，並強調 TCP/IP 通訊與系統架構整合。
description.en: With the rapid growth of internet services—such as financial transactions and robotic applications—modern systems must be scalable, reliable, and secure. This course addresses these needs by training students in programming skills from the application layer to the OS kernel, emphasizing TCP/IP networking and system architecture.

syllabi.outline:
隨著金融交易、機器人應用等網路應用快速成長，系統需同時具備高擴展性、可靠性與安全性。為因應此趨勢，本課程培養學生具備從應用層到作業系統核心的程式開發實力，並強調 TCP/IP 通訊與系統架構整合。同時在專案也將進行機器人作業系統開發的探討。
With the rapid growth of internet services—such as financial transactions and robotic applications—modern systems must be scalable, reliable, and secure. This course addresses these needs by training students in programming skills from the application layer to the OS kernel, emphasizing TCP/IP networking and system architecture. ROS2 (Robotic Operating System) will also be discussed for project-based learning.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester, Senior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit.  For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一媒體設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
description.en: Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

extra.彈性學習(17-18週):
本學期課為畢業製作的主要階段，除了延續上一學期對於專題中技術原型的掌控與內容拓展，最重要的也需回顧專題製作的養成之路中，各個階段的關鍵蛻變，檢視那些應已內化的創作技能與觀念，對於每一個創造的當下，明瞭所追求與獲得的價值所在。 
介入直覺與擴張循環–直接有效的互動、影響與循環 (有效操弄) 
模組的輕盈與延展–組件化、易更替性、延伸擴展性、多樣化的生產工法 
期末將以實體作品展演形式，創作型態不限於藝術、運用、與體驗，概念上之原型假設透過下列手法示範。 

1. 設計互動─ 規劃流暢操作與吸引人的體驗性。 
2. 限縮技術─ 確定運用技術之掌控性，並掌握其對承載內容所影響之核心要素。 
3. 擴展議題─ 例舉各種所傳達代表主體下，強調運用面與內容搭配的變化。 

學習過程將鍛鍊如何駕馭特定經轉化之模擬手法，加強相關研究與探索能力，以擴展其內容之契合度，進而完備其技術特性與傳達內容的整合性。
extra.類別:
● 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)

extra.學習成果: 配合期末展覽，以每四至六人為一共同創作組，作品之完整度及展示性將為製作重點，以四次的展覽體驗模式實施。命題方式是以朔源與重整概念的方式，使創作邏輯能站在形式對內容之交互關係出發，並作出以輕巧的互動機制，卻具影響效力於不同關注面向或議題的創作，讓學員探究能影響所關心面向的根本要素，使創作的影響力能從掌握主要因子展開。

syllabi.outline:
本學期課為畢業製作的主要階段，除了延續上一學期對於專題中技術原型的掌控與內容拓展，最重要的也需回顧專題製作的養成之路中，各個階段的關鍵蛻變，檢視那些應已內化的創作技能與觀念，對於每一個創造的當下，明瞭所追求與獲得的價值所在。 
介期末將以實體作品展演形式，創作型態不限於藝術、運用、與體驗，概念上之原型假設透過下列手法示範。 

1. 設計互動─ 規劃流暢操作與吸引人的體驗性。 
2. 限縮技術─ 確定運用技術之掌控性，並掌握其對承載內容所影響之核心要素。 
3. 擴展議題─ 例舉各種所傳達代表主體下，強調運用面與內容搭配的變化。 

學習過程將鍛鍊如何駕馭特定經轉化之模擬手法，加強相關研究與探索能力，以擴展其內容之契合度，進而完備其技術特性與傳達內容的整合性。可先請各指導老師安排組員能力的規畫，以達成創作能量的最佳化。 

明確的創作發展由各組與指導老師依各人專長領域自行訂定。配合期末展覽，以每四至六人為一共同創作組，作品之完整度及展示性將為製作重點，以四次的展覽體驗模式實施。命題方式是以朔源與重整概念的方式，使創作邏輯能站在形式對內容之交互關係出發，並作出以輕巧的互動機制，卻具影響效力於不同關注面向或議題的創作，讓學員探究能影響所關心面向的根本要素，使創作的影響力能從掌握主要因子展開。整個課程的施做分為四個階段展示: 進階規劃展示-重新思考核心技術的掌控度，分析其內容之契合度與其運用層面變數；進度展示一 -技術本質之聚焦與強化，凸顯其互動設計及搭配相應內容之動態運行方式；實作進度二- 針對互動流暢性及完整度講評；創作成果驗收總評。  
 題旨] 每個當下的清晰 

創作過程可長可短，對於互動性為主要體驗方式的數位型態創作，其生產過程更加強調能承先啟後的關鍵性進展：技術手法→內容變數→新認知→再次定義手法，所造成高度可能性的創造潛力循環。所以一件作品從一開始的發想，到嘗試與創造過程，而後達到最終理想型態，甚至之後的延伸運用或進化，在創作的核心思想上，應不斷重新檢視每個關鍵轉捩點所掌握的核心樞紐。 

在過去三年的專題製作養成路上，同學們已經歷過每學期需習得的重點觀念與技能。每個主旨要點所包含的技巧與內涵，都為現在畢製重要階段可運用的利器。於創作階段的各個重要當下，保持清晰思緒邏輯，1~2二年級著重數位創造觀念的建立，3年級著重互動形式與工法的運用。在這學期創作的主要發展進程中，創作團隊可於每個推進完整度的當下，運用這些關鍵概念為指標，持續檢視作品能否有不斷進化的核心優勢。

description.zh: 本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一視覺傳達設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
description.en: Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of visual communication design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

syllabi.outline:
本學期課為畢業製作的主要階段，除了延續上一學期對於專題中技術原型的掌控與內容拓展，最重要的也需回顧專題製作的養成之路中，各個階段的關鍵蛻變，檢視那些應已內化的創作技能與觀念，對於每一個創造的當下，明瞭所追求與獲得的價值所在。 
介期末將以實體作品展演形式，創作型態不限於藝術、運用、與體驗，概念上之原型假設透過下列手法示範。 

1. 設計互動─ 規劃流暢操作與吸引人的體驗性。 
2. 限縮技術─ 確定運用技術之掌控性，並掌握其對承載內容所影響之核心要素。 
3. 擴展議題─ 例舉各種所傳達代表主體下，強調運用面與內容搭配的變化。 

學習過程將鍛鍊如何駕馭特定經轉化之模擬手法，加強相關研究與探索能力，以擴展其內容之契合度，進而完備其技術特性與傳達內容的整合性。可先請各指導老師安排組員能力的規畫，以達成創作能量的最佳化。 

明確的創作發展由各組與指導老師依各人專長領域自行訂定。配合期末展覽，以每四至六人為一共同創作組，作品之完整度及展示性將為製作重點，以四次的展覽體驗模式實施。命題方式是以朔源與重整概念的方式，使創作邏輯能站在形式對內容之交互關係出發，並作出以輕巧的互動機制，卻具影響效力於不同關注面向或議題的創作，讓學員探究能影響所關心面向的根本要素，使創作的影響力能從掌握主要因子展開。整個課程的施做分為四個階段展示: 進階規劃展示-重新思考核心技術的掌控度，分析其內容之契合度與其運用層面變數；進度展示一 -技術本質之聚焦與強化，凸顯其互動設計及搭配相應內容之動態運行方式；實作進度二- 針對互動流暢性及完整度講評；創作成果驗收總評。  
 題旨] 每個當下的清晰 

創作過程可長可短，對於互動性為主要體驗方式的數位型態創作，其生產過程更加強調能承先啟後的關鍵性進展：技術手法→內容變數→新認知→再次定義手法，所造成高度可能性的創造潛力循環。所以一件作品從一開始的發想，到嘗試與創造過程，而後達到最終理想型態，甚至之後的延伸運用或進化，在創作的核心思想上，應不斷重新檢視每個關鍵轉捩點所掌握的核心樞紐。 

在過去三年的專題製作養成路上，同學們已經歷過每學期需習得的重點觀念與技能。每個主旨要點所包含的技巧與內涵，都為現在畢製重要階段可運用的利器。於創作階段的各個重要當下，保持清晰思緒邏輯，1~2二年級著重數位創造觀念的建立，3年級著重互動形式與工法的運用。在這學期創作的主要發展進程中，創作團隊可於每個推進完整度的當下，運用這些關鍵概念為指標，持續檢視作品能否有不斷進化的核心優勢。

syllabi.outline:
This course helps senior students in the Department of Interaction Design organize and present their previous design projects into a professional portfolio. The course covers project selection, design storytelling, process documentation, visual layout, personal branding, résumé preparation, self-introduction, online portfolio development, and final portfolio presentation.

Through lectures, case studies, group discussions, individual critiques, and staged presentations, students will develop a portfolio suitable for job applications, internships, graduate school applications, or freelance opportunities. Special emphasis will be placed on clearly communicating problem definition, user research, design process, interaction logic, prototyping, testing, and final outcomes.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

4. Students will cultivate sportsmanship, teamwork, and fair play.

description.zh: 本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
description.en: Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to train students to independently plan, analyze, evaluate, summarize, and think creatively through the use of project design. Through an in-depth exploration of life styles, current trends, and technological developments, students will practice the process of project design and become familiar with the knowledge and techniques of integrating design and technology. In this program, students work in groups to complete an integrated media design theme, and finally present their work in both on-campus and off-campus public exhibitions.

syllabi.outline:
This course helps senior students in the Department of Interaction Design organize and present their previous design projects into a professional portfolio. The course covers project selection, design storytelling, process documentation, visual layout, personal branding, résumé preparation, self-introduction, online portfolio development, and final portfolio presentation.

Through lectures, case studies, group discussions, individual critiques, and staged presentations, students will develop a portfolio suitable for job applications, internships, graduate school applications, or freelance opportunities. Special emphasis will be placed on clearly communicating problem definition, user research, design process, interaction logic, prototyping, testing, and final outcomes.

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

syllabi.outline:
本課程專為大專生設計，採「模組化技術教學」與「數位遠距延伸學習」雙軌並行。課程涵蓋籃球、排球、撞球及羽球四大經典球類，旨在引導學生從基本動作、規則理解至實戰抗衡，全面建立多元運動能力；並於遠距週導入運動傷害防護與線上規則評量，培養具備健康安全意識的終身運動者。

技能發展 (Psychomotor)： 掌握四大球類（籃球、排球、撞球、羽球）之核心基本技術與動作機制。

規則與戰術 (Cognitive)： 精確理解各項球類賽事規則、裁判法及戰術佈署，並具備運動傷害急救（PRICE/POLICE）觀念。

體能與防護 (Health & Safety)： 透過多樣化球類運動提升敏捷、協調與心肺適能，並建立運動安全與自我防護能力。

情意與素養 (Affective)： 培養團隊合作溝通、運動家精神，以及自主運用數位平台（Zuvio）進行終身學習之素養。
syllabi.assessment:
1. 出席與課堂表現 (40%) —— 實體課堂
出缺席紀錄 (20%)： 依據每週實體課堂簽到紀錄評分。

課堂態度與規範 (20%)： 包含運動服裝規範、學習參與態度、團隊合作精神，以及器材搬運與場地維護之主動性。

2. 術科測驗 (40%) —— 實體課堂
期中術科檢定 (20%)： 籃球（左右手運球上籃/定點投籃）、排球（低手/高手傳球）動作規範與控球表現。

期末術科檢定 (20%)： 撞球（基本架桿與直線擊球測試）、羽球（長球/發球精準度及步法）技術實實檢定。

3. 運動傷害防護認識 (10%) —— 第 17 週遠距學習
評分方式： 於 Zuvio 數位平台完成「運動傷害防護與急救處置（PRICE/POLICE 原則）」數位教材觀看，並完成線上隨堂觀念檢測或案例討論。

4. 期末線上學科測驗與課程總結 (10%) —— 第 18 週遠距學習
評分方式： 登入 Zuvio 平台完成四大球類（籃球、排球、撞球、羽球）比賽規則、裁判法及運動防護之綜合線上筆試，並提交課程學習總結。

description.zh: 「藝術生活」課程透過「藝術涵養與美感素養」的核心內涵，以「探索與表現」、「審美與溝通」、「實踐與應用」作為課程目標的主軸，發展課程內容包含基礎課程、環境藝術、應用藝術、音像藝術與表演藝術，內容須兼及社會文化發展的時代特質與相關議題，課程組織方面，強調以藝術與美感基礎漸序發展邏輯思維、美學涵養與創造力。
description.en: Applied Arts should be planned according to the disciplines' core ideal; through "art and aesthetic attainment" as the core concern to set up "exploration and expression," "aesthetic and communication," "practice and application" as the goals, curriculum development should include modeling principle, environmental art, applied arts, audiovisual art and performance art. In terms of curriculum organization, the content should be emphasized on logical thinking, aesthetic sense, and creativity developmentally.

3. 發現生活中的藝術之美

description.zh: 本課程適用於P-TECH學校。透過多元化的課程設計，透過教學培養學生職場中所需具備的技能及軟實力，為將來進入職場提前做好準備。其課程涵蓋七大主題：協同合作(collaboration)、溝通技巧(communication)、分析式思維(analytical thinking)、自我管理能力(self-management)、激勵(motivation)、領導力(leadership)、專責(responsibility)、好奇心(curiosity)等課程，並搭配企業參訪(worksite visits)、實習課程及企業導師等安排，培養具備職場技能及競爭力的學生。
description.en: The primary focus of Workplace Learning Curriculum is to provide students with introductory units on communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, leadership and responsibility, self-management, curiosity and motivation. The 7 skills are a framework for talking about professional skills within the P-TECH model. We are calling out these skills for the IBM P-TECH schools in hopes that our students will begin to develop fluency in discussing them, which will be highly valuable in distinguishing their readiness for internships and?? jobs from their competition.

extra.學習成果:
專題製作：
1. 停車場車位計數器
假設停車場共有8個車位，入口與出口分別設置感測器。
基本功能包括：
車輛進入時，剩餘車位減1。
車輛離開時，剩餘車位加1。
車位為0時，亮起「滿位」指示燈。
車位不得小於0或大於最大容量。
使用七段顯示器顯示剩餘車位。
主要學習內容包括加減計數器、比較器、輸入控制、防止計數超出範圍及七段顯示器解碼。

2.智慧交通號誌
學生設計一組十字路口號誌，控制兩個方向的紅、黃、綠燈。基本功能可設定為：
東西向綠燈時，南北向為紅燈。
東西向綠燈結束後，切換為黃燈。
黃燈結束後，兩個方向短暫全紅。
接著切換為南北向綠燈。
系統依序循環。
可進一步加入：
行人按鈕。
夜間閃黃燈。
緊急車輛優先通行。
倒數顯示器。
主要學習內容包括有限狀態機、計數器、時脈、狀態轉移及模擬波形分析。

description.zh: 此課涵蓋計算機處理器之基本結構原理及設計，包括: 指令集、組合語言、算術單元、暫存器、中央處理器、記憶體管理、匯流排、輸入及輸出、速度與效能、多核心處理器等。透過此課程，學生可學習到計算機處理器原理、設計與基本架構。
description.en: This course covers the fundamental principles and design of computer processors, including instruction sets, assembly language, arithmetic units, registers, central processing units, memory management, buses, input and output, speed and performance, and multi-core processors. Through this course, students will learn the principles, design, and basic architecture of computer processors.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。介紹產品製造的程序和各種加工方法，及使用的機械設備、製造過程材料及製程參數的影響，製程規劃及製造成本的因素、產品檢驗量測技術及品質管制的方法、製程自動化及電腦整合製造系統等。
description.en: Introduction to a variety of manufacturing processes and associated production equipments, operations planning and cost estimating of the production process, techniques of measurements and basic components of a quality control  system, concepts of process automation and computer integrated manufacturing.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以日常生活產品為出發點，引導學生了解材料選擇、製造方法、產品開發流程與智慧製造技術。課程涵蓋塑膠成形、金屬加工、組裝技術、積層製造(3D列印)、智慧工廠與AI應用等主題。
學生將透過產品拆解分析、影片案例討論、AI工具實作與專題製作等方式，學習如何將創意轉化為可製造之產品，並理解未來製造產業的發展方向。
修習本課程後，學生應能：
知識面 (Knowledge)
1.	認識各類材料與製造技術之基本原理。 
2.	瞭解產品從設計到製造之完整流程。 
3.	認識傳統製造與積層製造(3D Printing)之差異。 
4.	瞭解智慧製造與工業4.0之發展趨勢。 
5.	瞭解AI在製造產業中的應用模式。 
技能面 (Skills)
1.	分析產品所使用之材料與製造方法。 
2.	評估不同製程之優缺點。 
3.	使用AI工具輔助資料蒐集與問題分析。 
4.	製作製造技術相關之簡報與短影音。 
5.	完成跨領域產品創新提案。
態度面 (Attitude)
1.	建立工程思維與問題解決能力。 
2.	培養跨領域合作能力。 
3.	建立終身學習與AI協作能力。 
4.	理解智慧製造與永續發展的重要性。

description.en: Introduction of Variational Calculus and its Application in the Engineering Optimal Design, Constrained/Unconstrained Optimal Design Problems, Discrete Optimal Control and Mathematical Programming, Practical Examples of Optimum Design.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在建立學生對於機械最佳化設計之基本概念，包含如何將設計問題的物理模型以數學模型形式建立目標函數，並依照給定限制條件求解目標函數之極值或最佳化值問題。課程內容共分為五個部分：(1) 最佳化設計中目標函數的數學分析基礎、(2) 常用之一維搜尋最佳化方法、(3) 無限制多維問題的最佳化方法、(4) 限制問題的最佳化方法、(5) 機械最佳化設計實例分析。
This course aims to establish the basic concept of mechanical optimization design for students, including how to establish the mathematical model of objective function from the physical model, and solve the problem by finding the extremum or the optimal value of the objective function according to the given constraints. The course content is divided into five parts: (1) Mathematical analysis basis of objective function in optimization design, (2) Commonly used one-dimensional optimization method, (3) Optimization method for unlimited multi-dimensional problem, (4) The optimization method of the restriction problem, (5) Example of the mechanical optimization design.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
第1週
09/09 課程內容簡介、設計變數
第2週
09/16 概述：目標函數、限制條件、最佳化設計的數學模型
第3週
09/23 最佳化設計中目標函數的數學分析基礎：泰勒表示式、函數梯度
第4週
09/30 最佳化設計中目標函數的數學分析基礎：函數方向導數的極值點存在條件、無限制目標函數的極值點存在條件
第5週
10/07 最佳化設計中目標函數的數學分析基礎：函數凸性、凸函數及凹函數之基本性質、目標函數的限制極值問題、Kuhn-Tucker條件
第6週
10/14 最佳化設計中目標函數的數學分析基礎：函數凸性、凸函數及凹函數之基本性質、目標函數的限制極值問題、Kuhn-Tucker條件
第7週
10/21 最佳化設計的數值計算方法-迭代法及其收斂性、搜尋區間確定、外推法、進退法、切線法
第8週
10/28 常用之一維搜尋最佳化方法： 序列消去原理、Fibonacci法與黃金分割法(0.618法)
第9週
11/04 期中考 Midterm examination
第10週
11/11 常用之一維搜尋最佳化方法：二次插值法、外推法、平分法、格點法
第11週
11/18 無限制多維問題的最佳化方法：座標輪換法、加速步長法、最速下降法、牛頓法、修正牛頓法
第12週
11/25 無限制多維問題的最佳化方法：共軛梯度法
第13週
12/02 無限制多維問題的最佳化方法：共軛梯度法
第14週
12/09 限制問題的最佳化方法：單純形法、變尺度法、隨機試驗法
第15週
12/16 限制問題的最佳化方法：隨機方向搜尋法、復合形法
第16週
12/23 限制問題的最佳化方法：線性逼近法、消元法
第17週
12/30 限制問題的最佳化方法：拉格朗日乘數法、懲罰函數法
第18週
01/06 期末考 Final examination

description.zh:
先修課程：數位電路與微處理器

工業自動化基本控制元件的設計觀念、使用方法與應用規劃；內容包含人機介面裝置(Human Machine Interface, HMI)、可程式邏輯控制器(Programmable Logic Controller, PLC)、交流伺服馬達(AC Servo Motor)的原理解說與應用設計實作課程。
description.en:
Pre-requisites：Digital Circuit, Microprocessor

The fundamental design concepts、operations and application development of industrial automation controllers are focused. Architectures and applications design of Human Machine Interface(HMI), Programmable Logic Controller(PLC) and AC Servo Motor are introduced. Hands-on work and exercises are included.

This course focuses on the fundamental theories and methods of statistical machine learning, covering supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and common probabilistic models to help students build a comprehensive foundation in machine learning. The course is divided into three parts:

Part 1: Introduction to Concepts and Supervised Learning

Part Two: Unsupervised Learning

Part Three: Summary of Machine Learning

description.zh: 培育離岸風電相關結構與材料專業人才為當前目標。本課程之主旨為建立離岸風電之結構與材料基礎知識及分析能力。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the foundations of offshore wind structure and material. The object is to provide a fundamental understanding upon offshore wind so that the students can quickly apply what they have learned to analyze structure and material problems. The course is particularly suitable for students who are interested in the subject of offshore wind mechanical knowledge.

description.zh: 本課程以“智能工業生產教學工廠”為學習場域，整間工廠完全由北科大跨系所老師帶領學生自行建置，產線包括加工區、精密量測區、線上品管區、組裝區、自動倉儲，從接受訂單到智能化排單、加工、量測、品管、組裝、倉儲，所有雲端伺服器與程式軟體完全由學生自行架設與撰寫，是一條完全無人化的關燈展示生產與教學工廠。上課方式是廠商針對智能工廠各個工作細節具體提出實務需求，再由上課老師帶學生助教以此些問題作為上課基礎，教導學生共同解決，學生以班級為單位進入工廠實作學習，課程由負責建置“智能工業生產教學工廠”的老師依其專長領域分工合作開課，依據老師負責建置的部分及其專長進行分工教學，學生分組由個別老師帶領指導，學生將可依序學到完整工廠技術，學期結束再由各專長老師依照學生分組指導學生進行專題報告，學生的專題報告將以個別老師專長協助解決的問題撰寫報告，這樣的設計可以讓學生深入了解與探討如何解決問題。
description.en: This course is based on the intelligent manufacturing system education factory. The intelligent factory is completely built by ourselves and is the only one self-built factory in Taiwanese universities. The intelligent manufacturing system has seven areas, central server, reception, automatic warehouse, manufacturing, measuring, on-line quality control, and assembly. In process, we receive the raw materials and scanned by QR code scanner. After scanned, the raw materials are transported to the warehouse and wait for producing order. If the producing order received, the raw materials will be sent through all seven machines, where a finished component will be manufactured. One component from that batch will be sent to the measuring area for complete quality control, and the remaining compone.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以“智能工業生產教學工廠”為學習場域，整間工廠完全由北科大跨系所老師帶領學生自行建置，產線包括加工區、精密量測區、線上品管區、組裝區、自動倉儲，從接受訂單到智能化排單、加工、量測、品管、組裝、倉儲，所有雲端伺服器與程式軟體完全由學生自行架設與撰寫，是一條完全無人化的關燈展示生產與教學工廠。上課方式是廠商針對智能工廠各個工作細節具體提出實務需求，再由上課老師帶學生助教以此些問題作為上課基礎，教導學生共同解決，學生以班級為單位進入工廠實作學習，課程由負責建置“智能工業生產教學工廠”的老師依其專長領域分工合作開課，依據老師負責建置的部分及其專長進行分工教學，學生分組由個別老師帶領指導，學生將可依序學到完整工廠技術，學期結束再由各專長老師依照學生分組指導學生進行專題報告，學生的專題報告將以個別老師專長協助解決的問題撰寫報告，這樣的設計可以讓學生深入了解與探討如何解決問題。
This course is based on the intelligent manufacturing system education factory. The intelligent factory is completely built by ourselves and is the only one self-built factory in Taiwanese universities. The intelligent manufacturing system has seven areas, central server, reception, automatic warehouse, manufacturing, measuring, on-line quality control, and assembly. In process, we receive the raw materials and scanned by QR code scanner. After scanned, the raw materials are transported to the warehouse and wait for producing order. If the producing order received, the raw materials will be sent through all seven machines, where a finished component will be manufactured. One component from that batch will be sent to the measuring area for complete quality control, and the remaining compone.

syllabi.outline:
本課程設計的是鏈結AOI與雷射加工產業，與智能廠接軌共同來解決產業實際應產業之問題與需求。設計課程分成三階段，分別為課程講授、業師實作討論、業師實務專題，三階段前後銜接，循序漸進課程讓學全接觸AOI與雷射加工技術。第一部分課程講授主要為基礎之理論傳授，訂立實驗目標、計畫實驗過程、課後評量，予以教學反饋；第二部分實作與討論，採讓學進雷射相關的實驗設計與操作，融會貫通所學理論，培育其實作技能，藉由組與業師討論，練習規劃實驗，實驗安排由簡入深，從認識機台種類系統之光路架設、最終參數的調整等，並藉由組討論記錄表，予以教學回饋；第三部分為企業命題之實務專題，請業師提供產業實務問題，並由產業負責專題內容，讓學了解前業界發展向、業界現況與製程瓶頸等，將理論課程更實務鏈結到雷射應，期末進實務成果發表展與評選，培育其解決實務問題之能。
The first part of the course, classroom instruction, primarily focuses on imparting foundational theory, setting experimental objectives, planning the experimental process, conducting post-assessments, and providing instructional feedback. The second part involves hands-on practical work and discussions. Students engage in experimental design and operations related to laser technology, integrating the theoretical knowledge acquired earlier. Through group discussions with industry experts, they learn to plan experiments, starting with understanding different types of machinery, optical path configurations, and parameter adjustments. Discussion records are used to provide instructional feedback. The third part consists of practical projects based on industry propositions. Industry experts present real-world industry problems, and students work on projects related to these topics. name.en: The theory and practice of 3D Printing

description.zh: 3D列印（英語：3D printing），又稱加法製造、積層製造（Additive Manufacturing，AM），可指任何列印三維物體的過程。3D列印主要是一個不斷添加的過程，在電腦控制下層疊原材料。3D列印的內容可以來源於三維模型或其他電子資料，其列印出的三維物體可以擁有任何形狀和幾何特徵。本課程將介紹其原理及配合實機操作，使學生能對3D列印技術有正確的認識。(本課程鼓勵學生參加經濟部iPas的3D列印工程師考試)
description.en: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing (AM), refers to processes used to create a three-dimensional object in which successive layers of material are formed under computer control to create an object. Objects can be of almost any shape or geometry and are produced using digital model data from a 3D model or another electronic data. This course will introduce the principle knowledge of 3D printing and giving the opportunity to practice the use of 3D Printing.

This course includes the principle of additive manufacturing process, classifications, process parameters, and the systems. The application of additive manufacturing will also introduce together with practice works. Two mini projects need to complete during this semester.

1. 應變計實驗: 應變計原理與實務，應變計應用於受力構件之應變量測。

Course Title:Microprocessor
Description:This course introduces the working principles of computer.
It puts emphasis on both hardware and software, as well as both theory
and appplication. Basically, this course covers the introduction of
general microprocessors:their architecture and operation, Assembly
language program and module program, instruction addressing mode,
instruction operation, and I/O Program and interface. More
specifically, multi-programming configuration and multi-processing
configuration are also discussed here. New topics will be added if
needed.

name.en: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Applications

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於人工智慧（AI）與物聯網（IoT）的整合應用，並以Arduino作為核心開發平台，培養學生在智慧物聯網（AIoT）領域的基礎應用觀念，重點包括嵌入式系統、AIoT 架構、即時數據處理、物聯網及資訊安全性。課程從Arduino硬體架構與感測器技術出發，介紹各類通訊介面（如Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、LoRa），學習如何進行資料收集、分析與遠端控制。同時，課程將涵蓋人工智慧基礎，並探討如何透過AI技術提升IoT設備的智能決策能力。學生將透過觀念理解、案例介紹與理論基礎，了解完整的AIoT開發流程。
description.en: This course focuses on the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT), with Arduino as the core development platform. It aims to equip students with fundamental knowledge in the field of Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT), covering key topics such as embedded systems, AIoT architecture, real-time data processing, IoT communication, and cybersecurity. The course begins with an introduction to Arduino hardware architecture and sensor technologies, followed by an exploration of various communication interfaces, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and LoRa. Students will learn how to collect, analyze, and remotely manage data. Additionally, the course covers the fundamentals of AI and examines how AI technologies can enhance the intelligent decision-making capabilities of IoT devices. Through conceptual understanding, case studies, and theoretical foundations, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the AIoT development process.

syllabi.outline:
隨著人工智慧、5G通訊網路與感測技術的迅速發展，智慧物聯網應用已成為現代產業關注的核心領域。這些技術正加速整合，廣泛應用於智慧家庭、智慧醫療、工業自動化、軌道(台鐵、高鐵、捷運)系統及環境監測等多個場域，推動系統朝向智慧化、自動化與自我調適的方向發展。本課程旨在培養學生具備人工智慧與物聯網的基礎知識與實作能力，並透過專題與實驗導向的學習模式，深入理解智慧系統、資料處理的核心技術。課程內容涵蓋物聯網架構、感測器整合、資料傳輸模組、場域應用(軌道機電整合、軌道系統應用)、等主題，學生將學習如何使用Arduino等嵌入式平台設計與建置實體系統。除了傳統人工智慧的應用外，本課程亦有生成式人工智慧的潛在應用。學生將了解大型語言模型或圖像生成模型，進行資料合成、異常偵測、自然語言介面設計、影像識別以及智慧決策支援…等簡介，拓展物聯網應用的智能層次。為使學生具備設計與實作智慧物聯網系統的能力，並能將生成式AI融入創新應用中，為未來跨領域的技術整合與產業發展打下堅實基礎。
With the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), 5G communication networks, and sensing technologies, smart Internet of Things (IoT) applications have become a key focus in modern industries. These technologies are increasingly being integrated and widely applied in areas such as smart homes, healthcare, industrial automation, railway systems (Taiwan Railways, High Speed Rail, MRT) and environmental monitoring, driving systems toward greater intelligence, automation, and adaptability. This course is designed to equip students with fundamental knowledge and practical skills in both AI and IoT, adopting a project-based and hands-on learning approach to help them gain a deep understanding of core technologies in intelligent systems and data analysis. Course topics include IoT architecture, sensor integration, data transmission modules and field applications (railway electromechanical integration, rail system applications). Students will learn how to design and build physical systems using embedded platforms such as Arduino. In addition to conventional AI applications, the course also explores the potential of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI). Students will be introduced to large language models and image generation models, and how they can be applied in data synthesis, anomaly detection, natural language interface design, image recognition and intelligent decision support, further enhancing the intelligence level of IoT applications. The ultimate goal of this course is to enable students to design and implement smart IoT systems and to integrate generative AI into innovative applications, laying a solid foundation for future interdisciplinary technology integration and industry development.

本課程介紹電力電子轉換器之基本原理、分析方法與應用。課程內容包含功率半導體元件、基本 DC-DC 轉換器、CCM/DCM 分析、損耗與效率估算、整流器與功率因數校正、隔離型轉換器、諧振式轉換器、逆變器，以及電力電子控制基礎。學生將學習以伏秒平衡、電荷平衡、元件應力分析與波形分析理解各類轉換器之工作原理，並建立電力電子系統設計與應用的基礎能力。

This course introduces the fundamental principles, analysis methods, and applications of power electronic converters. Topics include power semiconductor devices, basic DC-DC converters, CCM/DCM operation, loss and efficiency estimation, rectifiers and power factor correction, isolated converters, resonant converters, inverters, and basic control concepts for power electronics. Students will learn converter operation through volt-second balance, charge balance, device stress analysis, and waveform analysis, developing essential skills for power electronics system design and applications.
