name.zh: 智慧空間互動程式設計
name.en: Interaction design and programming in a smart space

description.zh: 互動智慧空間設計著重虛實整合，再加上智慧代理人觀念，結合使用者經驗，促使程式專業人員與互動設計師合作，來發展使用者與環境隨時互動之智慧介面。本課程結合電子、資工、互動領域，針對無人機(大疆/Parrot)、生成對抗網路、軟體開發應用(Open source SDK)、APP開發、介面設計、小型企業創新研發等主題，由學習者發想設計，並深入發展程式與開發實務。課程內含空間認知與視覺化、空間資訊與介面設計、機器學習、類神經網路、SCRUM、軟體開發測試。相關程式與應用包括JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.
description.en: This course is integrated with AR、VR、MR, smart agent concepts, and user experiences study.  The purpose is to incorporate programmer and designer in designing a mixed-reality space which is actually a physical space considered as a real-time interface to trig many human-environment interactions. Based on Electronic Engineering, Computer Science and Information Engineering, and Interaction Design, we set study topics as Drones (Dji /Parrot), gan, Open source SDK, APP development, interface design, small business innovation. Students are encouraged to create their own concepts then develop programming. Course contents included of spatial perception and information visualization, spatial information and interface, machine learning, neural network, Scrum, software development and testing. The program and application included of JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.

syllabi.outline:
This course integrates information visualization, interactive web programming, cloud databases, Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, smart floor sensing systems, Generative AI, and Agentic AI to develop students’ abilities in designing and implementing smart space interactive systems.
Using a project-based learning approach, students will begin with front-end web development and progressively learn JavaScript programming, Apache ECharts data visualization, Firebase cloud database integration, Arduino-based sensor data acquisition, and smart floor sensing system applications. The course further introduces Gemini API, Prompt Engineering, and Agentic AI technologies to develop Smart Space Agents capable of environmental sensing, contextual analysis, and autonomous decision-making.
The course emphasizes practical implementation and interdisciplinary integration across interaction design, information visualization, artificial intelligence, and smart space applications. Through hands-on projects, students will gain experience in developing intelligent interactive systems for smart space and smart healthcare environments.

extra.學習成果:
在繳交報告時，必須包含以下 5 個核心章節：

1. 問題定義與理論基礎： 說明選擇前 16 週何種概念，以AI進行延伸議題探索及其欲透過程式解決的具體問題。

2. AI 提示工程與程式碼架構： 展現如何下達 Prompt 讓 AI 寫出程式，以及程式的核心演算邏輯。

3. 驗證與除錯紀錄（最重要）：

(1) 基準驗證： 用手算、經典公式或既有文獻數據與程式輸出進行對比。

(2) AI 除錯紀錄： 列出 AI 寫出的 Code 在哪裡出現邏輯漏洞，自己是如何發現並更正的。

4. 分析結果與延伸討論： 呈現程式產出的圖表（如動態趨勢圖、參數敏感度分析），並說明其工程/學理意義。

5. 錄製 3–5 分鐘程式執行與驗證影片： 展示程式運作、關鍵參數修改及結果圖表繪製過程。

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

description.zh: 本課程設計予五專部工科學生，其目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。

The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

本課程專為大專生設計，採「模組化技術教學」與「數位遠距延伸學習」雙軌並行。課程涵蓋籃球、排球、撞球及羽球四大經典球類，旨在引導學生從基本動作、規則理解至實戰抗衡，全面建立多元運動能力；並於遠距週導入運動傷害防護與線上規則評量，培養具備健康安全意識的終身運動者。

技能發展 (Psychomotor)： 掌握四大球類（籃球、排球、撞球、羽球）之核心基本技術與動作機制。

規則與戰術 (Cognitive)： 精確理解各項球類賽事規則、裁判法及戰術佈署，並具備運動傷害急救（PRICE/POLICE）觀念。

體能與防護 (Health & Safety)： 透過多樣化球類運動提升敏捷、協調與心肺適能，並建立運動安全與自我防護能力。

情意與素養 (Affective)： 培養團隊合作溝通、運動家精神，以及自主運用數位平台（Zuvio）進行終身學習之素養。
syllabi.assessment:
1. 出席與課堂表現 (40%) —— 實體課堂
出缺席紀錄 (20%)： 依據每週實體課堂簽到紀錄評分。

課堂態度與規範 (20%)： 包含運動服裝規範、學習參與態度、團隊合作精神，以及器材搬運與場地維護之主動性。

2. 術科測驗 (40%) —— 實體課堂
期中術科檢定 (20%)： 籃球（左右手運球上籃/定點投籃）、排球（低手/高手傳球）動作規範與控球表現。

期末術科檢定 (20%)： 撞球（基本架桿與直線擊球測試）、羽球（長球/發球精準度及步法）技術實實檢定。

3. 運動傷害防護認識 (10%) —— 第 17 週遠距學習
評分方式： 於 Zuvio 數位平台完成「運動傷害防護與急救處置（PRICE/POLICE 原則）」數位教材觀看，並完成線上隨堂觀念檢測或案例討論。

4. 期末線上學科測驗與課程總結 (10%) —— 第 18 週遠距學習
評分方式： 登入 Zuvio 平台完成四大球類（籃球、排球、撞球、羽球）比賽規則、裁判法及運動防護之綜合線上筆試，並提交課程學習總結。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為五專部工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週4小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en:
The course is aimed directly at the five-year-degree-program students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to
emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester, and 4 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Series.

description.zh: 本課程適用於P-TECH學校。透過多元化的課程設計，透過教學培養學生職場中所需具備的技能及軟實力，為將來進入職場提前做好準備。其課程涵蓋七大主題：協同合作(collaboration)、溝通技巧(communication)、分析式思維(analytical thinking)、自我管理能力(self-management)、激勵(motivation)、領導力(leadership)、專責(responsibility)、好奇心(curiosity)等課程，並搭配企業參訪(worksite visits)、實習課程及企業導師等安排，培養具備職場技能及競爭力的學生。
description.en: The primary focus of Workplace Learning Curriculum is to provide students with introductory units on communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, leadership and responsibility, self-management, curiosity and motivation. The 7 skills are a framework for talking about professional skills within the P-TECH model. We are calling out these skills for the IBM P-TECH schools in hopes that our students will begin to develop fluency in discussing them, which will be highly valuable in distinguishing their readiness for internships and?? jobs from their competition.

description.zh: 本程式設計課程以C語言為基礎，先介紹程式設計的觀念與方法，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C++程式語言物件導向概念。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練以應付各類工程上之應用，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計專業之基礎。
description.en: To familiarize the student with basic computer programming concepts. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, as well as an introduction into the syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming language. An important objective of the course is to present effective methods of program design using modular construction and structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 先修課程：3001011或負責教授同意。介紹結構體在受到張力、壓力、剪力、扭力及彎曲等外力狀態下之變形，分析應力、應變及變形，莫耳圓、壓力容器、樑、柱。
description.en:
Prerequisite: ME111 or Consent of Instructor
Introduction of the deformation, strain and stress of structures (Beam, Column, Pressure vessel) under several different loading conditions such as Tension, Compression, Shear force, Torsion and Bending moment.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹材料力學之各主題：(1) 了解與分析可變形體力學；(2) 物體在受到軸力、扭矩、剪力、彎矩等受力狀態下之變形；(2) 分析各不同受力下結構之反應如:應力、應變、變形、位移、應變能、極限承載力；(3) 材料之應力與應變轉換方程式；(4) 利用莫耳圓計算主軸應力、主軸應變及其轉換；(5) 介紹柱、樑、及軸等結構之設計原理；(6) 鐵道系統中材料的應用與材料機械性質；(7) 導入鐵道系統案例(如長焊鋼軌內應力、橋軌互制應力、車輛與軌道變形等)

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。量測原理及訊號處理的一般方法（含放大電路、動態響應及頻譜分析），說明各種感測器之原理、規格、結構圖、應用的場合及其訊號處理（含速度、位移、加速度、力量、扭矩、功率、壓力、流量、溫度、化學組成、濕度、濃度、照度、電流、電壓、磁通量、磁場強度、各型感測開關等），感測器與電腦之連線。
description.en: Measurement Principles, General Methods for Signal Processing (Amplified Circuits, Dynamic Response, and Frequency spectrum Analysis), Discussion of Principle, Specification, Structure, Occasion and Location of Application of a Variety of Sensors for Measuring Physical Quantities,such as Displacement, Velocity, Acceleration, Force, Torque, Power,Pressure, Flow Rate, Temperature, Chemical Composition, Humidity,Density, Luminosity, Current, Voltage, Magnetic Flux, Magnetic Intensity , a Variety of Sensing Switch, etc.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

一 常微分方程式：一階，二階，及高階常微分方程，拉譜拉斯轉換

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在全面介紹網絡和分佈式計算技術。 與傳統課程不同，它採用自上而下的主題方法，從應用層開始，然後描述傳輸層和網路層，最後涵蓋實體層。課程從應用層向下延伸到實體層，讓學生在學習網路的早期就接觸重要概念來激發他們的興趣。 本課程專注於互聯網和網路的基本重要問題，對計算機科學和電氣工程感興趣的學生提供良好的基礎，而無需廣泛的程式或數學知識。

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在全面介紹網絡和分佈式計算技術。 與傳統課程不同，它採用自上而下的主題方法，從應用層開始，然後描述傳輸層和網路層，最後涵蓋實體層。課程從應用層向下延伸到實體層，讓學生在學習網路的早期就接觸重要概念來激發他們的興趣。 本課程專注於互聯網和網路的基本重要問題，對計算機科學和電氣工程感興趣的學生提供良好的基礎，而無需廣泛的程式或數學知識。

cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

description.zh: 以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、電化學、反應動力學、量子力學、光譜學、表面現象、輸送性質等。
description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

description.zh: 本課程介紹自然科學的起源、近代自然科學的誕生與發展。各領域含物理學、化學、生物學、天文學、數學等，並介紹各項科學技術。
description.en: This is an introductory course concerning about the origin of nature science, the genesis and developments of the modern physics science.  The topics of physics science are physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy, and mathematics.  The contents and characteristic of various technology are also discussed in this course.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下： 機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。 設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。

description.en: This course introduces students of engineering to those areas of mathematics which are important in connection with practical engineering problems. The material in this course is arrange accordingly in four parts: (1) Fist-order, second-order and higher order differential equations. (2) Systems of differential equations. (3) Series solutions of differential equations and special function. (4) Laplace transforms.

description.zh: 介紹含碳化合物的命名、結構與性質的基本概念。課程重點在反應機構、合成、立體化學、化學分析及儀器分析方法。
description.en: Fundamentals of structure and properties of carbon compounds. Emphasis on reaction mechanisms, synthesis, stereochemistry, as well as chemical and spectroscopic methods of analysis.

syllabi.outline:
介紹含碳化合物的命名、結構與性質的基本概念。課程重點在烷、烯、炔類、芳香族與醇類相關的反應機構、合成、立體化學、化學分析及儀器分析方法。

This course introduces the basic concepts of naming, structure, and properties of carbon-containing compounds. The focus of the course lies in the reaction mechanisms, synthesis, stereochemistry, chemical analysis, and instrumental analysis methods related to alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, aromatic compounds, and alcohols.

description.zh: 以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、電化學、反應動力學、量子力學、光譜學、表面現象、輸送性質等。
description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

syllabi.outline:
以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、電化學、反應動力學、輸送性質等。
Applying mathematical and physical principles to explain the theories of chemistry, molecular structures and properties of matter. The content include but not limited to the basic laws of thermal dynamics, phase equilibrium, chemical equilibrium,  electrochemistry, reaction kinetics, and transport properties.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
一 分組(每組每週做不同實驗，請明確第二週實驗順序)、安全衛生教育講習
二、三 實驗實做前課程講解
四 固體密度的測定 藉比重瓶測定粒狀或粉狀等不規則形固體的密度
五 液體密度的測定 藉漢埃氏法測定液體或溶液的密度
六 表面張力的測定 藉毛細管上升法測定不同溫度下液體的表面張力
七 液體黏度的測定 以奧士瓦黏度計測定純液體或溶液於各種溫度時之相對黏度，並了解相對黏度及絕對黏度的定義及測定法
八 備課
九 全校期中考週
十 凝固點下降法測定分子量 依據Clausius-Clapeyron方程式及稀薄溶液理論，藉貝克曼凝固點下降分子量測定裝置，以圖解法求溶質之真正分子量
十一 中和熱的測定 藉由量熱器測定各種酸與鹼溶液的中和熱，並熟悉量熱器水當量的測定法
十二 液體蒸氣壓的測定 藉等壓管法測定液體蒸氣壓，並與Clausius-Clapeyron方程式相驗證，進而估算液體的汽化熱
十三 固體溶質溶解度的測定 了解溶解度的定義及其測定方法，以測定固體溶質在不同溫度下的溶解度並求該物質的溶解熱
十四 溶質於相互不溶解二溶劑間的分配率 測定溶質在相互不溶解二溶劑間的分配率，並依據熱力學原理，由分配律測求其會合度或解離度
十五 二成份系之液液平衡 測定水-酚系溶液之溶解度曲線（成份與溫度的關係），並求其臨界溶解溫度（或稱會溶溫度）及其組成
十六 期末實驗室器材整理
十七 期末打掃實驗室
十八 全校期末考週

description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

syllabi.outline: In the first semester, this course first introduces the core areas of physical chemistry by defining systems, states, and processes. Later, traditional thermodynamics is described and applied to understand the reaction spontaneous direction of macroscopic systems, including the explanation of the three laws of thermodynamics, to the description of thermodynamic behavior applied to gaseous and liquid systems.

description.en: It applies the theory of thermaldynamics to calculate chemical potential energy and its equilibrium of condensed phase, released pressure and activated factors, solution thermaldynamics, complex metal solution , phase diagram and phase change, computer-aided phase reaction and phase diagram simulation, and planning a mathmatics model of metallurgy.

syllabi.outline:
This course applies the theories of thermodynamics to evaluate the chemical potentials equilibrium phases. Three fundamental laws of thermodynamics will first be introduced.  The effects of temperature and pressure upon Gibbs Free energy are then discussed. Applications for solutions, phase diagram, and chemical reaction evaluations with aids of computers will be the main practical topics for thermodynamics. The concepts of thermodynamics will be used extensively for metallurgical and materials-related fields.

本課程討論材料熱力學的基本理論、技巧及應用等，特別是平衡時化學熱力學有關氣相，氣体定理，熱量，功，熱力學第一、第二及第三定律，溫度與壓力對焓，熵，自由能之影響等概念；利用電腦輔助計算溶液、相圖與相平衡、及化學反應平衡等均為熱力學的應用範疇，這些概念對於諸多冶金、材料相關的場域皆十分重要。

description.zh:
材料之特性取決於材料內部組織，所以課程內容也注重內部組織與材料特性之間的關係，內部組織的變化對材料特性之影響，由理論為基礎之探討至實際之應用上。對本課程有關的基本概念，則詳加說明，初學材料者能得到材料上所必備之基本知識，若基本概念已有充分了解，則利用這些知識即可參考材料規格或手冊就可得到欲知之條件，進而以此概念作基礎，亦可研習更高深之學問，本課程內容著重於介紹材料之結構，基本原理有： 1. 金屬之基本理論，金屬及合金之構造，材料之組織，塑性加工變形之理論，材料之物理化學，機械性質及其實驗。 2. 鋼和鐵之製造，組織及其熱處理，變態理論。 3. 構造用鋼，合金鋼，工具鋼，特殊鋼之特性、用
途及其熱處理方法。4. 鋼之表面硬化理論及其熱處理方法。 5. 鑄鐵之冶煉，種類及其熱處理方法。6.非鐵金屬材料，銅，鋁，鈦，鎂，錫，鋅，鉛，鎳等合金種類之特性及其處理方法。
description.en:

put more emphasis on the relationship between the inside tissue and material chacter-
istics, how the change of inside tissue influences it in full details from the discussion 
of the theory basis to practical application. It has a detail description to the basic idea
of this course, the novice may get requisite fundamental knowledge. Once they fully
perceive these basic ideas, they may refer to material specification or manual to get
the conditions they request, or they may use these fundation to further explore
advanced knowledge.

description.zh: 本課程討論，化學中相關物理量的基本理論，技巧及應用等，特別是化學熱力學及電化學等。有關氣相，氣体定理，熱量，功，熱力學第一、第二及第三定律，焓，熵，自由能，相平衡，溶液，化學平衡，酸鹼，電化學，電極，電池，半反應等基礎理論之探討。
description.en: This course discuss the fundamental theory, technique and application with regards to physical property in chemistry, especially at the chemical thermal dynamics and electrical chemistry. The research of the fundamental theory about gaseous phase, the gas laws, heat, work, the first, second and third law of the thermodynatmics, entropy, enthalpy, free energy, phase equilbrium, solution, chemicalequilbrium, acid and alkali, electrical chemistry, electrode,electric cell,half reaction ,etc.

This course explores the relationship between particle physics interactions and chemical phenomena, covering key concepts such as phase equilibrium, chemical equilibrium, the hydrogen atom model, and reaction rates. The main instructional content includes important theories such as gas behavior, fundamental thermodynamics, basic quantum mechanics, chemical kinetics, and electrochemistry.

description.zh: 本課程主要目標在介紹與實際問題相關之數學領域，以模擬解題及詮釋等方式，將數學方法應用在工程問題上。課程內容有常微分方程，線性代數，向量微積分，Fourier 分析及偏微分方程式等章節，訓練同學在理論，計算及實驗間建立正確的認知及意義。內容將繼續介紹複數分析及數值方法等章節，尤其對計算機的概念及演算法乃給予較多的強調，對實際問題亦有簡化討論。另外，在應用解決問題構想，練習例題及理論間，更有相輔相成的效果。至於線性規化，圖形組合，機率理論及數學機率等內容亦有概略介紹，務使同學有正確的認知。

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧(二)

description.zh: 本課程主要授與學生程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python語言為基礎，在Python包索引（PyPI中）的主機中，擁有成千上萬的Python模組。本課程內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。除此之外，也會介紹AI的相關應用如ChatGPT、類神經網路及深度學習等。
description.en: This course mainly teaches students the concepts and methods of programming, with Python as the programming language foundation. As a programming language, Python has thousands of modules available in the Python Package Index (PyPI). This course emphasizes training in logical thinking and programming skills while also focusing on essential aspects of programming, such as program structure, debugging, portability, and fundamental software engineering concepts. This aims to lay a solid foundation in programming for the learners. The course will also introduce related applications of AI, such as ChatGPT, neural networks, and deep learning.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
Ｗeek 1-2 運算思維與程式設計 - 跨入程式設計的大門
程式設計，是針對電腦要解決的問題提供處理方式的過程，也是軟體開發時的重要步驟。Python是一個執行功能強大，但語法簡潔優雅的程式語言，不僅容易學習，更容易應用實作在許多專題上！

Ｗeek 3-5 變數與運算式 - 不只先乘除後加減
變數建立時，應用程式就會配置一塊記憶體，並以變數名稱做為辨識此塊記憶體的標誌，設計者就可在程式中將各種資料存入使用。運算式包含了運算元與運算子，可以進行程式的運算動作。
‧本章範例包括：成績單、稅率報表及薪資表格式化輸出\梯形、長方形面積計算\複利本金計算...等。

Week 6-8 判斷式 - 邏輯思維的起點
程式設計也和日常生活雷同，常會遇到一些需要做決策的情況，再依決策結果執行不同的程式碼，這就是「判斷式」。
‧本章範例包括：密碼比對判斷\輸入成績評等\電影分級判斷\百貨公司折扣戰\數字比大小...等。

Week 9 期中上機檢核

Week 10-11 迴圈 - 翻滾吧！程式碼
電腦最擅長處理的工作就是重複執行的事情，而日常生活中到處充斥著這種不斷重複的現象，程式專門用來處理重複事件的命令稱為「迴圈」。
‧本章範例包括：建立數列\計算正整數總和\井字直角三角形\九九乘法表\找最小公倍數\階乘計算...等。

Week 12-14  串列與元組 - 大量數據收納術
串列又稱為清單或列表，與其他語言的陣列相同，其功能與變數相類似，是提供儲存資料的記憶體空間。元組的結構與串列完全相同，不同處在於元組的元素個數及元素值皆不能改變。
‧本章範例包括：串列初值設定\迴圈讀取串列\成績計算\刪除串列元素\成績排序...等。

Week 15  字典 - 為資料貼上標籤
字典資料型態，其元素是以「鍵-值」對方式儲存，運作方式為利用「鍵」來取得「值」。‧本章範例包括：血型個性查詢\四季天氣查詢\成績查詢\產品銷售查詢\世大運獎牌數查詢...等。

Week 16 期末上機檢

Week 17 線上授課
核函式與模組 - 簡化運算擴充功能的利器
在程式中通常會將具有特定功能或經常重複使用的程式，撰寫成獨立的小單元，稱為函式。Python擁有許多模組，可讓功能可以無限擴充。
‧本章範例包括：攝氏華氏溫度\公斤英磅轉換\均分蘋果\電費、家庭支出查詢\網址格式檢查\檔案格式檢查\成績單、業績報表列印\日期時間格式轉換\擲骰子遊戲\大樂透抽獎\四星彩開獎...等。

Week 18  線上授課
演算法：排序與搜尋 - 用邏輯來解決問題
演算法就是為了解決一個問題而採取的方法和步驟，通常會以虛擬碼來表示，再以熟悉的語言來實現。‧本章範例包括：數字排排站\追蹤泡沫排序\搜尋中獎者\彩券對獎...等。

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原 理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺 陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物 理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度 、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。

description.en: How to use the national sources in a way to have sustainable development is the main purpose of this study. Improper usage of resources will bring a serious disaster from the natural feed back. Construction should take care of the ecology system and the methods of carefulness would be studied in this course.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description 
Elements of ecosystems, biogeochemical cycling, environmental factor interactions, population dynamics, and community development. 

Course Goals 
This course is intended for students and will examine structure and function of ecological systems, including populations, communities, and ecosystems, role of evolution in structure and function of systems, and influence of society on the biosphere. By the end of the semester, students who complete all necessary assignments will be able to: 
1.	Understand major concepts and terminology in the field of ecology. 
2.	Identify reputable sources for ecological information. 
3.	Comprehend the methods and application of ecological research. 
4.	Evaluate human interactions with nature and effects on natural systems.

The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 環境生態學主要講述基本生態學之原理原則，進而應用於土木建設工程的方式主要內容包含：(1)環境生態系統、(2)生態學之基本法則、(3)質與能傳遞、(4)汙染物對生態之影響、(5)台灣地區之生態保育、(6)工程開發生態系統造成之影響、(7)環境影響評估、(8)交通及營建工程之環境問題、(9)全球環境變遷、(10)環境品質與法規。
description.en: How to use the national sources in a way to have sustainable development is the main purpose of this study. Improper usage of resources will bring a serious disaster from the natural feed back. Construction should take care of the ecology system and the methods of carefulness would be studied in this course.

syllabi.outline:
生態系統為環境永續的根本。生態系統提供之自然資源與生態服務，也是人類社會中不可或缺的來源。本課程將使同學了解生態系統的運作，以及生態系統的各個組成，透過對生態系統的了解，未來在環境中所建構的各種設施，才能因應環境變化，且不破壞環境。本課程主要目的為在工程中學習與環境的互動，將環境生態因子納入工程建設設計與施作中，使未來硬體建設能更適應環境變異，提高韌性，成為環境所接受的工程。
Ecosystem is the foundation of the environmental sustainability. Ecosystem provides natural resources and ecological service, which are the major supplies for human system. This course is focus on the operation of ecosystem and the components. The understanding of ecosystem would be helpful to build the constructions that is resilient to variable environment and not bring damage to environment. The purpose of this course is to learn the interactions between engineering and environment, and to know how to incorporate ecological factors into engineering design and construction. The hard constructions with environmental considerations are expected to be accepted by the natural environment.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋兩部分：(1)介紹一階常微分方程式，二階與高階的線性微分方程式，包含物理問題或是其他問題導出微分方程式，以實際重要性的簡單方法求解答。(2)線性代數，矩陣、向量、行列式、線性方程式組，應用於電路與力學之最佳化計算過程。

description.en: The content of this course includes gravimetric, titrimetric potentiometric, spectroscopic methods of analysis.  Topics in statistics and data analysis, preparation and analysis of real samples, and equipment and practice of chemical analysis are also discussed.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces the fundamental principles and applications of analytical chemistry. Topics include analytical processes, sampling and sample preparation, errors and statistical treatment of data, hypothesis testing, gravimetric analysis, chemical equilibria, electrochemical principles, interactions between light and matter, molecular characterization, and interpretation of analytical results. Common analytical reagents, instrumentation, and laboratory operations are also discussed. Emphasis is placed on obtaining representative samples, developing reliable analytical methods, evaluating data quality, and applying analytical chemistry to practical problems in environmental, materials, biological, and food sciences.

description.en: Inorganic chemistry is one of the three frames of chemistry. Various materials in our daily life are composed of inorganic materials. This course will be given in a manner of easy-getting-point. The contents comprise of chemistry of main group elements and transition elements. The course covers the following topics: (1) Survey of principles (2) Chemistry of main group elements (A. Boron; B. Group 1, 2, 15, 16, 17 Elements) (3) Chemistry of transition elements (A. Survey of Transition Elements; B. Elements of the first transition series; C. description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

syllabi.outline:
Course Introduction
Discrete mathematics is a branch of mathematics devoted to the study of discrete objects (i.e., objects that are distinct and unconnected). This course will introduce and apply various discrete structures and techniques to solve real-world problems.
Main Topics
1.	The Foundations: Logic and Proofs
o	Understanding the fundamentals of logical reasoning and constructing mathematical proofs.
2.	Basic Structures: Sets, Functions, Sequences, Sums, and Matrices
o	Exploring fundamental mathematical structures used in computer science and mathematics.
3.	Algorithms
o	Designing and analyzing algorithms for various computational problems.
4.	Number Theory and Cryptography
o	Applying number theory in cryptographic algorithms and understanding their mathematical underpinnings.
5.	Counting
o	Learning basic counting principles and techniques, including permutations and combinations.
6.	Discrete Probability
o	Introducing probability theory with discrete random variables and their applications.
7.	Advanced Counting Techniques
o	Delving deeper into combinatorial analysis and advanced counting methods.
8.	Relations
o	Examining relations and their properties, including equivalence relations and partial orderings.
Learning Objectives
•	Development of Mathematical Thinking and Logical Reasoning: Cultivate the ability to understand and create mathematical arguments, laying the foundation for advanced mathematical studies.
•	Foundations in Computer Science: Provide the necessary mathematical background for advanced courses in computer science, such as data structures, algorithms, compiler theory, and more.
•	Operations Research and Applications: Equip students with the mathematical background required to solve problems in operations research, chemical engineering, biology, and related fields.
Course Features
•	Emphasis on Problem-Solving: The course focuses on teaching mathematical reasoning and problem-solving rather than merely imparting skills.
•	Fostering Creativity and Critical Thinking: Through diverse topics and problems, students are encouraged to apply their knowledge to new challenges.
•	Practice in Mathematical Proofs: Students will learn how to read, write, and validate mathematical proofs, which will be valuable for advanced courses.

This course aims to equip students with the necessary tools and skills to tackle challenges in future courses and professional work.

syllabi.outline:
Course Introduction
Discrete mathematics is a branch of mathematics devoted to the study of discrete objects (i.e., objects that are distinct and unconnected). This course will introduce and apply various discrete structures and techniques to solve real-world problems.
Main Topics
1.	The Foundations: Logic and Proofs
o	Understanding the fundamentals of logical reasoning and constructing mathematical proofs.
2.	Basic Structures: Sets, Functions, Sequences, Sums, and Matrices
o	Exploring fundamental mathematical structures used in computer science and mathematics.
3.	Algorithms
o	Designing and analyzing algorithms for various computational problems.
4.	Number Theory and Cryptography
o	Applying number theory in cryptographic algorithms and understanding their mathematical underpinnings.
5.	Counting
o	Learning basic counting principles and techniques, including permutations and combinations.
6.	Discrete Probability
o	Introducing probability theory with discrete random variables and their applications.
7.	Advanced Counting Techniques
o	Delving deeper into combinatorial analysis and advanced counting methods.
8.	Relations
o	Examining relations and their properties, including equivalence relations and partial orderings.
Learning Objectives
•	Development of Mathematical Thinking and Logical Reasoning: Cultivate the ability to understand and create mathematical arguments, laying the foundation for advanced mathematical studies.
•	Foundations in Computer Science: Provide the necessary mathematical background for advanced courses in computer science, such as data structures, algorithms, compiler theory, and more.
•	Operations Research and Applications: Equip students with the mathematical background required to solve problems in operations research, chemical engineering, biology, and related fields.
Course Features
•	Emphasis on Problem-Solving: The course focuses on teaching mathematical reasoning and problem-solving rather than merely imparting skills.
•	Fostering Creativity and Critical Thinking: Through diverse topics and problems, students are encouraged to apply their knowledge to new challenges.
•	Practice in Mathematical Proofs: Students will learn how to read, write, and validate mathematical proofs, which will be valuable for advanced courses.

This course aims to equip students with the necessary tools and skills to tackle challenges in future courses and professional work.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生提供創業和經營新創企業所需的基本知識和技能。 課程內容涵蓋當前各種形態的創業模式和創業家精神所具備的一些關鍵特質與必要的技能，學生將學習到如何識別市場機會並評估將想法商業化的可行性。本課程也將深入介紹行銷的核心概念與市場運作，包括市場細分，目標顧客定位和行銷組合，學生將學習到如何根據市場需求制定行銷策略並有效地實施。該課程還將涵蓋品牌策略、定價策略、推廣和銷售等主題。完成本課程後，學生將獲得關於創業以及經營企業的關鍵知識和技能，以及對行銷在創業過程中的作用有更深入的理解。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with the foundational knowledge and skills necessary to start and operate a new business venture. Students will learn about the various forms of entrepreneurship and entrepreneurship essentials, such as the characteristics, traits, and skills of successful entrepreneurs. Students will learn how to identify opportunities and assess the feasibility of a business idea. The course will then delve into the core concepts of marketing, including market segmentation, targeting, positioning, and the marketing mix. Students will learn how to develop a marketing plan and implement it effectively. The course will also cover topics such as branding, pricing strategies, promotion, and distribution. Upon completion of this course, students will have gained the knowledge and skills necessary to launch and operate a new business, as well as a deeper understanding of the role of marketing in entrepreneurship.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

syllabi.outline:
本課程與產品設計有關。目標是訓練教導學生能夠：
•	設定和掌控產品設計進度；
•	系統化產品設計；
•	創新設計提案；
•	精緻模型製作技能。
本課程包括一系列複雜性不斷增加的設計議題，最終制定產品製造和交付的運營計劃。練習包括產品設計和產品製造注意事項。廣泛使用電腦輔助設計軟件。設計教學資源將在工作坊中提供。


This course is concerned with product design. The objectives are to enable students to:

•	set and control the schedule of product design;
•	systemise product design;
•	sketch performance;
•	prototype skill.

The course consists of a series of design projects of increasing complexity, culminating in developing an operations plan for product manufacture and delivery. Exercises include both product design and product manufacturing considerations. Extensive use is made of CAD software. Resources for the design exercises are presented in working studio sessions.

產品設計是對產品設計過程的介紹，重點是為日常產品設計。這是一個以項目為中心的課程。 學生以 1-3人進行產品設計專題工作，設計新產品並製作精緻模型。將向學生介紹創新產品設計與開發方法及針對各種設計主題進行產品設計，包括頭腦風暴、設計評估、設計素描、平面設計、手繪和電繪、草圖建模、概念發展、設計美學、精緻模型製作，以及書面、視覺和設計交流。產品設計課程圍繞三個主要內容方向：

•	設計規劃；
•	設計繪圖；
•	精緻模型製作。


Product Design is an introduction to the product design process focusing on designing for daily products. It is a project-centric class. Students work with 1-3 students to design and prototype new products. Students will be introduced to various design topics, including brainstorming; estimation; sketching; graphic design; drawing and CAD rendering; sketch modelling; concept development; design aesthetics; prototyping; and written, visual, and oral communication. The Product Design course is organised around three main content areas:-

•	planning;
•	sketch;
•	prototype.

description.en: In the design and manufacturing of a product is is essential that the machine as wellas the process be understood, Manufacturing requires tools and machines that can produce products economically as well as accurately. Economy depends to a large extent on the proper selection of a machine or process that will give a satisfactory finished porduct. This course serves as an introduction to various manufacturing, foundry, special casting, and special working process.

This course is introducing the knowledge and technique of furniture construction, both theory and practicing. The contents include R&D procedure, product engineering, basic mechanics, characteristics of wood, characteristics of composite board,, wood joints, mechanical fasteners, characteristics of frame type furniture, characteristics of panel type furniture, characteristics of shell type furniture etc.

description.zh: 練習設計構想草圖速繪法；從基本幾何形體至複雜產品、空間循序漸進；常用材質（木質、金屬、透明材質、石材及皮革等）之表現技法；產品精描、透視圖法、三視圖、爆炸圖、組立圖等之精描，說明圖板及各種畫材（麥克筆、粉彩、色鉛筆及水彩）等之應用。
description.en: This course put emphasis on offering students having enough skills on :1.Abilities to sketch their idea visible to the others.2.Coloring design sketches to let the drawings have better comprehensibility.3.Good skill for Renderings. Medias for this course shall include markers, pastels water colors and color pencils.

syllabi.outline:
1.利用電腦軟體SketchUp來表現設計的手法，從基本幾何形體至家具到空間、循序漸進完成透視圖、平立面圖、爆炸圖等表現手法。
2.介紹SketchUp軟體基礎知識、帶領學生快速進入SketchUp的世界，認識SketchUp工作介面，打下良好基礎。SketchUp輔助設計工具主要作用是對模型進行不同的編輯操作，讓家具放入空間實例結合。
3. 介紹SketchUp樣式，可表現各種顏料素材的形式應用。
4.利用layout軟體，建立剖立圖面關係，進而培養透視與立面的關係，利用電腦繪圖方式建立的設計表現手法。
1. Use computer software SketchUp to express design techniques, from basic geometric shapes to furniture to space, and gradually complete perspective drawings, plan elevation drawings, exploded drawings and other expression techniques.
2. Introduce the basic knowledge of SketchUp software, lead students to quickly enter the world of SketchUp, understand the SketchUp working interface, and lay a good foundation. The main function of SketchUp auxiliary design tools is to perform different editing operations on the model, allowing furniture to be integrated into space instances.
3. Introduce SketchUp styles that can express the application of various paint materials.
4. Use layout software to establish the relationship between section and elevation drawings, and then cultivate the relationship between perspective and elevation, and use computer graphics to establish design expression techniques.

description.zh: 本課程為整合家具與室內設計之基礎課程。藉由相關設計競賽活動或產學合作計畫案，以創意激發的訓練為主，透過實際設計程序的演練，習得設計的方法並培養解決問題的能力。

Through related design competitions or industry-academia cooperation projects, creativity is emphasized in the training, and students will learn design methods and cultivate problem-solving abilities by practicing actual design procedures.

syllabi.assessment:
1.主題探索研究：10%，包含家具歷史案例研究、設計師或風格分析、自然仿生對象分析。
2.設計概念發展：20%。歷史語彙轉譯、仿生概念推演、造形草圖討論與發表。

5.平時成績：10%，包含作業準時程度、出勤狀況與是否積極參與指定競賽項目。

description.zh: 1.進階的設計表現技法，藉由意象表徵，仿生擬人，情境描繪等方法，探求設計表達的背後的意義。2.設計表現法主要素求是由簡易材料之運用以手繪快速描繪出蘊釀中造形，呈現將來產品形態。3.發表的概念草圖與版面設計規劃技巧，也是本課程的訓練重點。4.本課程以團對合作來執行設計表達。

syllabi.outline:
利用電腦來呈現設計的表現手法，表現擬真的渲染軟體眾多，深入研究駕馭V-Ray，藉由V-Ray渲染產品與搭配空間完成精彩設計，面對 VRay複雜的渲染參數、光源、材質等設定，以真實場景為例，最終渲染出圖，並且製作360環繞圖片，藉由後期處理等方式，表現更加擬真，為本課程學習重點。
Using computers to present the design expression method, there are many rendering softwares that can show the reality. In-depth research and mastering VRay, through V-Ray rendering products and matching space to complete the wonderful design, facing VRay's complex rendering parameters, light sources, materials and other settings, taking the real scene as an example, finally rendering the picture, and making 360 surround pictures, through post-processing and other methods, the performance is more realistic, which is the learning focus of this course.

EMI Course: All class material will be delivered in English. All submitted works and presentation shall be in English as well.

description.zh: 本課程通過理論與實際案例介紹3D創作與空間設計軟體：3DS MAX的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實務案例練習操作，最後透過專題設定進行學生自己的內容創作。課程目的是訓練學生在運用3DS MAX軟體進行3D模型、角色造型、空間和相關物件的建構能力，並接續應用在空間展示的內容設計和表現。
description.en: This course content is about 3D creation and space design software through theoretical and practical cases: 3DS MAX - the concept and application scope, and then teacher introduces the methods of 3D environment construction into practical case practice operations, and finally creates students' own creation project. The purpose of the course is to train students to use the 3DS MAX software to construct 3D models, character modeling, space, and related objects, and use the result and performance to space display.

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en:
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：第一學年----主要在教導學生對美學基本素養、空間的體驗及空間構成演練，使具備建築設計之基本能力與知識，其主要授課要點如下：一.基本設計訓練及空間的體驗：1.設計基本原理的認識與操作。2.空間經驗的掌握與表達。二、空間的構成：1.基本元素的應用--線、版、體。2.比例、尺度、材質與構造的訓練。3.開口及光影的表現。4.空間的界定與串連。三、空間與造型：1.空間與造型的關係。2.量體與空間、造型。3.結構概念與空間、造型。四、機能與組織：1.行為模式分析。2.機能與動線安排。3.空間的組織。第二學年----主要在教導學生探討空間組織、造型與行為模式等使學生具備整合建築設計相關知識及操作之能力，其主要授課要點如下：1.在範圍上--以各種使用性質的單棟建築為主題。2.在設計內容上--進一步探討空間組織、造型、行為特性及模式。3.在實質因素上--訓練對基地實質環境的認識及掌握，並著重材料、構造、設備、結構等系統的結合。4.在實務人才的養成上--具備整合建築設計相關專業知識及操作的能力。第三學年----主要在教導學生對環境或都市之認知，並使其具備細部設計以至整體建築設計及監造之能力，以銜接未來之實務。

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：第一學年----主要在教導學生對美學基本素養、空間的體驗及空間構成演練，使具備建築設計之基本能力與知識，其主要授課要點如下：一.基本設計訓練及空間的體驗：1.設計基本原理的認識與操作。2.空間經驗的掌握與表達。二、空間的構成：1.基本元素的應用--線、版、體。2.比例、尺度、材質與構造的訓練。3.開口及光影的表現。4.空間的界定與串連。三、空間與造型：1.空間與造型的關係。2.量體與空間、造型。3.結構概念與空間、造型。四、機能與組織：1.行為模式分析。2.機能與動線安排。3.空間的組織。第二學年----主要在教導學生探討空間組織、造型與行為模式等使學生具備整合建築設計相關知識及操作之能力，其主要授課要點如下：1.在範圍上--以各種使用性質的單棟建築為主題。2.在設計內容上--進一步探討空間組織、造型、行為特性及模式。3.在實質因素上--訓練對基地實質環境的認識及掌握，並著重材料、構造、設備、結構等系統的結合。4.在實務人才的養成上--具備整合建築設計相關專業知識及操作的能力。第三學年----主要在教導學生對環境或都市之認知，並使其具備細部設計以至整體建築設計及監造之能力，以銜接未來之實務。
＊細節課程進度由召集老師同所有教課教師統一開會決議後於學期初公布

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

description.zh:
本課程主要教導學生認識建築物理環境之基本理論，包含光環境、溫熱環境、空氣環境、音環境等，做為學習建築環境控制系統與建築設備之基礎。本課程內容分為七大部分，包括(一)建築氣象學概論、(二)建築微氣候環境、(三)建築採光與照明、(四)建築傳熱與隔熱、(五)室內通風換氣、(六)濕氣與結露、(七) 隔音與吸音等課題。
本學期介紹物理環境基本學理外，同時輔以相關案例補充說明，幫助學生在建築設計中能關注到使用者舒適、健康需求，並使其建築設計符合節能的永續建築要求。
description.en:
In this course, students will learn about the fundamental theories of architecture physics which include luminous environment, thermal environment, air environment, and sound environment as an introduction to understanding Systems of Environment Control and Architectural Equipment. The course is divided into 7 sections, (1) Introduction to Architecture Meteorology, (2) Architecture Microclimate, (3) Natural Lighting and Illumination of architecture, (4) Thermal Conduction and Proofing of Architecture, (5) Indoor Air Change and Ventilation, (6) Humidity and Condensation, and  (7) Sound absorption and proofing.
  In this semester, other than introducing the fundamental theories, related case studies are also incorporated as additional support to help students to be attentive toward issues such as comfort and health in their architectural design class at the same time to encourage the utilization of such knowledge to create energy saving and sustainable architectural designs.

description.zh:
現代主義運動，帶動了新建築的發展，也致使廿世紀的建築有了全新的可能。工業革命之後所帶動的，不僅僅是生產與製造的工業化，也不僅僅是資本的集中以及資本量的大幅成長。整個十九世紀的發展都是為了邁向一個全新的紀元，營建材料的開發、營建技術的發展、空間概念的突破，開創新的建築面貌以及新的建築歷史。
這個將近兩百年的建築發展，影響了廿世紀的建築教育，並且提供養分，供給新的世代的建築新發展。本課程將就十九、廿世紀的建築發展的歷史脈絡進行梳理，學生將由本課程理解今日其所進行的建築設計之來源。
description.en:
The Modern Movement of Architecture leads the development of new architecture, it thus deduce a whole new possibility of architecture. The Industrial Revolution is the motor of the whole movement. The building construction is industrialized under this overall influence to the society, not only on the concentration of capitals. The social life has been changed. Nineteenth Century is a struggling period with European tradition, moving forward to a new imagination, on the development of construction material, technics, also on the breakthrough on the spatial concept.

This evolution on architecture influences architectural education of 20th Century, and feeds the new creation of architecture. This course is to understand this historic evolution and context, to understand the source and establish knowledge in face of their future architectural activities.

description.en: This course is an introduction to the study and practice of fundamental principles of design in terms of creative arts, relationship between art and engineering, and the importance of aesthetics applying to design.

syllabi.outline:
*全英語授課
EMI Course: All class material will be delivered in English. All submitted works and presentation shall be in English as well.
Base on introduction to aesthetics.  By daily observation of our surroundings and environment, students are asked to take a closer look to our living world.  Class will focus on case studies of aesthetic application and renovation on various design fields.  The goal of the class is to develop the daily behavior to living environment attention and eventually promoting aesthetic standards in every profession. 
Class will include individual presentation and group discussion.
In class exercise/ discussion/ quizzes counts major part of the grades.
全英語授課: 授課/作業/簡報均需以英語呈現。
以美學入門為基礎，觀察日常生活美學的可能，進而達到提升美學的培養。
課程將著重於各個產業別對於”美“的建構，探討各面向”美“的改造及創新等。以大眾美學為觀察目標進而達到在各專業裡推廣”美“的最終目的。
課堂活動及討論為佔總成績百分之四十。

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Dynamics (動力學)
Pre-requisite: 3001011 or approved by the course instructor. 
Course Contents: Force, mass, and acceleration, particle kinematics, particle dynamics, work and energy, impulse and momentum, rigid body motion, and dynamics of the rigid body system.
General applications, vehicle dynamics, and railway vehicles will be introduced, such as basic dynamics, vehicle dynamics, wheel-rail coupling, railway vehicle climbing and slipping, aerodynamics, vehicle dynamics and resistance of railway vehicles, railway vehicle braking, and applications of railway vehicles.
This course can be counted for credits if pursuing a micro-program in railway vehicles.
The course is based on 16 + 2 weeks of flexible learning.

For those students who enter the school before 2006 Fall Semester , this class is to utilize computers to do the experiments on different vehicle/engineering problems. description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在介紹和深入探討電路分析的進階概念和技術。將涵蓋正弦穩態功率計算、平衡三相電路、拉普拉斯變換及其在電路分析中的應用、頻率選擇電路、主動濾波電路、傅立葉級數和傅立葉轉換、雙埠網路等主題，旨在培養學生在電路設計與分析方面的能力。
This course aims to introduce and delve into advanced concepts and techniques in circuit analysis. It will cover topics such as sinusoidal steady-state power calculation, balanced three-phase circuits, Laplace transforms and their applications in circuit analysis, frequency selective circuits, active filter circuits, Fourier series and Fourier transforms, and two-port networks. The course is designed to develop students' abilities in circuit design and analysis.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
This course introduces Western literature as both a tradition to study and a category to question. We will read influential works that have inspired a lineage of later writers while examining the works that have been forgotten in this tradition. Students are invited to practice critical thinking, make connections across texts and cultures, and develop the confidence to discuss complex ideas in English.

This is a rigorous and intellectually demanding course. Students are expected
to give their best effort at contributing to our community as a classroom, from partner work and class discussions to group projects. Students are also expected to do all readings, participate actively, listen respectfully, and take risks in developing their own interpretations. By the end of the semester, students will be better able to analyze literary language and connect texts to broader cultural and historical questions.

Stimulated theme-based scenarios and authentic content will be used to engage students with the purpose of generating lively conversation, and video films. syllabi.outline: This course aims to enhance students’ speaking skills with a particular focus on listening comprehension, critical analysis of certain issues, organization of ideas, and lucid delivery of a speech. The course is designed thematically and divided into 6 teaching sections. Each section contains two weeks. In the first week, we will approach a specific issue by watching an introductory video clip, doing listening exercises and understanding key terms. And then students will be divided into groups to discuss and present their opinions regarding the issue. In the second week, we will further explore the issue by watching selected scenes from a relevant film. Each group will be asked to answer critical questions by analyzing the scenes, formulate and organize their ideas, and deliver a short speech at the end of the class.

description.zh: 本科目旨在探討現實世界裡語言和溝通的種種現象，如：社會中之語言變化、大眾媒體的語言使用等，並介紹應用語言學門之緣起和現況。學生將需要分享自己對於本地或國際有關語言應用議題的觀察，例如：職場溝通模式、辨識性言詞分析、語言教學/測試趨勢、口筆翻譯項目、語言在新型媒體中之應用等。
description.en: This course aims to explore a variety of phenomena in language and communication in the real world, e.g., language variations in societies, language in the mass media, etc. It will also provide an overview of the historical background and the existing profile of applied linguistics as an academic discipline. Students are expected to share their own observations on AL-related issues, e.g., workplace communication modes, critical discourse analysis, language instruction/testing trends, translation/ interpretation projects, language use in the new forms of media, etc., in the local or international context.

本堂課會探討幾個語言學子領域以及跨語言學、行為科學和社會科學之基礎課題：語言習得、社會語言學、心理語言學、計算機語言學等。學生將學習以實驗性的方法搜集資料、來探討他們選擇的語言現象。

This course will explore a variety of disciplines within linguistics as well as some cross-interdisciplinary linguistic domains. Students will learn to use experimental methods to collect data to investigate the language phenomenon of their choice. Class lectures will be intertwined with hands-on experiments (online or offline) and activities during the 3-hour meeting.

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述統計學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋三個領域：敘述統計、機率理論與推論統計，其中包含概念介紹、敘述統計、機率理論、推論統計。另有統計學的應用領域於推論未知的情況以作為相關決策之依據，並包含統計軟體使用介紹。
description.en: The purpose of Statistics is to give students an introductory of statistical thinking, methods development and the assessment of credibility and value of inferences made from data.  A conceptual introduction to the field of statistics and its many applications with extensive coverage of data collection and analysis as needed to evaluate the reported results of statistical students and make a good decision will be included as well. The statistical software introduction will also be introduced in the class.

description.zh: 本課程適合一般大專行銷管理之授課。其目的在尋求優良的產品行銷管理方法，以求企業之良好利潤。本課程授課內容在使學生瞭解行銷管理之觀念，產品設計、產品運銷、促銷及訂價。相關之授課內容包括：市場區隔、市場組織、購買行為、產品開發、零售、批發、促銷、廣告及訂價程序等。
description.en: The marketing course is suitable to college student. The purpose is to find good method of product marketing, in order to pursuit good profit of enterprise. The course contents' goal makes student understand the idea of marketing, product design, product transportation, promotion and price setting. The related course includes: market segmentation, market organization, the behavior of buying, product development, retailing, whole-saling promotion, advertising and price setting process.

syllabi.outline:
The course is designed to:
1.	To strengthen knowledge and skills in using AI (e.g., ChatGPT) for marketing management, this course will introduce generative AI (ChatGPT) and the marketing big data database (Statista comprehensive data database) to enhance students' competitiveness in AI application for marketing management and big data analysis.
2.	To help students become familiar with the knowledge of marketing management.
3.	To revisit every theory and concept learned in marketing management through case studies;
4.	Strengthen students' practical insight and achieve successful marketing management.
This course will play immersive English videos (business case videos) for students' discussion and learning. Therefore, the course will require students to use the Internet and computers to search for information.

為強化利用AI (e.g., ChatGPT) 進行行銷管理的知識與技能，本課程將導入生成式AI (ChatGPT) 與行銷大數據資料庫 (Statista綜合數據資料庫)，培養學生AI應用行銷管理與大數據分析的競爭力。此外，本課程主要利用沈浸式英文影音 (商業影音個案) 方式學習行銷管理的概念與實務, 因此本課程將會使用電腦影音設備以幫助同學更快速地融入行銷管理專業英文的學習情境. 同學每週將會觀看, 撰寫心得並研討一個行銷管理商業影音個案. 藉此強化同學學習效果.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在使同學對財務管理之專業知識產生一概略的認識，期望同學能瞭解資金之運用、籌措及管理之一些觀念及技巧，並做為未來進行相關財務決策或進一步研究財務理論之基礎。本課程會將攸關財務的主題加以介紹,包含：1.財務報表分析2.時間價值，債券與股票3.投資決策與折現分析4.風險、報酬與資金成本5.公司融資政策6.資本結構與股利政策7.財務規畫8.合併與購併9.風險管理

Financial Statement Analysis 2.	Valuing Bonds and Stocks3.	Capital Budgeting Decisions4.	Risk, Return, and Cost of Capital5.	Corporate Financing Decisions6.	Capital Structure and Dividend Policy7.	Financial Planning8.	Mergers and Acquisitions9.	Risk Management

syllabi.outline: This course is to build up the financial framework for students when making financial decisions. The focus is on setting out the basic principles of financial management and applying them to the main decisions faced by the financial managers. It helps students to understand various tools of financial management and use them effectively when making investment and financing decisions.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則(IFRS)﹐內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對IFRS有全面整體了解及運用之能力,亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。

It may also be helpful to participate in accountant the license test and the government workers examination.

在授課過程或課堂討論充分的對話是有效學習的關鍵, 主動與建設性的互動與是學習者最基本的權與義務. 重點在於表達，並無絕對的對或錯, 而是在於希望透過學生彼此斷地提出問題與回答問題, 讓相同或相的剖析與了解相互激盪, 使得授課或討議題可以持續且深入地討, 進而釐清關鍵問題.

 以下幾點可作為衡是否有效地進主動與建設性的與: (1)積極傾聽, (2)勇於表達與議題攸關且具附加價值的意, (3)建設性地質疑, 以及(4)整合或揉合相
同或相的述; 總體表現將反映在「課程與」的成績上

考試目的在於測試學習者對個別觀與整體架構的解程, 包括課程講授, 教科書閱, 以及課堂討等內容, 以衡個別差, 並作為教學溝通效果之依據.
考試是測試學習者應該知道的課程內容, 只要有積極與課程學習者, 無須過憂慮.

description.zh: 人際關係是探討對自我的了解及對人的認知，包括性格、態度、魅力、溝通、壓力、挫折和情緒等重要課題的處理；幫助同學學習與各種不同品味、信念、立場與生活方式的人作有效率的溝通，開放的表達出自己的感覺與想法，以建立良好的合作關係，從而開發潛能、爭取更好的發展機會。溝通是人際關係中重要的手段，本課程提供學生對溝通知識的了解，並熟悉溝通的實務運用。課程重心涵蓋溝通的本質與觀念性架構，溝通的理論與模型，溝通的規劃、執行與控制，溝通的策略與技能。
description.en: Interpersonal Relationship is to discuss about self-understanding and perception of other people, including how to handle key issues related to character, attitude, attractiveness, communication, pressure, frustration and emotion. It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development. The course discuss about the communication issue from business manager. It introduces the concepts of communication and the practice about communication. The core of the course include the knowledge of communication and structure、theory and models.

syllabi.outline: 這門課將提供學生物件導向設計原理的基礎知識，並加強他們在 C++ 程式設計方面的能力。修習這一門課的學生必須要先有具備程式設計的能力，建議先修習計算機程式設計（I）與計算機程式設計（II）。學生將學習如何利用物件導向的角度撰寫設計要求，同時撰寫單元測試以利於保證軟體品質，學生可從單元測試中監控測試覆蓋率，以利於設計測試案例。同時，這一門課將介紹如何使用 Git 進行版本控制，使用 GitLab 和 Jenkins 進行持續整合（CI）。透過理論講解和實作練習，學生將熟悉物件導向設計原則和 C++ 程式設計，並能夠在開發過程中運用單元測試、Git 和 Jenkins 等工具來提升程式品質和效率。

description.zh: 資料表示法：定點系統(fixed point system)，浮點系統(floating point system)，2.運算工作：定點之加減乘除，快速之運算，浮點運算，3.指令與控制：各種指令介紹，中斷，硬體控制單元設計(hardwired control)，微程式控制單元設計(microprogramming)，4.記憶系統：記憶體之層次 (memory hierarchy)，虛擬記憶系統 (virtual memory)，快速記憶 (cache memory)。
description.en: 1. data representation (fixed point and floating point systems) 2. arithmetic and logic operations 3. command and control (hardwired control and microprogramming) 4. memory organization (cache and virtual memory)

description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 即使科學昌明如此，但我們日常生活中使用的、不斷推陳出新的照相機、攝錄影機、影印機等，在在都說明幾何光學現在仍然是主宰設計的工具。光學主要是藉著對光本質方面的瞭解，發展有關的理論基礎與計算法則，並進而用在日常生活且增益人類福祉的一門科學。幾何光學則是光學理論中，一連串近似運算的結果，著重在成像的效果和應用的一門工具性知識。本系之幾何光學是一學期、三學分、每週三小時的課程，教學內容大致包含以下三部份：一、介紹光的性質、在介面上反射、折射之有關定理、成像的原因及應用。二、分析像差現象及其成因與評估。三、淺介透鏡之設計。
description.en: Light is the principal means by which we gain knowledge of the world. From putting continually the improved camera, video cassette recorder, copying machine, etc., to market can just account for how important a designing tool the Geometric-Optics is.To build a solid basic theory and a rule for calculating through understanding thoroughly the nature of light is the central goal of Optics. Using the basic theory of optics and processes of approximate estimate, the Geometric-Optics put its point on image formation and its applications.Here in our department, the Geometric-Optics is a 3-credit, 3-hour per week, one-semester course. There are three consecutives parts in the one-semester lecture:The 1st part : (a)the nature of light, (b)the related theorems about reflection and refraction, (c) image formation.The 2nd part : the formation and correctness of aberrations.The 3rd part : the designing of lenses.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Dynamics (動力學)
Pre-requisite: 3001011 or approved by the course instructor. 
Course Contents: Force, mass, and acceleration, particle kinematics, particle dynamics, work and energy, impulse and momentum, rigid body motion, and dynamics of the rigid body system.
General applications, vehicle dynamics, and railway vehicles will be introduced, such as basic dynamics, vehicle dynamics, wheel-rail coupling, railway vehicle climbing and slipping, aerodynamics, vehicle dynamics and resistance of railway vehicles, railway vehicle braking, and applications of railway vehicles.
This course can be counted for credits if pursuing a micro-program in railway vehicles.
The course is based on 16 + 2 weeks of flexible learning.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的重點在於介紹移動機器人學的基礎知識，包括：輪式機器人的移動學、運動學與動力學、移動機器人的感測、感知、與認知方法等。本課程同時簡介移動機器人的系統架構、軟/硬體設計、地圖建立、定位與導航的基本概念。透過本課程的解說可使同學們瞭解如何設計並控制移動式機器人；並使研究所的同學具有分析與評估移動式機器人研究的背景知識。
This course focuses on the fundamentals of mobile robotics including locomotion of wheeled robots, kinematics and dynamics, sensory, perceptual and cognitive methods of mobile robots. System architecture, hardware and software design, and the concept of map building, localization, and navigation are also introduced in the course. We hope this course can help students understand how to design and control mobile robots, and can empower graduate students to have background knowledge to evaluate research results for mobile robots.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將從電子儀器的基礎操作訓練開始，學生將學習如何正確使用實驗室中常見的基本儀器，包括示波器、直流電源供應器、訊號產生器及數位萬用電表。課程中將強調儀器的功能原理、正確的接線方法、量測數據的解讀與分析，並結合常見故障排除技巧，以提升學生在實務應用中的操作能力與自信心。同時也會介紹基本的實驗室安全規範，強調電氣安全與設備保護觀念。學生將透過實驗設計並驗證電子學的直流偏壓、功率輸出與訊號波形，進而培養對功率放大器設計的初步理解。本課程著重理論與實作並重，旨在培養學生具備紮實的電子電路實驗技能與分析能力，為進階課程或未來工程實務奠定堅實基礎。
This course begins with fundamental training in the operation of electronic instruments, where students will learn how to properly use commonly used laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, DC power supplies, signal generators, and digital multimeters. Emphasis will be placed on understanding the functional principles of each instrument, correct wiring techniques, and the interpretation and analysis of measurement data. Additionally, the course will cover common troubleshooting methods to enhance students’ practical skills and confidence in real-world applications. Basic laboratory safety rules will also be introduced, with a focus on electrical safety and equipment protection. Through hands-on experiments, students will design and verify concepts related to DC biasing, power output, and signal waveforms in electronics, thereby developing a foundational understanding of power amplifier design. The course balances theory with practice and is designed to equip students with solid experimental and analytical skills in electronic circuits, laying a strong foundation for advanced coursework or future engineering practice.

description.en: This course is mainly aimed at introducing the data structures commonly used in programming languages which include ADT (abstract data type) and complexity, static structures and their storage representations, arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting, and searching.

This course give the fundamental concpets and topics about data structures in computer science. The topics incluce ADT(Abstract Data Type), complexity, static structures, arrays ,stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting, searching, as well as graphs.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下： 機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。 設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows： College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Management： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum. College of Design： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

description.zh: 本課程是針對有志從事文化創意產業的學生而設計的創意策略與企劃課程。課程從廣告的基本概念開始說明，如產品的開發策略、市場規模估計、競爭產品的研究和分析、消費者行為研究、SWOT、3C等。本課程的目的是以創新思考和市場行銷概念引導學生，並鼓勵學生從當前的創意產業中，發掘潛在機會，以創造新鮮且有趣的想法。
description.en: This course is a strategy and general project management for students interested in pursuing careers in the cultural and creative industry. The course starts from the basic concepts and functions in the advertising, such as the development of product strategy, market size estimation, competitor identification and analysis, consumer behavior research, SWOT, 3Cs, and so on. This course aims to guide students equipped with innovation thinking and marketing sense. Additionally, the course drives students to look through potential opportunities in the creative industry and to implement new and interesting ideas.
