description.zh: 課程規劃教授近代工藝設計的演進歷程，並融入工藝時尚跨界合作之案例介紹,協助學生認識當代設計思潮並體會工藝產品的機能與造形之美。配合當前文化創意產業政策與時尚產業的發展，瞭解工藝設計與時尚趨勢之未來發展。
description.en: The course introduces the evolution of modern craft design, and integrates the case of cross-border cooperation between craftsmanship and fashion. It aims to help students understand contemporary design and experience the beauty of function and form. In addition, the course cooperates with the cultural and creative industry policy and the development of the fashion industry, trying to help students explore the future of craft design and fashion.

syllabi.outline:
1.介紹東西方工藝設計的本質及近代的演進歷程，並配合工藝設計名作介紹，認識當代設計思潮。
2.講解設計美學與工藝鑑賞的理論基礎，幫助學生體會工藝產品的機能與造形之美。
3.配合當前文化創意產業政策與時尚產業的發展，幫助學生瞭解工藝設計未來發展趨勢，培養對於時尚工藝的鑑賞品味。
syllabi.assessment:
期中報告 :（分組進行）
同學以4人一組為基礎，介紹一國際品牌、傳統工藝技法或職人創作。
並針對主題內容之背景知識、主要人物、工藝表現、設計特色及創新卓越之處，進行12分鐘的ppt課堂發表。請於課堂上準備一頁A4相關內容講義與同學分享。
(需於兩週前與指導老師討論內容安排)。
繳交作業：彩色紙本簡報於報告當天繳交一份


期末書面報告:（個人報告）
選擇一工藝技法，進行深入研究與說明，透過舉例當代工藝表現及職人作品，提出個人選擇工藝內容之看法與未來趨勢建議，同時以AI生圖方式產生結合工藝技法之產品圖像。(ex：木目金、寄木細工、色土鑲嵌、剔紅、釉下五彩等)
每人1張圖文並茂書面報告繳交。

description.zh: 本課程旨在經由對文化經濟學的認知，解讀文化經濟的發展邏輯與運行機制，建構文化經濟知識體系，期能為文化市場與文化產業發展提供理論基礎與思維座標。課程主要內容，一為在經濟邏輯運行下的文化活動，諸如文化產品、文化事業、文化資本、文化產業、文化市場等；另一為經濟活動所反映與體現的文化因素，以及對經濟運行產生作用的思維價值等。
description.en:
The course aims through awareness of cultural economics to interpret the development logic and operating mechanism of cultural economy and to construct a cultural economic knowledge system, and is expected to provide the theoretical basis and thinking coordinates for the development of cultural markets and cultural industries.
The main content of the course is economic logics underpinned cultural activities, such as cultural products, cultural business, cultural capital, cultural industries and cultural markets; on the other hand, cultural factors reflected and experienced by economic activities, as well as the value of thinking which plays an important role in economic activities.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在建立學生文化經濟學的基礎理論認識，理解文化商品、創意產業與文化政策的經濟運作邏輯，並初步掌握社會投資報酬率（SROI）的概念與應用方法，培養學生以經濟視角評估文化活動與計畫社會價值的能力。

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋文化典藏的徵集、維護與管理過程，並著重各項資料的編排、描述與加值應用。課程目標在培養學生具備文化典藏智能，包括：1. 認識文化典藏機構、典藏物件的類型與特性，以及永久保存的相關概念；2. 理解文化典藏著錄的方式與基本原則；3. 具備文化典藏資料查找、評估與運用之素養。
description.en: This course covers the process of acquiring, maintaining and managing cultural collections, and focuses on the organization, description and value-added application of various collection. The goal of the course is to provide students with knowledge of cultural collections, including: 1. an understanding of the types and characteristics of institutions and objects in cultural collections, as well as the concept of permanent preservation; 2. an understanding of the methods and basic principles of description in cultural collections; 3. the ability to locate, evaluate, and apply information in cultural collections.

syllabi.outline:
This course introduces second-year students to the principles and practices of cultural collections management within museums, archives, and other cultural institutions. Operating as a seminar–lecture hybrid with limited enrolment, it pairs instructor-led sessions with student-led discussions of designated English readings presented on alternating weeks. Core content covers foundational museological knowledge, acquisition and deaccessioning, object documentation, conservation and preventive care, cataloging systems, digitization and digital preservation, metadata standards, and collections governance, alongside value-added applications, open access, image licensing, and cultural ethics. 
Two field visits to cultural institutions are integrated into the schedule. Weeks 6 and 14 are dedicated to site visits; Weeks 3, 4, 8, 10, 12, and 15 feature rotating group presentations of assigned readings. Midterm and final assessments take the form of group presentations; specific formats will be announced in class.

description.zh: 我們的事業甚至人生成功與否，不是建立在我們獲得與貢獻多少，而是在獲得與付出的過程中，我們是否樂在其中。能否在此過程中進行創意性思考，無疑是決定我們是否樂在其中的關鍵。本課程至少包括下述和「創意思考」相關的課題：它的神經科學基礎，它的心理學方法，它在哲學與邏輯上的認識論基礎，如何培養創意思考的基因，如何區別個人進行與在團體中運用創意思考，等等。本課程將進行系列的理論與個案探討，使學習者不僅知道什麼是「創意思考」，更要能夠進行創意思考。
description.en: Whether our careers and even our lives are successful or not is contingent not just upon the results we produce, but also upon whether we enjoy the activity of achieving those results.  To achieve this goal, we need to be able to think creatively.  The course hence covers at least the following topics relevant to “Creative Thinking”: its neuroscientific basis, its psychological methods, the epistemic foundation in both philosophy and logic, the development of the gene of creative thinking, the difference between thinking creatively as an individual and in a group, etc.  The course will proceed with a series of close studies of theories and practical cases, so that the participants of the course will not only know 'what is creative thinking', but also be able to think creatively.

description.zh: 值此一網際網路和數位經濟時代，資料通訊與網路已經顯著影響企業經營、管理及決策與策略規劃同時也影響人們之生活及活動。它的應用非常廣泛、無所不在且多元。 商業公司及企業可以運用資料通訊及網路化資訊系統來提升競爭優勢及執行績效、經營者決策及客戶服務效率與全球化商務、產品及服務。資料通訊可以在各種設置上以有線及無線的方式使用。因此，本課程的開課目標旨在學習並瞭解資料通訊及網路之基本原理、基礎建設、技術、管理及企業應用等之議題。本課程主要探討之主題包括 (1)資料通訊基本原理、(2)資料傳輸技術、(3)網路應用、(4)有線及無線區域網路、(5) 有線及無線廣域網路、(6)網際網路與TCP/IP、(7)網路安全、(8)網路設計、(9)網路管理、(10)分散資料處理、(11)主從、內部網路與雲端運算、(12)第四代行動網路和往後世代等。
description.en: In this era of Internet economy, businesses and enterprises may leverage data communications (DC) and networked information systems to enhance competitive advantages, streamline managerial decision making, and customer services. DC may be adopted in a variety of devices on both wire and wireless modes. Consequently, the objectives of this course aim to study the issues of fundamentals, infrastructure, technologies, management and business applications on data communications and networks. The major topics of this course contains (1)Fundamentals of DC,   (2)Technologies of data transmission, (3)Network applications, (4)Wired and wireless local area networks, (5)Wired and wireless wide area networks, (6)The Internet and TCP/IP, (7)Network security, (8)Design networks, (9)Network administration, (10)Distributed data processing, (11)Client/Server, Intranet, and cloud computing, (12)Fourth generation (4G) Mobile networks and onwards.

syllabi.outline:
企業網路常遭遇的問題及先進的網路應用等議題建構課程內容，並配合專題實作或問題解決方式實作，規畫進行業界參訪及邀請業界專家示範，將目前最新進的技術知能及企業現場之網路議題介紹給學生，讓其能獲得更新更深入的學習體驗，提昇學習理解，進而培育學生以所學技術去解決企業網路應用及問題的能力，進而促進合作學習與分析企業資料通訊及網路架構之規畫、設計與實現。
本課程規劃課程以8週來教授課堂上的理論知識，另外10週將以實作工作坊、業界講師協同教學等相關活動。
We construct course content on topics such as common problems encountered by enterprise networks and advanced network applications, and coordinate with the implementation of special topics or problem-solving methods. We plan to conduct industry visits and invite industry experts for demonstrations, so as to integrate the latest technical knowledge. and corporate on-site network issues are introduced to students, so that they can obtain newer and more in-depth learning experiences, improve learning understanding, and then cultivate students' ability to use the learned technologies to solve corporate network applications and problems, thereby promoting cooperative learning and analysis Planning, design and implementation of enterprise data communication and network architecture.
This course is planned to teach theoretical knowledge in the classroom for 8 weeks, and the other 10 weeks will include practical workshops, collaborative teaching by industry lecturers, and off-campus visit-related activities.

syllabi.assessment:
1. Participation & Discussion: 20%
Attendance and active participation in class
Contribution to group discussions and Q&A
Engagement during peer presentations
2. Weekly News Analysis (In-class Presentation): 60%
Every two weeks, the group presents a report on a selected news article ( ~15 minutes ).
Evaluation criteria: completeness of summary, data & background analysis, discussion of impacts, clarity of delivery
Grading is group-based, but individual contribution will also be observed
3. Personal Report: 20%
Each student submits a Final written report
Required sections: news source, summary, background, supporting data, impact analysis, personal opinion
Evaluation criteria: completeness (40%), depth of analysis (30%), originality of insights (20%), formatting & punctuality (10%)

syllabi.notes:
彈性學習/Flexible Learning 教師需於「課程進度」填寫 1至 16週課程內容，並於下列欄位填寫 17至 18週彈性學習內容。
一、類別 (可複選)
參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查
二、內容 
(1)第 17週:本週為彈性學習，學生需彙整本學期所學之「科技與金融」核心概念，選定一則特定的重大財金時事（如科技巨頭財報、地緣政治等），獨立進行資料蒐集與分析。 
(2)第 18週:學生完成撰寫並繳交 1-2 頁之期末個人書面報告 (Personal Report)，由教師進行評閱與提供個別回饋。
三、時數 總共 6小時。
四、學習成果 第 18週規定時間內繳交期末個人書面報告，以此檢視學生對新聞事件背景的掌握完整度、分析深度與見解原創性。
五、評量比例 (1)期末個人書面報告 (Personal Report):20%

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Course Introduction - Overview of course, grading, report format, and how to track reliable financial news
Week 2: Tech & Finance Basics - Role of tech stocks in global markets; why they drive sentiment
Week 3: Semiconductors & Supply Chains - Chip war, geopolitics, supply chain restructuring
Week 4: AI & Market Impact - Generative AI boom, capital flows, productivity & risk
Week 5: Tech IPOs - Startup listings (IPO, SPAC), valuation, fundraising trends
Week 6: Big Tech Earnings - Apple, Meta, Amazon, NVIDIA earnings and market reactions
Week 7: Digital Finance & FinTech - Virtual banks, payment innovations, digital transformation in finance
Week 8: Blockchain & Crypto - Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, regulatory environment
Week 9: ESG & Green Tech - EVs, renewable energy, carbon markets and sustainability
Week 10: Tech & Consumer Markets - E-commerce, platform economy, advertising ecosystems
Week 11: Tech War & Geopolitics - US–China tech rivalry, export controls, policy risk
Week 12: Tech Investment Trends - Cross-border deals, M&A, venture capital in tech
Week 13: Macroeconomics & Tech Valuations - Interest rates, inflation (CPI), Fed policies, and their impact on tech growth
Week 14: Cybersecurity & Data Regulation - Cyber threats, data privacy, antitrust, and compliance costs
Week 15: Comprehensive Case Study - The "Magnificent Seven", the AI capital loop (Infinite Money Glitch), and bubble risks
Week 16: Course Wrap-up & Future Outlook - Semester review and forecasting future intersections of tech and finance

【彈性學習週：佔學期總成績 20%】
Week 17: Flexible Learning - 學生獨立彙整本學期所學，選定特定時事撰寫並繳交期末個人書面報告。
Week 18: Flexible Learning  - 教師評閱個人書面報告 (評量標準：完整度、分析深度、見解原創性等) 與個別回饋。

description.zh: 本課程偏重在如何將Python應用在金融實務領域上:怎麼取得網路上費的資料，怎麼使用Python視覺化功能分析，怎麼使用Python進行有用的回測，怎麼做投資組合最佳化配置。
description.en: This course focuses on how to apply Python in the field of financial practice: how to acquire free data online, how to utilize Python's visualization capabilities for analysis, how to conduct useful backtesting using Python, and how to optimize investment portfolio allocation.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述管理學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋四個領域：(1)瞭解管理學之理論與相關學者之研究報告；(2) 討論企業界管理應用實務案例；(3) 探討多國化管理之趨勢與差異及(4) 如何落實管理理論研討與趨勢。另外一有管理相關功能實務應用之討論與介紹
description.en: The purpose of Management has four distinct objectives:(1) to introduce a new management paradigm；(2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of management and organizational behavior into a single volume, including the management functional and departmental descriptions；(3) to discuss business management applications in practice and (4) to effectively implement the management basic ideas. The planning, organization, decision, leadership and monitoring among variety culture will be covered and discussed in the class as well.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹人機介面設計過程中所需了解之相關專業知識，配合設計實務的操作，使學生能充分了解使用者介面設計的流程以及相關的應用，始其具有能進行人機使用者介面實務製作的能力。課程內容包含介面設計概念模式、介面使用性、人機介面設計程序、使用者需求、介面原型設計、介面設計原則以及使用者測試等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及實作等方式進行，並以報告繳交與課堂發表及作品為評量依據。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge for human-computer interaction (HCI) design, accompanying with design practice. This will allow students to understand the process of user interface design and related application, so as to be capable of practical interface design. The contents include conceptual model, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study and practical work, and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentation and design work.

syllabi.outline:

syllabi.outline:
本課程以建立設計思維與表現能力為目標。課程面向包括：建立美感、創意發想、應用媒材、跨域整合、傳達概念、分析批判。透過平面及立體的構成練習以及造形與色彩的研究，傳授基礎設計原理，訓練學生計畫性創造能力，並透過專題實作熟練設計技巧與流程。
This course aims to develop students’ design thinking and expressive abilities. The course covers areas including aesthetic development, creative ideation, media application, interdisciplinary integration, concept communication, and critical analysis. Through 2D and 3D composition exercises, as well as studies of form and color, students learn the fundamental principles of design. The course also trains students in systematic creative thinking and enables them to become familiar with design techniques and processes through project-based practice.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。 課程規劃主要著重在"設計方法"以及"設計思維(Design Thinking)的實際操作演練;希望透過本課程讓同學們以互動體驗實作的方式來建構設計概念發展的模式。 課程內容包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫及實作等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discussion.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生在多媒體設計上的音樂製作與聲音設計之理論與實務訓練，透過 MIDI 概念講解、數位音樂製作流程介紹、作品欣賞、軟體操作、實務聲音設計與錄製、電腦輔助音樂製作實務，來強化學生在音樂與聲音設計上的審美能力、企劃能力、與實作能力。
description.en: This course aims to enhance students' theoretical and practical ability of music production and sound design in multimedia. It is intended to strengthen students' aesthetic, planning, and production ability of sound. Topics covered in this course include MIDI, music production, music appreciation, software operation, sound design, recording techniques as well as computer-assisted music arrangement.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供給對於電子音樂、聲音藝術、數位音樂、遊戲配樂、以及聲音相關研究等有興趣的學習者們一系列有效工具的介紹與實務練習，並為學習者建立數位音樂、遊戲配樂、聲音設計的基本概念。本課程透過介紹音訊編輯的技術、相關聲音設計工具的使用，學習創意的聲音設計與電子音樂製作。課程當中，除了聲音設計的工具介紹之外，並教導學生使用 Ableton Live 序列器軟體，搭配 Max for Live 的聲音設計工具，讓使用者可以在序列器中使用自己所設計的軟體合成器與數位位效果器，進而可延伸至多媒體、遊戲、新媒體展演等之音樂與音效應用。此外，本課程亦將結合「自適性音樂」的技術，透過中介軟體 FMOD 與遊戲引擎 Unity 進行結合，建立自適音樂的雛形架構，作為互動設計的音樂設計依據。此外，本課程也加入 ＡI 音樂與音訊處理相關工具之介紹與應用。

This course mainly introduces sound design and electronic music production tools and skills. Through the introduction of audio editing technology and the use of related sound design tools, students can learn creative sound design. In the course, students are taught to use the Ableton Live sequencer software, combined with its sound design tools in Max for Live, to design their own software synthesizers and digital effects to be used in the sequencer. These skills may be used in multimedia design, game audio, new media performances, and etc. In addition, this course will also cover the concept and technology of "adaptive music", integrating the middleware FMOD into the game engine Unity to establish a prototype framework of adaptive music for interactive design.

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授動畫的企劃與設計，以及其製作原理與應用。透過對網路、動畫、遊戲、及其他數位媒體的討論，使同學了解動畫的設計製作流程、腳本撰寫、軟體應用等。
description.en: This course is focused on the introduction of animation planning and design, as well as its principle and application. Through the study on the internet, animation, game and other digital media, students can understand the design process of animation, story drafting and software application.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在講授動畫的企劃與設計，以及其製作原理與應用。透過對網路、動畫、遊戲、及其他數位媒體的討論，使同學了解動畫的設計製作流程、腳本撰寫、軟體應用等。

透過理論講解和操作示範介紹電腦動畫的原理和方法。除了功能的訓練之外同時也著重動畫的美感、創造性、表演性等等運用面的需求。
使用軟體是以3Ds Max為主，在熟悉3ds max工具的同時，更明確的認清原創為藝術創作的首要目標，以利用此軟體多元並高度的掌控性，重組現實世界的運行法則，像是重力、光影、質感等，並企圖創造出各種感知進化的契機。此動畫課程除了包含進階的建模、材質與運算，將加入角色製作與攝影機語言的敘述搭配空間與物件造形所傳達之視覺感知，將時間性的美感與張力融入創作。

description.zh: 近年來網頁技術的快速發展，網頁設計也從傳統的後台PHP進展到以HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術為主的前端工程。此外，UI／UX的協同設計也是建立一個好的網頁的重要部分。 本課程旨在教導學生使用HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術進行現代化的網頁設計，課程內容以靜態網頁的版面設計為主，包含RWD的響應式跨平台網頁設計。其中也涵蓋了UI／UX的概念建立。期待同學能經由這門課建立前端工程需要的基本技能。
description.en: In recent years, the rapid development of web technology, web design has also progressed from the traditional platform- PHP to HTML5+ CSS3 + Java script technology-based, front-end engineering. In addition, the collaborative design of the UI/UX is an important part of building a good Web page. This course is designed to teach students to modernize web design using HTML5-CSS3-Javascript technology, with a focus on static web layout and responsive cross-platform web design with RWD. It also covers the concept building of UI/UX. Expect students to establish the basic skills needed for front-end engineering through this course.

This course is designed to teach students to modernize web design using HTML5-CSS3-Javascript technology, with a focus on static web layout and responsive cross-platform web design with RWD. It also covers the concept building of UI/UX. Expect students to establish the basic skills needed for front-end engineering through this course.

description.zh: 本課程概念為數位化產品設計與開發介紹，為使學生明白數位化產品設計與開發在現代產業中的重要性，課程重點將介紹出版編輯觀念之基礎認識，讓學生增進對數位出版流程的理解，在設計過程中兼顧學理介紹與實務應用。另外探討數位劇本之優點、特性、設計步驟與要領、講述策略、核心技術、未來趨勢等。
description.en: The course is intended not only to familiarize students with the importance of digital products and development in the industry, but also to investigate the basic knowledge of editing and publishing. Students will have a combination of theoretical and practical training in this course.

syllabi.outline:
EMI Course (全英語授課): All class material will be delivered in English. All submitted works and presentation shall be in English as well.
This course covers the basics of publication editing, helping students develop practical layout skills. Through hands-on projects like posters, magazines, book covers, or/ and packaging, students will practice key design principles—including the Golden Ratio, the Van de Graaf Canon, Juxtaposition, and Narrative Form—to achieve effective visual and information communication.
課程將以介紹圖文編輯基礎在實務編排中學習掌握排版編輯之能力。課程將以數個編排技巧為基礎如Golden Ration、The Van de Graaf Cannon、Jaxtaposition、Narrative Form 等操作練習包含數位簡章、數位雜誌、及數位書籍或包裝等，藉由練習達到視覺及資訊傳達之目的。

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

■ 線上數位教材學習
■ 遠距教學
■ 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查
二、內容
1.第 17 週: 學生依本課程進度，使用 MyCT 線上遠距教學平台，完成《來學華語》第二冊第一課至第五課之課文朗讀錄音練習。線上教學系統將依學生朗讀表現（包含：發音、語調、流利度和重音等標準）提供成績紀錄。教師則以此作為期末口語成績之參考依據。

description.zh: 以傳授設計原理、平面及立體設計觀念、美的形式原理、平面及立體的構成練習、對各種材料特性的應用經驗以及造形與色彩的研究達到設計感覺的養成並提高計畫性創造能力，是發展實用性及機能性以前之設計訓練的基礎。
description.en: This course aims to develop the ability of students to meet specific sensory needs through the creation of abstract visual order in the form of two-dimension and three-dimension. The visual organization of design elements including line, plane, volume, and the analysis of their abstract relationships and principles of order are studied.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹基礎互動程式語言的架構以及設計的方法，並培養學生如何透過互動程式的設計與應用的分析及發展，實踐互動科技中有關圖像、視覺、聲音、觸感等互動效果的專案製作能力。
description.en: This course provides the fundamental knowledge, the structure and the designing methods of interactive programming. Student will learn the capability of using interactive programming design, analysis and development to implement the graphic, visual, sound, and touching interaction in interactive technology.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

syllabi.outline:
*EMI Course (全英語授課)
This course introduces the fundamentals of storytelling and script planning. By exploring narrative structures and the design thinking process, students will gain hands-on experience in developing an interactive script—from initial planning and analysis to the creation of a finalized visual narrative. Active in-class participation, including brainstorming sessions and discussions, will be evaluated. 
For the final group project, students will collaborate to produce a short video based on their original scripts.

description.zh: 近年來網頁技術的快速發展，網頁設計也從傳統的後台PHP進展到以HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術為主的前端工程。此外，UI／UX的協同設計也是建立一個好的網頁的重要部分。 本課程旨在教導學生使用HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術進行現代化的網頁設計，課程內容以靜態網頁的版面設計為主，包含RWD的響應式跨平台網頁設計。其中也涵蓋了UI／UX的概念建立。期待同學能經由這門課建立前端工程需要的基本技能。
description.en: In recent years, the rapid development of web technology, web design has also progressed from the traditional platform- PHP to HTML5+ CSS3 + Java script technology-based, front-end engineering. In addition, the collaborative design of the UI/UX is an important part of building a good Web page. This course is designed to teach students to modernize web design using HTML5-CSS3-Javascript technology, with a focus on static web layout and responsive cross-platform web design with RWD. It also covers the concept building of UI/UX. Expect students to establish the basic skills needed for front-end engineering through this course.

description.zh: 本課程概念為數位化產品設計與開發介紹，為使學生明白數位化產品設計與開發在現代產業中的重要性，課程重點將介紹出版編輯觀念之基礎認識，讓學生增進對數位出版流程的理解，在設計過程中兼顧學理介紹與實務應用。另外探討數位劇本之優點、特性、設計步驟與要領、講述策略、核心技術、未來趨勢等。
description.en: The course is intended not only to familiarize students with the importance of digital products and development in the industry, but also to investigate the basic knowledge of editing and publishing. Students will have a combination of theoretical and practical training in this course.

syllabi.outline:
EMI Course (全英語授課): All class material will be delivered in English. All submitted works and presentation shall be in English as well.
This course covers the basics of publication editing, helping students develop practical layout skills. Through hands-on projects like posters, magazines, book covers, or/ and packaging, students will practice key design principles—including the Golden Ratio, the Van de Graaf Canon, Juxtaposition, and Narrative Form—to achieve effective visual and information communication.
課程將以介紹圖文編輯基礎在實務編排中學習掌握排版編輯之能力。課程將以數個編排技巧為基礎如Golden Ration、The Van de Graaf Cannon、Jaxtaposition、Narrative Form 等操作練習包含數位簡章、數位雜誌、及數位書籍或包裝等，藉由練習達到視覺及資訊傳達之目的。

syllabi.outline: 物件導向程式語言是一種便於開發重用性高且結構複雜的系統設計方法。本課程將介紹Python的基本撰寫技術以及進階物件導向的特徵，其中包含資料型態、結構、函數、物件與類別等內容。由於Python擁有豐富的擴充套件與簡潔的語法，它正是目前發展與實作人工智慧最核心的程式語言。人工智慧(AI)已在各個領域中影響人類生活，特別是在機器學習與深度學習技術的發展。本課程亦會提供學生關於人工智慧的基本概念，包含了資料處理、類神經網路等演算法之介紹、深度學習於影像辨識的應用以及生成式AI概念。本課程最終目標則是希望學生能夠將Python以及人工智慧技術應用在當前的工程以及工業問題中。

description.zh: 本課程之目標是希望充實同學在基礎力學之專業知識，與大二材料力學等課程能夠相銜接，同時能夠瞭解力學在工程上之簡單應用。課程內容包含：向量與質點平衡、力系的平衡、摩擦、面積矩與質量慣性矩、結構分析、虛功法。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enrich students' professional knowledge in basic mechanics, to be able to connect with sophomore materials mechanics and other courses, and to understand the simple application of mechanics in engineering. The course content includes: vector and particle balance, Equilibrium of force system, friction, area moment and mass moment of inertia, structural analysis, virtual work method.

description.zh: 本實習課旨在讓學生透過進入本校既有半導體製程教學場域，內容包括晶圓清洗、光阻塗佈、光學曝光、顯影製程、薄膜製作、金屬薄膜沉積、電鍍、化學機械平坦拋光製程、蝕刻製程、晶圓切割及薄膜量測與製程紀錄等基本操作。同時導入安全管理、場域操作規範與設備使用流程，使學生熟悉製程環境並具備初步操作能力，建立學生理論與實務操作的連結。
description.en:
This lab course is designed to provide students with hands-on experience in the semiconductor manufacturing environment available on campus.
Students will engage in fundamental process operations, including wafer cleaning, photoresist coating, optical lithography exposure, development, thin-film fabrication, metal film deposition, electroplating, chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), etching processes, wafer dicing, thin-film characterization, and process documentation.
The course also incorporates safety management, facility operation protocols, and equipment usage procedures to ensure that students become familiar with the fabrication environment and acquire essential operational skills. Through this training, students will be able to establish a strong connection between theoretical knowledge and practical semiconductor process operation.

description.zh: 這門課程涵蓋三個部分：(I) 解一階、二階以及高階線性微分方程，並理解如何以常微分方程（ODEs）建構物理問題的數學模型；(II) 使用拉普拉斯轉換解常微分方程；(III) 矩陣代數、行列式、特徵值與特徵向量的相關理論與應用。
description.en: This course covers three sections: (I) solving first-order, second-order and higher-order linear differential equations, and understanding modeling physics problems with ODSs; (II) solving ODEs using Laplace transforms; (III) matrix algebra, determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

syllabi.outline:
本課程全面介紹常微分方程（ODEs）與積分轉換，此兩者皆為工程應用中不可或缺的基礎數學工具。課程內容主要分為兩大核心部分：（1）一階、二階及高階線性常微分方程的解析技巧與數學建模，並著重於如何從實際的工程與物理問題中推導出這些微分方程。（2）拉氏轉換（Laplace Transform）的理論與應用，特別聚焦於其高效求解高階非齊次微分方程、不連續訊號輸入以及聯立常微分方程組的能力
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and integral transforms, which are fundamental mathematical tools for engineering applications. The curriculum is divided into two primary components: (1) The analytical techniques and modeling of first-order, second-order, and higher-order linear ordinary differential equations, emphasizing how to derive these equations from practical engineering and physical problems. (2) The theory and application of the Laplace transform, focusing on its capability to solve higher-order nonhomogeneous differential equations, discontinuous inputs, and systems of ODEs efficiently.

description.zh: 1.瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含：(1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件 (2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等 (3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應 (4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域 (5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。2.瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含： (1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路 (2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析 (3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換 (4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數 (5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用 (6)Laplace轉換及應用。

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。
description.en: This course provides an overview of the fundamental principles, properties, and applications of various materials, including metals, ceramics, polymers, and composites. Topics covered encompass crystal structures and defects, atomic diffusion in solids, phase diagrams and transformations, materials processing and applications, physical properties (optical, electrical, magnetic, and thermal), mechanical properties (strength, ductility, hardness, toughness, fatigue, and creep), as well as mechanisms and methods for material strengthening.

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 本華語課程規劃為三年制教學，共分三個階段。第一年以基礎華語教學為主，重點包括：發音訓練、基礎字彙、句型與語法，以及日常生活會話。第二年在延續第一年內容的基礎上，強化段落閱讀與書寫能力，並擴展識字量。第三年則著重提升學生的聽力理解、口語表達與語境掌握能力，並融入華人社會與文化的相關內容。
description.en: This Chinese language courde is designed as a three-year curriculum, structured into three progressive stages. In the first year, the focus is on foundational Chinese instruction, including pronunciation training, basic vocabulary, sentence patterns and grammar, as well as daily conversational skills. The second year builds upon the first by strengthening paragraph reading and writing skills, and expanding character recognition. In the third year, the emphasis shifts to enhancing students’ listening comprehension, oral communication, and contextual understanding, while integrating topics related to Chinese society and culture.

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。
description.en: This course provides an overview of the fundamental principles, properties, and applications of various materials, including metals, ceramics, polymers, and composites. Topics covered encompass crystal structures and defects, atomic diffusion in solids, phase diagrams and transformations, materials processing and applications, physical properties (optical, electrical, magnetic, and thermal), mechanical properties (strength, ductility, hardness, toughness, fatigue, and creep), as well as mechanisms and methods for material strengthening.

description.en: This CSP (Chinese for Specific Purposes) course is designed to equip pre-service international students in Taiwan with the Chinese language skills pertinent to semiconductor technology. The program aims to establish a solid foundation by introducing basic Chinese terminology used in the semiconductor industry. Students will receive training in essential technical Chinese terms related to semiconductor processes, equipment, and devices. The course will enhance their Chinese listening and reading skills, which are vital for academic success in advanced engineering disciplines. Through this CSP, future engineers will be prepared for more advanced technical training in high-tech sectors. The CSP will contribute to the future globalization of local high-tech industries.

description.zh: 本華語課程規劃為三年制教學，共分三個階段。第一年以基礎華語教學為主，重點包括：發音訓練、基礎字彙、句型與語法，以及日常生活會話。第二年在延續第一年內容的基礎上，強化段落閱讀與書寫能力，並擴展識字量。第三年則著重提升學生的聽力理解、口語表達與語境掌握能力，並融入華人社會與文化的相關內容。
description.en: This Chinese language courde is designed as a three-year curriculum, structured into three progressive stages. In the first year, the focus is on foundational Chinese instruction, including pronunciation training, basic vocabulary, sentence patterns and grammar, as well as daily conversational skills. The second year builds upon the first by strengthening paragraph reading and writing skills, and expanding character recognition. In the third year, the emphasis shifts to enhancing students’ listening comprehension, oral communication, and contextual understanding, while integrating topics related to Chinese society and culture.

name.en: The Social and Cutural Characters in Taiwan

description.zh: 本課程的主要內容是涵括台灣社會與台灣文化兩大部份，台灣社會部份可分為早期台灣原住民社會，十七世紀以後漢人社會的建立，十九世紀從移民社會到定居社會，近代工商業社會的建立等幾部份；文化方面則以原住民文化，漢人文化及近代文化為教授重點，希望在一學期的課程中使學生對台灣的社會與文化有一概括性的了解。
description.en: This course primarily includes two major sections: Taiwan's society and Taiwan's culture.  Taiwan's society is made up of early aboriginal society, Han immigrant society after 17th century, the society of settlement in 19th century and the establishment of industrial/commercial society after 1930.  Taiwan's culture focuses on aboriginal culture, Han culture, and contemporary culture.  This one-semester course provides students with the basic knowledge about the Taiwan's society and culture in the hope that the students would have a comprehensive understanding of the culture and society in Taiwan.

syllabi.outline:
This course is designed for international students with a Chinese proficiency level of A1. The course revolves around everyday life scenarios, guiding students to understand Taiwanese society, culture, and related life themes through text reading, topical discussions, classroom activities, and cultural experiences, helping them build a basic understanding of local culture.

The course content includes individual and group reports, cultural experience activities, and cultural experience worksheets. Students will learn relevant Chinese vocabulary and expressions through active participation and observation, and record, organize, and reflect on what they have learned through the worksheets. The course also includes assignments and diverse classroom exercises, providing ample opportunities for students to practice listening, speaking, reading, and writing, aiming to comprehensively improve their Chinese communication skills and intercultural understanding.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

description.zh: 程式設計已成為各領域基礎且關鍵的能力之一，具備基本的程式能力，不僅能提升問題解決的邏輯思維能力，更是理解現代科技的入門門檻。本課程以 Python 為主要教學語言，從零開始，帶領學生學習變數、條件判斷、迴圈、函式、資料結構等基礎概念，並透過實作練習，加強學生對程式邏輯與結構的理解。此外，課程將安排簡介AI應用的單元，讓學生了解如何運用基礎程式技巧操作簡單的人工智慧工具，啟發其對未來應用的興趣與想像。無論未來是否從事程式相關工作，本課程都將奠定學生跨領域運用數位能力的基礎。
description.en: Programming has become one of the most fundamental and essential skills across all fields. Having basic programming knowledge not only enhances logical thinking and problem-solving abilities, but also serves as an entry point to understanding modern technology. This course uses Python as the primary teaching language and starts from the ground up, guiding students through core concepts such as variables, conditional statements, loops, functions, and data structures. Through hands-on exercises, students will strengthen their understanding of programming logic and structure. In addition, the course includes an introductory module on AI applications, allowing students to explore how basic programming skills can be used to operate simple artificial intelligence tools, sparking their interest and imagination for future applications. Regardless of whether students pursue a programming-related career, this course provides a solid foundation for applying digital skills across disciplines.

description.en: The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA) 6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine

syllabi.outline: This course introduces the fundamental concepts of digital logic design with a focus on applications relevant to semiconductor process and equipment engineering. Topics include number systems, Boolean algebra, logic minimisation, combinational circuits, sequential circuits, registers, counters, and finite state machines. Throughout the course, concepts are connected to real equipment scenarios including sensor signal processing, threshold alarms, safety interlocks, process sequence control, and equipment start/stop logic. The course is designed for first-year students without prior electronics or programming background; emphasis is placed on building intuition and practical understanding rather than mathematical derivation.

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five areas: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to let students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

description.zh: 本課程在介紹及闡述化學原理及物質之性質，強調現代化學理論及概念之導入。介紹的內容包括有效數位、氣體、計量化學、原子結構、化學鍵、物質狀態改變、合成的高分子材料、熱力學、化學平衡、酸鹼理論與氧化還原反應、核化學。
description.en: -The course is to introduce the principles of chemistry and the properties of matter with emphasis on modern chemical theory and conceptual problems. Individual topics include significant figures, gas, stoichiometry, atomic structure, chemical bonding, and the states of matter, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, thermodynamic, chemical equilibrium, acid-base theory and oxidation-reduction reactions, nuclear chemistry.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，培養學生邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習微積分及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.多項式，2.不等式及其應用，3.直角坐標及函數，4.三角函數及其應用，5.複數，6.平面之圓錐曲線，7.指數及對數函數，8.向量，9.矩陣，10.三度空間的基本觀念，11.數列與級數，12.排列組合與機率。
description.en: The course aims at: developing comprehension of algebra, trigonometry, analytical geometry, activating capabilities of logic inference and induction, enlightening confidence and independence, strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and graph, furnishing a sound basis for future specialty including Calculus. The content includes: 1.Polynomial, 2.Inequalities and its Application, 3.Rectangular Coordinate System and Functions, 4.Trigonometric Functions and its Application , 5.Complex Numbers, 6.Conic Section, 7. Exponential and Logarithmic Functions, 8.Vectors, 9.Matrix, 10.Elementary Concept of Three Dimensional Space, 11.Sequences and Series, 12.Permutation, Combination and Probability.

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出的方式帶領學生了解發生在生活週遭的故事，自大架構的歷史發展出發，以物質文化、日常生活、宗教祭儀、農村發展、都市變遷等不同面向的人事物作為案例分析與討論，同時搭配人文地理學相關概念，包含地方感、文化地景、區域發展等，使學生理解人文與環境之間的互動關係，進而對於當代社會樣貌能有更深入的觀察與認識。
description.en: This course introduces different concepts of history and geography. Case studies related to material culture, daily life, religious ceremonies, rural and urban transition are offered for understanding the historical connections between human being and environment. Some geographical concepts, includes sense of place, cultural landscape, regional development are also applied in this course to help students to examine the relationship between history and geography, and culture and nature.

syllabi.outline: 本課程第一部份探討的是以「人」為主體論述的歷史。從個人、家族、學校、地方到國家這五部分，介紹相關的歷史材料與重要事件，引導學生了解自己的文化根源，進而建立自我認同，並培養學生分析問題、建構知識體系的能力。 第二部份則以飲食、服飾、建築、交通與科技這五主題，讓學生得以接觸多元文化下的歷史發展，且能從中激發對於歷史人文的興趣，進而主動關注當下社會議題。

description.zh: 本課程目的在啟發學生英語聽力，分析及思辨能力。本課程自報紙，雜誌及電視選取豐富的教材, 以訓練聽力及筆記的技巧。 此外，在課堂上將討論一些有爭議性的或者有趣的議題，以培養學生獨立思辨能力。
description.en: The course aims to develop the student's listening techniques and critical thinking in English. A variety of texts will be selected from newspapers, magazines and T.V. to reinforce listening training and note-taking skills. Besides, some controversial or interesting issues will be discussed in class to encourage the student's independent and critical thinking.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。
本國語文課程以《世說新語》為主要文本，這部由南朝劉義慶編撰的經典筆記小說，內容涵蓋魏晉南北朝時期的逸聞軼事與人物風貌。通過閱讀、分析和討論，學生將深入了解魏晉風度、清談文化以及個人與社會價值觀的演變，並認識《世說新語》的文學價值及其對後世的影響，並從人物性格，理解個人生命發展。

extra.彈性學習(17-18週): 本課程依循「16＋2週」彈性教學精神，前16週完成極限、導數、導數應用、積分及微積分基本定理等核心內容，第17至18週規劃「微積分生活與工程應用專題」，引導學生整合知識並解決實際問題。第17週由教師介紹包裝材料最佳化、拋射物運動、邊際成本與最大利潤、車輛速度與累積路程、水槽注排水、藥物濃度、人口成長、工程量及不規則面積估算等案例。學生分組選定主題，設定變數、單位與合理假設，將生活或工程情境轉換為函數模型，再運用導數、最佳化、定積分或數值積分進行分析。各組可使用Desmos、GeoGebra、Excel、Python或生成式AI繪製圖形、整理資料及驗證結果，並從公式、定義域、單位與現實合理性等方面查核數位工具所產生的答案。第18週進行分組成果發表與即時答詢，各組須說明問題背景、建模方法、計算過程、驗證結果、實際意義及模型限制，並繳交簡報、專題報告、計算與AI查核紀錄及組員分工表。評量項目包含課堂參與、模型合理性、計算正確性、工具應用、口頭表達及學習反思，以培養學生的數學建模、批判思考、團隊合作、數位素養與溝通能力，理解微積分是分析現象與支持決策的重要工具。

extra.學習成果:
完成本階段彈性學習後，學生預期能從日常生活、商業管理或工程現象中發現可運用數學分析的問題，並將抽象的微積分知識轉化為具體的解決策略。在認知層面，學生能理解變化率、累積量、極值與近似值的意義，辨別不同問題所需要的分析方法，而非僅依賴公式套用。在實作層面，學生能依據資料與條件進行推理，檢查計算結果、變數範圍及單位是否合理，並利用圖形、表格或數值結果支持自己的論點。面對數位工具或生成式AI提供的答案，學生能保持批判態度，透過人工計算、圖形觀察與多種方法交叉比對，辨識可能出現的錯誤、遺漏或不合理結論，進而修正並提出有根據的判斷。

在合作與表達方面，學生能與組員分配任務、整合不同意見並共同完成成果，清楚說明分析過程與主要發現，也能針對他人的提問給予適當回應。透過同儕觀摩與自我反思，學生能比較不同解題方法的優缺點，了解數學答案不一定能完全代表真實情況，並認識資料品質、簡化條件及外在因素對結果的影響。最終，學生能建立主動探索、合理質疑與自主查證的學習態度，提升邏輯推理、問題解決、數位應用、團隊合作及溝通表達等綜合能力，並將這些能力延伸至後續專業課程及實際情境之中。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 以C語言為主的電腦應用程式設計，內容包含1. C程式概觀 2. 資料型態 3. 格式化輸入輸出 4. 運算子 5. 選擇敘述（ if-else敘述，switch敘述） 6. 迴圈（for, while, do while） 7. 函式與儲存類別（函數的資料傳遞，外部變數）8. 陣列（含字元陣列）9. 指標 10.字串 11.結構與聯集 12.檔案（標準I/O，記錄I/O，隨機存取）10.人工智慧導論及AI之工業應用
description.en: Computer programming using C language programming: topics including 1. Introduction of C language, 2. Basic Data Type, 3. Format, input and output, 4. Operator, 5. Statement (if-else, goto or switch statement), 6. Loop (for, while and do while), 7. Statements of subprograms (Parameters Called by Value and Address), 8. Array (including character array), 9. Pointer, 10. String, 11. Structure and Union, 12. Files (Input/Output) 10. Introduction of AI in industrial applications

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。
本國語文課程以《世說新語》為主要文本，這部由南朝劉義慶編撰的經典筆記小說，內容涵蓋魏晉南北朝時期的逸聞軼事與人物風貌。通過閱讀、分析和討論，學生將深入了解魏晉風度、清談文化以及個人與社會價值觀的演變，並認識《世說新語》的文學價值及其對後世的影響，並從人物性格，理解個人生命發展。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

syllabi.outline:
大學入門與工程倫理課程旨在協助大一新生順利適應大學生活與學習環境，建立正確的學習態度、專業認同及生涯規劃觀念，並培養自主學習與終身學習能力。課程內容涵蓋高等教育的理念、目的與價值，引導學生認識大學教育的內涵與學習方式，了解如何運用校園資源、規劃學習目標、提升學習成效，以及培養時間管理、溝通表達、團隊合作與問題解決等核心能力。同時，課程亦將介紹電機工程領域的發展趨勢、產業現況及未來職涯方向，協助學生建立專業認同感，並透過專題講座、學長姐經驗分享、實驗室參訪及多元學習活動，拓展學生視野，培養跨領域學習與自我成長能力。藉由本課程之學習，引導學生實踐自我探索、自我管理、自我經營與生涯規劃，進而建立宏觀視野與積極進取的人生態度。
此外，本課程亦融入工程倫理教育，使學生了解工程師在專業實務中所應承擔之責任與義務。課程將介紹工程倫理之基本概念、工程師專業守則及倫理決策原則，並探討工程技術對社會、環境、公共安全與永續發展之影響。透過工程倫理案例分析與討論，引導學生思考工程實務中可能遭遇之倫理衝突與價值抉擇，培養誠信、公正、負責與尊重生命安全之專業態度，建立工程師應具備之社會責任感與倫理判斷能力。期望學生於修習完成後，不僅能具備良好的大學學習能力與專業發展規劃，更能成為兼具專業知識、倫理素養與社會關懷之工程人才。
Introduction to University Life and Engineering Ethics is designed to help first-year students successfully adapt to university life and establish a strong foundation for academic achievement, professional development, and lifelong learning. The course introduces the philosophy, objectives, and values of higher education, helping students understand the nature of university learning and develop effective study habits. Topics include academic planning, self-directed learning, time management, communication skills, teamwork, problem-solving abilities, and the effective use of campus resources. The course also provides an overview of the development trends, industrial applications, and career opportunities in Electrical Engineering, enabling students to develop professional identity and career awareness. Through invited lectures, senior student sharing sessions, laboratory visits, and various learning activities, students will broaden their perspectives and strengthen their interdisciplinary learning capabilities and personal growth.
In addition, the course incorporates engineering ethics education to help students understand the professional responsibilities and obligations of engineers. Topics include the fundamental concepts of engineering ethics, professional codes of conduct, ethical decision-making principles, and the impact of engineering technologies on society, the environment, public safety, and sustainable development. Through discussions and analyses of real-world engineering cases, students will explore ethical conflicts and value-based decision-making processes commonly encountered in engineering practice. The course aims to cultivate integrity, fairness, accountability, and respect for public welfare and safety while fostering ethical reasoning and social responsibility. Upon completion of the course, students are expected to possess not only effective university learning skills and career development awareness but also the ethical mindset and social consciousness required of future engineering professionals.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.en:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Number representation, number bases and base conversions, and binary codes
2. Boolean algebra and functions, canonical forms
3. Combinational design techniques: K-maps, tabulation method
4. Combinational logic circuits: adders/subtractors, comparators, multiplexors/demultiplexors, and decoders/encoders
5. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA)
6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數，12.常微分方程。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes : 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series, 12.Ordinary Differential Equation.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:
本課程涵蓋以下主題：
1.數字的進制轉換以及二進制表示方式
2.布林代數式與函數
3.數位電路化簡技巧，如卡諾圖與製表法
4.組合邏輯電路，如：加法器/減法器、比較器、多工器、邊/解碼器
5.可編程邏輯電路，如：唯讀記憶體/可編程唯讀記憶體（ROM / PROM）、可編程邏輯電路（PLD）、可編程邏輯陣列（PLA）
6.順序邏輯電路，如：狀態機
description.en:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Number representation, number bases and base conversions, and binary codes
2. Boolean algebra and functions, canonical forms
3. Combinational design techniques: K-maps, tabulation method
4. Combinational logic circuits: adders/subtractors, comparators, multiplexors/demultiplexors, and decoders/encoders
5. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA)
6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數，12.常微分方程。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes : 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series, 12.Ordinary Differential Equation.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.en:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Number representation, number bases and base conversions, and binary codes
2. Boolean algebra and functions, canonical forms
3. Combinational design techniques: K-maps, tabulation method
4. Combinational logic circuits: adders/subtractors, comparators, multiplexors/demultiplexors, and decoders/encoders
5. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA)
6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。

description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

extra.彈性學習(17-18週): 本課程依循「16＋2週」彈性教學精神，前16週完成極限、導數、導數應用、積分及微積分基本定理等核心內容，第17至18週規劃「微積分生活與工程應用專題」，引導學生整合知識並解決實際問題。第17週由教師介紹包裝材料最佳化、拋射物運動、邊際成本與最大利潤、車輛速度與累積路程、水槽注排水、藥物濃度、人口成長、工程量及不規則面積估算等案例。學生分組選定主題，設定變數、單位與合理假設，將生活或工程情境轉換為函數模型，再運用導數、最佳化、定積分或數值積分進行分析。各組可使用Desmos、GeoGebra、Excel、Python或生成式AI繪製圖形、整理資料及驗證結果，並從公式、定義域、單位與現實合理性等方面查核數位工具所產生的答案。第18週進行分組成果發表與即時答詢，各組須說明問題背景、建模方法、計算過程、驗證結果、實際意義及模型限制，並繳交簡報、專題報告、計算與AI查核紀錄及組員分工表。評量項目包含課堂參與、模型合理性、計算正確性、工具應用、口頭表達及學習反思，以培養學生的數學建模、批判思考、團隊合作、數位素養與溝通能力，理解微積分是分析現象與支持決策的重要工具。

extra.學習成果:
完成本階段彈性學習後，學生預期能從日常生活、商業管理或工程現象中發現可運用數學分析的問題，並將抽象的微積分知識轉化為具體的解決策略。在認知層面，學生能理解變化率、累積量、極值與近似值的意義，辨別不同問題所需要的分析方法，而非僅依賴公式套用。在實作層面，學生能依據資料與條件進行推理，檢查計算結果、變數範圍及單位是否合理，並利用圖形、表格或數值結果支持自己的論點。面對數位工具或生成式AI提供的答案，學生能保持批判態度，透過人工計算、圖形觀察與多種方法交叉比對，辨識可能出現的錯誤、遺漏或不合理結論，進而修正並提出有根據的判斷。

在合作與表達方面，學生能與組員分配任務、整合不同意見並共同完成成果，清楚說明分析過程與主要發現，也能針對他人的提問給予適當回應。透過同儕觀摩與自我反思，學生能比較不同解題方法的優缺點，了解數學答案不一定能完全代表真實情況，並認識資料品質、簡化條件及外在因素對結果的影響。最終，學生能建立主動探索、合理質疑與自主查證的學習態度，提升邏輯推理、問題解決、數位應用、團隊合作及溝通表達等綜合能力，並將這些能力延伸至後續專業課程及實際情境之中。

description.en: Following the progress of the course of chemistry biology,introduce chemical engineering students to learn basically operations and techniques for several kinds of devices. Scheduling laboratory experiments include the determination of COD, the determination of molar nitrogen volume, the synthesis of complex, the determination of redox titration, vapor pressure, the determination the solubility, rates of chemical reactions, chemical equilibrium, and the preparation of Nylon-6, 6, Bradford Analysis of Protein Quantification, Bacteria Growth curve measurement and Serial Dilution, DNA Polymerase Chain Reactions, Plasmid isolation and restrictions. This course is designed to train students how to use their brain and hands simultaneously and to settle down their science concepts.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。
description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc

syllabi.outline:
本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.
