name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline:
CALCULUS (I):
This course aims at developing comprehension of derivation and integral、activating capabilities of logic inference and induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content of Calculus(I)
includes: 1.Functions and Models, 2.Limits and Derivatives, 3.Differentiation Rules, 4.Applications of Differentiation, 5.Integrals, 6.Applications of integration, 7.Techniques of integration  8. Futher Applications of Integration, 9.Parametric equations and polar coordinates  10. Sequences, Series, and Power series, 11.Vectors and the geometry of space 12.Partial derivatives 13.Multiple integrals

description.zh: 介紹單位換算與有效數位，元素的原子結構、化學方程式平衡與計算，反應熱，氣體與氣體定律，大氣層與環境污染，週期表，化學鍵，化合物的分子結構，熱力學，動力學，反應機構，平衡常數，氧化與還原，酸鹼反應，電化學，混合物的分離及現代科技材料，奠定良好化學基礎。
description.en: The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.

description.zh: 配合化學及生物學課程之進展，教導學生學習各項基本實驗操作及儀器設備之技巧，進行各項實驗課程，如COD 的測定，氮莫耳體積之測定，錯合物之生成，氧化還原滴定，蒸汽壓，測量溶解度，反應速率，化學平衡，耐綸-6,6之製備，蛋白質標準定量法，微生物生長曲線測量及微生物序列稀釋，DNA複製連鎖反應，質體分離及輿圖鑑定以訓練學生養成手腦並用的務實科學素養。
description.en: Following the progress of the course of chemistry biology,introduce chemical engineering students to learn basically operations and techniques for several kinds of devices. Scheduling laboratory experiments include the determination of COD, the determination of molar nitrogen volume, the synthesis of complex, the determination of redox titration, vapor pressure, the determination the solubility, rates of chemical reactions, chemical equilibrium, and the preparation of Nylon-6, 6, Bradford Analysis of Protein Quantification, Bacteria Growth curve measurement and Serial Dilution, DNA Polymerase Chain Reactions, Plasmid isolation and restrictions. This course is designed to train students how to use their brain and hands simultaneously and to settle down their science concepts.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。
description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc

syllabi.outline:
本課程為一學期制普通物理，專為無微積分背景，工程科系方向之同學設計，目的在引導學生探索自然現象之基本法則，並為爾後修習專業課程奠定堅實基礎。課程內容包含力學（運動學、牛頓運動定律、功與能、動量）、流體力學、熱力學（溫度、理想氣體、熱力學定律、熱機與熵）、電磁學（靜電、電路、電磁感應與發電原理）、光學及近代物理概論。

教學以講授為主，輔以問題導向之單元設計、科學史案例，及線上互動模擬實驗（PhET），以「預測—觀察—解釋」方式引導概念推理。報告作業允許並規範生成式人工智慧之使用，以訓練學生之查證與批判能力；考試不得使用人工智慧工具。

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.en: The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introductory course designed to provide undergraduate students with a foundation in the fundamental principles of chemistry. This course covers atomic and molecular structure, chemical reactions, stoichiometry, thermochemistry, the physical state of matter, thermodynamics, and kinetics. In the course, students will explore the properties of matter, the behavior of elements and compounds, and the laws governing chemical reactions. They will also develop an understanding of the scientific method and the role of experimentation in the study of chemistry. By the end of the course, students should have a solid understanding of the principles and concepts of chemistry since General Chemistry is a prerequisite for many higher-level courses in chemistry.

description.en: Following the progress of the course of chemistry biology,introduce chemical engineering students to learn basically operations and techniques for several kinds of devices. Scheduling laboratory experiments include the determination of COD, the determination of molar nitrogen volume, the synthesis of complex, the determination of redox titration, vapor pressure, the determination the solubility, rates of chemical reactions, chemical equilibrium, and the preparation of Nylon-6, 6, Bradford Analysis of Protein Quantification, Bacteria Growth curve measurement and Serial Dilution, DNA Polymerase Chain Reactions, Plasmid isolation and restrictions. This course is designed to train students how to use their brain and hands simultaneously and to settle down their science concepts.

description.en: The course introduces basic computer concept, AI-related applications and programming technique. The contents include data types, flow control, functions, subroutine, arrays, strings, files, neural networks, deep learning and their applications.

syllabi.outline:
This course focuses on understanding the algorithms behind programming solutions rather than the syntax of any specific programming language. Students will learn how to conceptualize, develop, and implement algorithms to solve engineering problems using a dual-language approach. Fortran will be used to introduce algorithmic fundamentals, while Python—generated and explored through ChatGPT—will demonstrate how logical structures can be adapted across languages.

A key emphasis of this course is cultivating literacy in using Generative AI tools, especially ChatGPT, for programming. Students will learn how to prompt ChatGPT effectively, interpret and critique AI-generated code, and use it as a tool to accelerate their understanding of computational thinking. The course aims to empower students to confidently build adaptable, reliable solutions for engineering applications, especially those involving data analysis, simulation, and visualization.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
本課程專為工程與材料科系背景學生規劃。主要目的有二：一是協助學生理解物理基本定律，建立微觀結構與巨觀性質之物理概念；二是提供往後修習核心專業課程之基礎能力。本學期課程內容聚焦於古典力學，並延伸至波動與幾何光學（含光學薄膜與介面行為）。課程內容將按照實際教學需求、學生微積分進度，加強或節略某些章節。
授課教師保留依實際教學現況、學生學習成效、設備狀態及不可抗力因素，適度調整評分方式、比例與課程內容之最終權利。

description.zh: 本課程提供給一般工程學科，學習化學原理及物質之性質，著重於現代化學理論及觀念之介紹。包括：原子之電子組態、原子週期表、化學鍵結、動力學、酸鹼平衡、金屬與非金屬元素、有機分子、狀態之改變、合成高分子、電化學、未來的能源。
description.en: The course is a general survey of principles of chemistry and properties of matter of general interest to the engineer. They are explained in terms of modern chemical theory with emphasis on conceptual problems. The selected topics include gas phase, the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, kinetics, acid base equilibrium, the chemistry of metallic and nonmetallic elements, and organic molecules, the change of states, synthetic polymers materials, electrochemistry, energy sources for the future.

syllabi.outline: A brief introduction of general chemistry and chemical reactions, covering atomic structure and bonding, quantitative chemistry, gas, thermodynamics, kinetics, etc. In addition to the basic principles of chemistry, this course will focus on letting students understand the relationship between chemistry and daily life.

description.zh: 配合化學課程之進展，教導學生學習各項基本實驗操作及儀器設備之技巧，進行各項實驗課程，如COD 的測定，氮莫耳體積之測定，錯合物之生成，氧化還原滴定，蒸汽壓，測量溶解度，反應速率，化學平衡，耐綸-6,6之製備以訓練學生養成手腦並用的務實科學素養。
description.en: Following the progress of the course of chemistry, introduce chemical engineering students to learn basically operations and techniques for several kinds of devices. Scheduling laboratory experiments include the determination of COD, the determination of molar nitrogen volume, the synthesis of complex, the determination of redox titration, vapor pressure, the determination the solubility, rates of chemical reactions, chemical equilibrium, and the preparation of Nylon-6, 6. This course is designed to train students how to use their brain and hands simultaneously and to settle down their science concepts.

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。
description.en: This course is a basic topics of  Materials Science.

description.zh: 本課程主要在提供學生有關計算機系統之基本知識及應用。授課內容包括：1.電腦的演進  2 .電腦的硬體架構(內部組件、中央處理機及主記憶體、輸出入裝置、資料儲存媒介與裝置)  3. 電腦的軟體(電腦系統概述、作業系統、資料組織與檔案處理、程式語言簡介、程式設計與軟體開發、資訊系統設計與發展程序)  4.計算機的應用。
description.en: This introductory course covers the fundamentals and applications of computers, including, 1.the evolution of  computers, 2.computer hardware structure , 3.computer software & applications.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將作為大一學生入學後第一門程式語言奠基課程，旨在提供學生們了解程式設計的基礎，並探索其與人工智慧的關聯。除了傳授基本的程式設計概念外，我們還將探討人工智慧在程式設計中的應用與意義。課程內容將包括電腦運作概念、程式設計原則、分支敘述、迴圈敘述、輸出輸入敘述、陣列處理、字元處理以及子程式等關鍵課題。同時，我們將特別強調人工智慧對於程式設計的重要性，以及它如何影響我們如何思考、解決問題和開發軟體。透過本課程的學習，學生們將能夠建立堅實的程式設計基礎，並了解人工智慧在這個領域中的關鍵作用。
This course serves as the first foundational programming language course for first-year students, aiming to provide them with a comprehensive understanding of the basics of programming and explore its relationship with artificial intelligence. In addition to imparting fundamental programming concepts, we will delve into the applications and significance of artificial intelligence in programming. The course will cover key topics such as computer operation concepts, programming principles, conditional statements, loop statements, input/output statements, array processing, character processing, and subroutines. Simultaneously, we will emphasize artificial intelligence's importance in programming and how it influences our thinking, problem-solving approaches, and software development. Through this course, students can establish a solid foundation in programming and grasp the pivotal role of artificial intelligence in this field.

Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

extra.彈性學習(17-18週): 本課程依循「16＋2週」彈性教學精神，前16週完成極限、導數、導數應用、積分及微積分基本定理等核心內容，第17至18週規劃「微積分生活與工程應用專題」，引導學生整合知識並解決實際問題。第17週由教師介紹包裝材料最佳化、拋射物運動、邊際成本與最大利潤、車輛速度與累積路程、水槽注排水、藥物濃度、人口成長、工程量及不規則面積估算等案例。學生分組選定主題，設定變數、單位與合理假設，將生活或工程情境轉換為函數模型，再運用導數、最佳化、定積分或數值積分進行分析。各組可使用Desmos、GeoGebra、Excel、Python或生成式AI繪製圖形、整理資料及驗證結果，並從公式、定義域、單位與現實合理性等方面查核數位工具所產生的答案。第18週進行分組成果發表與即時答詢，各組須說明問題背景、建模方法、計算過程、驗證結果、實際意義及模型限制，並繳交簡報、專題報告、計算與AI查核紀錄及組員分工表。評量項目包含課堂參與、模型合理性、計算正確性、工具應用、口頭表達及學習反思，以培養學生的數學建模、批判思考、團隊合作、數位素養與溝通能力，理解微積分是分析現象與支持決策的重要工具。

● 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用(AI-assisted learning and tool application)
extra.內容: 本課程依循「16＋2週」彈性教學精神，前16週完成極限、導數、導數應用、積分及微積分基本定理等核心內容，第17至18週規劃「微積分生活與工程應用專題」，引導學生整合知識並解決實際問題。第17週由教師介紹包裝材料最佳化、拋射物運動、邊際成本與最大利潤、車輛速度與累積路程、水槽注排水、藥物濃度、人口成長、工程量及不規則面積估算等案例。學生分組選定主題，設定變數、單位與合理假設，將生活或工程情境轉換為函數模型，再運用導數、最佳化、定積分或數值積分進行分析。各組可使用Desmos、GeoGebra、Excel、Python或生成式AI繪製圖形、整理資料及驗證結果，並從公式、定義域、單位與現實合理性等方面查核數位工具所產生的答案。第18週進行分組成果發表與即時答詢，各組須說明問題背景、建模方法、計算過程、驗證結果、實際意義及模型限制，並繳交簡報、專題報告、計算與AI查核紀錄及組員分工表。評量項目包含課堂參與、模型合理性、計算正確性、工具應用、口頭表達及學習反思，以培養學生的數學建模、批判思考、團隊合作、數位素養與溝通能力，理解微積分是分析現象與支持決策的重要工具。
extra.學習成果:
完成本階段彈性學習後，學生預期能從日常生活、商業管理或工程現象中發現可運用數學分析的問題，並將抽象的微積分知識轉化為具體的解決策略。在認知層面，學生能理解變化率、累積量、極值與近似值的意義，辨別不同問題所需要的分析方法，而非僅依賴公式套用。在實作層面，學生能依據資料與條件進行推理，檢查計算結果、變數範圍及單位是否合理，並利用圖形、表格或數值結果支持自己的論點。面對數位工具或生成式AI提供的答案，學生能保持批判態度，透過人工計算、圖形觀察與多種方法交叉比對，辨識可能出現的錯誤、遺漏或不合理結論，進而修正並提出有根據的判斷。

在合作與表達方面，學生能與組員分配任務、整合不同意見並共同完成成果，清楚說明分析過程與主要發現，也能針對他人的提問給予適當回應。透過同儕觀摩與自我反思，學生能比較不同解題方法的優缺點，了解數學答案不一定能完全代表真實情況，並認識資料品質、簡化條件及外在因素對結果的影響。最終，學生能建立主動探索、合理質疑與自主查證的學習態度，提升邏輯推理、問題解決、數位應用、團隊合作及溝通表達等綜合能力，並將這些能力延伸至後續專業課程及實際情境之中。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline: 這是專為材料科系背景之同學設計的物理課程，由於材料性質是由材料內部結構決定, 老師會花一年的時間, 將材料系學生應該要知道的近代物理知識介紹給同學, (上學期)課程前半部主要著重在近代物理發展史,  量子力學簡介, 基本粒子介紹, 電子結構與原子間作用力, (下學期)課程則著重在化學鍵是如何建構出自然界的材料, 不同的材料其電性/導熱性/光學性質的成因, 最後會介紹物理最重要的光學現象(繞射)如何應用在材料科學領域中的結構分析

description.en: The course is a general survey of principles of chemistry and properties of matter of general interest to the engineer. They are explained in terms of modern chemical theory with emphasis on conceptual problems. The selected topics include gas phase, the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, kinetics, acid base equilibrium, the chemistry of metallic and nonmetallic elements, and organic molecules, the change of states, synthetic polymers materials, electrochemistry, energy sources for the future.

description.en: Following the progress of the course of chemistry, introduce chemical engineering students to learn basically operations and techniques for several kinds of devices. Scheduling laboratory experiments include the determination of COD, the determination of molar nitrogen volume, the synthesis of complex, the determination of redox titration, vapor pressure, the determination the solubility, rates of chemical reactions, chemical equilibrium, and the preparation of Nylon-6, 6. This course is designed to train students how to use their brain and hands simultaneously and to settle down their science concepts.

description.zh: 本課程包括：緒論、物質和原子學說、礦物和岩石、火成岩和岩漿 活動、沉積岩和沉積作用、變質岩和變質作用、風化和土壤、火山 作用、地質時間、塊體運動、河流、地下水、沙漠和風的作用、冰 川和冰川作用等。
description.en: Geology is a study of the planet Earth. It is concerned with the origin of the planet, the material and morphology of the Earth, and its history and present forms. Contents include : science and the world we live in, a view of the earth, the dynamic earth, materials of the earth's crust (atom and minerals), igneous rocks (volcanic and plutonic), sedimentary rocks, pages of earth history, tectonic features (folds and faults), life as a fuel maker (coal and oil), salt domes, metamorphism and metamorphic rocks, igneous intrusions, volcanoes and their products, dating and pages of earth history, rock weathering and soils, surface erosion and landscape slopes, the work of rivers, development of river systems and associated landscapes, underground water, glaciers and glaciation, ice ages and climate change, wind action and desert landscapes.

syllabi.outline: 緒論、物質和原子學說、礦物和岩石、火成岩和岩漿活動、沉積岩和沉積作用、變質岩和變質作用、風化和土壤、火山作用、地質時間、塊體運動、河流、地下水、沙漠和風的作用、冰川和冰川作用、海洋、海岸之地質作用、地震、地球之內部、地殼變動、大陸和山脈、能源和能源礦產、地球之資源、板塊構造學說、地球和太陽系等。

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline: This course is intended to deliver a fundamental knowledge about the principles of mechanics based on which most of the professional and advanced courses in civil engineering were developed. Main topics will include vectors and scalars, motion in one and two dimensions, the Newton’s laws of motion, work and energy, conservation of energy, linear and angular momentum, oscillatory motion, mechanical waves, fluid mechanics, temperature and the kinetic theory of gases, the laws of thermodynamics, etc.

description.zh: 使學生認知測量是各項工程建設的一項重要基礎性先行的工作，使能適應各項測量外業觀測、內業計算及繪圖等作業。課程概要如下：1)測量之基本概念、(2)各種測量儀器的認識與使用、(3)控制測量（括三角、三邊導線高程等)之施測方法及計算、(4)地形圖及地籍圖之測及應用、(5)各項工程放樣測量。

syllabi.outline: 測量學是各項工程建設的重要基礎性先行工作，然而在近年資通訊與光電產業發展下，高度數位化也帶來了許多產業上的變革。本課程即是透過室內教學以及外業實習相互論證，學生實地接觸到新型數位測量儀器與技術，以輔助傳統測量理論的學習，進而理解整體測量輪廓。學習目標定為學生可以在精度需求與實務規範下，規劃且執行一合宜的基本測量業務。

name.zh: 人工智慧導論與程式語言
name.en: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Programming Languages

description.zh: 本課程將作為大一學生入學後第一門程式語言奠基課程，旨在提供學生們了解程式設計的基礎，並探索其與人工智慧的關聯。除了傳授基本的程式設計概念外，我們還將探討人工智慧在程式設計中的應用與意義。課程內容將包括電腦運作概念、程式設計原則、分支敘述、迴圈敘述、輸出輸入敘述、陣列處理、字元處理以及子程式等關鍵課題。同時，我們將特別強調人工智慧對於程式設計的重要性，以及它如何影響我們如何思考、解決問題和開發軟體。透過本課程的學習，學生們將能夠建立堅實的程式設計基礎，並了解人工智慧在這個領域中的關鍵作用。
description.en: This course serves as the first foundational programming language course for first-year students, aiming to provide them with a comprehensive understanding of the basics of programming and explore its relationship with artificial intelligence. In addition to imparting fundamental programming concepts, we will delve into the applications and significance of artificial intelligence in programming. The course will cover key topics such as computer operation concepts, programming principles, conditional statements, loop statements, input/output statements, array processing, character processing, and subroutines. Simultaneously, we will emphasize artificial intelligence's importance in programming and how it influences our thinking, problem-solving approaches, and software development. Through this course, students can establish a solid foundation in programming and grasp the pivotal role of artificial intelligence in this field.

name.zh: 土木與環境暨基本實作
name.en: Civil Engineering,  Environment and Model Design

description.zh: 本課程除介紹土木工程的基本領域，如結構工程、大地工程、營建管理、生態與防災、水資源與水利工程、空間資訊、環境工程等外，亦強調環境生態、環境與人文等社會層面的議題，更著重於土木工程與環境的關係，期使未來在土木建設之際，亦能瞭解環境、尊重生態及朝永續利用的目標努力。另本課程亦強調訓練學生團隊合作、設計構想與動手實作能力，藉由課堂所學基本土木工程知識，利用簡易材料與設備再以電腦軟體輔助，自行構思、設計與製作土木結構或設備模型，及利用既有設備測試所設計之成品。
description.en: In this course, not only professional fields of civil engineering including structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction management, ecological engineering and disaster prevention, water resources and hydraulic engineering, and spatial information are introduced, but also environmental, ecological, societal, and cultural issues are emphasized. The most important point is focused on the relationship between civil engineering and environment such that students who take this course can understand environment, appreciate ecology, and pursue sustainable development when they are engaged in civil engineering construction in future. In addition, training of team works and ability to think, design, and carry out a plan by hand are emphasized. Students can plan, design, fabricate, and test a structural model using available material, equipment, and computer-aid software based on knowledge learned from fundamental civil engineering courses.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. syllabi.outline: This is an introductory physics covering principles of mechanics, i.e., statics and dynamics; work and energy, conservation laws, waves, sound, temperature, heat transfer and thermodynamics. The course objectives include: 1.) A calculus based survey course of basic physics principles. 2.) Resolve a system of forces as they relate to the dynamics of motion. 3.) Explain Newton’s Laws of Motion and apply them in the analyses of problems. 4.) Apply the principles of motion and conduct controlled experiments. 5.) Solve problems and demonstrate the application of the scientific method.

name.zh: 人工智慧導論與程式語言
name.en: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Programming Languages

description.zh: 本課程將作為大一學生入學後第一門程式語言奠基課程，旨在提供學生們了解程式設計的基礎，並探索其與人工智慧的關聯。除了傳授基本的程式設計概念外，我們還將探討人工智慧在程式設計中的應用與意義。課程內容將包括電腦運作概念、程式設計原則、分支敘述、迴圈敘述、輸出輸入敘述、陣列處理、字元處理以及子程式等關鍵課題。同時，我們將特別強調人工智慧對於程式設計的重要性，以及它如何影響我們如何思考、解決問題和開發軟體。透過本課程的學習，學生們將能夠建立堅實的程式設計基礎，並了解人工智慧在這個領域中的關鍵作用。
description.en: This course serves as the first foundational programming language course for first-year students, aiming to provide them with a comprehensive understanding of the basics of programming and explore its relationship with artificial intelligence. In addition to imparting fundamental programming concepts, we will delve into the applications and significance of artificial intelligence in programming. The course will cover key topics such as computer operation concepts, programming principles, conditional statements, loop statements, input/output statements, array processing, character processing, and subroutines. Simultaneously, we will emphasize artificial intelligence's importance in programming and how it influences our thinking, problem-solving approaches, and software development. Through this course, students can establish a solid foundation in programming and grasp the pivotal role of artificial intelligence in this field.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將做為大一學生入學後第一門程式語言奠基課程，作為程式設計的基礎。教授內容包括電腦運作概念、程式設計原則、分支敘述、迴圈敘述、輸出、輸入敘述、陣列處理、字元處理、及子程式等課題。本課程並介紹 AI 基本原理與程式應用。

name.zh: 土木與環境暨基本實作
name.en: Civil Engineering,  Environment and Model Design

description.zh: 本課程除介紹土木工程的基本領域，如結構工程、大地工程、營建管理、生態與防災、水資源與水利工程、空間資訊、環境工程等外，亦強調環境生態、環境與人文等社會層面的議題，更著重於土木工程與環境的關係，期使未來在土木建設之際，亦能瞭解環境、尊重生態及朝永續利用的目標努力。另本課程亦強調訓練學生團隊合作、設計構想與動手實作能力，藉由課堂所學基本土木工程知識，利用簡易材料與設備再以電腦軟體輔助，自行構思、設計與製作土木結構或設備模型，及利用既有設備測試所設計之成品。
description.en: In this course, not only professional fields of civil engineering including structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction management, ecological engineering and disaster prevention, water resources and hydraulic engineering, and spatial information are introduced, but also environmental, ecological, societal, and cultural issues are emphasized. The most important point is focused on the relationship between civil engineering and environment such that students who take this course can understand environment, appreciate ecology, and pursue sustainable development when they are engaged in civil engineering construction in future. In addition, training of team works and ability to think, design, and carry out a plan by hand are emphasized. Students can plan, design, fabricate, and test a structural model using available material, equipment, and computer-aid software based on knowledge learned from fundamental civil engineering courses.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以「北科人物故事與城市記憶」為核心，結合田野調查、報導文學與GIS故事地圖製作，引導學生從人物經驗出發，認識臺北科技大學與周邊城市空間的歷史變遷、產業記憶與地方文化。

課程將以北科相關人物為主軸，訪問畢業校友、企業經營者、教師、退休職員、在地居民、周邊店家與文史工作者，蒐集他們與北科、建國啤酒廠、光華橋、光華商場、八德路商圈及周邊社區相關的生命故事。建國啤酒廠將作為北科城市記憶的一環，呈現其曾作為學生實習場域、產業空間與地方記憶節點的歷史意義。

一、田野調查與人物專訪

學生將走入北科校園與周邊街區，透過實地觀察與人物訪談，蒐集校友求學經驗、產業發展記憶、地方生活故事與城市空間變遷資料，理解北科與臺北城市發展之間的連結。

二、報導文學寫作訓練

課程訓練學生將訪談資料、現地觀察與歷史背景，轉化為具有人物描寫、場景敘事與社會觀察的報導文學作品。期中成果以一篇人物報導為主，透過個人故事呈現北科的教育傳承、產業連結與地方記憶。

三、GIS故事地圖建置

學生將整理訪談內容、照片、歷史資料與地點座標，運用GIS工具建置「北科人物故事地圖」。地圖內容可涵蓋北科校園、建國啤酒廠、光華橋舊址、光華商場、八德路商圈、周邊老店與校友創業據點，呈現人物、事件與空間之間的關係。期末成果以GIS故事地圖作為數位敘事作品。

四、課程目標

本課程旨在培養學生田野觀察、人物訪談、報導文學寫作、GIS數位敘事與地方關懷能力。透過採訪、書寫與地圖製作，學生能從北科人物故事出發，重新理解校園、產業、社區與城市變遷之間的多重關係。

This course centers on “NTUT Personal Narratives and Urban Memory,” integrating fieldwork, reportage writing, and GIS-based story mapping. It guides students to explore the historical transformation, industrial memory, and local culture of National Taipei University of Technology and its surrounding urban spaces through personal experiences.

The course takes people associated with NTUT as its primary focus. Students will interview alumni, entrepreneurs, faculty members, retired staff, local residents, neighborhood shop owners, and cultural-history workers to collect life stories related to NTUT, Jianguo Brewery, Guanghua Bridge, Guanghua Market, the Bade Road commercial district, and nearby communities. Jianguo Brewery will be treated as one part of NTUT’s urban memory, highlighting its historical significance as a former site for student internships, an industrial space, and a locus of local memory.

**I. Fieldwork and Personal Interviews**

Students will enter the NTUT campus and surrounding neighborhoods to conduct site observations and interviews. They will collect materials on alumni experiences, memories of industrial development, local life stories, and changes in urban space, thereby understanding the connections between NTUT and Taipei’s urban development.

**II. Training in Reportage Writing**

The course trains students to transform interview materials, field observations, and historical contexts into reportage works characterized by personal portrayal, scene-based narration, and social observation. The midterm project will consist of a profile-based reportage piece that presents NTUT’s educational legacy, industrial connections, and local memory through an individual life story.

**III. GIS-Based Story Mapping**

Students will organize interview content, photographs, historical materials, and geographic coordinates to create an “NTUT Personal Narrative Story Map” using GIS tools. The map may include NTUT’s campus, Jianguo Brewery, the former site of Guanghua Bridge, Guanghua Market, the Bade Road commercial district, surrounding long-standing shops, and alumni entrepreneurial sites. It will present the relationships among people, events, and spaces. The final project will be a GIS-based story map as a form of digital narrative.

**IV. Course Objectives**

This course aims to cultivate students’ abilities in field observation, personal interviewing, reportage writing, GIS-based digital storytelling, and local engagement. 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.en: This course introduces molecular materials from chemistry point of view. It covers the following topics: structures of atoms and molecules, polymer molecules, and biochemistry.

syllabi.outline:
從最基本的科學知識進階到基礎簡單的化學反應，最後介紹當今化學的最新發展和前景。
本課程將以從延伸高中化學為起始 (Chapter 1-6),然後逐步加入量子化學(Chapter 7-11)與近代化學的熱門課題. 課程內容除了包含計量化學,量子化學,熱化學,動力學,基本生化外,也將介紹學生如何使用現有的結構化學工具(電腦軟體及資料庫)來幫助學習.(此部分將以課後作業為主).希望學生在一學期的學習,可以了解當今化學的多樣性,以便為其將來更進一步興趣鋪路.

The course will be started from the review of senior high school chemistry. Then, the modern quantum chemistry will be introduced to make students familiarized the modern chemistry approach on the interpretation of the physical chemistry phenomena in material and biological science. This includes the introduction to quantum world, Schrödinger equation, chemical bonding, molecular shape and structure and so on. Later, the thermodynamics be applied to the interpretation of  physical and chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, aqueous equilibrium and electrochemistry.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description
This course aims to provide students with a solid understanding of differential and integral calculus. It is designed to cultivate logical reasoning, inspire creative thinking, strengthen computational and deductive skills, and emphasize practical applications and graphing techniques. The goal is to build a strong mathematical foundation for future studies in engineering mathematics and related professional courses, ultimately achieving the objective of applying what is learned in real-world contexts.
Course topics include:
1.	Limits and Continuity
2.	Derivatives and Their Applications
3.	Indefinite and Definite Integrals
4.	Transcendental Functions and Their Inverses
5.	Integration Techniques
6.	Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integrals
7.	Applications of Definite Integrals
8.	Solid Geometry and Vector Calculus
9.	Partial Derivatives
10.	Multiple Integrals
11.	Series

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:
瞭解組合邏輯與序向邏輯電路之分析，設計及簡化之方法，內容包含：
１.數系：數位系統所使用之各種數系及其轉換之方法
２.布氏代數：了解布氏代數的基本運算法和定律，及認識基本邏輯   及邏輯閘
３.布氏代數之簡化：介紹各種布氏代數之簡化方法
４.組合邏輯：據布氏代數及邏輯閘，計分析各種組合邏輯電路
５.可程式邏輯陣列：介紹ＰＬＡ，ＰＡＬ，ＦＰＧＡ等之設計方法
６.正反器：介紹各種正反器電路及了解其基特性
７.同步與非同步序向電路：介紹各種同步與非同步序向電路分析與   設計之方法 
８.遞迴網路：介紹遞迴網路之設計方法
９.ＶＨＤＬ：介紹如何使用ＶＨＤＬ語言設計數位電路

description.zh: 瞭解程式語言的基本結構，並以C語言為主要實習對象，其內容包含：1. 程式語言簡介：介紹各種程式語言及其特性，並對C語言之發展沿革架構及持點詳加討論，2. 資料型態：介紹C語言之資料型態及各種運算子，3. 基本輸入：介紹各種輸出入函數及輸出入實習，4. 流程控制：介紹指定指述，選擇敘述及迴圈敘述，並做實習，5. 前置處理：介紹前置處理觀念及程式實作，6. 函式：介紹主副程式及實作，7. 陣列與字串：介紹各種陣列之特性及字串與陣列之關係，並做實習，8. 結構型態：介紹結構，列舉及同位資料型態及應用實習，9. 指標：介紹指標之觀念及應用實習，10. 位元運算：介紹位元運算及應用實習，11. 檔案處理：各種檔案之介紹及檔案輸出入函數，12. 鍵盤與游標控制：介紹鍵盤、游標之控制及字元之特性，並作相關實習，13. 繪圖與音樂：介紹文字模式及繪圖模式函數，並作實習，14. C語言與物件導向：介紹C++與物件導向之關係，及物件與類別之基本定義，並作相關實習。
description.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages. C language is used for the practice. The course includes: 1. Introduction to programming languages: introduce various programming languages as well as their properties and discuss the history, the structure and advantages of C language. 2. Data types: introduce the data types and operators of C language. 3. Basic Input and Output: introduce various input and output functions and work on their practices. 4. Processes Control: introduce assignments, select statements and loop statements and work on their practices. 5. Preprocess: introduce the concept of the preprocess and work on the programming practice. 6. Functions: introduce the main program and subroutines. 7. Array and strings: introduce the properties of various arrays as well as the relations between strings and arrays and work on their practices. 8. Structure data types: introduce structure data types and work on the practices. 9. Pointers: introduce the concept of pointe

syllabi.outline:
本課程將以C高階程式語言作為主要教學內容，首先從C基本語法開始，包含：常數(Constant)與變數(Variable)表示法、運算子(Operator)、保留字(Keyword)與程式基本結構...等，然後介紹C基本控制結構，如：選擇(Selection)、迴圈(Loop)，再來說明陣列(Array)、指標(Pointer)之使用，以及函式(Function)制定、遞迴(Recursion)使用、字串(String)處理、檔案(File)處理...等，最後介紹在C語法進階資料型態，如：Structure，除此之外，亦介紹程式設計中基礎排序演算法，如：氣泡排序(Bubble Sorting)與選擇排序(Selection Sorting)。

1.	修課學生可從本課程熟悉C基本語法。
2.	修課學生可從本課程學習C程式設計之實作。
3.	修課學生可從本課程練習基礎排序演算法。

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

syllabi.outline:

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

瞭解組合邏輯與序向邏輯電路之分析，設計及簡化之方法，內容包含：
１.數系：數位系統所使用之各種數系及其轉換之方法

７.同步與非同步序向電路：介紹各種同步與非同步序向電路分析與   設計之方法

name.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages.

description.zh: 瞭解程式語言的基本結構，並以C語言為主要實習對象，其內容包含：1. 程式語言簡介：介紹各種程式語言及其特性，並對C語言之發展沿革架構及持點詳加討論，2. 資料型態：介紹C語言之資料型態及各種運算子，3. 基本輸入：介紹各種輸出入函數及輸出入實習，4. 流程控制：介紹指定指述，選擇敘述及迴圈敘述，並做實習，5. 前置處理：介紹前置處理觀念及程式實作，6. 函式：介紹主副程式及實作，7. 陣列與字串：介紹各種陣列之特性及字串與陣列之關係，並做實習，8. 結構型態：介紹結構，列舉及同位資料型態及應用實習，9. 指標：介紹指標之觀念及應用實習，10. 位元運算：介紹位元運算及應用實習，11. 檔案處理：各種檔案之介紹及檔案輸出入函數，12. 鍵盤與游標控制：介紹鍵盤、游標之控制及字元之特性，並作相關實習，13. 繪圖與音樂：介紹文字模式及繪圖模式函數，並作實習，14. C語言與物件導向：介紹C++與物件導向之關係，及物件與類別之基本定義，並作相關實習。
description.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages. C language is used for the practice. The course includes: 1. Introduction to programming languages: introduce various programming languages as well as their properties and discuss the history, the structure and advantages of C language. 2. Data types: introduce the data types and operators of C language. 3. Basic Input and Output: introduce various input and output functions and work on their practices. 4. Processes Control: introduce assignments, select statements and loop statements and work on their practices. 5. Preprocess: introduce the concept of the preprocess and work on the programming practice. 6. Functions: introduce the main program and subroutines. 7. Array and strings: introduce the properties of various arrays as well as the relations between strings and arrays and work on their practices. 8. Structure data types: introduce structure data types and work on the practices. 9. Pointers: introduce the concept of pointe

description.zh: 瞭解計算機之硬体組織與資料結構等基本原理及其應用，並介紹各種程式語言特性，內容包括：1.計算機簡介：介紹計算機之演進及計算機之種類與特性，2.計算機系統簡介：介紹計算機系統的組成及軟硬体系統所含概之內容，3.資料的表示法與數字系統：介紹數系及文數字表示法，4.輸出入裝置及儲存体：介紹各種輸出入設備及資料儲存体，5.程式語言與程式設計：介紹各種程式語言結構，及撰寫之方法，6.資料結構：介紹資料在記憶体內之各種排列方法以節省記憶空間及提高存取效率，7.作業系統：介紹各種管理電腦資源的系統軟体及其作業方式，8.檔案與資料庫：介紹各種檔案的類型及資料庫之基本架構，9.資料通訊與計算機網路：介紹資料通訊之種種特性及電腦網路之結構與類別，10.人工智慧：介紹人工智慧基本概念及基本功能。

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 介紹會計學之基本觀念， 會計循環 - 包括分錄、過帳、試算、結算及財務報表之編製。逐一說明財務報表各個項目，最後並介紹財務報表之分析。修畢本課程之後能瞭解會計學之基本原理，會計資料處理及財務報表產生之整個過程，以及簡單之財務報表分析技術，並為未來之企業及財務相關課程打下良好基礎。
description.en: This course introduces the basic concepts of accounting.  All the necessary processes are included as well the financial report analysis. description.zh: 本課程在四技為3學分。介紹成本觀念與成本會計資訊系統，成本彙集程序，材料與人工規畫與控制，製造費用之規畫，差異分析，部門化會計處理及責任會計與報告。修畢本課程後能瞭解製造業之成本流程，材料、人工及製造費用之規畫與控制，責任會計與報告，因而具備了控制成本，提高效率之管理能力。
description.en: This course introduces the cost concept and cost accounting information systems, cost aggregation process, materials and labor planning and control, manufacturing cost planning, and difference analysis.

syllabi.outline:
成本會計主要在記錄成本之發生，追蹤成本的流程，將累積的成本做適當的分配，本課程將介紹成本分類及其習性分析、各種成本制度及其彙總（分批成本制、分步成本制）、標準成本等數量計算之基礎成本會計。
Cost accounting mainly records the occurrence of costs, tracks the cost process, and appropriately allocates costs. This course will introduce cost classification and habit analysis, various cost systems and their summary like Job costing, process costing, and standard costs . Basic cost accounting for equal quantity calculations.

description.zh: 介紹 AI 相關的應用以及 Python 及 VBA 語言資料處理的應用,課程內容介紹類神經網路、深度學習、ChatGPT 之應用與基礎原理,Python 及 VBA 程式開發環境、流程圖、程式之編輯除錯、基本輸出/入、條件判斷、迴圈等程式結構,訓練學生撰寫函數與副程式之基本能力。
description.en:
This course introduces AI-related and data-processing applications in Python and VBA languages. The course content introduces the application and basic principles of neural
networks, deep learning, ChatGPT, Python/ VBA programming environments, flowcharts,code editing and debugging, and program structures such as fundamental input/output,sequence, condition, and loop to train students' essential ability of coding functions and subroutines.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在訓練大學部學生於撰寫程式之能力，程式語言(一)以Python 為實踐主體，課程內容包含: 複習Operators and Expression、流程控制 (while, for, if-elif-else)、函式(function)、module、data structure；並學習 input/output、OOP (Class 概念)、及 exception；並將介紹廣泛使用之標準程式庫，包括: sys、datetime、os、random、argparse、numpy、pandas、matplotlib、pillow、pyqt、scipy， scikit-learn、opencv-python、request、Selenium、beautifulsoup4 等；並將配合學期之project，訓練同學團隊合作及系統開法之經驗。
The objective of this course is to cultivate the programming ability for undergraduates. Python is the language used in this course since its simplicity and widely applicable. The content of this course includes: reviewing operators and expression, flow control, functions, module, data structure, and extensively learning input/output, class (OOP), and exception. Besides, this course will introduce the commonly used packages, such as os, numpy, sys, pandas, matplotlib, pillow, pyqt, etc.  There will be a term project to let student experience team-working and system design and management.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程提供大一學生必備之英語文語言技巧，強調專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分，並整合英語文之聽、說、讀、寫之能力，提升英語文在專業領域的應用。
description.en: This course equips first-year students with essential English language skills, focusing on developing their communication abilities in specific professional fields. The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. description.zh: 介紹 AI 相關的應用以及 Python 及 VBA 語言資料處理的應用,課程內容介紹類神經網路、深度學習、ChatGPT 之應用與基礎原理,Python 及 VBA 程式開發環境、流程圖、程式之編輯除錯、基本輸出/入、條件判斷、迴圈等程式結構,訓練學生撰寫函數與副程式之基本能力。
description.en:
This course introduces AI-related and data-processing applications in Python and VBA languages. The course content introduces the application and basic principles of neural
networks, deep learning, ChatGPT, Python/ VBA programming environments, flowcharts,code editing and debugging, and program structures such as fundamental input/output,sequence, condition, and loop to train students' essential ability of coding functions and subroutines.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在訓練大學部學生於撰寫程式之能力，程式語言(一)以Python 為實踐主體，課程內容包含: 複習Operators and Expression、流程控制 (while, for, if-elif-else)、函式(function)、module、data structure；並學習 input/output、OOP (Class 概念)、及 exception；並將介紹廣泛使用之標準程式庫，包括: sys、datetime、os、random、argparse、numpy、pandas、matplotlib、pillow、pyqt、scipy， scikit-learn、opencv-python、request、Selenium、beautifulsoup4 等；並將配合學期之project，訓練同學團隊合作及系統開法之經驗。
The objective of this course is to cultivate the programming ability for undergraduates. Python is the language used in this course since its simplicity and widely applicable. The content of this course includes: reviewing operators and expression, flow control, functions, module, data structure, and extensively learning input/output, class (OOP), and exception. Besides, this course will introduce the commonly used packages, such as os, numpy, sys, pandas, matplotlib, pillow, pyqt, etc.  There will be a term project to let student experience team-working and system design and management.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 掌握形式從屬機能旨意，熟悉施作技術限制與創意可行性，學習從設計到實作的落實，透過各種機械設備操作、加工技術學習，實際接觸及操作真實材料，了解材料種類、性質、加工過程、組裝知識、技術與美學等，以呈現設計作品之原型與成品。
description.en: Based on “Form follows Function”, student will learn interacts and limitations among technology feasibility and creative application, in order to master sequential implementations form design ideas to real works. Students are required to operate various mechanical equipment and processing technologies, thus to realize the types and nature of the materials, processing procedure, as well as the assembly of knowledge, technologies and aesthetics to format intended design prototypes and establishments.

syllabi.outline: 視覺設計為現代設計實務的核心技能。為迎合新世代數位設計趨勢，本課程全面導入生成式 AI 工具與 2D 電腦輔助設計軟體之整合應用。課程核心聚焦於設計流程的各個階段，訓練學生運用 AI 進行快速概念發想與高效視覺化，並結合傳統數位技法進行精細修潤。透過視覺設計專題與實務演練，培養學生兼具 AI 協作思維與視覺美感傳達能力，達成跨工具的數位技法整合。

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在引領學生於 AI 協作設計的時代脈絡下，掌握 2D 影像編輯與繪圖軟體在視覺傳達、家具產品及空間設計等跨領域的多元表現技法。
隨著生成式 AI 技術的快速迭代，視覺表徵的手法正經歷深刻變革。如何精準揉合 AI 生成技術與進階影像編輯技法，將設計概念具象化，將造型語彙精準表達，已成為新世代設計師不可或缺的核心競爭力。
本課程以 Adobe Photoshop 為核心演繹工具，著重培養學生在「概念溝通」、「圖像轉譯」、「造型發展」與「情境渲染」等面向的實務能力，進而深化其在 AI 輔助設計流程中的高階視覺溝通與應用力。
English Syllabus
This course aims to equip students with versatile 2D image editing and digital rendering skills essential for cross-disciplinary applications spanning visual communication, furniture, and spatial design within the context of the AI-driven design era.
As generative AI technologies rapidly evolve, paradigms of visual representation are undergoing a profound transformation. The ability to seamlessly integrate AI-generated content with advanced image editing techniques to materialize concepts and precisely articulate form language, has become a critical competency for next-generation designers.
Utilizing Adobe Photoshop as the primary digital tool, this course focuses on actualizing computer-aided visual design capabilities. Students will develop practical proficiency in concept communication, visual translation, form development, and contextual rendering, thereby strengthening their advanced communication and application skills in an AI-assisted design workflow.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.
