description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en:
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

description.zh: 本課程目標針對大一新生入門介紹建築專業分支領域。由建築學基本涵構作概略介紹，輔以案例介紹及適當實地參觀研討，進而了解建築學相關知識體系，並對未來四年建築專業課程內容有全盤性認識，進ㄧ步結合未來出路願景。著重訓練思考及觀察能力，以利學生認識建築學之整體關聯性，進而建立其全方位學習藍圖。內容包括建築相關產業與建造程序、體驗建築、建築單位尺寸、建築結構系統之美、建築設計風格、建築教育、新一代建築師、建築構造與材料、建築的社會文化性、建築與環境共生、建築與都市發展、建築相關法令等。

description.zh: 本課程整體目標為奠定學生建築製圖基礎能力，以期培育學生成為符合建築業界所需之人才；針對建築製圖之知識、技能、態度進行授課；主要為灌輸學生建築製圖基本常識、觀念；以所學實際運用於各種圖說之實際練習與操作。課程內容有(1)製圖用筆、比例尺、三角板、圓規等工具之介紹與應用；(2)各種線條與工程字傳授與練習；(3)建築圖說符號之說明與應用；(4)三視圖與輔助視圖之講解及練習理解；(5)空間應有尺度介紹與圖說練習；(6)人物、植栽、舖面等點景之介紹與練習；(7)建築平、立、剖面之陰影等建築表現法指導與操作。本課程符合系教育目標如下： 1. 訓練學生建築設計與工程基礎專業能力； 2. 透過實作方式彙整建築設計與建築構造之技能； 3. 引導建立建築專業道德倫理態度； 4. 整合建築理論與實務提升就業競爭力。
description.en: This is a fundamental course in architecture. The goal of the course is to establish the basic ability in handmade graphics. This class introduces fundamental issues in graphics such as(1) Introduce the graphics tools. (2) The usage of architectural graphic symbols. (3)Lines and fonts. (4)Reading and practicing three-dimensional diagrams. (5) Handling the relationship between space and scale. (6) Drawing practice on Landscape and human figure. (7)Shades and Shadows on the architectural graphics. After this course the students will acquire the following aspects: 1). Basic knowledge in architectural design and engineering. 2). Practical skill in architectural design and structure. 3). Correct attitude in architectural professions moral. 4). Integrate theory and real-life practice.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. extra.彈性學習(17-18週): 本課程依循「16＋2週」彈性教學精神，前16週完成極限、導數、導數應用、積分及微積分基本定理等核心內容，第17至18週規劃「微積分生活與工程應用專題」，引導學生整合知識並解決實際問題。第17週由教師介紹包裝材料最佳化、拋射物運動、邊際成本與最大利潤、車輛速度與累積路程、水槽注排水、藥物濃度、人口成長、工程量及不規則面積估算等案例。學生分組選定主題，設定變數、單位與合理假設，將生活或工程情境轉換為函數模型，再運用導數、最佳化、定積分或數值積分進行分析。各組可使用Desmos、GeoGebra、Excel、Python或生成式AI繪製圖形、整理資料及驗證結果，並從公式、定義域、單位與現實合理性等方面查核數位工具所產生的答案。第18週進行分組成果發表與即時答詢，各組須說明問題背景、建模方法、計算過程、驗證結果、實際意義及模型限制，並繳交簡報、專題報告、計算與AI查核紀錄及組員分工表。評量項目包含課堂參與、模型合理性、計算正確性、工具應用、口頭表達及學習反思，以培養學生的數學建模、批判思考、團隊合作、數位素養與溝通能力，理解微積分是分析現象與支持決策的重要工具。
extra.類別:
● 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用(AI-assisted learning and tool application)
extra.內容: 本課程依循「16＋2週」彈性教學精神，前16週完成極限、導數、導數應用、積分及微積分基本定理等核心內容，第17至18週規劃「微積分生活與工程應用專題」，引導學生整合知識並解決實際問題。第17週由教師介紹包裝材料最佳化、拋射物運動、邊際成本與最大利潤、車輛速度與累積路程、水槽注排水、藥物濃度、人口成長、工程量及不規則面積估算等案例。學生分組選定主題，設定變數、單位與合理假設，將生活或工程情境轉換為函數模型，再運用導數、最佳化、定積分或數值積分進行分析。各組可使用Desmos、GeoGebra、Excel、Python或生成式AI繪製圖形、整理資料及驗證結果，並從公式、定義域、單位與現實合理性等方面查核數位工具所產生的答案。第18週進行分組成果發表與即時答詢，各組須說明問題背景、建模方法、計算過程、驗證結果、實際意義及模型限制，並繳交簡報、專題報告、計算與AI查核紀錄及組員分工表。評量項目包含課堂參與、模型合理性、計算正確性、工具應用、口頭表達及學習反思，以培養學生的數學建模、批判思考、團隊合作、數位素養與溝通能力，理解微積分是分析現象與支持決策的重要工具。
extra.學習成果:
完成本階段彈性學習後，學生預期能從日常生活、商業管理或工程現象中發現可運用數學分析的問題，並將抽象的微積分知識轉化為具體的解決策略。在認知層面，學生能理解變化率、累積量、極值與近似值的意義，辨別不同問題所需要的分析方法，而非僅依賴公式套用。在實作層面，學生能依據資料與條件進行推理，檢查計算結果、變數範圍及單位是否合理，並利用圖形、表格或數值結果支持自己的論點。面對數位工具或生成式AI提供的答案，學生能保持批判態度，透過人工計算、圖形觀察與多種方法交叉比對，辨識可能出現的錯誤、遺漏或不合理結論，進而修正並提出有根據的判斷。

在合作與表達方面，學生能與組員分配任務、整合不同意見並共同完成成果，清楚說明分析過程與主要發現，也能針對他人的提問給予適當回應。透過同儕觀摩與自我反思，學生能比較不同解題方法的優缺點，了解數學答案不一定能完全代表真實情況，並認識資料品質、簡化條件及外在因素對結果的影響。最終，學生能建立主動探索、合理質疑與自主查證的學習態度，提升邏輯推理、問題解決、數位應用、團隊合作及溝通表達等綜合能力，並將這些能力延伸至後續專業課程及實際情境之中。

description.zh: 本課程為車輛、機械工程科系背景之同學設之計普通物理課程，使大一新生能銜接中學的物理課程至未來專業的領域。課程內容上學期包含牛頓力學、功與能、轉動，和流體力學、熱力學概論；下學期含有庫倫定律、電磁學、光學及近代物理。課程每週三小時，連續教授二個學期。
description.en: This course is designed for students of vehicle and/or mechanical engineering background, so that freshmen can connect the physics course of middle school to the future professional field. The first semester includes Newtonian mechanics, work and energy, rotation, and introduction to fluid mechanics and thermodynamics; the second semester includes Coulomb's law, electromagnetism, optics and modern physics. The course lasts three hours a week for two consecutive semesters.

syllabi.outline:
本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。
The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧(一)

description.zh: 本課程為程式設計之基礎課程，目標在熟悉基本C語言程式，並認識人工智慧，內容著重程式語言邏輯思考與程式設計能力之授課，同時輔以計算機及人工智慧之基本概念，使修習者得以奠定良好之程式設計基礎。
description.en: This course covers the fundamentals and applications of computer language C, and the basis of artificial intelligence (AI).  This course aims to make students learn program logics and programming, and the basic knowledge of computer and artificial intelligence.  Then students can build solid basis about computer programming.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為程式設計之基礎課程，目標在熟悉基本C++語言程式與基礎人工智慧知識，內容著重程式語言邏輯思考與程式設計能力之授課，包含數位資料型態與處理、資料儲存與轉換、計算機架構、及人工智慧基礎介紹，同時搭配程式語言設計與實作，使修習者得以奠定良好之程式設計基礎。
This is a foundational course in computer programming that aims to familiarize students with basic C++ programming and fundamental concepts in artificial intelligence. The content also focuses on logical thinking in programming languages and software design, covering digital data types and processing, data storage and conversion, computer architecture, and a basic introduction to artificial intelligence. Concurrently paired with programming language design and hands-on implementation, this course enables learners to establish a solid foundation in computer programming.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。
本國語文課程以《世說新語》為主要文本，這部由南朝劉義慶編撰的經典筆記小說，內容涵蓋魏晉南北朝時期的逸聞軼事與人物風貌。通過閱讀、分析和討論，學生將深入了解魏晉風度、清談文化以及個人與社會價值觀的演變，並認識《世說新語》的文學價值及其對後世的影響，並從人物性格，理解個人生命發展。

description.zh: 本課程分為兩部分：（1）英文文法觀念的溫故知新，並引導學生將正確的文法觀念運用在閱讀與寫作上，學生可加強基本句型練習、句子改正及句型修正。相關討論包括直述句、引述句、句型變化與修飾;（2）英語修辭法：聽講溝通的有效原理原則。課堂討論主題包括：指稱、一致、倒裝等修辭觀念。修習本課後，學生對出現在相同邏輯意義語境中， 利用不同表達方式以凸顯各種語意的方式與內涵，當有更進一步的體認。
description.en: This course is divided into two parts: (a) The first part is designed for the students to  familiarize themselves with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing. A review of grammatical ideas at high level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors, and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures. The main subjects include English sentence structures, verbal usages, conjunctions, and sequences. Related topics for class discussion cover direct and indirect speech, sentence transformation and modification of sentences; (b) The second half of the course focuses on English rhetoric--principles of effective written and spoken communication. Topics for class discussion include reference, coherence, reverse structures and some related rhetorical concepts. It is hoped that the students will know better the significance brought about by the variations of different expressions that occur in the similar linguistic contexts.

description.zh: 本課程旨在引導學生熟悉詩歌、小說、及戲劇等文學作品之各種讀法。學生將於本課程裡研究諸如人物、主角、反派角色、場景、旁白、獨白、矛盾修辭法、誇張修辭法等文學及修辭術語。此外，學生亦將學習欣賞諸如明喻、暗喻、意象、象徵、符號等各種比喻的語文用法。藉此，學生將可提昇其對文學語言複雜特性的敏感度。
description.en: This course aims to acquaint students with various approaches to literature of different genres, including poetry, fiction, and drama. In this course, students will explore the concepts of literary and rhetorical terminology, such as character, protagonist, antagonist, setting, aside, soliloquy, oxymoron, and hyperbole. They will also learn to appreciate all kinds of figurative language, such as simile, metaphor, image, symbol, and sign. They will thus improve their sensitivity to the complexities of language reflected in literary works.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to help students enhance their comprehension and reading ability of literary works, with the expectation to provide students a better understanding of western literary works as well as to explore students’ interest in literature.
It will be a reading-based course, and in addition to the cultivation of mind, students will be expected to improve vocabulary as well. The instructor intends to center on sixteen writers this semester, with the foci on the relationships between the genders in the first eight weeks, and human nature after the midterm exam. Through oral presentations and class discussion, students will have a broader view of how literature is on some level a reflection of “human” life and have the capability to interpret literary works.

description.zh: 當代英美流行小說,例如:帶珍珠耳環的少女,時空旅人之妻,姊姊的守護者,暮光之城系列等等,主題推陳出新,內容扣人心弦,有的反應當前的文化議題,有的表現出創新的文學想像,在在都激發著同學們閱讀原文小說的興趣.又由於小說的書寫語言為當今英語世界所使用,沒有年代隔閡,所以原文流行小說也是優良的英語學習材料.在字彙,片語,句型,段落及文章結構,到故事情節發展與深入探討主題的每個層面上,都提供了豐富的素材,供同學們學習觀摩.因此,本課程將挑選不同類型之時下英美流行小說四本,每月一本,規劃進度,在課堂上進行導讀與討論,並加強字彙,句型,與文章結構上的分析,幫助同學們在英語書寫,閱讀技巧,跨文化了解與思辨能力上,獲得最大的進步!
description.en: Contemporary popular novels originally written in English, such as the Girl with a Pearl Earring, the Time Traveler's Wife, and the Twilight, have a strong appeal to readers worldwide, but non-native English speakers often enjoy these works in translated versions or film adaptations.  To encourage our students to read these popular English novels in the original language, the instructor will choose four novels of various subject matters and use them as effective teaching materials in the classroom. The objectives are (1) to enrich students' cultural background knowledge of the English speaking world today, (2) to cultivate students' life-long reading habit of keeping up contemporary materials, and (3) to strengthen their critical thinking as well as language skills, especially reading and writing, through line-by-line close readings in the context and guided discussions on the narrative structures of the whole fiction.

Contemporary popular novels originally written in English, such as the Girl with a Pearl Earring, the Time Traveler's Wife, and the Twilight, have a strong appeal to readers worldwide, but non-native English speakers often enjoy these works in translated versions or film adaptations.  To encourage our students to read these popular English novels in the original language, the instructor will choose four novels of various subject matters and use them as effective teaching materials in the classroom. The objectives are (1) to enrich students' cultural background knowledge of the English speaking world today, (2) to cultivate students' life-long reading habit of keeping up contemporary materials, and (3) to strengthen their critical thinking as well as language skills, especially reading and writing, through line-by-line close readings in the context and guided discussions on the narrative structures of the whole fiction.
syllabi.assessment: Students will be strongly discouraged from using generative AI as a shortcut for language production, critical thinking, and independent projects. AI should never become a substitute for your own voice or judgment. This course is a place to practice discovering ideas and making choices for yourself, which matters more than quickly generating smooth (and ultimately lifeless) English.

This course explores contemporary popular fiction as a space of pleasure, imagination, argument, and serious literary study. We will read works that may involve witchcraft, romance, crime, horror, cozy cat cafes, and speculative worlds. We will ask why some books become popular, the market forces behind anglophone publishing, how genre shapes what readers expect, and how popular fiction engages questions of ideology, cultural anxiety, identity, power, desire, class, gender, race, and belief.

This is a rigorous course designed for students who are seriously interested in reading and vocally engaging with literature. Each student should give their best effort at contributing to the community of the classroom through coming to class prepared, answering questions, participating in discussions, and doing partner work with peers. Students should expect to read every week and develop thoughtful interpretations based on specific details from the texts.

name.zh: 高階英文字彙習得與應用
name.en: The Acquisition and Application of Advanced English Lexical Use

description.zh:
此課程旨在協助學生建立相當於美國大學入學測驗的高階字彙，亦即相當於接受高等教育之英語系國家人士所具備的用字能力。此課程將通過故事方式介紹此類字彙，其中也包括字形學之解析。學生修習此課程後應能將高階字彙使用於正確的上下文中，因此可達成下列諸目的：
"	提昇高階字彙數量
"	加強英文閱讀能力
"	習得重要字源解析
"	避免上下文中的用字錯誤
"	提高英語表達能力
"	加強英文寫作能力
"	精進英語文溝通技巧
description.en:
This course aims to help students build a more powerful vocabulary on the SAT (the qualifying exam for US college admission) level, i.e. the level of proficiency of an educated native speaker's. Students will be introduced to the lexical use through story scenes. Morphological analysis of the words will be included in the course. At the exit of this course, students are expected to use them in their proper contexts and hence reach the following goals:
"	Develop a powerful vocabulary
"	Improve reading skills
"	Learn important word roots
"	Avoid word usage error in context
"	Become a better speaker
"	Strengthen his/her writing ability
"	Improve communication skills

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
1.      Course title: Advanced Vocabulary (for  B2+ C1+ C2 EFL students)
2.      Text sources:
(1) Building Vocabulary Skills, Improving Vocabulary Skills, Advancing Vocabulary Skills, by Sherrie L. Nist and Carole Mohr. Publishers: Townsend Press, Bookman. 
(2) Film clips, literary passages, BBC News videos, soliloquies and great speeches from historical documents
3.      Syllabus
Week 1 — Introduction (a diagnostic and methodological week)
Focus: Vocabulary learning strategies; self-assessment; establishing word banks
Activity: Vocabulary Levels Test; introduction to word maps, context-guessing, collocation notebooks, and vocabulary journals

Unit 1 Topic: Identity and belonging (film clips)
Week 2 — Dead Poets Society (1989)
Clip: "Carpe Diem" opening classroom scene (~4 min)
Week 3 — The Devil Wears Prada (2006)
Clip: Miranda's cerulean sweater monologue (~3 min)
Week 4 — The Pursuit of Happiness (2006)
Clip: "Don't ever let somebody tell you you can't do something" (~2 min)

Unit 2 Topic: Human nature and society (literary passages)
Week 5 — The Great Gatsby: Chapter 1 excerpt (Fitzgerald)
Focus: Descriptive/evaluative vocabulary; social class
Week 6 — Animal Farm: Chapter 1 (Orwell)
Focus: Political/rhetorical vocabulary
Week 7 — Never Let Me Go: Chapter 1 excerpt (Kazuo Ishiguro)
Focus: Memory, identity, and loss; culturally resonant for Asian students

Unit 3 Topic: The World Today (BBC News Videos)
Week 8 — Topic: climate and environment
Source: BBC Learning English, "6 Minute English" environmental episodes
Week 9 — Topic: technology and society
Source: BBC Learning English, "6 Minute English" AI/technology episodes

Week 10 — Midterm Exam
Format: Vocabulary-in-context gap fill, idiom matching, collocation quiz, short paragraph using target words from previous units

Unit 4 Topic: Emotion and ethics (film clips)
Week 11 — Schindler's List (1993)
Clip: "I could have got more…" breakdown scene (~4 min)
Week 12 — Inside Out (2015)
Clip: Joy and Sadness discuss core memories (~5 min)

Unit 5: The art of the spoken word (soliloquies and great speeches) 
Week 13 — Shakespeare: Hamlet – "To Be or Not to Be" (Act III, Scene 1)
Performance clips: Kenneth Branagh (1996), David Tennant (2009), Benedict Cumberbatch (2015) — all on YouTube
Week 14 — (1) Jane Austen: Pride and Prejudice – Mr. Darcy's First Proposal (Ch. 34) and (2) Jane Eyre's "I Am No Bird" Speech (Ch. 23, Brontë)
Film clips: (1) 2005 *Pride and Prejudice (Keira Knightley); (2) 2011 Jane Eyre (Mia Wasikowska) — both on YouTube
Focus: Romantic/social vocabulary; gender and power; contrast between entitled passion and fierce equality
Week 15 — (1) Charlie Chaplin: The Great Dictator – Final Speech (1940); (2) Atticus Finch: To Kill a Mockingbird – Closing Argument
Film clip: Chaplin's speech on YouTube (public domain)
Focus: justice, democracy, and humanity; formal rhetorical register

Week 16 — Final Exam
Format: Authentic reading passage; vocabulary-in-use test; idiom interpretation section; short essay (200–250 words) incorporating vocabulary from all units

Week 17 & Week 18: A vocabulary dossier made by students
Unit 6: Independent research
extra.彈性學習(17-18週): The goal for Week 17 and Week 18 is for each student to compose a personal dossier containing 100 words she/he needs to know the most. The student will explore the roots of the chosen vocabulary, the multiple meanings in association with the contexts in the full richness of its cultural and emotional context. The student can draw materials from her/his specialized field, film, canonical literature, BBC news media, and celebrated dramatic soliloquies.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述管理學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋四個領域：(1)瞭解管理學之理論與相關學者之研究報告；(2) 討論企業界管理應用實務案例；(3) 探討多國化管理之趨勢與差異及(4) 如何落實管理理論研討與趨勢。另外一有管理相關功能實務應用之討論與介紹。
description.en: The purpose of Management has four distinct objectives:(1) to introduce a new management paradigm；(2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of management and organizational behavior into a single volume, including the management functional and departmental descriptions；(3) to discuss business management applications in practice and (4) to effectively implement the management basic ideas. The planning, organization, decision, leadership and monitoring among variety culture will be covered and discussed in the class as well.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學期中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

extra.彈性學習(17-18週): 本課程依循「16＋2週」彈性教學精神，前16週完成極限、導數、導數應用、積分及微積分基本定理等核心內容，第17至18週規劃「微積分生活與工程應用專題」，引導學生整合知識並解決實際問題。第17週由教師介紹包裝材料最佳化、拋射物運動、邊際成本與最大利潤、車輛速度與累積路程、水槽注排水、藥物濃度、人口成長、工程量及不規則面積估算等案例。學生分組選定主題，設定變數、單位與合理假設，將生活或工程情境轉換為函數模型，再運用導數、最佳化、定積分或數值積分進行分析。各組可使用Desmos、GeoGebra、Excel、Python或生成式AI繪製圖形、整理資料及驗證結果，並從公式、定義域、單位與現實合理性等方面查核數位工具所產生的答案。第18週進行分組成果發表與即時答詢，各組須說明問題背景、建模方法、計算過程、驗證結果、實際意義及模型限制，並繳交簡報、專題報告、計算與AI查核紀錄及組員分工表。評量項目包含課堂參與、模型合理性、計算正確性、工具應用、口頭表達及學習反思，以培養學生的數學建模、批判思考、團隊合作、數位素養與溝通能力，理解微積分是分析現象與支持決策的重要工具。

extra.學習成果:
完成本階段彈性學習後，學生預期能從日常生活、商業管理或工程現象中發現可運用數學分析的問題，並將抽象的微積分知識轉化為具體的解決策略。在認知層面，學生能理解變化率、累積量、極值與近似值的意義，辨別不同問題所需要的分析方法，而非僅依賴公式套用。在實作層面，學生能依據資料與條件進行推理，檢查計算結果、變數範圍及單位是否合理，並利用圖形、表格或數值結果支持自己的論點。面對數位工具或生成式AI提供的答案，學生能保持批判態度，透過人工計算、圖形觀察與多種方法交叉比對，辨識可能出現的錯誤、遺漏或不合理結論，進而修正並提出有根據的判斷。

在合作與表達方面，學生能與組員分配任務、整合不同意見並共同完成成果，清楚說明分析過程與主要發現，也能針對他人的提問給予適當回應。透過同儕觀摩與自我反思，學生能比較不同解題方法的優缺點，了解數學答案不一定能完全代表真實情況，並認識資料品質、簡化條件及外在因素對結果的影響。最終，學生能建立主動探索、合理質疑與自主查證的學習態度，提升邏輯推理、問題解決、數位應用、團隊合作及溝通表達等綜合能力，並將這些能力延伸至後續專業課程及實際情境之中。

description.zh: 建立一個商務網站包括前端網頁與後端伺服器網頁，本課程將介紹前端網頁設計的方法，包括CSS,HTML,JavaScript。網頁的基本框架是Html標籤語法，網頁的樣式設計是CSS的樣式設計，網頁的互動效果是透過JavaScript程式來達成的。由於JavaScript容易理解的特性，史丹佛大學已經將JavaScript取代Java，成為程式設計的入門教材 本課程也會介紹目前網頁的主流：響應性網頁RWD(bootstrap)的設計方法。
description.en: Building a business website includes front-end web pages and back-end server web pages. This course will introduce the methods of front-end web page design, including CSS, HTML, and JavaScript. The basic framework of a webpage is the syntax of Html tags, the style design of the webpage is the style design of CSS, and the interactive effect of the webpage is achieved through JavaScript programs. This course will also introduce the current mainstream of web pages: the design method of responsive web RWD (bootstrap).

syllabi.outline:
本課程是一門專為數位時代設計的跨領域實務導向課程，核心目標在於引導學生從零開始建構具備商業價值的電子商務網站，並掌握現代數位行銷的關鍵技術。課程全面覆蓋「前端網頁設計」、「後端雲端網站架設」與如何把電商網站做數位行銷的「SEO搜尋引擎優化技術」，並前瞻性地導入最新 AI 代理人（AI Agent）工具。

在網站開發方面，課程採取循序漸進的全端教學。前端以 HTML、CSS 標籤與樣式語法為基石，結合被史丹 Stanford 大學列為程式入門教材的 JavaScript，由淺入深學習代碼基礎、對話盒、文字方塊與互動按鈕實作，以精準追蹤客戶行為；同時，課程亦涵蓋主流的 Bootstrap 響應式網頁設計（RWD），確保商務網站在各式裝置上的極致體驗。後端則深入探討網頁伺服器架設（IIS、Apache）、資料庫技術（PHP + MySQL）與域名（DNS）申請，讓學生掌握完整的商業網站運行架構。

本課程最大的特色在於尖端科技與商務行銷的完美結合。學生將實作引進新一代 AI 代理人——Manus 與 Google AntiGravity，體驗自動化工作流程，達成智慧化架站與雲端託管部署。在數位行銷與流量變現領域，本課程揚棄純理論教學，強調純實務的操作演練。內容完整涵蓋搜尋引擎優化（SEO）的四大實務：透過網頁 TDK 摘要向搜尋引擎精準自我介紹、操作 Google Search Console（GSC）建立網站索引、佈局「熱門與長尾關鍵字」提升搜尋排名，以及實作圖片 SEO。透過這四種關鍵資訊技術的交織應用，協助學生優化工作流，最終達成極大化電商網站行銷效果的目標。

This course is a practice-oriented, cross-disciplinary offering designed specifically for the digital era. Its core objective is to guide students from the ground up in building commercially viable e-commerce websites while mastering essential digital marketing technologies. The curriculum comprehensively covers front-end web design, back-end cloud hosting and architecture, and search engine optimization (SEO) techniques, alongside the forward-looking integration of cutting-edge AI Agent tools.

In terms of web development, the course adopts a step-by-step full-stack pedagogical approach. Front-end development relies on HTML and CSS as fundamental building blocks for web structure and styling. Combined with JavaScript—widely adopted as an introductory programming language, including at Stanford University—students progressively master coding fundamentals, interactive controls, and client-side behavioral tracking. Furthermore, the course incorporates Bootstrap responsive web design (RWD) to ensure optimal user experiences across all devices. For the back-end, students gain hands-on experience with server deployment (IIS, Apache), database technology (PHP + MySQL), and domain name (DNS) configuration, establishing a solid understanding of complete commercial website infrastructure.

A defining highlight of this course lies in the seamless fusion of advanced technology and business marketing. Students will gain practical experience leveraging next-generation AI agents—such as Manus and Google AntiGravity—to automate development workflows, smart site building, and cloud hosting deployment. In the domain of digital marketing and traffic generation, the course prioritizes practical execution over abstract theory. The curriculum covers four major SEO pillars: configuring page TDK tags for search engine indexing, utilizing Google Search Console (GSC) for site indexing and performance analysis, embedding popular and long-tail keywords to boost ranking, and executing image SEO. Through the integration of these key technologies, students will optimize digital workflows and maximize the marketing impact of e-commerce platforms.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline:
本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。

description.en: Linear algebra is a fundamental mathematics course in science and engineering. In this course, the basic concepts and computation skills of linear algebra will be covered. The course includes the following topics: 1.Systems of linear Equations 2.Matrices 3.Determinants 4.Vectors in R2 and R3 5.Vector spaces 6.Linear transformations 7.Eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

syllabi.outline:
線性代數為工程類學科之基礎數學之一，著重於訓練學生矩陣運算及基本數學証明。課程大綱如下：
1. 解聯立方程式
2. 矩陣運算
3. 行列式
4. 向量空間
5. 線性轉換
6. 特徵值及特徵向量
7. 選擇性題材，視時間充許教授下列之一：矩陣數值方法，Jordan form或線性規劃

As a basic mathematics in engineering, the course Linear Algebra emphasizes on the subject of matrix computation (theory) and the technique of mathematical proving. The outline of the course includes the following:
1. Systems of Linear Equations
2. Matrices
3. Determinants
4. Vector Spaces
5. Linear Transformations
6. Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
7. Advanced Topics: select one of the following if time permitted: Numerical Techniques in Matrix operations, Jordan form, or Linear Programming.

To learn basic matrix arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication power, transpose, and inverse.

To understand the basic terminologies and notations of matrices and systems of linear equations, in the forms of vector equation and matrix equation.

Week 6 - Week 7

Week 8 Midterm Exam

Introduction to vector spaces.

To understand the meaning of eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix, and the approaches to find them. 
Diagonalization of a matrix (linear transformation).

Week 14 - Week 15
6. Orthogonality and Least Squares (Chapter 6)
To introduce inner product of vectors, and thus the geometric concepts of length, distance, and angle (perpendicularity).
To be familiar with the use of orthogonal bases.
Least-Squares approximation.

description.zh: 本課程以計算機硬體及軟體之基本介紹為始，逐步引入程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python及C語言為基礎，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C++程式語言。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練及其在資訊工程上之應用，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計專業之基礎。
description.en: To familiarize the student with basic computer programming concepts. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, as well as an introduction into the syntax and semantics of the Python,C and C++ programming language. An important objective of the course is to present effective methods of program design using modular construction and structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:
瞭解組合邏輯與序向邏輯電路之分析，設計及簡化之方法，內容包含：
１.數系：數位系統所使用之各種數系及其轉換之方法
２.布氏代數：了解布氏代數的基本運算法和定律，及認識基本邏輯   及邏輯閘
３.布氏代數之簡化：介紹各種布氏代數之簡化方法
４.組合邏輯：據布氏代數及邏輯閘，計分析各種組合邏輯電路
５.可程式邏輯陣列：介紹ＰＬＡ，ＰＡＬ，ＦＰＧＡ等之設計方法
６.正反器：介紹各種正反器電路及了解其基特性
７.同步與非同步序向電路：介紹各種同步與非同步序向電路分析與   設計之方法 
８.遞迴網路：介紹遞迴網路之設計方法
９.ＶＨＤＬ：介紹如何使用ＶＨＤＬ語言設計數位電路

瞭解組合邏輯與序向邏輯電路之分析，設計及簡化之方法，內容包含：
１.數系：數位系統所使用之各種數系及其轉換之方法
２.布氏代數：了解布氏代數的基本運算法和定律，及認識基本邏輯   及邏輯閘
３.布氏代數之簡化：介紹各種布氏代數之簡化方法
４.組合邏輯：據布氏代數及邏輯閘，計分析各種組合邏輯電路
５.可程式邏輯陣列：介紹ＰＬＡ，ＰＡＬ，ＦＰＧＡ等之設計方法
６.正反器：介紹各種正反器電路及了解其基特性
７.同步與非同步序向電路：介紹各種同步與非同步序向電路分析與   設計之方法
８.遞迴網路：介紹遞迴網路之設計方法
９.ＶＨＤＬ：介紹如何使用ＶＨＤＬ語言設計數位電路

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline: Our school's general physics courses are specially designed for students with engineering backgrounds. The main purpose is to encourage students to participate in the exploration of the mysteries and laws of the operation of nature, and to provide a solid foundation for subsequent professional courses. The content of this course includes mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, optics and modern physics. The professor can design the course based on three hours per week and two semesters, and then consider the different needs of each department to strengthen or omit certain chapters.

description.en: The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.

description.zh: 配合化學課程之進展，教導學生學習各項基本實驗操作及儀器設備之技巧，進行各項實驗課程，如COD 的測定，氮莫耳體積之測定，錯合物之生成，氧化還原滴定，蒸汽壓，測量溶解度，反應速率，化學平衡，耐綸-6,6之製備以訓練學生養成手腦並用的務實科學素養。
description.en: Following the progress of the course of chemistry, introduce chemical engineering students to learn basically operations and techniques for several kinds of devices. Scheduling laboratory experiments include the determination of COD, the determination of molar nitrogen volume, the synthesis of complex, the determination of redox titration, vapor pressure, the determination the solubility, rates of chemical reactions, chemical equilibrium, and the preparation of Nylon-6, 6. This course is designed to train students how to use their brain and hands simultaneously and to settle down their science concepts.

description.zh: 本課程是針對近代生物學感興趣的學生所設計，內容涵蓋生命與能量、細胞與分子生物學、生物多樣性、動植物的結構與功能、遺傳訊息的傳遞、生命的演化與生態。讓學生瞭解生命體系的輪廓，為生物科技的基礎課程。
description.en: A one-term introductory course intended for students interesting in modern life science. This course will cover topics in energy and life, cellular and molecular biology, biological diversity, structure and function of plant and animal, and transmission genetics. Principles of evolution and ecology will also be covered.

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。

description.zh: 使學生認知測量是各項工程建設的一項重要基礎性先行的工作，使能適應各項測量外業觀測、內業計算及繪圖等作業。課程概要如下：1)測量之基本概念、(2)各種測量儀器的認識與使用、(3)控制測量（括三角、三邊導線高程等)之施測方法及計算、(4)地形圖及地籍圖之測及應用、(5)各項工程放樣測量。

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以「北科人物故事與城市記憶」為核心，結合田野調查、報導文學與GIS故事地圖製作，引導學生從人物經驗出發，認識臺北科技大學與周邊城市空間的歷史變遷、產業記憶與地方文化。

課程將以北科相關人物為主軸，訪問畢業校友、企業經營者、教師、退休職員、在地居民、周邊店家與文史工作者，蒐集他們與北科、建國啤酒廠、光華橋、光華商場、八德路商圈及周邊社區相關的生命故事。建國啤酒廠將作為北科城市記憶的一環，呈現其曾作為學生實習場域、產業空間與地方記憶節點的歷史意義。

一、田野調查與人物專訪

學生將走入北科校園與周邊街區，透過實地觀察與人物訪談，蒐集校友求學經驗、產業發展記憶、地方生活故事與城市空間變遷資料，理解北科與臺北城市發展之間的連結。

二、報導文學寫作訓練

課程訓練學生將訪談資料、現地觀察與歷史背景，轉化為具有人物描寫、場景敘事與社會觀察的報導文學作品。期中成果以一篇人物報導為主，透過個人故事呈現北科的教育傳承、產業連結與地方記憶。

三、GIS故事地圖建置

學生將整理訪談內容、照片、歷史資料與地點座標，運用GIS工具建置「北科人物故事地圖」。地圖內容可涵蓋北科校園、建國啤酒廠、光華橋舊址、光華商場、八德路商圈、周邊老店與校友創業據點，呈現人物、事件與空間之間的關係。期末成果以GIS故事地圖作為數位敘事作品。

四、課程目標

本課程旨在培養學生田野觀察、人物訪談、報導文學寫作、GIS數位敘事與地方關懷能力。透過採訪、書寫與地圖製作，學生能從北科人物故事出發，重新理解校園、產業、社區與城市變遷之間的多重關係。

This course centers on “NTUT Personal Narratives and Urban Memory,” integrating fieldwork, reportage writing, and GIS-based story mapping. It guides students to explore the historical transformation, industrial memory, and local culture of National Taipei University of Technology and its surrounding urban spaces through personal experiences.

The course takes people associated with NTUT as its primary focus. Students will interview alumni, entrepreneurs, faculty members, retired staff, local residents, neighborhood shop owners, and cultural-history workers to collect life stories related to NTUT, Jianguo Brewery, Guanghua Bridge, Guanghua Market, the Bade Road commercial district, and nearby communities. Jianguo Brewery will be treated as one part of NTUT’s urban memory, highlighting its historical significance as a former site for student internships, an industrial space, and a locus of local memory.

**I. Fieldwork and Personal Interviews**

Students will enter the NTUT campus and surrounding neighborhoods to conduct site observations and interviews. They will collect materials on alumni experiences, memories of industrial development, local life stories, and changes in urban space, thereby understanding the connections between NTUT and Taipei’s urban development.

**II. Training in Reportage Writing**

The course trains students to transform interview materials, field observations, and historical contexts into reportage works characterized by personal portrayal, scene-based narration, and social observation. The midterm project will consist of a profile-based reportage piece that presents NTUT’s educational legacy, industrial connections, and local memory through an individual life story.

**III. GIS-Based Story Mapping**

Students will organize interview content, photographs, historical materials, and geographic coordinates to create an “NTUT Personal Narrative Story Map” using GIS tools. The map may include NTUT’s campus, Jianguo Brewery, the former site of Guanghua Bridge, Guanghua Market, the Bade Road commercial district, surrounding long-standing shops, and alumni entrepreneurial sites. It will present the relationships among people, events, and spaces. The final project will be a GIS-based story map as a form of digital narrative.

**IV. Course Objectives**

This course aims to cultivate students’ abilities in field observation, personal interviewing, reportage writing, GIS-based digital storytelling, and local engagement. syllabi.outline:
課程內容主要包括兩個項目:
 
1. 設計的思維與邏輯:
這堂課程與一般的設計概論不同，主要的目的在建立清晰的設計思維概念，從實務的觀點，來解說"什麼是設計"以及"什麼是好的設計"。本課程會透過理論的講解以及大量的影片與實際案例，建立對設計邏輯的基本理解
2. 手繪實作與練習: 
除了觀念的建立外，這堂課也會講解基本手繪的技巧，並以作業實作的方式，建立大家對設計的流程，方法與觀念初步的認識，期末將讓大家以手繪的方式設計一個"座椅"，成為你的第一個設計案

本課程分上課週與評圖週
從第二週起，有手繪作業，第三周則是上課週，第四週則是評圖週，隔週上課，隔週評圖，設計手繪作業，有兩週的時間完成

**本課程是針對未來想要從事設計相關產業的同學所設計的專業課程，目的在建立實作流程技法與觀念理論的專業基礎

** 本課程不是常識性(通識性質)的課程,但是如果你想深入了解:
1基礎的設計流程與技法,
2建立做設計應有的專業素養,
3對設計應有的基本概念,
這會是相當扎實的課程

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

name.zh: 文化事業發展與人才培育
name.en: Cultural Vocation Development and its Men Power Cultivation

description.zh:
文化事業是以「文化」為素材所開展的事業，性質上以文化、美學或社會價值為訴求，但也往往同時兼具經濟價值。本課程旨在介紹文化事業的內涵與範疇，比較其與當前政府推展的「文化創意產業」間的異同，其中「文化」、「文化政策」、「國際文化生態」等都是觸及的議題。其次，討論「高品質的文化服務」與「從業人員的素養」，探討從事者應具備的基本能力與人格特質，並借重測驗工具協助同學理解個人人格特質組成及分布。
    對於重要文化事業區塊，或將採取主題介述方式，邀請業界人士進行講座，而實地參訪與場景演練也是重要的教學活動。
description.en: Cultural Vocation is a developing vocation base on culture. The scope of the nowadays so-called "Cultural Business" has more or less been verlapped with "The Business of Culture and Creativeness" with the essence of emphasis not only on the economic values but also on those of culture, esthetics and society. The course will be focused on introductory methodology through main topic discussions by inviting professionals from different realms of industries for panel symposiums. In addition, on-site visits and case simulations are also to be included as important educational activities. The initial courses will be discussions on cultural relevant topics such as "Culture", "Cultural policies", "Cultural Development" and "International Cultural Systems". Further various scopes and contents of "Cultural Vocation" and status quo of its development will be introduced and discussed.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生認識中國及台灣本土的文學題材，熟悉各家的文學特色，進而懂得欣賞，並且能夠將之轉譯成文化符碼，靈活應用。然礙於文學作品繁多，課程時間有限，是以無法按照時間序，以史的方式一一介紹文學作品。是以為了避內容過於概論性或過於淺薄，本課程將以主題來進行教學。亦即依文類、時代、作家或風格來帶領同學由深而廣，逐漸培養同學賞析文學的能力。
description.en: This course aims to introduce students to literary topics in China and Taiwan, familiarize them with the literary characteristics of various authors, and enable them to appreciate and translate them into cultural codes for flexible application. However, due to the vast number of literary works and limited course time, it is not possible to introduce literary works in a chronological or historical manner. Therefore, in order to avoid overly general or shallow content, this course will be taught thematically. That is, students will be guided from depth to breadth by literary genres, time periods, authors, or styles, gradually cultivating their ability to appreciate literature.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在讓學生認識台灣各時期的文學內容與變遷，熟悉各階段的文學特色，進而懂得欣賞，並且能夠將之轉譯成文化符碼，靈活應用。課程將依照年代與主題來進行教學，並結合分組合作進行文學作品改編戲劇演出，學生在熟悉文學內容同時能主動發想、進行文字編修、服裝、舞台設計等跨領域學習。
This course aims to familiarize students with the development and evolution of Taiwanese literature across various historical periods, enabling them to familiarize themselves with the literary characteristics of each stage. Furthermore, it empowers students to translate these literary elements into cultural codes for versatile applications. The curriculum is organized chronologically and thematically. Through collaborative group projects, students will adapt literary works into theatrical performances. While mastering the literary content, students will also engage in interdisciplinary learning, actively participating in creative conceptualization, text editing, costume design, and stage design.

description.zh: 本課程為非資訊科系的程式設計入門課程，期能讓學生瞭解運算思維概念，並對資訊程式運作與設計方式有初步掌握。課程將以Python語言為實作演練工具，透過實際規劃、編寫、除錯與測試等階段，逐步培養學生基本程式設計能力。課程也將規劃人工智慧(AI)入門概念與基本做法，並由學生實際動手完成AI應用於文化發展領域議題的專題作品，讓學生能體會AI新科技對產業發展的現況，並思考面對未來AI新時代的準備方向。
description.en: This course is an introductory programming course for non-computer science majors, aiming to facilitate students understand the concept of computational thinking and gain a preliminary grasp of information program operation and design methods. The course will employ Python as the implementation and practice tool, gradually cultivating students' basic programming skills through practical planning, coding, debugging, and testing stages. Furthermore, the course will introduce the concepts and basic practices of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Students will have hands-on experience completing a project applying AI to cultural development issues. This allows students to appreciate the status of AI technology in industry and contemplate the preparation directions for the upcoming AI era.

description.en: The Network and Multimedia course is to introduce the software most used in internet, such as: Netscape, Internet Explorer, Email, BBS, Gopher, FTP, Telnet, and so on. And how does multimedia process the documents, audio, video, graph, and picture data. This course will also focuses on the following topics: 1. Basic audio information processing techniques. 2. extra.課程進度(1-16週):
第一階段：AI 網頁設計觀念與視覺素材準備（第 1 - 4 週）
目標：掌握 UI/UX 基本邏輯與網站設計元素，並利用 AI 批量生成網頁影音視覺素材。
第 1 週：課程大綱與上課相關規定說明。網頁結構簡介：解析什麼是前端、後端、網域與伺服器。
第 2 週：UI/UX 核心思維與 AI 心智圖討論用戶體驗（UX）與視覺介面（UI）基本設計原則。
第 3 週：AI 文案與風格調色盤生成網頁文案：利用 AI 寫出有高轉化率的行銷文案，以及使用 AI 色彩生成器與字體搭配工具建立網頁視覺規範。
第 4 週：AI 圖像與商業素材生成實戰使用 Midjourney / Adobe Firefly / Canva AI 生成網頁配圖、Icon 與 Banner。提示詞優化：如何生成去背商品圖與具有一致風格的插畫。
第二階段：AI 快速原型設計與代碼架站（第 5 - 8 週）目標：不寫程式碼，並體驗快速建站工具。
第 5 週：Figma 結合 AI 進行快速原型設計Figma 基礎操作與熱門 AI 外掛介紹。用 AI 外掛一鍵將文字描述轉化為 Wireframe（線框圖）與 UI 介面。
第 6 週：AI 一鍵生成式建站：Wix AI 與 Gamma體驗 Wix AI 與 Gamma 的對話式建站流程。
第 7 週：微型電商架站討論與介紹。
第 8 週：期中專案提案與架構總檢視獨立專案簡報：發表自己的網站目標、受眾與設計風格。
第三階段：AI 程式碼生成與前端微調（第 9 - 13 週）目標：進入核心開發！透過生成式 AI 工具直接「說」出網頁原始碼，並學會基礎閱讀與修改。
第 9 週：期中考週。
第 10 週：看懂 AI 寫的程式：HTML5 與 CSS3 基礎解密網頁的骨架（HTML）與皮相（CSS）基本語法認識。網頁如何自動適應手機、平板與桌電螢幕。
第 11 週： CSS 網頁組件。
第 12 週：JavaScript 與 AI 互動特效網頁的肌肉（JS）：控制網頁動作（如彈跳視窗、側邊選單等）。
第 13 週：AI 錯誤偵測與 Debug 實戰手冊常見的網頁報錯（Console Error）與程式破綻處理。如何為網站注入動態資料，進行搜尋引擎優化，並發佈至網際網路上。
第 14 週：網頁動態表單與 AI 後端自動化（Make / Supabase）處理使用者資料。
第 15 週：網站速度檢查：使用 PageSpeed Insights 檢測並依 AI 建議壓縮圖檔。實作：完成全站的 SEO 設定優化。
第 16 週：（Git/GitHub 基本觀念）。使用 Vercel 或 GitHub Pages 進行一鍵費部署。綁定專屬自訂網域（Domain）與申請費 SSL 安全憑證。實作：將專案正式發佈上線，取得可公開分享的網站網址。網站無障礙與多語系 AI 翻譯擴充利用 AI 快速將全站語法翻譯成多國語言版本（如中英雙語網頁）。檢查網頁無障礙設計（Accessibility）確保所有族群皆可流暢閱讀。
第 17 週：成果發表（一）：學員線上展示發表自己的最終動態網站作品。
第 18 週：成果發表（二）：學員線上展示發表自己的最終動態網站作品。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹設計的本質、設計的基本要素，包括線、形、空間、紋理、質感、明暗與色彩，從實作中實驗各種材料的特性，練習平面及立體的構成以達到設計感的養成與創造力的激發；為來自不同背景的新生掌握視覺設計之基本語言，奠定美術與設計的基礎。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the essence and the basic elements of design. In includes line, shape, space, texture, light, shade and color. In order to stimulate students' creativity and develop their sense of design, students have to test the feature of varied materials, and exercise the form of two-dimensional and three-dimensional. Besides, students who are with different backgrounds will be established the base of art and design, and they will learn the basic language of visual design in the course.

description.zh: 本課程以衣食住行、飲食男女等日常活動、交往、思維為主軸，考察一般人的歷史活動與日常生活在各時期的變化。當歷史不再只是帝王將相的豐功偉業或名流大家的傳奇生活，升斗小民的日常生活看似微不足道，點點滴滴的匯聚而成的正是一個社會的大歷史。
description.en: This course focuses on different aspects of daily activities of ordinary people throughout historical periods trying to explore the development and structure of their culture including clothing, housing, foods, family functions, and transportation. By taking a close look at their interactions, concerns, manners and customs can the students gain an insight into the other side of history far beyond kings and queens, wars and struggles that construct orthodox historical accounts and documents.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以衣食住行、飲食男女等日常活動、交往、思維為主軸，考察一般人的歷史活動與日常生活在各時期的變化。當歷史不再只是帝王將相的豐功偉業或名流大家的傳奇生活，升斗小民的日常生活看似微不足道，點點滴滴的匯聚而成的正是一個社會的大歷史。
This course focuses on everyday activities, social interactions, and paradigms of thought—encompassing basic necessities, dietary habits, and human relationships—to examine the historical actions and evolution of ordinary people's daily lives across various periods. History ceases to be defined solely by the monumental achievements of rulers and generals or the legendary lives of prominent figures. Instead, the daily lives of common people, though seemingly microscopic, aggregate piece by piece to constitute the macro-history of a society.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程提供大一學生必備之英語文語言技巧，強調專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分，並整合英語文之聽、說、讀、寫之能力，提升英語文在專業領域的應用。
description.en: This course equips first-year students with essential English language skills, focusing on developing their communication abilities in specific professional fields. The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description
This course aims to provide students with a solid understanding of differential and integral calculus. It is designed to cultivate logical reasoning, inspire creative thinking, strengthen computational and deductive skills, and emphasize practical applications and graphing techniques. The goal is to build a strong mathematical foundation for future studies in engineering mathematics and related professional courses, ultimately achieving the objective of applying what is learned in real-world contexts.
Course topics include:
1.	Limits and Continuity
2.	Derivatives and Their Applications
3.	Indefinite and Definite Integrals
4.	Transcendental Functions and Their Inverses
5.	Integration Techniques
6.	Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integrals
7.	Applications of Definite Integrals
8.	Solid Geometry and Vector Calculus
9.	Partial Derivatives
10.	Multiple Integrals
11.	Series

description.zh: 本課程主要使學生能強化會計學的基本觀念，並以國際會計原則(IFRS)為架構，熟悉會計流程與財務報表之編製。課程內容包含會計恆等式與財務報表的介紹、借貸法則、會計處理程序(分錄、過帳、試算)與調整、結帳與會計循環的完成、買賣業會計、存貨的會計處理、現金、應收帳款、不動產、廠房與設備、無形資產、負債、股東權益、以及投資活動的會計處理，最後則是現金流量表的編制，與財務報表的運用與分析。
description.en: This course is an introduction to the basic concepts and standards underlying financial accounting systems. Several important concepts will be studied in detail, including: cash, accounts and notes receivable, inventory, marketable securities, equity investments, PPE, intangibles, debt, equity issuance, and dividends. The course emphasizes the construction of the basic financial accounting statements - the income statement, retained earnings statement, statement of financial position, and statement of cash flows - as well as their interpretation. Financial accounting focuses on providing information that is relevant and useful for external users. This course expands your knowledge of understanding of the basic language and conceptions of accounting. The basic accounting concepts that will help you solve problems and exercises designed to transaction recording and financial statement preparation.
