name.zh: 數位科技與人工智慧導論
name.en: Introduction to Digital Technology and Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 數位科技與人工智慧是資訊科技發展的兩大重要驅動力，本課程旨在培養本系學生在此領域學習的藍圖與概念建立。本課程將介紹數位科技與人工智慧的基本概念、原理與應用。在數位科技方面，將涵蓋IT基礎設施、網際網路、資訊安全、虛擬化與雲端，IoT等主題。在人工智慧方面，將涵蓋機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、電腦視覺等主題。
description.en:
Digital Technology and Artificial Intelligence are two major driving forces of the development of information technology. This course aims to cultivate students' learning blueprints and concepts in this field. This course will introduce the basic concepts, principles and applications of digital technology and artificial intelligence.
In the areas of digital technology, it will cover topics such as IT infrastructure, the Internet, information security, virtualization and cloud computing, and IoT. In the areas of artificial intelligence, it will cover topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.

description.zh: 課程的目標期待透過理論與案例研究幫助學生理解「金融科技」，包括改變付款方式的破壞力、分析不斷變化的監管環境，並對人工智慧、區塊鏈、上雲、行動銀行、開放銀行、機器人顧問、眾籌、P2P借貸等金融科技議題有著更深入的了解；此外，也介紹資訊安全與目前監管機構在金融科技的角色。
description.en: The objective of the course is to help students understand "Financial Technology" through theory and case studies, including the disruptive impact of changing payment methods, analyzing the constantly evolving regulatory environment, and gaining a deeper understanding of financial technology topics such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, mobile banking, open banking, robo-advisors, crowdfunding, peer-to-peer lending, etc. Additionally, it introduces information security and the role of current regulatory agencies in financial technology.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹金融科技（FinTech）之基本概念、核心技術及金融創新應用，期待同學瞭解人工智慧、區塊鏈、雲端運算、生物辨識等新興科技如何改變金融服務模式，並探討金融監理、資訊安全、個人資料保護、洗錢防制及永續金融等重要議題。透過案例分析與專題報告，培養同學跨領域思維及金融科技素養。

This course introduces the fundamental concepts, enabling technologies, and innovative applications of Financial Technology (FinTech). Students will explore how artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, biometric authentication, cybersecurity, and sustainable finance are transforming financial services. The course also discusses financial regulation, personal data protection, anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorism financing (CTF), and fraud prevention. Through case studies and presentations, students will develop interdisciplinary perspectives and FinTech literacy.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。

description.zh: 本課程教授近代百年設計，以平面設計為主軸，同時亦對當時設計運動所影響的設計相關領域，包括產品、服飾、室內與建築設計風格，做關聯性的介紹。透過近代百年設計發展主要運動的介紹，建立學生對於設計史的知識與設計文化涵養的紮根，並學習思考設計運動時代下的美學思潮脈絡與發展關係。
description.en: This course introduces students to graphic design as well as the influence of design movement in the fields of products, fashion, interior and architecture design that shaped the twentieth century in design. Through the introduction of the twentieth century in design, this course advances student’s understanding of design history and cultural enrichment. Students take an in-depth look at the context and development of movements that are significant in the history of design.

description.zh: 課程規劃的目標為以互動設計的理論為基礎，實務導向為原則，使學習者能將學術界的理論與產業界的實務加以結合以充實對於互動設計具有的了解。學習的內容包含互動設計系統構成要素、實務與理論基礎、方法與技術、科技支援與應用等單元，各單元並包含不同互動設計個案的研討，使理論能與實務進行驗證。課程亦安排至相關領域業界的參訪以及互動相關展覽參觀，以加深對於互動設計實務的印象與了解。
description.en: The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. Course topics include essential factors of interactive system, interaction design theory and practice, methods and techniques, technical support and application. Course also incorporates case studies, company visits and exhibitions relevant to interaction design to enhance the understanding of integrating theory and practice.

syllabi.materials:
互動設計概論 – 創造互動設計無限應用的可能
Interaction Design – Creating Valuable Application of Interactive System Design

A. 前言
一、定義：數位化時代的互動設計
    1-1 使用者的體驗
    1-2 產業界的技術推力
    1-3 市場的接受度
    1-4 創客(Maker)的實作
    1-5 3D列印與開放式硬體 (Arduino)
    1-6 展覽策展人的規劃
二、互動設計的首要原則：使用者經驗
    1-1問題-解決過程
    1-2使用者經驗定義 (含使用者中心設計UCD)
    1-3使用者經驗的心理學基礎 (Donald A. Norman的思考)
    1-4使用者行為研究法 (IDEO Method Cards)

B. 生活中的互動設計
一、互動設計 vs. 人機介面
  Chapter 1：人機介面的人因基礎
    1-1人機系統基本概念 (系統輸入輸出、控制與顯示)
    1-2人的認知過程與介面設計 (認知過程、人的感知系統)
    1-3心智模型與介面設計
  Chapter 2：人機介面使用性
    2-1使用性工程 (基礎觀念)
    2-2介面使用性設計與使用者評估 (使用性lifecycle、評估方法)
    2-3使用性設計實務 (網頁使用性設計、真實世界中的使用性)
    2-4介面設計之原理原則 (介面一致性…)
  Chapter 3：人機介面設計重要構面
    3-1介面設計類型 (從傳統控制顯示介面、GUI到自然人機介面)
    3-2介面使用者經驗設計 (Jesse James Garrett的UXD)
    3-3資訊架構與流程 (任務分析)
    3-4原型設計 (prototyping)
  Chapter 4：常用之介面設計方法與工具
    4-1心情看板moodboard
    4-2人物誌與情境persona & scenario
    4-3快速原型工具Axure RP、POP
    4-4卡片排序Card sorting
二、互動設計 vs. 智慧空間
  Chapter 5: 透視智慧空間的新發展
    5-1智慧空間之發展與潛在思維 Technological Development and Philosophy
    5-2智慧空間-從概念到實踐 Smart/ Human Centered Design
    5-3台灣智慧空間發展與產業 Industry/ Policies  
  Chapter 6: 智慧化空間技術與材料
    6-1智慧空間與互動技術之需求 Needs  
    6-2適用於空間之互動感知技術Spatial sensor technology
    6-3虛擬實境與擴增實境 Augment & Virtual reality display
    6-4智慧化介面 Smart interface
  Chapter 7: 感知與回應模式
    7-1資訊空間與介面 Information control and interface
    7-2資訊流與資訊尋求 Information flow and information seeking
    7-3資訊視覺化與回應 Information visualization and reflection
    7-4使用者感受與操控User perception and affordance
  Chapter 8: 智慧化空間設計與應用
    8-1應用方向-3D實境 3D VR/ AR
    8-2應用方向-自動化 Automation
    8-3應用方向-節能  Energy saving
    8-4應用方向-物聯網 Internet of things
    8-5應用方向-物業管理 Property management
    8-6應用方向-通用設計 Universal design
三、互動設計 vs. 展示科技
  Chapter 9: 展示內容與手法
    9-1 會場環境端評估
    9-2 觀眾研究(如:空間心理學.參觀行為等)
    9-3 博物館相關理論
  Chapter 10: 展示科技與互動設計
    10-1 觸控介面
    10-2 非接觸式智慧導覽服務
    10-3 影像辨識
    10-4 動作偵測
    10-5 特殊顯示(如:水字幕.浮空投影等)
    10-6 體感偵測
    10-7 人臉辨識
    10-8 擴增實境
  Chapter 11: 超展示設計
    11-1 多媒體展演
    11-2 五感體驗
    11-3 大型博覽會分析
  Chapter 12: 發現生活中的展示科技
四、互動設計 vs. 數位學習
  Chapter 13: 科技進化下的數位學習
    13-1 數位學習的定義與範圍
    13-2 台灣數位學習產業與變遷
    13-3 新科技下數位學習的發展與契機
  Chapter 14: 數位學習的技術與工具
    14-1 數位學習之觸控技術
    14-2 數位學習之體感技術
    14-3 數位學習與虛實整合的教具
    14-4 科技輔助式學習工具
  Chapter 15: 學習成效與評估模式
    15-1 使用者省思與數位檔案評量
    15-2 建構式發問與數位化形成性評量
    15-3 總結性評量與線上追蹤
    15-4 影響學習成效的評估
  Chapter 16: 具互動性的數位學習應用案例
    16-1 虛實整合的教具應用
    16-2 AR與VR的數位學習應用
    16-3穿戴式裝置結合行動學習的應用
    16-4 跨載體無所不在的學習應用
    16-5 開放式/費線上學習的應用

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者—產品—環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。
description.en: The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹情境劇本法 (scenario) 之相關知識與其在互動設計上之應用。藉由此課程的學習，學生可以了解如何使用代表性的角色擬定以及故事板的操作以發現關鍵設計議題。透過方法的了解以及實作模擬，學生能具備業界所需之互動情境或介面設計應有之情境敘事技巧與能力。課程內容包含情境故事法介紹、人-機-境概念、互動情境模擬、代表性角色擬定以及故事板製作。學生評量方式則包含報告撰寫以及作業繳交。
description.en: The aim of the course is to introduce basic knowledge and application of scenario technique on interaction design. Through this course, students can understand how to define the characters of an interactive scenario and develop storyboard to draw out key design theme. Students will be capable of scenario technique for practical interaction design. Course contents include introduction of scenario method, human-machine-scenario, interactive scenario narration, character mapping and storyboard. Students will be evaluated by reports and their works.

syllabi.outline:
The primary goal of this course is to equip students with foundational 3D modeling and rendering skills, while guiding them through the complete process of transforming a design concept into a tangible output. The course will focus on Rhino 3D, a widely used tool in both fabrication and industrial design. Through a series of tutorials and hands-on exercises, students will develop a solid understanding of the software and gain essential skills applicable to various design industries.

By the end of the semester, each student is expected to complete a comprehensive Graphic Doding project, which must include codes, renderings, animations, and a 3D model. This final package will serve as the key evaluation criteria for the course.

In addition, we will dedicate part of the class to introducing digital fabrication workflows, providing students the opportunity to gain hands-on experience with turning digital models into physical objects.

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者—產品—環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。
description.en: The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. To explore the context of user-product-environment, students understand visual communication and multimedia language as a basis of interaction design toward completely new experiences and sensation.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。

description.en:
The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows：
CMEE：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.en: Introduction of Modern Control Theory﹒Linear space Analysis , State equation and Response, Controllability and Observability , Stability Analysis, State Feedback and Estimation, Controller Design and Applications, Observer Design and Applications, Nonlinear systems, Time varying Systems, Applications of Modern Control theory.﹒

syllabi.outline:
Modern control theory mainly focuses on linear system analysis and design.  This is the course where students from a variety of backgrounds begin to acquire the mathematical tools used in research literature involving linear systems.  The core material covered in this course is the theory of time-varying linear systems, in both continuous-time and discrete-time, with frequent specialization to the time invariant case.

The goals of the course can be summarized as below:
	Learning some useful facts about linear systems, emphasizing motivation and significance rather than mathematical formalism.
	Learning some useful facts from matrix theory and linear algebra, and seeing them used.
	Learning about mathematical reasoning.
The course is presented in a standard format of lectures and readings sets.  In addition to the closed-book final examination, there will be a number of homework assignments equally spaced over the term.  You will be asked to do selected homework questions during class hours for evaluation purpose.  Each student is required to make a presentation and submit a report based on a technical paper in related topics.  The lecture will be based mainly, but not entirely, on material in the textbook.  Course-related information will mainly be distributed via emails.  Please make sure to keep us updated about your email addresses.
syllabi.assessment: The final grade will be a weighted average of attendance 10%, in-class open-book homework 20%, midterm 30%, final 30%, flexible learning reports 10%, and in-class performance credits evaluated by Professor.

description.zh: 本課程以鋰電池為例，將深入探討鋰電池的電網與電動車領域與相關領域之主要研究課題，並應用控制理論實現電池系統鑑別、電池電量狀態與電池健康狀態量測。本課程針對研究所學生開設，藉由理論探討與模擬實作，加強學生的理論知識與實作能力，並透過定期期刊文章研討，加強學生的閱讀與簡報專業論文之能力。
description.en: This course takes lithium-ion batteries as an example. It introduces current research challenges of lithium-ion batteries’ applications (i.e., electrical vehicles (EVs) and power grids). It then investigates battery system identification approaches, battery state-of-charge (SOC) estimation algorithms, battery state-of-health (SOH) prognosis algorithms, and related control theories. This course is set targeting to institute students, where the goal of this course is to help them gain necessary domain knowledge, develop simulation and implementation skills, and improve capabilities of reading and reporting journal papers.

description.zh: 排程主要在規劃與排定活動執行的優先順序，以使各項資源得到最佳的運用。本課程除了介紹排程的基本理論外，對排程於各種問題的應用亦有闡述。課程的主要目的在使學生學習排程的基本概念與法則，並瞭解排程於各種生產型態的應用。
description.en: Scheduling consists of planning and prioritizing activities that need to be performed in an orderly sequence of operation. It is a tool that optimizes use of available resources. This course focuses on theoretical as well as applied aspects of scheduling of resources. The purpose of this course is to guide the students to learn the basic concept and rules of sequencing and scheduling, and to understand the different scheduling application aspects for various shop floors.

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

name.en: Ergonomics evaluation and redesign in products

description.zh: 本課程期望學生能夠能有獨立思考的能力，對產品建構出合理的實驗設計架構，透過採集人的生理與心理數據對產品進行人因工程評估，最後將實驗發現應用於產品的重新設計上，讓產品能夠更符合使用者的需求與認知。
description.en: In this course, students are expected to demonstrate independent thinking, develop a reasonable experimental design, conduct ergonomics evaluations on products by collecting both physiological and psychological data, and ultimately apply the findings to redesign products. This ensures that the products align more effectively with the needs and perceptions of users.

This course aims to cultivate students' independent thinking abilities, enabling them to construct reasonable experimental design frameworks for products, conduct human factors engineering evaluations of products by collecting physiological and psychological data, and finally apply experimental findings to product redesign to better meet user needs and perceptions. In addition, this course will combine SDG 3 - Good Health and Wellbeing and SDG 5 - Gender Equality as starting points to identify key human-centered issues in collaborative settings, and after conducting logical human factors evaluations, ultimately propose key design parameters and specifications.

description.zh: 本課程主要是介紹六標準差方法。六標準差(Six Sigma)是一套管理系統，它是透過聆聽顧客的聲音(Voice of Customer)，經由關鍵品質(Critical to Quality)的分析，利用專案的方式，以流程改善工具解決有問題的企業流程。本課程著重了解“Six Sigma”理論、分析工具及統計應用軟體(Minitab)之運用，針對六標準差綠帶、黑帶專業培訓課程，藉由理論分析與實際操作使用的說明，協助學生將”Six Sigma”導入企業，以獲得關鍵流程的改進。
description.en: This course primarily introduces the Six Sigma methodology. Six Sigma is a management system that listens to the Voice of Customer, analyzes Critical to Quality factors, and utilizes project-based approaches with process improvement tools to address problematic business processes. The course focuses on understanding the theory of Six Sigma, analysis tools, and the application of statistical software (Minitab). It is designed for Green Belt and Black Belt professional training in Six Sigma. Through theoretical analysis and practical exercises, the course assists students in implementing Six Sigma in enterprises to achieve improvements in key processes.

description.en:
The aim of this course is to introduce basic methods of numerical analysis and to provide the groundwork for the research in the Institute of Industrial Engineering and Management. The objectives guide students to: 
(1) Write simple program for numerical calculations. 
(2) Find approximate solutions of various mathematical problems. 
Course content includes error analysis, solving a nonlinear equation (e.g. bracketing methods for locating a root, Newton-Raphson and secant methods), Taylor series and Lagrange approximation, Gaussian elimination, LU decomposition, Solving nonlinear system, Curve Fitting, Interpolation by spline function, Fourier series and expansion, numerical differentiation & integration, solving differential equations, Minimization of a function, etc.

syllabi.outline: This course teaches the basic theory of numerical methods to apply numerical algorithms in solving various types of mathematical problems by using a computer. The content includes error analysis and problem-solving of nonlinear equation (bisection, Newton, secant method), linear and nonlinear systems, curve fitting ( regression, Lagrange interpolation, spline curve), numerical differentiation and integration, ordinary differential equation, optimization, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description:

This course provides a comprehensive and hands-on introduction to engineering optimization methodologies, with a particular emphasis on the integration of Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) tools and simulation-driven design. Using ANSYS as the primary computational platform, students will learn how optimization techniques can be applied to solve complex engineering problems in product design, structural analysis, and operational performance.

The course focuses on continuous-variable optimization problems involving real-valued objective functions and engineering constraints. Students will develop both theoretical understanding and practical skills in formulating optimization problems, selecting appropriate solution strategies, and interpreting results within realistic engineering contexts. Special attention is given to the interaction between numerical optimization algorithms and finite element analysis (FEA), enabling students to perform simulation-based design optimization.

Through lectures, case studies, and project-based learning, participants will gain experience in applying optimization methods to multidisciplinary engineering applications, including mechanical, biomedical, and dental engineering systems.

Learning Objectives:

Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:

* Understand the fundamental principles and mathematical foundations of engineering optimization.
* Formulate engineering design problems using objective functions, design variables, and constraints.
* Apply optimization algorithms within the ANSYS environment.
* Integrate finite element analysis with optimization workflows for simulation-driven design.
* Evaluate and interpret optimization results to support engineering decision-making.
* Develop practical optimization models for real-world engineering applications.

Key Topics:

* Fundamentals of Engineering Optimization
* Mathematical Formulation of Optimization Problems
* Design Variables, Objective Functions, and Constraint Handling
* Numerical Optimization Algorithms
* Finite Element Analysis and Optimization Integration
* Parametric Modeling and Design Exploration in ANSYS
* Simulation-Based Design Optimization
* Case Studies in Mechanical, Biomedical, and Dental Engineering
* Sensitivity Analysis and Design Validation
* Practical Applications and Industry-Oriented Projects

Course Project:

As a capstone project, students will develop and analyze a simulation-based optimization model using ANSYS. Representative projects may include the optimal design of a dental implant under biomechanical and anatomical constraints, balancing structural performance, durability, and clinical requirements through advanced engineering optimization techniques.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。膜披覆製程是近年來高科技產業技術一項前途被看好的製程技術之一，廣用於刀具、模具、光學元件、感測器及半導體工業等等。此門課程將提供此項技術之介紹、相關配備、原理與能量提供方式、將包括：沉積技術與應用、化學氣相沉積法、物理氣相沉積法、電鍍技術、真空工程、直流電源、射頻電源、微波、熱燈絲等各種能量介紹、以及膜的成核與生長理論。
description.en: The technology of films coating has advanced dramatically. This advancement was driven primarily by the need for new products and devices in the electronics and optical industries etc.. The rapid progress in various devices would not have been possible without the development of new files coating technology, improved film characteristic and superior file qualities. This course is intended to serve us a guide for the student or practitioner in the field, as a review and overview of this rapidly evolving technology for the graduate students in several branches of science and engineering.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹薄膜材料與氣相沉積技術之基本原理、製程方法及工程應用。課程內容首先回顧材料科學基本概念，接續探討氣相沉積技術中的氣體傳輸、吸附、脫附、表面擴散及薄膜成長機制等核心理論，並介紹真空科學相關知識。課程介紹之製程技術涵蓋物理氣相沉積（PVD）與化學氣相沉積（CVD）之原理與應用，包括電阻式加熱蒸鍍、電子束蒸鍍、雷射蒸鍍、分子束磊晶成長與濺鍍技術，及各類化學氣相沉積製程與成長動力學。
This course aims to introduce the fundamental principles, processing methods, and engineering applications of thin-film materials and vapor deposition technologies. The course begins with a review of the basic concepts of materials science, followed by discussions of the core theories underlying vapor deposition processes, including gas transport, adsorption, desorption, surface diffusion, and thin-film growth mechanisms, as well as relevant concepts in vacuum science. The processing technologies covered in this course include the principles and applications of physical vapor deposition (PVD) and chemical vapor deposition (CVD). Topics include resistance heating evaporation, electron-beam evaporation, laser deposition, molecular beam epitaxy (MBE), sputtering technology, and various chemical vapor deposition processes and their growth kinetics.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於介紹移動機器人學的基礎知識，包括：輪式機器人的移動學、運動學與動力學、移動機器人的感測、感知、與認知方法等。本課程同時簡介移動機器人的系統架構、軟/硬體設計、地圖建立、定位與導航的基本概念。透過本課程的解說可使同學們瞭解如何設計並控制移動式機器人；並使研究所的同學具有分析與評估移動式機器人研究的背景知識。
description.en: This course focuses on the fundamentals of mobile robotics including locomotion of wheeled robots, kinematics and dynamics, sensory, perceptual and cognitive methods of mobile robots. System architecture, hardware and software design, and the concept of map building, localization, and navigation are also introduced in the course. We hope this course can help students understand how to design and control mobile robots, and can empower graduate students to have background knowledge to evaluate research results for mobile robots.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹綠色科技及其在二十一世紀對人類生活的影響，內容包括現今幾個最重要的「潔能」與「節能」科技，以及一些「環保」相關科技。「潔能科技」包括風力能、太陽能、水力能、地球內部能源、生質能、路面能、聲音能、燃料電池、電動車等；「節能科技」包括節能住宅、變頻空調等；「環保科技」則包括碳回收主題。介紹內容包括各項技術原理介紹及其發展概況。
description.en: This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, earth interior energy, bioenergy, roadway energy, sound energy, fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The environmental protesting technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

description.en: The laser is one of the three major items invented in 20th century.  Medical laser applications have been widely used in many fields.  This lecture will cover: 1. Laser Physics; 2. Safety Standards; 3. Laser-Tissue-Interaction; 4. Laser in Medical Applications; 5. Laser in Periodontology; 6. Laser in Oral Surgery; 7. Laser Assisted Bleaching; 8. Low Level Laser Therapy; 9. Practical Hands-on and Live Patient Demonstration.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description

The invention of the laser stands among the most significant technological breakthroughs of the twentieth century, transforming numerous scientific, industrial, and medical disciplines. Today, laser technology plays an increasingly important role in modern healthcare, offering minimally invasive, precise, and efficient treatment options across a wide range of medical and dental specialties.

This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental principles, safety considerations, and clinical applications of laser technology in medicine and dentistry. Students will gain an understanding of laser physics, laser-tissue interactions, and evidence-based treatment protocols, while exploring the latest advancements in laser-assisted procedures.

Key Topics Include:

Fundamentals of Laser Physics
Laser Safety Standards and Regulations
Laser-Tissue Interaction Mechanisms
Medical and Dental Laser Applications
Laser Use in Periodontology
Surgical Applications in Oral and Maxillofacial Procedures
Laser-Assisted Teeth Whitening (Bleaching)
Low-Level Laser Therapy (LLLT) and Photobiomodulation
Practical Hands-on Sessions and Participation in the Dental Laser Association

description.en: Space mechanics is the application of both particle and rigid-body dynamics in space field. The course contents cover orbital mechanics (application of particle dynamics) and satellite altitude dynamics (application of rigid-body dynamics). The main focus is for the students to build a fundamental mechanics knowledge about orbital engineering for the further development in related fields.

description.zh: 奈微米工程於生物醫學之應用日趨重要，量測與操作工具的開發與實際的生醫應用對象的大小尺寸具有密切的相關性，對於生物系統的充份瞭解是工程表現的重要過程之一。在此課程中將配合本校實驗室目前之相關研究設備進行原理講解與應用討論，包括之項目將由分子、細胞到組織之感測、分析與操縱。選修學生須依下列重點：奈微米生醫感測系統、奈米生醫材料、奈米生醫光電以及實驗室晶片等領域選擇期中期末報告之題目與計畫內容，主要要求在尋求創新思考方向，以求在原理或應用上的突破，積極推動跨領域與技術先進之整合性研究。
description.en: Nano/micro engineering in bio-medicine applications has become increasingly important. The development and operation of measurement tool for biomedical applications has a close correlation to the actual size of the object. In this course we will explain the principles of devices and discuss the applications based on the school's research laboratories, including sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules, cells, and tissues. Students will be required to do a project about Nano-micron biomedical sensor systems, nano-biomaterials and nano-biomedical areas such as optical and lab-chip. The interim and final report should devote to the topic and plans in the search for the direction of Creative Thinking with a view to the breakthrough of theory or application, and actively promote the integration of advanced interdisciplinary research and technology.

The application of nano-micron engineering in biomedicine is becoming more and more important. The development of measurement and operation tools is closely related to the size of actual biomedical application objects. A full understanding of biological systems is one of the important processes of engineering performance. In this course, the principle explanation and application discussion will be carried out with the current research equipment in our laboratory, including the sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules. Elective students should choose the topics and project content of the mid-term report in the fields of nano-micron biomedical sensing system, nano-biomedical materials, nano-biomedical optoelectronics, and laboratory chips. The main requirement is to seek innovative thinking , In order to seek breakthroughs in principles or applications, and actively promote integrated research across fields and advanced technologies.

syllabi.outline:
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to numerical methods and their application in solving scientific and engineering problems.
本課程旨在全面介紹數值方法及其在解決科學與工程問題上之應用。
Students will learn to translate real-world problems into mathematical models and apply various numerical algorithms for their solution.
學生將學習如何將實際問題轉化為數學模型，並應用各種數值演算法進行求解。
Key topics include mathematical modeling, error analysis, linear algebra, interpolation, approximation, numerical integration and differentiation, solving ordinary and partial differential equations, Monte Carlo methods, optimization, and an introduction to numerical methods in data science and high-performance computing.
主要內容包括數學建模、誤差分析、線性代數、內插法、逼近法、數值積分與微分、常微分與偏微分方程求解、蒙地卡羅方法、數值優化，以及數據科學與高效能計算中數值方法之簡介。
The course emphasizes hands-on experience through in-class programming sessions and utilizes online weeks for flexible learning.
本課程強調透過課堂程式設計實作獲得實務經驗，並利用線上教學週進行彈性學習。

課程重要事項 (Important Course Notes)

Bilingual Instruction (雙語教學): This course will be conducted with materials and explanations provided in both English and Chinese to support diverse learning needs. 本課程將以中英文雙語提供教材與解說，以支持多元學習需求。
Language of Assessment (評量語言): Major assignments, presentations, and examinations are required to be completed in English. 主要作業、報告及考試需以英文完成。
Programming Sessions (程式設計實作課): This course includes several in-class programming sessions. 本課程包含數次課堂程式設計實作。 Active participation and completion of programming tasks are mandatory. 學生必須積極參與並完成程式設計作業。
Online Teaching Weeks (線上教學週): Specific weeks will be conducted online. 特定教學週將採線上教學。 Students are expected to engage with materials and activities as directed on the [LMS/Email/Course Website]. 學生應依循[學習管理系統(LMS)/電子郵件/課程網站]之指示參與課程材料與活動。
Attendance Policy (出席規定): Students who are absent three (3) or more times (including programming sessions and online sessions where applicable) during the semester will automatically receive a failing grade for the course. 一學期內缺席三（3）次（含以上，適用於程式設計實作課與線上課程應參與部分）者，該課程成績以不及格計。(缺席三次不及格)

description.en: ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. In this course, the principle of the additive manufacturing technology in terms of its opto-electro-mechanical-system will be discussed. The application and the system development of additive manufacturing are the major topics of this course.

name.en: API Development for Engineering Computer Software

description.zh: 許多現成的工程軟體並無法滿足所有客製化的需求，因此會開放作謂的「應用程式介面」（Application Programming Interfaces, API）供使用者進行二次開發，使其能自行拼湊、重組與創造需要的功能。本課程以建築資訊塑模（BIM）或人工智慧（AI）應用為主要示範案例，訓練學生有系統地理解API的規格說明文件，並且有效率地開發API應用程式，以達到各種工程應用軟體的客製化應用，並提升不同軟體間的交互操作性。
description.en: Many engineering software packages may not fully meet all customized requirements, thus they provide Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for users to engage in secondary development. This course takes Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications as primary demonstration examples, and trains the enrolled students to systematically understand API documentations as well as efficiently develop API applications. It can help the enrolled students to customize their software for solving the engineering problems. In addition, it also enhances the  interoperability between different engineering software packages.

syllabi.outline:
許多現成的工程軟體並無法滿足所有客製化的需求，因此會開放作謂的「應用程式介面」（Application Programming Interfaces, API）供使用者進行二次開發，使其能自行拼湊、重組與創造需要的功能。本課程以建築資訊塑模（BIM）或人工智慧（AI）應用為主要示範案例，訓練學生有系統地理解API的規格說明文件，並且有效率地開發API應用程式，以達到各種工程應用軟體的客製化應用，並提升不同軟體間的交互操作性。
Many engineering software packages may not fully meet all customized requirements, thus they provide Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for users to engage in secondary development. This course takes Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications as primary demonstration examples, and trains the enrolled students to systematically understand API documentations as well as efficiently develop API applications. It can help the enrolled students to customize their software for solving the engineering problems. In addition, it also enhances the  interoperability between different engineering software packages.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹地工合成材料之種類、功能及其於工程領域之應用，並以土壤加勁為核心主題，培養學生具備設計、分析與評估加勁構造物(含擋土牆與邊坡)之理論與實務能力。課程內容亦涵蓋相關之施工技術、監測與維護方法、國內外實務案例，並進一步探討加勁構造物於天然災害防治上之應用與最新發展趨勢。
description.en: The overall objective of this course is to introduce the types, and functions, of geosynthetics and their engineering applications. Specifically, this course focuses on the soil reinforcement and provide students the fundamentals and tools needed for design, analysis, and performance evaluation of geosynthetic-reinforced soil (GRS) structures including both walls and slopes. Class also discusses construction, monitoring, maintenance, case histories as well as current state-of-art applications of GRS structures against various natural disasters.

syllabi.outline: The overall objective of this course is to introduce the types and functions of geosynthetics, along with their engineering applications. Specifically, this course focuses on soil reinforcement and provides students with the advanced knowledge necessary for the design, analysis, and performance evaluation of mechanically stabilized earth (MSE) walls. The course also covers topics such as construction, monitoring, maintenance, case histories, and the current state-of-the-art applications of geosynthetic-reinforced soil (GRS) structures in mitigating various natural disasters.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description 
Introduction to multi-media sampling techniques and analytical methods for evaluation outdoor/indoor air, soil/surfaces, and water. The course will also emphasize environmental investigative techniques, instrument selection, and quality control, including documentation, calibration, and sample management.

Course Goals 
This course will provide an introduction to multi-media sampling techniques and analytical methods for evaluation outdoor/indoor air, soil/surfaces, and water. By the end of the semester, students who complete all necessary assignments will be able to: 
1.	Collect samples in their research and in their professions. 
2.	Identify and quantify environmental pollution. 
3.	Defend their data and can base good decisions on their measurements.

description.zh:
近年發生之福島核災、印度新德里爆炸案等各種天然及人為災害已顯著影響到人類的生活品質與安全。本課程目標有三：(1)了解各種災害形成原因及環境背景因素；(2)評估災害對社會、環境及人類之影響及因應措施；(3)新穎技術可擴大環境監測尺度並預警災害。較為代表性之災害會於課堂中案例講述，加深同學學習印象。工程背景較為薄弱之學生，亦適合選修此課程。

(1)	災害管理內涵與重要觀念。
(2)	評估災害風險與危機管理。
(3)	研擬災前的災後復原重建計畫。
description.en:
The recurrent occurrences of various natural and manmade disasters like the December 2004 Tsunami, the bomb blasts in the cinema halls of Delhi and many such incidences have diverted our focus towards safety of one’s own life. The goals of this course are three-fold: (1) To educate students about the underlying natural process that give rise to hazards. (2) To emphasize how society evaluates and confronts the dangers posed by these natural processes from a political, social, and ethical perspective. (3) Expose students to the technological innovations that are allowing an increasing large human population to monitor, predict, and warn society about natural hazards and impending disasters. Case studies of recent and past natural disasters will be discussed. This course is designed for students without an extensive background in science or math and can be used to partly satisfy minor programs in Environmental Geosciences.

syllabi.outline: Disaster is divided to natural and anthropogenic disaster. Either natural or anthropogenic disaster damage can be minimized by proper management, including pre- and post- management. Learning from the history, several disasters have been identified and more and more technologies have been developed to mitigate the possible disasters. In this course, natural disasters are focus because it is more difficult to predict and prevent. With the changing environment and climate, the intensity and frequency of natural disasters become more strong and unpredictable; therefore, the disaster management is very important. Real cases for different types of disaster will be chosen and discussed in this course. Facing these disasters, what we can do and how we can prepare is a survival issue. Through the comprehensive discussion, the students are expected to learn the structural and nonstructural solutions for the various disasters. Especially, the solutions are focus on ecological engineering and environmental friendly methods. A new and widely accepted idea, natural-based solutions (NBS) or ecosystem-based approaches, is increasingly applied to disaster management and will be discussed in this course.

description.en: Compared to the undergraduate Rock Mechanics course, this is a more advanced course to examine the behaviors of rocks under different stress conditions。 It will focus on the index properties, the permeability properties, the strength properties, and the deformation properties of rocks。 In addition, it will address the difference between rocks and soils by contrast。 Finally, this course will introduce students to the concept of probability, and how it can be applied to the Rock Mechanics。 The students taking this course will have plenty of reading assignments, and are required to participate in the classroom discussions。

description.en: Open channel hydraulics treats the motion of water in conduits that have a free surface, that is, in which the flow of water is not completely bounded by the channel perimeter and one surface is exposed to atmospheric pressure.  The flows can be steady (time-invariant) or unsteady, uniform (space-invariant) or non-uniform (gradually, rapidly, or spatially varied).  For engineers, open channels are very common for the conveyance of natural waters, storm discharges, sewage collection systems, and aqueducts for water distribution systems. Knowledge of the mechanics of open-channel flow, then, is important for the proper design of these facilities.

description.en: This is a comprehensive course in probability and statistics for students in engineering and technology discipline.  It emphasizes modern statistical methods and data analysis using real data and examples to offer students exposure to practical applications.  This course will provide an opportunity to learn how probabilistic analysis and statistical reasoning and testing can be applied to a wide range of problems in civil engineering.  Topics to be covered will include data analysis, probability, random variables, probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, sampling, linear regression, statistical process control and analysis of variance.

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛設計分析」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計能力之人員，本課程初期將從規範面瞭解車輛設計要求，進而從結構面進行車輛設計與分析，過程中將引導學生採用主流分析軟體進行車輛穩定性與行車舒適度探討。最後將探討與台灣既有鐵道系統的相容性，進行駕駛室與機電設備配置等設計。期望透過本課程，能培植鐵道車輛設計分析人才，厚植本土鐵道車輛設計能力。
description.en: This aim of the course of "Railway Vehicle Design and Analysis" is to cultivate personnel on railway vehicle field. At the beginning of this course, the design requirement and criteria will be given as basic knowledge. Then students will be ask to perform structural design and analysis for railway vehicles. Passenger comfortable index and vehicle dynamic response will be taken into consideration during the process of design and analysis. Finally, the compatibility of the new design with the existing railway system will be discussed.

description.zh:
本課程使學生充分瞭解燃料電池專業學科基礎知識，並進一步啟發及增進學生未來能源科技發展知能。
燃料電池是一種電化學的發電裝置，其運作原理係利用電化學反應將燃料內之化學能直接轉換為電能，因其在能量轉換過程中並不經過熱機過程，因此能量轉換效率較高。本課程之授課綱要可分為以下幾項：
燃料電池系統簡介、燃料電池效率及開迴路電壓、燃料電池工作電壓、質子交換膜燃料電池、磷酸燃料電池、鹼性燃料電池、直接甲醇燃料電池、固態氧化物燃料電池、燃料電池的燃料供應、燃料電池電力傳輸、燃料電池系統分析。
description.en:
This course enables students to fully understand the basics of professional disciplines of the fuel cell, and to further inspire and enhance the knowledge of students about future energy technology. 
Fuel cell is an electrochemical power generating device. It can directly convert the chemical energy of fuel into the electrical energy via the electrochemical reaction. Because it does not go through the process of thermal engine in the energy conversion process, and therefore a higher energy conversion efficiency. Teaching outlines of the course can be divided into the followings:
Introduction to fuel cell system, Efficiency and open voltage, Operational fuel cell voltages, Proton exchange membrane fuel cell, Phosphoric acid fuel cell, Alkaline fuel cell, Direct methanol fuel cell, Solid oxide fuel cell, Fueling fuel cell, Delivering fuel cell power, Analysis of fuel cell system.

syllabi.outline:
THE FUEL CELL is an important component in Energy Engineering and can be defined as an electrochemical system that converts chemical energy in the fuel into electrical energy with the help of electrodes and redox electrochemical. There are many kinds of fuel cells that help us in meeting the energy demands of this modernizing world. Understanding them theoretically is very significant for research advancements in the field of Energy. 
This course ' THE FUEL CELL’ is a basic course taught entirely in English. 
The aim of this course is to provide introductory knowledge to students about the basics, types, working mechanism, applications and advancements in the field of fuel cells.
This class will also deal with sustainable fuel cells for producing clean energy and thereby preventing hazardous environmental issues through significant energy efficiency improvements and sustainable use of resources.
This course enables students to fully understand the basics of professional disciplines of the fuel cell, and to further inspire and enhance the knowledge of students about future energy technology. 
This course also has an important objective of motivating non-native English students to improve their English language skills like conversing, discussing and writing assignments in English.
These practices will help them deliver better English presentations and also enhance their thesis and paper writing abilities.
The students of this class will be separated into groups for weekly presentation purposes and every week the Teacher will assign a topic for presentation.
In every class, the Teacher will initially finish the teaching.
Then one person from every group has to give his/her presentation.
The students can use Powerpoint and YouTube videos to make their presentations interesting.
syllabi.assessment:
The Teacher will conduct one Midterm exam and one Final exam throughout the semester.
The total score of exam will be for 100 marks, in which the Teacher will consider the assignment marks, class attendance and the weekly presentation of every student.
The final score will be for 100% and it will be a sum of evaluations as 50% (from the final written exam) 25% (from the Midterm exam score) 15% (from the class presentations) 10% (from class attendance and attentiveness).

name.zh: 電腦輔助能源與熱流科學分析
name.en: Computer-Aided Analysis on Energy ad Thermofluid Sciences

description.zh: 本課程適合修過工程數學及基礎熱流的碩博士班學生選修。授課內容主要是應用Matlab及CFD套裝軟體分析能源與熱流科學領域的相關問題，並著重於案例分析。課程內容主要包括利用數值分析解析邊界層問題、有限差分法求解穩態與暫態熱傳導以及二維強制驅動流問題，案例分析包括室內氣流運動、潔淨室氣流分佈、熱交換器性能分析、儲冰系統分析、電子散熱以及氫能系統等。
description.en: This course is suitable for the graduate students who have taken fundamental courses of engineering mathematics and thermofluid sciences. The objective of this course is to apply Matlab and CFD packages to analyze the problems related to energy and thermofluid sciences. Case study is the focus of this course. Course contents mainly include the application of numerical methods on solving boundary-layer problems, analyzing steady and transient heat conduction problems, and 2-D lid-driven flow problems by finite difference method. Case study covers room air flow motion, clean room simulation, heat exchanger performance, electronic cooling, thermal ice storage system and hydrogen energy, etc.

name.en: Energy Performance Measurement and Verification and Carbon Management

description.zh: 因應全球淨零碳排趨勢，能源管理與碳管理為國家各產業提升競爭力的重要環節。本課程將從ISO50001能源管理與ISO14064碳管理制度出發，講授能源管理、能源績效評估、碳管理、和績效提升/減碳計算之量測與驗證方法學。講授內容涵蓋：關鍵觀念、節能/減碳技術、績效/減碳量測與驗證方法、節能/減碳統計分析方法學、和案例EXCEL操作與討論。
description.en: In response to the global trend of net-zero carbon emissions, energy management and carbon management are important links in improving the competitiveness of various industries in the country. This course will start from the ISO50001 energy management and ISO14064 carbon management systems and teach the measurement and verification methodologies of energy management, energy performance assessment, carbon management, and performance improvement/carbon reduction calculations. The teaching contents cover: key concepts, energy saving/carbon reduction technology, performance/carbon reduction measurement and verification methods, energy saving/carbon reduction statistical analysis methodology, and EXCEL case practice and discussion.

description.en: Organizational behavior (OB) is a field of research that investigates the impact that individuals, groups, and structure have on behavior within an organization, and then it applies that knowledge to make organizations work more effectively.  Specifically, OB focuses on how to improve productivity, reduce absenteeism and turnover, and increase employee citizenship and job satisfaction.

description.zh:
本課程主要探討高分子在溶液及固態時的物理化學現象及其應用。內容包括輔G熱力學?高分子的微結構及定性。
輔G熱力學探討統計熱力學、晶格理論、Flory-Huggin理論、Flory-Krigbaum理論、相分離、θ-溫度、滲透壓、GPC測分子量、高分子膠體。
?高分子之微結構包括有高分子之形狀、自由旋轉分子鏈距離、光散射、中子散射、排拒體積、碎形、霍氏光譜及核磁共振儀在高分子微結構之分析。
description.en:
The course is to investigate the physical phenomena of macromolecules in the solution and solid state. It includes the solution thermodynamics and chemical microstructure of polymer chains.
The solution thermodynamics is to study lattice theory, statistical thermodynamics, Flory-Huggin theory, Flory-Krigbaum theory, phase separation, θ-temperature, Osmometry, GPC, and polymer gels.
Light scattering and Neutron scattering are used to characterize the polymer microstructure. Polymer radius of gyration, freely rotating chains, excluded volume, fractal, and scaling are also discussed. Finally, spectroscopy methods are used to study polymerization models and microstructure.

description.zh: 本課程包含材料的結構鑑定和材料的性質分析。材料的結構鑑定方法有：元素分析、吸收光譜法、振動光譜法、核磁共振光譜法、質譜法、x-射線光譜法和電子顯微鏡法。材料的性質分析包含：材料熱性質(DSC, TGA, TMA,DMA)和材料機械性質(伸張、壓縮、剪力強度等)。
description.en: The materials of the course include structure identification and property analysis of materials. Methods of structure identification  of materials are : elemental analysis, absorption spectroscopy, vibration spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, x-ray spectroscopy and electron microscopy. Metheds of property analysis of materials are : thermal properties of materials (DSC,TGA,TMA,DMA) and mechanical properties of materials (tensile, compression and shear strengths).

syllabi.outline: In this course, we will systematically introduce various analysis techniques including UV-vis spectroscopy, photoluminescence spectroscopy, fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance, mass spectrometer, thermal analyses, optical microscopy, electron microscopy and atomic force microscopy. Students who study this course can establish a theoretical framework for the analysis of various organic materials, which will help their future research and employment development.

description.zh: 本課程主要探討各種高分子之聚合方法及動力學之研究，如逐步聚合、遊離基連鎖聚合、乳化聚合、離子連鎖聚合、連鎖共聚合反應、開環聚合、立體規則高分子之合成，未終止的游離基聚合方法。從分子量的分佈，結構物性之關係，作高分子聚合之最佳化設計，並且探討這些聚合方法如何應用在最新的科技上，如光電材料、複合材料。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the polymer synthesis and Kinetics studies. The synthesis includes step polymerization, free radical chain polymerization, emulsion polymerization, ionic chain polymerization, chain copolymerization, ring opening polymerization, sterospecific polymerization and living free radical polymerization. The synthesis scheme is optimized with the structure-properties relationship and molecular design. The potential application of these methods in high-tech materials, such as optoelectronics, and composites, will be elucidated.

description.zh: 電腦運算速度的進展，隨著電子產業的快速進步，有很大的突破。因此，應運電腦模擬計算已經成為很多領域重要的工具之一。本課程將討論如何應用現今已有的免費分子模擬軟體，來進行分子設計與進一步了解其分子能階，及光譜預測。除此之外，應用在分子模擬上的分子力學，分子動力學，與量子化學的基本觀念也將一併闡述說明。課程中，除基本理論介紹外，也包含實際的軟體實作。
description.en: The progress of electronic industry accelerates the computer development so that computer simulation becomes one of the important tool in many fields. In this course, we will discuss how to apply the computer to assist the molecular structure design. In order to gain insight into the basic idea of structural design, the fundamental background in molecular mechanics, molecular dynamics, and quantum chemistry will be introduced. A practical software introduction will also be included in the course.

description.zh: 本課程區分為四個實習，共一學年之都市設計實習，每學期應從事幾項實習，依該學期之情況而定：(一)大型基地開發之建築規劃與都市設計實習：參照台北市都市發展局擬定之「都市設計與土地使用開發許可」之審議標準，練習建築、敷地與都市設計三者整合關係之設計實習。(二)都市更新地區都市設計實習：以台北市更新地區為範例，選定基地範圍從事都市更新地區之改造，建立地區未來像，並擬定都市設計準則。(三)都市計畫通盤檢討地區都市設計實習：依據都市計畫通盤檢討第八條規定，都市計畫通盤檢討地區必須依據該地區之交通、產業、文化、生態及基地等因素，擬定都市設計準則；以台北市都市計畫通盤檢討為例，練習都市設計準則之訂定，或以都市計畫細部計畫為例，研擬土地使用分區管制與設計準則。(四)新發展區都市設計實習：選定一個地區，可能是擴大都市發展地區或新市鎮、新社區之規劃設計實習。

description.zh: 研究生相較於大學期間訓練的最主要差別在於其必須從事個人的學術研究。因此，研究生須要資訊與洞察力以達成獲得較高學位之論文寫作能力。故本課程主要內容包括： 一、 研究的特性 二、 智慧收集-「什麼」的問題 三、 研究-「何故」的問題 四、 良好研究的特質 五、 研究的基本類型 六、 從事研究的技能 七、 研究倫理 八、 研究設計練習
description.en: The necessity for personal academic research is the key cultural change that postgraduate students will encounter compared with their undergraduate days. Thus, postgraduate students need information and insights to develop the capacity to operate successfully achieving a higher-level degree. To examine these concerns, the course includes: 1. Characteristics of research 2. Intelligence-gathering-the "what" questions 3. Research-the "why" questions 4. Characteristics of good research 5. Basic types of research 6. The craft of doing research 7. Research ethics 8. Research design practice

syllabi.outline:
研究生相較於大學期間訓練的最主要差別在於其必須從事個人的學術研究。因此，研究生須要資訊與洞察力以達成獲得較高學位之論文寫作能力。故本課程主要內容包括： 一、 研究的特性 二、 智慧收集-「什麼」的問題 三、 研究-「何故」的問題 四、 良好研究的特質 五、 研究的基本類型 六、 從事研究的技能 七、 研究倫理 八、 研究設計練習
The necessity for personal academic research is the key cultural change that postgraduate students will encounter compared with their undergraduate days. Thus, postgraduate students need information and insights to develop the capacity to operate successfully achieving a higher-level degree. To examine these concerns, the course includes: 1. Characteristics of research 2. Intelligence-gathering-the "what" questions 3. Research-the "why" questions 4. Characteristics of good research 5. Basic types of research 6. The craft of doing research 7. Research ethics 8. Research design practice

description.zh: 本課程授課主要內容分為三部分：第一部份為都市防災概論，此部分主要針對國內外文獻作一回顧，進而瞭解都市防災整體架構，區分為（1）文獻回顧；（2）防災基本計畫；及（3）防災整體架構等。期使國內都市計畫能逐步邁向防災都市計畫，以建立『安全都市』為目標。此部分的主要內容區分為：（1）都市災害風險理念的形成；（2）防災都市計畫與地區防災系統規劃；（3）都市計畫防災系統規劃原則；（4）都市計畫防災作業準則內容架構；（5）都市計畫防災作業準則；（6）安心都市計畫的形成與實現。第三部分為實務操作部分，以草屯鎮為例，藉九二一大地震的實例，深入探討災情調查的方法，實際調查狀況及研訂災後重建的程序與計畫內容，期望成為國內都市重建計畫的範例，主要內容區分為：（1）緒論；（2）重建理論；（3）草屯鎮現況發展；（4）災情調查方法與重建程序之建立；（5）災情調查分析與重建計畫內容研訂等。

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要以對於當代建築具有啟發性和創新性的經典著作 (包括建築理論、文學、電影、哲學) 為範圍，透過修課者的精讀、研討交流、對話，以窺探形塑當代建築的重要觀念與內涵，並結合與之相對應的建築作品進行作品的閱讀與詮釋。

本課程希望修課者以研究者、創作者和建築學者的三種身份，從(形而下)到非物質面(形而上)的互文關係，且具有相互指涉互為一體的角度來理解、洞察和探索建築，培養建築學上的抽象性思考和創作觀點，並藉此建構建築視野的哲思；另一方面，做為創作型論文的設計方法論的基礎養成。

課程以非授課形式進行，修課者每周進行指定、和延伸性閱讀，於上課時間進行閱讀報告與心得之討論，授課老師進行導讀，並就討論內容提出分析比較與歸納。

透過整學期指定的多重文本閱讀，以具有個人意識的主題進行交叉比較和探討，期望修課者最終能建立個人思辯和申論式的建築書寫。

description.zh: 本門課之目的是讓學生熟悉質與量研究方法的設計。主題涵蓋研究計劃之準備及撰擬 ;主要研究方法，如調查研究法、相關研究法、實驗研究法、行動研究法；質性和量化資料之搜集與分析；敘述統計和推論統計。
description.en: This course familiarizes students with qualitative and quantitative research procedures and the statistical design involved in education and applied linguistics research. Topics will include the nature and process of research; survey research; experimental research; correlational research; action research; data collection and data analysis; descriptive statistics; and sampling and inferential statistics.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to introduce the foundational principles of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies. It provides learners with a conceptual and practical grounding in research design, enabling them to conduct methodologically sound explorations and investigations across both paradigms. Furthermore, the course examines the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the research process—highlighting their applications in data collection, transcription, coding, and analysis—to enhance research efficiency, accuracy, and depth.
本課程旨在介紹質性與量化研究方法的基本原理，並為學習者提供研究設計的概念基礎與實務能力，使其能夠在兩種研究範式中進行方法嚴謹的研究。此外，課程亦將探討人工智慧（AI）工具於研究歷程中的應用，包括在資料蒐集、轉錄、編碼與分析等階段的整合運用，藉此提升研究的效率、準確性與深度。

description.zh: 本課程為任職於英語教育之教師所設計，主旨在於分析數位教材於英語教學中的角色。藉由電腦/科技輔助語言教學、電腦媒介溝通、以及線上教學相關理論、研究與應用的研討來瞭解數位教材如何輔助英語學習。因應數位教材與學習者特性所採用之評量、評估、以及施測方法亦將是本課程重點。
description.en: This course is designed for in-service English teachers to analyze the pedagogical role of electronic courseware in the language classroom. Theories and studies of CALL (computer-assisted language learning), TELL (technology-enhanced language learning), CMC (computer-mediated communication), and online learning will be discussed to understand the utilization of electronic courseware in assisting English learning. Assessment, evaluation, and testing measurements in responding to electronic courseware and to learner characteristics will also be discussed.

name.zh: 語音學和英語發音教學

description.zh: 傳統發音教學大多根據教師直覺認為語音是該如何產製的、或發音課本中教條式的規則。在這堂課，學生將透過具體的聲學和構音資料、來學習重要語音學原則，並學習將原則正確地應用在發音教學當中。學生也將探討如何將這些知識轉化成不同年齡層和語言程度之學生可以接受的內容。
description.en: Traditionally, pronunciation teaching has been based on "armchair data" (e.g., the instructor's intuition on how a sound should be articulated) or prescriptive statements in pronunciation textbooks. In this course, students will learn fundamental principles of phonetics through experimental acoustic and articulatory data and learn how to apply them to pronunciation teaching. Students will be challenged to translate what they have learned to digestible pronunciation instructions for students of different ages and proficiency levels.

Traditionally, teaching pronunciation has been based on "armchair data" (e.g., the instructor's intuition on how a sound should be articulated) or prescriptive statements in pronunciation textbooks. In this course, students will learn fundamental principles of phonetics through experimental acoustic and articulatory data and learn how to apply them to pronunciation teaching. Students will be challenged to translate what they have learned into digestible pronunciation instructions for students of different ages and proficiency levels.

description.zh: 在西方，「傳奇」不像其他的文類般受到認定和推崇，很難將它定位歸類，有點像是古典文類的小跟班。傳奇既沒有悲劇史詩的莊嚴崇高，也沒有抒情詩的優美，更沒有喜劇的逗趣嗆人。但是它卻以通俗文類一脈流傳，一直到二十一世紀。傳奇始於中古世紀，後來並沒有發展成自成一格的文類，反而在寫作和思想上超越了原本的形式，形成了特殊的風格。我們可以說，傳奇入侵其他傳統文類，與之結合，然後重新塑形，因而變化多端，成為現代西方文化中一股無所不在的強大力量。本課程將回顧傳奇的發展史，從中古時期獨樹一格的文類，到了現代發展成具有哲學和詮釋特質的一種形式。我們的重點將探討這之間的變化如何發生? 並研究為何傳奇在西方歷史中歷久不衰，甚至成為我們理解現代西方思想及特色的一扇重要窗口。
description.en: In the West, romance has often seemed to win less acclaim than other genres, a strange younger sister to the celebrated classical forms, not quite as sublime as epic tragedy, not as beautiful as lyric, not as provocative as comedy.  Yet it has nonetheless endured as a popular form into the 21st century.  Evolving since the Middle Ages to become less a genre in its own right than a transcendent mode of writing and of thought which invades, combines, and reshapes the other traditional genres, romance's protean nature has made it an omnipresent and influential force in modern Western culture.  This course will trace the development of romance as a genre and as a philosophical and interpretive mode from the Middle Ages to the present, as we ask how it has changed and why it has persisted throughout Western history, becoming essential to our understanding of thought and of character in the modern West.

syllabi.notes: The focus on the course is on critical thinking and original inquiry; by reading literature closely and learning relevant research and analytic methods, students will gain transferrable skills. Thus, students writing any kind of thesis (not just a literature or cultural studies thesis) are welcome to the course.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
Course texts are subject to change over the summer as I continue to refine the course, something that will certainly be necessary with the new 16+2 format. This is the first year that I have taught the genre and culture course under its new course description, about the Romance. In the past, I taught a course more generally on fantasy, which is one of my research interests. However, many of the authors I am discussing also considered their works to be Romances. (And, as you take this course, keep in mind that the Romance has nothing to do with Romantic love [though it occurs in some of the stories] but instead comes from the fact that the original works were written in Romance languages (e.g. Old French) instead of Latin! (We won't be reading Old French Romances, but we will spend a little time with King Arthur.) 

Texts may include the following, though I may switch one or two out. 

Week 1--Introduction (Robert Louis Stevenson [there is a chance I may switch a Stevenson novel for one of the works below] and Andrew Lang) 

Weeks 2–4 (Arthurian Romance) 
--Parts of Le Morte d'Arthur and of Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
--Part of Alfred Lord Tennyson's Idylls of the King

Week 5
--Shakespeare's The Winter's Tale (Shakespearian Romance) (Read aloud or viewed)

Week 6
Book 4 of Jonathan Swift's Gulliver's Travels

Week 7-9
--Mary Shelley's Frankenstein (Gothic Romance) [or Pauline Hopkins's Of One Blood]

Week 10–12
--Charlotte Brontë's Jane Eyre (Novel vs. Romance) 

Week 13–15
--Tolkien's The Two Towers (we will watch Peter Jackson's The Fellowship of the Ring in class in week 13 and may discuss parts of the text it is adapted from, followed by weeks of discussion of The Two Towers)

Week 16--Tolkien wrap up and Paper Peer Review

+2 (Students may consult on their final paper)

(This schedule may be modified at my discretion.)

syllabi.materials:
1. 高效率實驗室管理術 (作者: 劉如熹、黃文澤、莫誠康)
《高效率實驗室管理術》由臺大化學系 - 劉如熹教授帶領兩位學生 -   黃文澤博士及莫誠康博士耗時多年集結、編寫而成的心血結晶。
本書是一本關於實驗室管理的實用指南，深入探討了如何打造一個高效、創新且可持續發展的實驗室，並對研究管理與行政管理兩大核心進行了詳細剖析。
主要內容包括：
• 研究管理：如何建立明確的願景，提升研究品質與效率，並運用週報、月報等方式追蹤進度。

先修課程：負責教授同意。
封裝技術論及相關技術方法，如施力、軟焊、或熔接等用來將兩個或多個微電子、微機械、微光學或其他相關元件結合的技術原理及製程。內容也涉及被封裝的元件的材料及封裝可靠度有關的特性如力學、熱傳、電磁干擾等。案例包括黏晶、打線、覆晶、黏著技術及軟焊技術等。
description.en: The lecture describes packaging technology as a summary of those technological methods, which use joining of two or more electronic, micro-mechanic micro-optic or other components like this by force, soldering or welding processes. Besides the presentation of these processes, the parts, i.e. thin film circuit elements, thick film components, including their material and technology relevant properties such as mechanical, heat transfer, electromagnetic interference,  which influence the packaging reliability are described. Examples such as die bonding, wire bonding, flip-chip bonding adhesive technology and soldering technology are chosen to show joining technology for semiconductor, MEM components, hybrid CKTs, packages and modules.

syllabi.outline: This course will teach the fundamentals for packaging, including phase diagrams of solders, bonding technology, metallurgical reactions, and reliabilities, as well as the state-of-the-art Cu-Cu hybrid bonding. It will also cover bonding technology of microelectronic packaging: Die Attach/Chip Bond, Wire Bond, Tape automatic bonding, Flip Chip Technology, Pb-based and Pb-free Solders, Microbumps, 3D IC packaging, Cu-Cu bonding, and Cu hybrid bonding. Metallurgical reactions include Cu-Sn, Ni-Sn, Sn-Au, Ag-Sn, Pd-Sn, and In-Sn. The following reliability issues will be taught: multiple reflow, electromigration, thermomigration, Stress, temperature cycling tests, solid state aging, Sn whisker, and Mean-time-to-failure measurement.

description.en: This course deals with the mechanical behavior of materials. It emphasizes the relationship among macroscopic properties, material microstructure, and fundamental concepts of bonding and crystal structure. Contents of this course include the elastic and elastic behavior , dislocation , plastic deformation in single and polycrystalline materials ,strengthening mechanism of crystalline materials, composite materials, high temperature of crystalline materials ,fracture , fatigue and embrittlement.

syllabi.outline:
重要公告，全英語授課及課程要求 (All English Instruction & Course Expectations):
本課程所有教學內容（包括授課、教材、討論及評量）均以英語進行。英語程度不佳，上課聽不懂，或僅想輕鬆取學分的同學，請鄭重考慮後再選修。本課程為高等進階課程，具一定難度，預期及格率設定於 60% 至 80% 之間。
This course is conducted entirely in English (including lectures, materials, discussions, and assessments). Students with insufficient English proficiency, who may have difficulty understanding lectures delivered in English, or those merely seeking easy credits are strongly advised to reconsider before enrolling. This is an advanced-level course with a significant degree of difficulty; the anticipated pass rate is set between 60% and 80%.




This course provides a comprehensive introduction to advanced manufacturing processes, with a special focus on Creep Age Forming (CAF) and Hot Stamping. Students will gain a theoretical understanding of the underlying principles, including the development and application of constitutive equations. A significant portion of the course involves hands-on laboratory work focusing on SEM analysis, creep aging experiments, and sample preparation (Weeks 3, 7, 9, 12, 15). Students will also practically implement constitutive equations using MATLAB and Finite Element (FE) software through subroutine coding. The course also includes open-book examinations (Weeks 5, 10, 14) requiring library research, with findings discussed in class. Selected weeks (4, 8, 13) will be delivered via online teaching.

Important Course Notes

1. International Student Friendly: This course is designed to be welcoming and supportive for international students.

2. Language of Instruction and Assessment: For all students (domestic and international), all questions, presentations, and examinations must be completed in English.

3. Laboratory Requirement: In addition to scheduled class hours, this course requires frequent participation in laboratory experiments involving SEM analysis, creep aging, and sample preparation. The results from these experiments will be discussed in class and will contribute significantly to your continuous assessment grade.

4. Open-Book Exam Procedure: For open-book exams, students must come to the classroom to collect the exam paper, then proceed to the library to research and answer the questions. Answers and findings will be discussed collectively at the end of the relevant class session.

5. Online Teaching Weeks: Weeks 4, 8, and 13 will be conducted online. Please check [LMS/Email/Course Website] for access details and materials.


本課程旨在全面介紹高等製造製程，特別著重於潛變時效成形 (Creep Age Forming, CAF) 與熱沖壓 (Hot Stamping)。學生將學習相關理論基礎，包含構成方程式 (Constitutive Equations) 的建立與應用。課程的重要組成部分為實作實驗，聚焦於 掃描式電子顯微鏡 (SEM) 分析、潛變時效實驗及試片準備（第3、7、9、12、15週）。學生亦將透過撰寫副程式 (Subroutine)，運用 MATLAB 及有限元素 (Finite Element, FE) 軟體實際應用這些構成方程式。本課程亦包含開書考試 (Open-Book Exams)（第5、10、14週），學生需至圖書館搜集資料，並於課堂上進行研討。特定教學週（第4、8、13週）將採線上教學方式進行。

課程重要事項

1.國際學生友善課程： 本課程致力於為國際學生營造一個友善且具支持性的學習環境。
2.授課與評量語言： 所有學生（含本地生及國際學生）的課堂提問、口頭報告及所有考試均需使用英文完成。
3.實驗課程要求： 除排定課堂時數外，本課程要求學生積極參與實驗課程，內容包括 SEM分析、潛變時效及試片準備。實驗結果將於課堂中討論，並佔平時考核之重要比例。
4.開書考試程序： 開書考試時，學生須至教室領取試題紙本，隨後前往圖書館查詢資料以完成作答。答案及研討成果將於該次課程結束前進行小組或全班討論。
5.線上教學週： 第4、8、13週將採線上教學。請留意teams以獲取登入詳情及教材。

syllabi.outline:
課程重要警示 (Critical Course Warning):

全英語授課 – 選課門檻提醒 (All English Instruction – Enrollment Threshold Warning): 本課程採全英語授課。若您的英語能力不足以流暢聽懂課程內容、參與討論，或僅為取得學分而無心學習者，請勿選修。 This course is conducted entirely in English. If your English proficiency is insufficient to fluently understand lectures and participate in discussions, or if you are enrolling merely to obtain credits without a genuine commitment to learning, DO NOT ENROLL in this course.
高等課程 – 難度與預期及格率 (Advanced Course – Difficulty & Anticipated Pass Rate): 此為高等進階課程，內容具相當難度，對學生的投入程度要求較高。本課程預期及格率設定於 60% 至 80% 之間，請確實評估自身學術能力、學習意願及時間投入。


This course, "Advanced Mechanics of Materials," delves into the sophisticated mechanical behavior of materials, with a primary focus on composite materials.
本課程「高等材料力學」旨在深入探討材料的精密力學行為，並重點專研複合材料。
While building upon fundamental mechanics of materials principles, the curriculum is specifically tailored to explore the unique characteristics of composites.
在既有材料力學基礎上，本課程將針對複合材料的獨特性質進行深入教學。
Topics include the introduction to constituent materials (fibers, matrices, and emerging sustainable components like biochar), micromechanics, macromechanical behavior of a lamina, classical lamination theory, stiffness and strength analysis, stress-strain transformations, fatigue failure, and damage mechanisms in composites.
內容包括組成材料介紹（纖維、基材，以及如生物炭等新興永續性組分）、微觀力學、單層板的宏觀力學行為、古典層板理論、勁度與強度分析、應力應變轉換、複合材料的疲勞破壞與損傷機制。
A significant emphasis will be placed on understanding and utilizing biochar-enhanced composites.
課程將特別強調對生物炭增強複合材料的理解與應用。
The course structure incorporates laboratory sessions for hands-on experience and online teaching weeks for flexible learning.
課程結構包含實驗課程以獲取實作經驗，及線上教學週以促進彈性學習。
The course will also investigate the application of advanced composite materials, including those incorporating biochar, particularly in areas like railway systems, sustainable construction, and lightweight structural design.
課程亦將探討高等複合材料的應用，包含那些整合生物炭的材料，尤其是在鐵道系統、永續建築及輕量化結構設計等領域。

課程重要事項 (Important Course Notes)

Bilingual Instruction (雙語教學): This course will be conducted with materials and explanations provided in both English and Chinese to support diverse learning needs. 本課程將以中英文雙語提供教材與解說，以支持多元學習需求。
Language of Assessment (評量語言): Major assignments, presentations, and examinations are required to be completed in English. 主要作業、報告及考試需以英文完成。
Laboratory Requirement (實驗課程要求): This course includes several hands-on laboratory sessions. 本課程包含數次實作實驗課程。 Active participation and completion of lab-related tasks are mandatory. 學生必須積極參與並完成實驗相關任務。
Online Teaching Weeks (線上教學週): Specific weeks will be conducted online. 特定教學週將採線上教學。 Students are expected to engage with materials and activities as directed on the Microsoft Teams. 學生應依循Microsoft Teams之指示參與課程材料與活動。
Attendance Policy (出席規定): Students who are absent three (3) or more times (including labs and online sessions where applicable) during the semester will automatically receive a failing grade for the course. 一學期內缺席三（3）次（含以上，適用於實驗課與線上課程應參與部分）者，該課程成績以不及格計。(缺席三次不及格)

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
Week 11 (第十一週 – 線上教學):
Strength and Failure Theories for Composite Laminae / Stiffness of Off-Axis UD Composites
複合材料單層板之強度與破壞理論 / 非軸向單向性複合材料勁度
Introduction to the major failure criteria for a unidirectional lamina, including maximum stress, maximum strain, Tsai-Hill, and Tsai-Wu theories. Calculation of stiffness and compliance for off-axis (non-principal direction) UD composites, and prediction of first-ply failure.
介紹單向性單層板的主要破壞準則，包含最大應力、最大應變、Tsai-Hill 及 Tsai-Wu 理論。計算非軸向（非主方向）單向性複合材料的勁度與柔度，並預測首層破壞。
Competency Indicator: C406
能力指標: C406
Week 12 (第十二週):
Failure Analysis and Design of Composite Laminates
複合材料層板之破壞分析與設計
Application of lamina failure criteria to multidirectional laminates. First-ply failure (FPF) and last-ply failure (LPF), progressive (ply-by-ply) failure analysis, and the introduction of safety factors and strength ratios for design. Brief discussion of how particulate fillers such as biochar affect laminate strength and damage progression.
將單層板破壞準則應用於多方向層板。首層破壞 (FPF) 與末層破壞 (LPF)、漸進式（逐層）破壞分析，並導入設計用之安全係數與強度比。簡要討論生物炭等顆粒型填充劑如何影響層板強度與損傷發展。
Competency Indicator: C406 (Continued)
能力指標: C406 (續)
Week 13 (第十三週): (Lab Session / 實驗課)
Lab #4: Strength & Failure Testing of Composites
實驗 #4：複合材料強度與破壞測試
Experimental determination of composite strength; tensile and/or flexural testing to failure, observation of failure modes (fiber breakage, matrix cracking, delamination). Comparison of measured strength with failure-theory predictions.
複合材料強度之實驗測定；進行拉伸與/或彎曲破壞試驗，觀察破壞模式（纖維斷裂、基材裂紋、層間剝離）。比較實測強度與破壞理論之預測值。
Competency Indicator: C406 (Practical Application / 實務應用)
Week 14 (第十四週):
Hygrothermal and Environmental Effects on Composites
複合材料之濕熱與環境效應
Effects of temperature and moisture on composite behavior. Hygrothermal stresses and strains, residual (curing) stresses in laminates, and coefficients of thermal/moisture expansion. Discussion of environmental durability and degradation, with attention to the moisture sensitivity of biochar-filled and bio-based composites.
溫度與濕度對複合材料行為之影響。濕熱應力與應變、層板中的殘留（固化）應力，以及熱膨脹/濕膨脹係數。探討環境耐久性與劣化，並特別關注含生物炭及生質基複合材料之吸濕敏感性。
Competency Indicator: C407
能力指標: C407
Week 15 (第十五週): (Online Teaching / 線上教學)
Design of Laminated Composite Structures
層狀複合材料結構之設計
Design methodology for laminated composite structures. Selection of stacking sequence and ply orientation to meet stiffness and strength requirements, design for specific loading cases, and use of carpet plots / design charts. Introduction to weight and cost trade-offs.
層狀複合材料結構之設計方法。選擇疊層順序與纖維方向以滿足勁度與強度需求、針對特定負載條件之設計，以及地毯圖／設計圖表之運用。初步介紹重量與成本之取捨。
Competency Indicator: C407 (Continued)
能力指標: C407 (續)
Week 16 (第十六週):
Special Topics: Sustainable and Biochar-Reinforced Composites
專題：永續與生物炭增強複合材料
Emerging and sustainable composites. In-depth look at biochar-reinforced and bio-based composite materials: processing, property tuning, and applications. Introduction to life-cycle assessment (LCA), recyclability, and the role of sustainable fillers in reducing environmental impact.
新興與永續複合材料。深入探討生物炭增強與生質基複合材料：製程、性質調控與應用。介紹生命週期評估 (LCA)、可回收性，以及永續填充劑在降低環境衝擊上所扮演的角色。
Competency Indicator: C408
能力指標: C408
Week 17 (第十七週):
Final Project Presentations & Discussion
期末專題報告與研討
Students present analysis, design, or experimental work integrating micromechanics, lamination theory, failure analysis, and sustainable-material consideration

description.zh: 本課程介紹電子顯微鏡之結構，成像及繞射原理，以及在材料科學方面之應用，課程內容包括穿透式電子顯微鏡之構造，電磁透鏡與成像原理，電子繞射原理，繞射圖型分析，試片之製作方法。掃描式電子顯微鏡之構造及成像原理。EDS及WDS之X光光譜測量。
description.en: The course introduces the structure of a electron microscope, the theories of image forming and diffraction, the applications of materials science.  The course contents include structure of the transmission electron microscope, the electromagnetic lens and theory of image formation, theory of electronic diffraction, analysis of diffraction pattern, and the preparation of test sample.  The structure and principle of forming image for a scanning electron microscope, the X-ray spectrography of EDS and WDS are also included in this course.

name.zh: 人工智慧的基礎與創新(一)
name.en: Foundations and Advances in Artificial Intelligence I

description.zh:
本課程深入探討人工智慧領域的基礎知識和最新技術，包括機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、生成對抗網絡等領域。學員將從人工智慧的概述和歷史開始，逐步深入了解機器學習和深度學習的基礎概念和演算法，並探討其在不同領域的應用。課程還介紹了最新的AI技術趨勢，包括注意力機制、自監督學習、大型AI通用模型和元學習等。
課程運作模式：每週講授一個主題，包括理論授課和實習操作。學員將參與課堂討論和小組活動，以促進想法交流和知識分享。
description.en:
This course delves into the fundamentals and latest advancements in the field of artificial intelligence, covering topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and generative adversarial networks. Participants will begin with an overview of artificial intelligence and its historical development, progressively delving into the foundational concepts and algorithms of machine learning and deep learning, along with their applications across various domains. The course also introduces the latest trends in AI technology, including attention mechanisms, self-supervised learning, large-scale AI models, and meta-learning.
