description.zh: 電腦數值控制技術的主要目標是實現機械系統的精密運動控制。本課程因此教授實現機械系統高精度運動所需的關鍵方法。涵蓋的主題包括：位置與軌跡控制的插補方法；應用於系統運動學與動力學的數值分析技術；以及精密運動控制系統的分析與設計。本課程結合實際應用案例以闡明這些方法。藉由本課程，學生將瞭解精密運動控制的設計與分析方法，並且能夠利用現有的軟體與硬體技術對機械系統進行精密控制。
description.en: The primary objective of computer numerical control technology is to enable precise motion control within mechanical systems. Accordingly, this course teaches key methodologies essential for achieving the high-precision motions of mechanical systems. Topics covered include: interpolation methods for position and trajectory control; numerical analysis techniques applied to system kinematics and dynamics; and the analysis and design of precision motion control systems. The course incorporates practical application cases to illustrate these methodologies. Through this course, students can understand the design and analysis methods of precision motion control, and be able to use existing software and hardware technologies to precisely control mechanical systems.

syllabi.outline: 先修課程：負責教授同意。電腦數值控制技術主要目標是實現機械系統之精密運動控制。本課程因此教授實現機械系統高精度運動所需之關鍵方法，涵蓋主題包括：位置與軌跡控制插補方法、運動學與動力學數值分析、以及精密運動控制分析與設計。藉由本課程，同學們將瞭解精密運動控制之設計、分析、與模擬，並且能夠應用既有之軟體與硬體技術對機械系統進行精密運動控制。

Managing the risk inherent in developing and using IS applications. Attaining and practicing technological leadership. This course is taught by HBS cases.

description.zh: 面對各種數位化革新技術浪潮的衝擊，零售業者必須置入各項智能科技進行數位行銷與商業模式的開發，例如零售業者使用無人商店、智能支付系統、擴增/虛擬實境、元宇宙、物聯網 (IoT)、消費數據分析、人工智慧 (AI)、機器學習等先進技術，將傳統零售環境轉變為更智慧、更便捷、更個性化的消費體驗。甚至利用這些新興數位科技與和數據資源實踐零售業態的升級和轉型，進而不斷涌現出新型業態和新型商業模式的品牌體驗與管理。據此，本課程將以介紹當代智慧零售個案為主軸，介紹智慧零售實務的同時，也帶出其背後運作的主要理論基礎，藉此以促進實務與理論並重的學習效益。
description.en: Faced with the impact of various digital innovation waves, retailers must integrate various smart technologies to develop digital marketing and business models. For example, retailers use advanced technologies such as unmanned retail stores, smart payment systems, augmented/virtual reality, the metaverse, the Internet of Things (IoT), consumption data analysis, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning to transform the traditional retail environment into more intelligent, more convenient and more personalized consumption experience. Retailers use these emerging digital technologies and data resources to implement retail upgrading and transformation and then emerge with new business models for brand experience and management. Accordingly, this course will focus on introducing contemporary smart retail cases. Introducing smart retail cases will also bring out the main theoretical foundations, resulting in learning benefits that emphasize practice and theory.

syllabi.outline:
面對各種數位化革新技術浪潮的衝擊，零售業者必須置入各項智能科技進行數位行銷與商業模式的開發，例如零售業者使用無人商店、智能支付系統、擴增/虛擬實境、元宇宙、物聯網 (IoT)、消費數據分析、人工智慧 (AI)、機器學習等先進技術，將傳統零售環境轉變為更智慧、更便捷、更個性化的消費體驗。甚至利用這些新興數位科技與和數據資源實踐零售業態的升級和轉型，進而不斷涌現出新型業態和新型商業模式的品牌體驗與管理。據此，本課程將以介紹當代智慧零售個案為主軸，介紹智慧零售實務的同時，也帶出其背後運作的主要理論基礎，藉此以促進實務與理論並重的學習效益。
Faced with the impact of various digital innovation waves, retailers must integrate various smart technologies to develop digital marketing and business models. For example, retailers use advanced technologies such as unmanned retail stores, smart payment systems, augmented/virtual reality, the metaverse, the Internet of Things (IoT), consumption data analysis, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning to transform the traditional retail environment into more intelligent, more convenient and more personalized consumption experience. Retailers use these emerging digital technologies and data resources to implement retail upgrading and transformation and then emerge with new business models for brand experience and management. Accordingly, this course will focus on introducing contemporary smart retail cases. Introducing smart retail cases will also bring out the main theoretical foundations, resulting in learning benefits that emphasize practice and theory.

description.en: Corporate governance is the combination of legal and political governance mechanisms external to the firm, along with monitoring and incentive governance mechanisms internal to the firm, linked and driven by the forces of investment markets, to produce value-increasing outcomes for firms' owners and, ultimately, society at large. In this course, we will survey corporate governance, taking the investor's point of view. By the end of the course, you should have a well-informed understanding of the basic corporate governance problem and the major issues in corporate governance, prominent proposed solutions to the corporate governance problem, the way the problem is actually addressed in a variety of companies and countries, and evidence on the prospects for and drawbacks of the various solutions. This course is therefore comprised of distinct intellectual components-the practice and the science-which are intertwined throughout the semester's activities.

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於讓同學們瞭解經營績效評估的方法，強調理論與實作並重。首先會介紹資料包絡分析法(DEA)的基本概念，讓同學們對於DEA理論有基本的瞭解，接下來再讓同學們學習如何使用電腦套裝軟體進行實際運算，並探討各種企業經營效率分析上的應用。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to let students understand the methods of business performance evaluation, emphasizing both theory and practice. Firstly, this course will introduce the basic concept of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) so that students can understand DEA theory. Then students will learn how to use computer-packaged software for actual calculations and discuss the application of various business efficiency analyses.

description.zh: 建立學生對各類資料探勘技術與理論的基礎觀念及架構，以奠定學生日後從事資料探勘分析與研究工作時之需。相關的分析技術將包括應用在分類(classification)、推估(estimation)、預測(prediction)、關聯式分組(affinity grouping)、同質分組(clustering)等功能中的決策樹、(decision tree)多變量分析(multivariate analysis)及類神經網路(neural network)等方法。此外為了讓學生對相關技術有更深的瞭解，課程中將以個案實例為主，並配合各種資料探勘套裝軟體，以應用的觀點使學生更容易接受了解在商業智慧分析上資料探勘分析的功用。

Students are expected to learn the followings in English: (1) Terminologies commonly used in management; (2) Draft and write-up of English memorandum; (3) Development of meeting materials such as agenda, motions, minutes, etc.; (4) Business proposals and plans; and (6) Contemporary topics and trend in global management issues. Students will be required to make group presentations and discussions on the selected management topics in English.

syllabi.outline:
Marketing Management and Research
This course examines the principles and practices of marketing management and applied market research for graduate students. It focuses on how organizations identify market opportunities, understand customer behavior, design marketing strategies, and use research evidence to support managerial decisions. Students will explore strategic marketing decision-making, consumer insights, market analytics, digital transformation, and evidence-based marketing practices. The course emphasizes both academic rigor and managerial application, preparing students to design, evaluate, and implement data-driven marketing strategies in complex global environments.

name.zh: 數位轉型與創新商業模式
name.en: Digital Transformation and Innovative Business Models

description.zh: 本課程在於協助同學了解數位轉型的浪潮趨勢，以及適應新科技所改變的商業模式。課程將介紹創新的商業模式例如共享經濟、金融科技、線上至離線、使用者生成內容等平台模式應用。每個模式將會連結到實務中企業個案，以協助同學進一步深入了解與分析創新的模式概念。本課程將涵蓋數位轉型與創新模式的基本概念，以數位轉型與科技適應角度，透過實務案例來了解創新商業模式。
description.en: This course aims to help students understand the trend of digital transformation and technology adaption in business models. The innovative business models will be introduced such as sharing economy, FinTech, online-to-offline, user-generated content, and so on. The matched cases will be selected to elaborate and analyze the innovative business models. This course will provide comprehensive knowledge of innovative business models by digital transformation and technology adaption (information and communication technology).

description.zh: 本課程之目的在探討如何運用量化的管理決策模型來解析管理上的各種問題，主要決策模型求解方法有：線性規劃、整數規劃、非線性規劃、層級分析法與網路分析法等。課程內容主要以案例說明為主，讓同學瞭解理論如何與實際問題結合，故課程中會用工程與管理上之各種實際應用問題做說明，最佳化求解軟體與決策工具軟體會用來進行問題求解與輔助說明所得數據之管理意涵，並進行模型成本效益分析。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to discuss how to use quantitative management decision-making models to analyze various management problems. The methods for solving the decision-making models include: linear programming, integer programming, nonlinear programming, hierarchical analysis process and network process etc. The course content is mainly based on case illustrations such that students can understand how the theory is combined with practical problems. Therefore, various practical application problems in engineering and management will be used to explain the models. Optimization software and decision-making tools will be used to solve the problems and assist in explaining the management implications of the obtained data, and perform model cost-benefit analysis.

description.zh: 本課程介紹密碼學的理論與實際，其主要內容如下：簡介；背景知識；DES保密系統；RSA保密系統；其他公開金匙系統；數位簽章；網路安全
description.en: Principles and practice of cryptography are covered in this course. It contains the following material:  Introduction；Background Theory；Data Encryption Standard (DES)；RSA Cryptosystem；Other Public-key Cryptosystems；Digital Signatures；Internet Security

syllabi.outline:
Cryptography is a science used to design algorithms and formulate protocols for achieving security requirements, e.g. privacy, authentication, and data integrity. Recently, with the vigorous development of electronic communication and e-commerce, the importance of cryptography has gone beyond its historical military use. Cryptography provides technology to achieve security, for example: it allows us to successfully use credit cards for online transactions without revealing the card number to others. Over the past 25 years, cryptography has transformed from a technology developed for a specific purpose to a science with a solid theoretical foundation. This course will also teach the following directions of cryptography. Its main purpose is to arouse students' interest in cryptography and cultivate cryptography talents. 1. Definition: Discuss how to clearly and clearly define cryptographic problems (also known as cryptographic concepts), and quantify the so-called security in different cryptographic concepts. 2. Cryptographic architecture and security proof: The complete cryptographic architecture will be introduced, and the security of its architecture can be guaranteed by some difficult assumptions. 3. Theoretical basis: Cryptography architectures are all based on difficult assumptions. This part will introduce commonly used difficult assumptions, and discuss current theoretical and practical developments. 4. Cryptographic application: How to use the cryptographic architecture to apply it to higher-level security requirements is also a very important topic in cryptography. 5. Information Security: Realize network security or multimedia security through cryptography.

密碼學是一門用來設計演算法和訂定協議的科學，目的為如何在不安全的環境中達到安全的需求，如：隱私、認證、以及資料的完整性。近期，在電子通訊和電子商務的蓬勃發展下，密碼學的重要性已遠超越它在歷史上的軍事用途，而已經充滿在我們的生活當中。非常重要的是密碼學提供了實現安全的技術，例如：它讓我們可以成功使用信用卡於線上交易，同時又不洩漏卡號給其他人。 由過去25年來的進展，密碼學已經從一個為了達成特定目的所開發的技術轉變成一門富有嚴謹理論基礎的科學。本課程並將會教授以下密碼學的方向，其主要目的是激起學生對密碼學的興趣，並培育密碼學人才。 1. 定義：探討如何明確且清楚的定義密碼學問題(又稱密碼概念)，以及量化所謂的安全性於不同的密碼概念上。 2. 密碼架構與安全性證明：將會介紹完整的密碼學架構，並且證明分析其架構安全性可以被某些困難的假設所保證。 3. 理論基礎：密碼架構都會接於困難假設，這部分將會介紹常用的困難假設，以及探討目前在理論以及實務上的發展。 4. 密碼應用：如何利用密碼架構應用在更高層的安全訴求上也是密碼學相當重要的課題。 5. 資訊安全：透過密碼學來實現網路安全或多媒體安全。

description.zh: 網路搜尋已經成為最受歡迎的應用之一. 資訊檢索主要在探討如何有效的在大量文字及多媒體文件中搜尋使用者想要的資訊. 本課程將介紹資訊檢索的基本觀念, 檢索模型, 文字資訊檢索, 檢索結果評估, 索引與搜尋, 以及其他多媒體檢索相關應用
description.en:
With the expansion of the World Wide Web (WWW), Web search has become one of the most popular applications. Information retrieval (IR) is a research field that targets at effectively and efficiently searching information in huge amounts of text and multimedia documents. In this course, we will introduce the basic models, text IR, retrieval evaluation, indexing and searching, and applications for IR.
Outline:
1. Overview of Information Retrieval
2. Modeling
3. Retrieval Evaluation
4. Text IR
5. Query Languages and Operations
6. Indexing and Searching
7. Applications for IR
8. Web Search

syllabi.outline: Web search engine has become one of the necessary tools in modern lives. This course aims at investigating how to index large amount of text documents and search what users need in an effective way. We will introduce the basic concepts of information retrieval, characteristics of documents and languages, various retrieval models, evaluation of retrieval results, indexing and searching, text classification, text clustering, and Web search. In addition to texts, we will also introduce some applications of multimedia retrieval.

Students will be guided from a broader and global perspective to learn the social and human aspects of protecting the Earth. Lectures will cover systems thinking and its importance to Sustainable Development. Innovative and emerging technologies for sustainability and "net zero" emissions will be explored. Natural Capitalism and its strategies, Circular Economy, and the Bottom (Base) of the Pyramid (BoP) theory will also be taught to help strive for a sustainable future.

name.en: Planning and Management for Air Quality

description.zh: 以都會區空氣品質為範圍，配合污染源類別﹙粒狀物，SOx， NOx， VOC， THC及O3﹚，本課程從逸散性、固定污染性、移動污染性等不同方向，以講述空品之規劃與管理等問題。此包括PSI指標與空品特性分析，及減目標與管制策略之研訂等。
description.en: The course gives a brief introduction to planning and management for air quality. The main contents are focused on fugitive pollution, stationary, and movable sources. Index of pollution standard will be also discussed in the course.

syllabi.outline: 深入討論空氣污染之來源、影響、監測、傳播、宿命、法令規章等知識，以發展適當的空氣品質規劃政策與空氣品質保護管理措施。以都會區空氣品質為範圍，配合污染源類別，本課程從逸散性、固定污染性、移動污染性等不同方向，以講述空品之規劃與管理等問題。包括法規, 指標與空品特性分析，及減排目標與管制策略之研訂等。The course covers in-depth knowledge of planning and management for air quality. The main contents are focused on the control and management of  fugitive pollution, stationary, and mobile sources. Air Quality Monitoring, Modeling, and pollution standard will be also discussed in the course.

name.en: Environmental Economics and Environmental Policies Analysis

description.zh: 政策研究能檢視理論和實務的切合程度。本課程將帶領大家認識環境政策的經濟分析方法，學習經濟的思維觀點，以及如何運用經濟方法瞭解解決環境問題。除此之外上課內容並與法律結合，探討環境法的經濟分析觀點和傳統思維有何不同，尤其是對環境行為上之改變效果。希望學生能夠具體瞭解經濟分析方法幫助政府解決環境問題及規劃環境政策時所扮演的角色。
description.en: There is a significant trade-off between economic growth and environmental quality.  From this course, students will learn fundamental concepts in Environmental Economics and how to analyze environmental policy issues by using economic tools.  In additions, this course combines economic analysis to law, especially shows students how regulations affect people's behavior.  After this class, students not only know how economic approaches help the government deal with environmental issues and the differences between theory and practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程由微觀經濟學角度出發，分析各種環境問題，並介紹各種經濟誘因行政策工具，以補足傳統環境工程教育偏重工程面之不足。
This course applies theories in micro economics to analyze environmental problems. Policy tools that are often applied in solving environmental problems are further introduced and being evaluated using micro economic principals.

name.en: Disaster Prevention and Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation

description.zh: 全球暖化與氣候變遷已對人類社會造成面臨前所未有的挑戰。不論是哪個國家，都遭受其帶來的影響。並且在IPCC發布的報告中，諸多科學證據證實氣候變遷已是不可改變的事實，因此為了謀求世界各地環境的永續發展，「減緩」與「調適」是現階段全球順應氣候變遷積極採取的方式。在聯合國報告中曾經指出我國臺灣舉凡環境及氣候條件隸屬於氣候變遷高危險群，極端氣候事件，例如熱浪、颱風、洪水…等皆逐漸嚴重影響我們的家園，因此，防減災與氣候變遷調適相對更加重要。其中氣候變遷調適更是能夠面對未來氣候可能產生的衝擊，透過周延的規畫以適應充滿挑戰與變化的新環境。因此本課程針對國際與我國減少災害風險與氣候變遷調適介紹，並探討其各中因應方式與困境等課題，期藉培養與提高對氣候變遷防減災與氣候變遷調適的認識。
description.en:
Global warming and climate change are the biggest challenges to human society. With current warming trend proceeds at an unprecedented rate, climate change poses a threat to all countries. In the IPCC assessment reports, much of scientific evidence indicates climate change an unalterable fact, so in order to meet the needs of present generations without jeopardizing the ability of futures generations to meet their own need, approaches on "mitigation" and "adaptation" needed to be adopted in response to climate change. 
Taiwan is vulnerable and at high risk to climate change because of geographic exposure and climatic conditions. Extreme weather events, such as heat wave, typhoon, and flood, bring catastrophic damages in Taiwan. Hence, proper climate change adaptation and disaster risk reduction measures needed to be taken proactively to reduce many of the adverse impacts and to enhance beneficial impacts. syllabi.outline:
自第七週起，本課程將介紹人工智慧於氣候變遷調適與災害管理之應用，內容涵蓋氣候AI與災害AI的國際發展趨勢、責任AI治理、天氣預報、災害預警、氣候資料判讀、淹水與都市熱島分析、機器學習、水風險，以及企業氣候風險管理。課程結合理論講授、案例討論、數位工具操作與線上自主學習，培養學生運用AI及空間分析工具理解氣候風險、判讀災害資訊，並提出調適策略之基礎能力。
From Week 7 onwards, this course introduces the applications of artificial intelligence in climate change adaptation and disaster management. Topics include global trends in Climate AI and Disaster AI, responsible AI governance, weather forecasting, disaster early warning, climate-data interpretation, flood and urban heat island analysis, machine learning, water risk, and corporate climate-risk management. Through lectures, case discussions, digital-tool exercises, and online self-directed learning, students will develop fundamental skills in applying AI and spatial-analysis tools to understand climate risks, interpret disaster information, and propose adaptation strategies.

description.zh: 本課程以論文研討方式學習 "機器學習" 理論之基本概念與應用及各種演算法。課程內容包含概念式學習、決策樹、圖型理論、神經網路、貝氏網路、案例式學習及支持向量機等方法。經由這門課，學生能對現代機器學習技術及其應用有基本的了解。
description.en: This is a graduate seminar-based course that provides an overview of many algorithms in machine learning and its applications. In this course, we will take an interdisciplinary look at current research topics in machine learning covering Concept Learning, Decision Tree, Graphical Model, Neural Network, Bayesian Network, Instance-based Learning, and Support Vector Machine. Through the course, students can have the basic ideas and intuition behind modern machine learning methods.

syllabi.outline:
類神經網路，機器學習分支之一，具有universal approximation的特性(非線性函數近似器)；因此，其可被應用於控制器設計。另外，其也可被應用於解決分類/函數近似/時間序列預測等問題。本課程內容包含：(1) 介紹、(2) 類神經網路、(3) 類神經網路應用於分類問題、(4) 類神經網路應用於迴歸(函數近似)問題、(5) 其它機器學習技術並應用於分類/迴歸問題及(6) 應用。
This course covers important concepts and topics of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) that can be developed and used to solve classification or function approximation problems. The outline of this course is given as follows. (1) Introduction, (2) ANN, (3) ANN applied in classification, (4) ANN applied in function approximation, (5) ANN applied in time-series data forecasting, and (6) Applications.

description.zh: 本課程主要探討多輸入多輸出系統(MIMO)其系統行為之描述，內容包括MIMO系統之穩定性分析、觀察性分析及其控制器設計，並探討MIMO系統的物理觀念及其數學描述的各種方法，是線性系統之進階課程，適合碩士班以上之學生學習。
description.en: The main objective of this course is to explore the behaviors of multivariable systems. The contents includes: stability analysis, observability analysis, and controller designs for MIMO linear systems. Besides, we will introduce the physical concept of MMIO linear systems and various methods of describing MIMO linear systems via mathematical model. This is an advanced course to linear system theory, and is especially for graduate students.

description.zh: 本課程主要探討非線性系統與線性系統之間的不同，並介紹Lyapunov stability及其相關觀念。除此之外，將介紹如何利用各種穩定性分析的觀念及各種方法探討非線性系統的穩定性，最後並介紹如何設計控制器使非線性系統穩定。
description.en: This course mainly explores the different between the nonlinear system and linear system, and introduces the concept Lyapunov stability. Besides, one wants to introduce how to utilize the concept and method of stability analysis to explore the stability of nonlinear system. Finally, the designs of nonlinear controllers are introduced to stabilize the nonlinear systems.

description.zh: 本課程以講授工業用計算機網路中實體層、媒體存取控制與邏輯連結層為主。在實體層中，將討論到目前廣泛於工業上使用的實體媒介。在媒體存取控制上，則討論乙太網路，記號匯流排與記號環網路為主。媒體存取控制也包含目前廣泛於各類控制器上使用的控制區域網路 (CAN Bus)。在邏輯連結層上，主要討論路由器使用的路由協定與路由演算法。
description.en: The main subjects of this course include physical layer, media access control and logic link layer. Popular physical layer medium are discussed first. Media access control sub-layer that includes Ether-Net, Token Bus and Token Ring are the main subjects in the second portion. The contents of the media access control also include CAN bus which is widely used in various controllers. Routing protocol used by routers are discussed in third portion of this course.

syllabi.outline:
This course presents analytic concepts in computer network analysis. It is designed for the beginning graduate students who are interesting in computer networks. Students should have a mathematical maturity typical of undergraduate curricula in science and engineering, including calculus and discrete mathematics, as well as a course in operating systems and a course in computer architecture.

The teaching approach in this course emphasizes modeling, analysis and design principles used in modern computer networks, including the Internet of today. The subject material includes reference models, queuing systems, graph theory, routing algorithms and resource management systems. Case studies include Internet foundation protocols, such as IP and TCP, as well as Internet multicasting and differentiated service principles.

syllabi.outline: 傅氏光學是波動光學中的基本理論。當光波在像空氣一樣的單純介質中傳播時，光波在兩個平行的平面上的光場分佈呈現著相似於二傅立葉轉換的關係，這樣大大的方便我們以線性系統理論加以分析和計算，於是，我們可以將光學系統中所有的線性元件，包括光在自由空間中的傳播行為，都用二的複數函數加以表示，光學系統便是這些元件函數的組合，這也就方便了我們對它的分析和計算。和幾何光學不同的是，傅氏光學提供了光波中繞射現象的影響，我們也因此可以更完整、精確的計算出光學系統的功用和性能。

description.zh: 本課程介紹固體，尤其是半導體的光學性質，目的在了解光學檢測及光電元件的基礎原理。 藉由學習電磁波與半導體的交互作用，一方面可了解光在半導體中的產生、傳播、吸收、散射、及在界面的透射與反射等現象的規律，另一方面亦可認識光學特性與能帶結構、聲子結構、束縛與自由電子、及各種激發態之間的關係。課程內容包含固態物理複習、光學特性簡介、古典模型、帶間躍遷、激子、螢光現象、半導體低維系統的光學性質、自由載子及缺陷的光學性質、聲子相關特性、非線性光學性質等。
description.en: This course introduces the optical properties of solids, mainly semiconductors. The fundamental principles of absorption, reflection, luminescence and light scattering will be illustrated in terms of classical and quantum theories as appropriate. It mainly includes (1) Introduction (2) Classical propagation (3) Interband absorption (4) Excitons (5) Luminescence (6) Low-dimensional systems of semiconductors (7) Free electrons (8) Luminescence centers (9) Phonons (10)Nonlinear properties.

name.zh: 前瞻材料光學量測與應用
name.en: Optical Measurement and Applications of Emerging Materials

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於具應用潛力之前瞻光電材料之性質、製程技術，以及其於光學檢測與雷射應用中的角色。涵蓋之材料類型包括光電半導體材料（如 III-V 族、鈣鈦礦）、液晶、有機高分子材料、奈米材料（如金屬奈米粒子）與二維材料（如石墨烯、MXene 等）。學生將深入了解這些材料的光電特性，並探討其在雷射、感測器、顯示器、可撓式電子與生醫檢測元件等領域的實際應用。課程內容亦介紹多種光學與雷射相關的量測技術，包括光學吸收、螢光、光致發光（PL）、拉曼光譜、表面增強拉曼散射（SERS），以及雷射激發之光學檢測方法。透過應用導向的案例分析與實作設計，強化學生於材料、雷射與光學系統整合方面的跨領域實務能力。
description.en: This course focuses on the properties and fabrication techniques of advanced optoelectronic materials, as well as their roles in optical detection and laser-related applications.Covered material categories include optoelectronic semiconductors,liquid crystals, organic polymers and biocompatible materials.Students will gain in-depth understanding of the optoelectronic properties of these materials and explore their practical applications in laser systems,sensors,displays,flexible electronics,and biomedical diagnostic devices.The course also introduces a variety of optical and laser-based characterization techniques,including optical absorption,fluorescence,photoluminescence,Raman spectroscopy,surface-enhanced Raman scattering,and laser-excited optical detection methods.Through application-oriented case studies and hands-on project design, students will develop interdisciplinary practical skills in integrating materials, lasers, and optical systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹先進光學材料(包含光電半導體、奈米晶體、二維材料、有機光電材料與液晶等)的特性及其在雷射技術中的應用，包括相關材料的性能與製備、光學量測設備以及相關雷射應用的案例。透過此課程，學生將學習新的光學材料之光電物理特性，掌握雷射技術的基本原理並評估不同光學材料在雷射應用中的可能性。
This course provides a systematic introduction to the properties of advanced optical materials, such as optoelectronic semiconductors, nanocrystals, two-dimensional materials, organic optoelectronic materials, and liquid crystals, as well as their applications in laser technology. The course covers the performance analysis and fabrication methods of these materials, the operating principles of optical measurement instruments, and real-world applications through various laser technology case studies. Through this course, students will gain a solid understanding of the optoelectronic properties of advanced optical materials, comprehend the fundamental principles and mechanisms of laser technology, and develop the ability to evaluate the potential of different optical materials for laser applications.

description.zh: 本課程是介紹基因工程學之基礎知識。內容包括寄主細胞的選擇：細菌、酵母菌、真菌等微生物或昆蟲細胞、哺乳類動物細胞等動物細胞或者是植物細胞。聚合連鎖反應、基因轉殖、質體轉型、病毒轉換、基因槍等常用的基因工程學之方法。
description.en: This course is to introduce basic knowledge of genetic engineering, including the selection of host cells, bacterial, yeast, fungi, insect cell, mammalian cell, or plant cell. The powerful methods of genetic engineering, including polymerase chain reaction (PCR), gene clone, plasmid transformation, virus transduction, and biolistics are also introduced in this course.

syllabi.outline: Electrochemical analysis can provide more advanced information, including biochemical reactions, morphology, as well as properties related to physics, chemistry, and electricity. Utilizing relevant technical methods, such as electrochemical tools, can be used to study heterogeneous and homogeneous reactions, as well as to obtain chemical activity and spectra among various interfaces for the development of microdevices. For biological analysis, electrochemical biosensors exhibit the highest reproducibility and can be successfully applied to electroactive biochemical species, matrix materials, and their specifications. Bioelectroanalytical methods include the most advanced and useful techniques, most of which are built on the foundation of this field.

description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材(富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料(二硫化鉬與金屬化)等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

description.en: This course is a special topics of Photo- Electronic Materials.

syllabi.outline:
本課程專為研究所設計，旨在排除製程干擾，深入探討材料科學理論在光電領域中的核心地位。課程將結合光波特性與半導體科學，解析光電材料在原子與電子層級的行為。內容聚焦雷射二極體與太陽能電池的材料分類、組織變態與強化機構。課程將特別探討金屬、高分子等奈米複合材料系統 如何影響光電元件的轉換效率。透過分析材料失效原因與防止方法，學生將能從材料本質出發，理解界面穩定性對元件壽命的影響。課程亦包含論文研讀，引導學生追蹤前沿材料研究趨勢。
Specifically designed for graduate students, this course focuses on the fundamental Material Science theories in the optoelectronic and semiconductor field, excluding thin-film manufacturing processes. The curriculum integrates thermodynamic and kinetic reviews to analyze the behavior of optoelectronic materials at atomic and electronic levels. The content focuses on the material classification, phase transformation, and strengthening mechanisms Laser Diodes, and Photovoltaics. We will specifically explore how composite material systems—including metals, ceramics, polymers, and nanomaterials—influence the conversion efficiency of optoelectronic devices. By analyzing reasons for material failure and prevention methods, students will understand the impact of interface stability on device longevity from a fundamental material perspective. The course also includes Paper Reading sessions to guide students in tracking frontier material research trends.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的是訓練並教導研究生經由聆聽演講與文獻閱讀，來發掘及思考學術研究之發展與其目前所面臨的挑戰。包括論文之蒐集與閱讀、實驗流程設計、儀器之基本原理、結果分析、討論與結論等。
The objective of this course is to train and guide graduate students to identify emerging research directions and critically evaluate current challenges in academic research through seminar attendance and scientific literature review. The course covers key aspects of research practice, including literature search and analysis, experimental design, fundamental principles of scientific instruments, data interpretation, discussion of results, and formulation of conclusions.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
課程實施依照一般研討會模式進行，施行規範詳列如下：
1. 本課程上課時間為每週三 13:10 – 15:00。
2. 博士生、碩二生文獻報告時間必需控制在20分鐘，回答問題約5-10分鐘，需著整齊服裝。
3. 每位學生必需全程參與，觀摩學習學術研討之進行，並於期間提出相關疑問。
4. 文獻: 須出自 SCI 所收錄之期刊，且必須為正式的學術研究報導。
5. 口頭報告佔學期總成績之70 %，提問與出席率佔30 %。碩一生出席率佔總成績之60 %，提問與服務佔40 %。每缺席一次扣總成績5分，兩次遲到或早退等同於缺席一次。
6. 學生須於報告前備妥內容摘要與文獻電子檔，並於報告三天前並傳送所有學生與授課老師。
7. 口頭報告有重大缺失者，得於學期結束前重講，得更換文獻。問題回答未盡完善者，須於一週後備妥資料上台報告。
8. 課程中不得使用手機。

The course will be conducted in a standard conference format. The course regulations are as follows:

1. Classes are held every Wednesday from 1:10 PM to 3:00 PM.
2. PhD students and 2nd-year master students are required to deliver a literature presentation within 20 minutes, followed by a 5–10 minute question-and-answer session. Students are expected to dress appropriately during their presentations.
3. All students are required to attend the entire seminar session, actively observe and learn from academic discussions, and participate by raising relevant questions when appropriate.
4. Literature Selection: The selected articles must be published in SCI-indexed journals and must be original research papers.
5. Grading Policy:
* For graduate students presenting literature reviews, oral presentations account for 70% of the final grade, while participation through questioning and attendance accounts for 30%.
 * For first-year master's students, attendance accounts for 60% of the final grade, while participation, questioning, and service contributions account for 40%.
* Each absence will result in a deduction of 5 points from the final grade. Two instances of tardiness or early departure will be counted as one absence.
6. Students must prepare a presentation summary and an electronic copy of the selected article and distribute them to all students and the instructor at least three days before the presentation.
7. Students whose oral presentations contain significant deficiencies may be required to repeat their presentations before the end of the semester and may select a different article if necessary. Students who provide insufficient responses during the discussion session must prepare additional information and deliver a follow-up presentation one week later.
8. The use of mobile phones is prohibited during class.

description.zh: 地質災害調查分析課程將介紹地震、山崩、滑坡、地破、地縫等災害的發生原因及其調查分析方法，包括地質調查、工程地質勘查、地球物理探測和遙感技術等方面。課程內容還包括地質災害預防與治理方法等方面。
description.en: This course will introduce the causes and investigation and analysis methods of geological disasters such as earthquakes, landslides, rockfalls, ground fissures, and soil subsidence. It includes geological survey, engineering geological exploration, geophysical exploration, and remote sensing technology. The course also covers prevention and control methods of geological hazards.

syllabi.outline: 本課程是針對自然界因地質作用所引發的地質災害進行研究，尤其著重於各種地質災害的調查與分析。根據衛星影像與航照判釋、現場地質勘查與分析以及各種潛在危險災害發生率與影響性評估方法，對各種地質災害類型依發生頻率及潛在危險性，討論在區域開發上之限制與事前的整治防範。同時也分析各個地質災害案例，了解人與自然環境的互動關係。

description.zh: 本課程重點在於台灣專利法的主要法律議題，包括產業利用性、新穎性、進步性、可實施性、說明書支持性、請求項不明確性、請求項解釋、侵權行為、救濟手段、專利授權、強制授權、專利訴訟之展開和舉發。本課程教材包括專利法教科書、智慧局頒發的專利審查基準和智慧財產法院裁判。
description.en: This course focuses on the main legal issues of the Taiwan Patent Law including industrial utility, novelty, inventive step, enablement, written description, claim indefiniteness, claim interpretation, infringement, remedies, patent licensing, compulsory licensing, initiation of patent litigation, and opposition. The class materials include a patent law textbook, patent examination guidelines issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office and recent decisions from the Taiwan Intellectual Property Court.

syllabi.outline:
一、課程內容：本課程係碩士一年級的基礎課程，係對專利法制的一般性、綜觀(巨觀)性介紹；其主要內容：包括我國的專利法制、其他國家的重要專利理論與學說。
二、教學目標：期使同學於期末，能對現今專利法制的重要觀念與趨勢，能有普遍性的認識與瞭解。
三、授課對象，主要為本所一年級的同學，其他系所同學，亦歡迎選修本課程。
四、注意事項：修習本課程的同學，前半學期為專利基礎知識的介紹，而於期中後，則須於上課前閱讀指定教材，並參與課程中的討論與回答問題，期末則需完成一篇期末報告。

description.zh: 為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展，國家特制定商標法，本課程以介紹我國商標法為重點，主要內容包括商標規範之基本原理、商標之構成要素、商標之分類方式及各類型商標之特性與功能、申請商標註冊之程序、商標註冊之審查及核准、商標權之取得及行使、異議程序及紛爭處理、權利侵害之救濟等。
description.en: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and the consumers' interest, maintain fair competition of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. This course is focusing on the introduction of Trademark Act. Topics will mainly include the basic principle of trademark standard, the integrant part of trademark, the characteristic and the function of trademark, the application procedures, examination and approval, acquisition of the trademark rights and exercises, the procedure of opposition and the dispute processes, remedies for right infringement and so on.

syllabi.outline:
Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof. A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others. A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 20% and in Chinese 80%, and the class materials are cases in Chinese.

商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、 立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表 彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於商標法的瞭解。事實上，本課程之進行，20%以英文講授、80%以中文講授，而且課堂教材以中文案例為主。

name.en: Intellectual Property Management for Global Brands

description.zh:
於高科技、知識經濟時代，作為無形資產之「全球品牌」，已成為促進公司價值及成長之引擎。此全球品牌大時代氛圍，「全球品牌」策略愈發重要。品牌策略管理在提供客戶認知、產品績效及企業價值。藉由品牌溝通，品牌創造客戶對品牌之熟悉及偏好，而達成商業管理目標，進而提昇股東價值及股價市值。
本課程將就下列議題及知名品牌運作模式為說明：一、品牌發展策略，二、品牌價值，三、品牌商標保護策略(即1. 商標計畫，2. 商標執行，3. 商標控制）。四、公司治理與品牌管理。五、智財品牌授權。
description.en:
In High-tech knowledge economy, as intangible assets "global brand", has become an engine for raising company value. During this global brand era, "global brand" strategy is important for enhancing customer awareness and business performance.  Through diversified brand communication, global brand creates customer familiarity and preference, and to achieve business goals, thereby enhancing shareholder value.
The course focuses on the following topics: First, the brand development strategy, Second, brand value, Third, brand & trademark protection strategy. Fourth, corporate governance and brand management. .Fifth, intellectual property/brand licensing.

syllabi.outline: This course examines global brand management from business, legal, and strategic perspectives. It focuses on brand development strategy, brand equity and valuation, trademark protection, corporate governance and brand management, and intellectual property and brand licensing. Through lectures, academic papers, case studies, oral presentations, and project-based learning, students will develop the ability to analyze brand-management issues and formulate effective global brand strategies.

name.en: Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model (I)

description.zh: 本課程上學期將以智慧財產局頒佈之「專利審查基準」為藍本，依「先程式後實體」原則先就「程式審查」部分介紹專利申請之程式，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明專利說明書暨圖式之構成、可專利類型、產業利用性、新穎性、進步性等專利要件。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the procedure for patent application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Firstly, in the "formality examination" section, topics such as the constitution of a patent specification and drawings, the allowable subject matter for patents, utility, novelty, inventiveness and other patent elements, the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, and the priority of an patent application, will be sequentially discussed.

name.en: Practice in Biomedical Materials/Devices Patent Application

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際醫材產品或相關技術，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書(含申請專利範圍)撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論之後專利答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: This course focuses on the procedural aspects of the patent prosecution in biomedical materials/devices. The topics cover patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and office action response. In addition, the practical aspect of international patent prosecution is presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies are also discussed in class.

name.zh: 文化生活美學發展專題
name.en: Seminars on the Aesthetics of Life

description.zh:
探索古代生活中重要的文化主題，尤其是恬適快意又發顯美感訊息的生活內容與活動模式，這滲透著義涵與美感的主題，歷經翻檢淘洗終被標舉揭櫫，即是本課程著意介述、體驗、評論的元素。
「美學」是以對美的本質及其意義的研究為主題的科學，「文化學」研究文化現象或文化體系，「審美文化」則以其特有形態來彌補「道」、「器」間的距離，以實物印證觀念，用觀念史來概括和昇華物態。「文化生活美學」在相關的三者間另闢新徑，取材傾向生活行為方式及活動內容，探索理解與感受，結合「意義的貞定」、「美感領受的追求與實現」，以古典中國文士階層的開發為主力，擴及君王貴族及民間百姓的留存。
本課程分為二部，前者宏觀文化變遷現象及其架構成因，其次，梳理古來時節風尚，人文藝術的脈絡，廣泛取材於文學、思想、器物、禮制、用香、茶藝等生活美學內容，回溯、體驗、評論，而體驗經濟模式的企劃，正是為「文化生活產業化」預做準備。
description.en:
Life Aesthetics is the kernel of cultural life; it has become integral in the process toward cultural industrialization and industrial culturalization. In fact, "creative industries" may be connected to various sectors of developments and has become a prospect eagerly and aggressively pursued by visionary people, especially in the wake of Chinese economic expansion.
This course will examine the important elements constituting cultural lives across different dynasties in Chinese history and investigate their patterns of presentations. The beauty of traditional behavioral culture, the significance of solar terms and seasonal festivals, and the implications of cultural concerns can serve as sources, based on which students' creativity be stimulated and further brought into full play.

name.zh: 文化資產保存理論與資源應用

description.zh: 本課程分為兩大部分，其一為理論和議題的探究，自文化資產概念出發，探究文資保存範疇下的各項議題，包含有形無形文化保存的真實性、文化價值的差異與認定、詮釋與再現、資源管理和應用；其二為講授文化資產資源應用所需的研究方法和工具－田野調查；同時透過國內外文化資產的案例作分析與討論，深度檢視文化資產的多元面貌。
description.en: This course aims to understand the concept of heritage from the context of Taiwan and UNESCO. Different issues related to heritage preservation are discussed in this course, include the value and authenticity of tangible and intangible heritage, the representation and interpretation of culture and history, and reuse and management of cultural spaces. Moreover, fieldwork, the research methods of doing heritage preservation and resource management is also taught in this course. Finally, international case studies of heritage reuse and management are examined, to understand different ways of heritage practice.

syllabi.outline:
本課程分為三大部分，其一為探討文化資產保存的概念及相關議題；其二為講授文化資產資源應用所需的研究方法和工具－田野調查，並進行實務練習；其三為結合大學社會責任概念，透過和場域的合作，引導學生將理論概念透過不同的方式，應用相關工具和資源，將文化保存落實於社會場域中。
This course aims to understand the concept of heritage preservation and different issues related to the conservation, preservation and reinterpretation of cultural resources. Moreover, fieldwork, the research methods of doing heritage preservation and resource management is also taught in this course. Finally, by cooperating with USR project, students are involved in diverse cases of heritage preservation, and apply the theory to practice

description.zh: 本課程主要闡述財務管理中最重要的投資決策、融資決策與短期資金管理決策之基本架構及企業經理人之財務決策，配合各項相關議題進行個案研討，結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹財務管理之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務管理的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的融資與投資決策制定。課程內容涵蓋：金融市場與金融機構、財務報表與現金流量分析、財務規劃與預測、風險與報酬、債券與股票之評價、資金成本、資本預算決策、資本結構與財務槓桿、營運資金管理、股利政策…等。本課程結合財務管理實務並融入財務決策研討，以培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才。透過本課程之修習，期許學生能具備財務管理領域之學科知識與專業技術整合能力、獨立研究之能力、判斷性思考與決策能力，以及制訂並解決財務管理問題之能力。

description.zh: 本課程主要是在於介紹一些駭客常用的攻擊方法和可能使用工具，並藉由這些技術的解說讓學生瞭解實際駭客的攻擊行為與思維模式，進而習得如何保護所管理的網路或資訊系統免於被攻擊成功。課程中將輔以實機操作，教導您如何利用現有電腦資源掃描及測試系統的安全問題，藉以保護系統安全，課程中將加強實際的上機操作，藉由上課所模擬的網路環境中，讓同學能夠實際感受攻擊的可能實況
description.en: This course is mainly to introduce network and system attack methods and security assessment tools used by hackers, and to explain the attack behavior and thinking strategy of hackers through the explanation of these technologies. In addition, this course teaches students learn how to protect the managed network or information system to against from being compromised successfully. The course will be supplemented by practices, and teaching students how to use the existing tools to scan and test the security of the system. In order to protect the security of the system, the course will focus on the system and network practices, which can let the students feel the possible network and system attacks.

description.zh: 來自於內部與外部的攻擊使企業在系統及網路保護遭遇許多挑戰，為了有效控制企業風險，政府在內部控制相關法規明確要求資訊系統相關的內部控制，而電腦稽核為確保內部控制的關鍵角色。本課程內容以國際電腦稽核師(CISA)認證的各項領域內容為主。期望學生能夠對於瞭解資訊系統稽核及其風險管理相關概念有初步的瞭解，進而瞭解資訊安全及資訊系統稽核的機制與手法，作為協助學生順利考取國際電腦稽核師(CISA)認證碁石。
description.en: Internal and external attacks have caused enterprises to encounter many challenges in system and network protection. In order to effectively control enterprise risks, the government's accounting regulations explicitly require information system-related internal controls, and computer audit is a key role for ensuring internal control. The content of this course is based on the content of various fields of the International Computer Auditor (CISA) certification. Students are expected to have a preliminary understanding of the information system audit and its risk management related concepts, and then understand the mechanisms and techniques of information security and information system auditing. Finally, it is expected as a way to help students successfully obtain the CISA certification.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於如何應用計量方法來進行財金議題之研究，課程內容包括縱斷面資料分析、橫斷面資料分析、追蹤資料分析、以及多變量時間序列分析等，讓學生掌握有助於分析經濟和金融數據的計量經濟學學習方法的知識，培養同學具有應用計量軟體進行分析研究的能力。
description.en: The course is aimed to provide essential econometric methods and their application to research issues. Topics cover regression analysis using time-series data, cross-sectional data, and panel data. The multivariate time-series analysis is also introduced in the course. This course is designed to prepare students with knowledge of econometric methods that are useful for analyzing economic and financial data. Students will focus on learning econometric software skills in estimating and analyzing econometric models.

The course is aimed to provide essential econometric methods and their application to research issues. Topics cover regression analysis using time-series data, cross-sectional data, and panel data. The multivariate time-series analysis is also introduced in the course. This course is designed to prepare students with knowledge of econometric methods that are useful for analyzing economic and financial data. Students will focus on learning econometric software skills in estimating and analyzing econometric models.

description.zh: 雲端(Cloud)與物聯網(Internet of Things, IoT)重塑了整個計算世界對於事物的運行方式。除了為各行業提出了新的前沿應用外，也衍生更多在兩者融合對於管理、資訊安全與隱私保護等不得不重視的課題。本課程主要討論雲端與物聯網相關的安全性問題，包括由物聯網衍生出來的新威脅、弱點及兩者融合的相關安全議題。引領學生具備發展雲端與物聯網安全的重要觀念與技術，進而可以分析、設計與規劃未來物聯網與雲端運算融合之應用、與安全管理。
description.en: Cloud and the Internet of Things (IoT) have reshaped the way things are performed across the computing world. In addition to proposing new cutting-edge applications for various industries, there are also more issues that must be paid attention to in the integration of the two, such as management, information security and privacy protection. This course mainly discusses the security issues related to cloud and the IoT, including new threats and weaknesses derived when the two technologies converge. To lead students to understand important concepts and technologies for cloud and IoT security, and then to able to analyze, design, plan application and implement security management of the integration of the cloud and IoT.

description.zh: 本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
description.en: This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

name.zh: 網路系統程式開發與安全

description.zh: 隨著金融交易、機器人應用等網路應用快速成長，系統需同時具備高擴展性、可靠性與安全性。為因應此趨勢，本課程培養學生具備從應用層到作業系統核心的程式開發實力，並強調 TCP/IP 通訊與系統架構整合。
description.en: With the rapid growth of internet services—such as financial transactions and robotic applications—modern systems must be scalable, reliable, and secure. This course addresses these needs by training students in programming skills from the application layer to the OS kernel, emphasizing TCP/IP networking and system architecture.

syllabi.outline:

syllabi.outline:
Human-Computer Interaction Design: Autumn 2026 - Syllabus
Meeting Times and Location: Wednesday, periods: 2-4, 
Credit Hours: 3.0
Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang

Course Description: 
"Human-Computer Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design, and industrial design purposes. 
An interface is a link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” between users and design.
This course will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the human-computer interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and able to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and human-computer interaction design practices. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function," and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences and understand the role that interaction with content and installation fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas.
This class is devoted to lectures, discussions, practice activities, design work sessions, and critiques of practical work. 


Course Objectives/Goals: 
At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 
1.	Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 
2.	Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 
3.	Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 
4.	Apply iterative cycles of research, testing, and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals, and experiences. 
5.	Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 
6.	Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 
7.	Utilize client-based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction, and interface design. 
8.	Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction, and interface design.

description.en: As generative AI and large language models (LLMs) reshape design processes, interaction designers must integrate AI technologies with human-computer interface design to enhance the user experience. This course explores the application of AI in human-computer interaction (HCI), focusing on essential skills for developing intelligent interactive systems. Topics include HCI fundamentals, semantic understanding and response mechanisms, and AI-driven innovations in user experience. Lectures build theoretical foundations, hands-on practice strengthens technical skills, and project-based learning guides students from ideation to prototyping.

description.zh: 系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
description.en: Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

description.zh: 「太空軟體系統設計」課程旨在培養學生在太空任務中設計、開發和操作軟體系統的專業能力。學生將深入了解太空環境對軟體系統的特殊要求，包括真空、輻射、溫度等因素對系統性能的影響。課程將探討飛行軟體的設計和架構，學生將學習如何設計出能夠在極端條件下穩定運行的飛行軟體系統，確保太空任務的順利執行。此外，課程將涵蓋軟體驗證和確認技術，學生將學習如何確保軟體系統的功能性和安全性，並掌握各種測試方法和工具的應用。課程還將關注容錯和自我修復能力的設計，學生將學習如何設計具有容錯和自我修復功能的軟體系統，以應對可能的故障情況。最後，課程將介紹太空軟體系統的專案管理和實施，學生將學習如何有效地管理軟體開發專案，確保項目按時交付並符合品質標準。此外，課程還將包括深度學習在太空軟體系統中的應用，學生將探索如何利用深度學習技術來改進太空任務中的軟體系統設計和性能，以及酬載資料處理軟體的設計和開發，以支援太空任務中的資料收集和分析。通過本課程的學習，學生將具備設計和開發太空軟體系統所需的技能和知識，為未來在太空工程或相關領域的工作做好準備。
description.en: The course "Space Software System Design" aims to cultivate students' professional abilities in designing, developing, and operating software systems for space missions. Students will gain in-depth understanding of the special requirements that the space environment imposes on software systems, including the impact of factors such as vacuum, radiation, and temperature on system performance. The course will explore the design and architecture of flight software, teaching students how to design flight software systems that can operate stably under extreme conditions, ensuring the smooth execution of space missions. Additionally, the course will cover software verification and validation techniques, enabling students to ensure the functionality and safety of software systems and master various testing methods and tools.

This course focuses on the design of embedded software systems for space vehicles and mission control. Emphasis is placed on fault tolerance, reliability, low-power operations, and rigorous validation. Topics include flight control software, ground support systems, human-machine interface, cybersecurity, and the use of AI in space mission automation.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

description.zh: 本課程致力於深入研究各種低軌道衛星地面站系統的複雜結構和相關元素。課程首先介紹低軌道衛星地面站系統的基本概念，包括其在衛星通訊中的角色和功能。學生將深入了解地面站系統在支援低軌道衛星通訊方面的重要性。接著，課程將詳細介紹不同類型的地面站，如海事衛星、GEO/LEO地面站以及固定式/移動式地面站。學生將學會分析這些地面站的特點、應用場景，以及相應的技術要求。課程的內容還包括天線次系統，涵蓋天線的種類、原理和性能特點。同時，課程將探討LOC（地面中控系統）的功能和重要性，使學生瞭解地面站系統的集中控制和管理。接下來，學生也將深入研究資料介接網路，包括資料的傳輸方式、協定和安全性，以確保地面站系統的有效運作。最後，課程將關注其他支援系統，包括電源、控制和機構等，使學生全面理解地面站系統的整體結構和運作機制。透過實例分析，學生將獲得地面站系統架構解析的實際能力。
description.en: This course introduces the structure and key components of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite ground station systems. Students will learn the fundamental roles and functions of these systems in satellite communication, gaining insights into various types such as maritime, GEO/LEO, and fixed/mobile ground stations. The course examines their application scenarios and technical requirements, and explores antenna subsystems, including their types and performance. It also covers the Local Operations Center (LOC), highlighting centralized control and system management. Additionally, data interface networks are discussed, with emphasis on transmission methods, protocols, and security. Supporting systems like power and control mechanisms are introduced. Practical case studies help students understand and analyze ground station architectures.

本課程致力於深入研究各種低軌道衛星地面站系統的複雜結構和相關元素。課程首先介紹低軌道衛星地面站系統的基本概念，包括其在衛星通訊中的角色和功能。學生將深入了解地面站系統在支援低軌道衛星通訊方面的重要性。接著，課程將詳細介紹不同類型的地面站，如海事衛星、GEO/LEO地面站以及固定式/移動式地面站。學生將學會分析這些地面站的特點、應用場景，以及相應的技術要求。課程的內容還包括天線次系統，涵蓋天線的種類、原理和性能特點。同時，課程將探討LOC（地面中控系統）的功能和重要性，使學生瞭解地面站系統的集中控制和管理。接下來，學生也將深入研究資料介接網路，包括資料的傳輸方式、協定和安全性，以確保地面站系統的有效運作。最後，課程將關注其他支援系統，包括電源、控制和機構等，使學生全面理解地面站系統的整體結構和運作機制。透過實例分析，學生將獲得地面站系統架構解析的實際能力。
This course explores the complex structure of various Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite ground station systems, introducing fundamental concepts and their roles in satellite communication. Students gain a profound understanding of the pivotal role these systems play in supporting LEO satellite communication. The course analyzes different ground station types, including maritime satellites, GEO/LEO ground stations, and fixed/mobile ground stations, detailing their characteristics, applications, and technical requirements. It also covers antenna subsystems, the Local Operations Center (LOC), data interface networks, and supporting systems like power and control. Practical case analyses help students develop skills in deciphering ground station system architecture.

name.en: Application of AI and Advanced robot control systems

description.zh: 本課程以實踐機器人和人工智慧應用為核心，採用美國麻省理工學院（MIT）的專案任務導向學習模式。透過結合講授、討論、實際應用和案例分析，課程將會幫助學生深入理解人工智慧和機器人技術。學生有機會積極參與小組項目，透過情境思考實際應用所學知識，並親自操作機器學習工具和機器人平台，以培養實際技能。
description.en: This course is designed for the practical application of robotics and artificial intelligence (AI). It adopts the project-based learning model inspired by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). The course combines lectures, discussions, and case studies to give students an in-depth understanding of AI technology and robotic applications. Students can engage in group projects, apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios, and gain hands-on experience with machine learning tools and mobile robot platforms.

syllabi.outline:
學生自備: 電腦及Python3 環境
課程大綱: 
這是個由麻省理工學院教授所設計的課程。同學們將循序漸進的了解機器人作業系統與AI的運用。本課堂業界最先進的四足機器人——波士頓動力公司研發的AI狗, Spot。透過這堂課程，學員將了解最新的AI技術。透過AI狗的運作原理、相關機構設計，馬達設計，機電架構，高階控制軟體。課程將提供最新的SPOT軟體與API的運用。同學們將不僅有機會親手操作SPOT，還將為SPOT開發各類自動控制與AI應用。

隨著機器人的普及，同學們也將學習機器人的控制軟體ROS2。並了解各式傳感器的運用，如LiDAR、Radar、IMU、相機等機器人領域的硬體。也將運用ROS2來做高階的運用，如地圖建構、定位、導航，路徑規劃，模擬工具，AI影像辨識與機器學習等應用。課程結束後學員能夠由基礎到進階，逐步掌握AI機器人的技術。此外，透過小組協作，實機操作與課程互動，同學們將上課習得的知識需轉化成解決問題的技能。挖掘知識如何應用。

With the increasing adoption of robotics, students will learn the robot operating software ROS2 and gain an understanding of various sensors such as LiDAR, Radar, IMU, and cameras, which are essential in the field of robotics. They will also apply ROS2 in advanced applications, including mapping, localization, navigation, path planning, simulation tools, AI-based image recognition, and machine learning. By the end of the course, students will be able to progressively master AI robotics technologies, from the fundamentals to advanced topics. In addition, through group collaboration, hands-on practice, and interactive learning, students are expected to transform the knowledge acquired in class into problem-solving skills, exploring how to apply what they have learned in real-world contexts.

description.zh:
本課程擬建立學生對於半導體製程中真空技術等基礎認知，做為未來投入半導體產業時學習製程設備之知識基礎；本課程亦提供真空設備產業資訊與技術概況。
本課程包含半導體製程中真空技術及薄膜工程知識，真空技術內容包含真空原理、系統、量測與測漏；薄膜工程則是在真空技術基礎上，提供學生半導體薄膜製程與設備原理，內容涵蓋半導體元件製程常用之薄膜技術(PVD、CVD、ALD與磊晶)。
description.en:
In this course, basic knowledges of vacuum technology and thin film engineering will be provided, and can be the foundation for learning semiconductor process equipment as students join the industry.  Vacuum equipment and industry outlook will also be covered.
Basics of vacuum principle, equipment and measurement/leak detection will be provided in the course.  With the basics of vacuum technology, students will further explore the knowledge of thin film processes, such as PVD, CVD, ALD and epitaxy, especially for manufacturing semiconductor devices.
The syllabus of course is outlined as follows.

description.zh: 本課程介紹有關化合物半導體的材料之基本性質與應用，課程內容包含材料特性、磊晶工程與技術、磊晶分析等面向進行授課，並著重於化合物半導體磊晶實務經驗及化合物半導體光電元件之應用。
description.en: The course covers the fundamental properties and applications of compound semiconductors, including materials properties, epitaxial growth and technology, epitaxial materials analysis, and focuses on practical experiences in compound semiconductor epitaxy and the application of compound semiconductor optoelectronic devices.

syllabi.outline:
This doctoral seminar aims to equip PhD students with advanced knowledge and practical skills to develop, write, submit, and publish high-quality academic articles in international journals. The course covers the complete publication process, including introduction development, literature review and theory building, hypothesis development, research design, theoretical and managerial implications, journal submission strategies, reviewer response techniques, and interactions with leading scholars. Through hands-on exercises and case analyses, students will learn how to produce publishable research and navigate the peer-review process effectively.

本課程旨在培養博士生具備撰寫、投稿與發表高品質國際學術期刊論文之能力。課程內容涵蓋論文撰寫與發表之完整歷程，包括前言撰寫、文獻回顧與理論建構、假說發展、研究方法設計、理論與實務意涵撰寫、投稿策略、審稿回覆技巧，以及與國內外學者之交流分享。透過案例分析與實作演練，協助學生發展具發表潛力之研究成果。

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

name.zh: 使用者經驗設計與評量

description.zh: 本課程將包含使用者經驗設計的基礎，以及使用者研究量測的內涵及方法。本課程中，將透過課堂上課、討論、以及實習的方式，介紹使用者研究的實際案例、評估模式、團隊合作方法、設計與評估工具、實踐思維、挑戰、以及實際執行的程序。預期學生將於本課程中，透過分組獲得使用者經驗在互動設計、空間設計以及產品設計上，有關使用者研究的設計、評估、施行、以及質化與量化分析量測評估的知識與方法。
description.en: This course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design and product design individually.

syllabi.outline:
As the internet has grown and become pervasive in our lives, the world has gotten smaller. More and more, as consumers, we can share our experiences. For a company, great experiences can be a competitive advantage. They can keep your customers loyal and turn them into your biggest cheerleaders. On the flip side, terrible experiences can stop you in your tracks very quickly. No one wants to be that company being talked about for all the wrong reasons. Building great user experiences requires listening and empathy. In this course, you’ll learn the tools and techniques to make your design/products delightful for users.
This course is an introduction to User Experience with a focus on Space, Product, and Interaction Design. Students create a complete UX brief, from ideation to annotated wireframes that could be handed off to a developer to be built. They will also learn to conduct the research necessary and create all the supporting documentation required to defend their design decisions. There is a large focus on how to dissect and analyze common design patterns.
This class is an interdisciplinary integration course. The majority of students are design college students looking to transition their skills into digital, or product managers looking to improve their design skills. Other students often include engineers who want to learn how to make their design/products more usable and entrepreneurs looking to build out the user experience for their idea.
Overall, this course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models, and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing, and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing, and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design, and product design individually

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的是訓練並教導研究生經由聆聽演講與文獻閱讀，來發掘及思考學術研究之發展與其目前所面臨的挑戰。包括論文之蒐集與閱讀、實驗流程設計、儀器之基本原理、結果分析、討論與結論等。
The objective of this course is to train and guide graduate students to identify emerging research directions and critically evaluate current challenges in academic research through seminar attendance and scientific literature review. The course covers key aspects of research practice, including literature search and analysis, experimental design, fundamental principles of scientific instruments, data interpretation, discussion of results, and formulation of conclusions.

* Non-presenting first-year master's students: Attendance (60%), participation and seminar service (40%).
* A deduction of 5 points will be applied for each absence. Two instances of tardiness or early departure will be counted as one absence.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
課程實施依照一般研討會模式進行，施行規範詳列如下：
1. 本課程上課時間為每週三 13:10 – 15:00。
2. 博士生、碩二生文獻報告時間必需控制在20分鐘，回答問題約5-10分鐘，需著整齊服裝。
3. 每位學生必需全程參與，觀摩學習學術研討之進行，並於期間提出相關疑問。
4. 文獻: 須出自 SCI 所收錄之期刊，且必須為正式的學術研究報導。
5. 口頭報告佔學期總成績之70 %，提問與出席率佔30 %。碩一生出席率佔總成績之60 %，提問與服務佔40 %。每缺席一次扣總成績5分，兩次遲到或早退等同於缺席一次。
6. 學生須於報告前備妥內容摘要與文獻電子檔，並於報告三天前並傳送所有學生與授課老師。
7. 口頭報告有重大缺失者，得於學期結束前重講，得更換文獻。問題回答未盡完善者，須於一週後備妥資料上台報告。
8. 課程中不得使用手機。

The course will be conducted in a standard conference format. The course regulations are as follows:

1. Classes are held every Wednesday from 1:10 PM to 3:00 PM.
2. PhD students and 2nd-year master students are required to deliver a literature presentation within 20 minutes, followed by a 5–10 minute question-and-answer session. Students are expected to dress appropriately during their presentations.
3. All students are required to attend the entire seminar session, actively observe and learn from academic discussions, and participate by raising relevant questions when appropriate.
4. Literature Selection: The selected articles must be published in SCI-indexed journals and must be original research papers.
5. Grading Policy:
* For graduate students presenting literature reviews, oral presentations account for 70% of the final grade, while participation through questioning and attendance accounts for 30%.
 * For first-year master's students, attendance accounts for 60% of the final grade, while participation, questioning, and service contributions account for 40%.
* Each absence will result in a deduction of 5 points from the final grade. Two instances of tardiness or early departure will be counted as one absence.
6. Students must prepare a presentation summary and an electronic copy of the selected article and distribute them to all students and the instructor at least three days before the presentation.
7. Students whose oral presentations contain significant deficiencies may be required to repeat their presentations before the end of the semester and may select a different article if necessary. Students who provide insufficient responses during the discussion session must prepare additional information and deliver a follow-up presentation one week later.
8. The use of mobile phones is prohibited during class.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。論文撰寫、投稿及專題報告
1.人數：全部博士生參與，與授課老師協商指導，需於本學期末之前投稿，提交投出證明，方才取得學分。
2.論文投稿範圍：以最近5年內與論文相關之SCI、SSCI、EI、A＆HCI、TSSCI（如科技部2014年通過之相關TSSCI名單：戶外遊憩研究、地理學報、住宅學報、建築學報、都市與計劃、運輸計劃季刊、運輸學刊、台灣土地研究、歐美研究、藝術教育研究…）或該領域經審查後出版之學術性期刊文章；或國內外研討會。
3.語文：中英文皆可，需於本學期末之前投稿，提出證明，方才取得學分；並請準備演講或報告摘要給同學參考。
4.時間：論文進行定期全班報告，由授課老師共同排定時間；其餘週次，各組帶開，由授課教師進行論文討論。
5.作業討論繳交：論文題目確定、撰寫過程與分組授課老師討論。論文投出後學期結束前，以E-mail繳交全文及投稿證明給所長，由全體授課老師評分。未完成繳交視同期末考缺考，不得補交，成績不及格論。

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of interactive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

syllabi.notes:
google第 17 週：工程口說表達與專業簡報技巧
教學重點聚焦於科技與工程領域的實用口說用語，由教師引導學生學習如何運用精準的語意轉折詞與工程專業核心字彙，在數位環境中進行流暢的技術簡報與小組專案討論。在線上活動的規劃上，教師將透過遠距視訊軟體進行即時互動式教學，現場示範國際工程簡報常用的句型結構與講述邏輯。隨後，課堂將安排學生進行線上即時分組，每位學生須針對特定的工程主題或科技趨勢進行 3 分鐘的英文口說演練。教師隨即在同步課堂中，針對學生的發音清晰度、演說語調、專業用詞準確性以及邏輯組織能力，給予即時且具體的口頭回饋與修正建議，藉此建立學生在國際專業群體中以英語進行技術交流的自信心。

第 18 週：科技論文文法結構與聽力深化
本週的教學核心在於深化學生對於科技論文語法與嚴謹結構的分析能力，包含工程文獻中高頻率出現的被動語態運用技巧，以及如何用精準的英文句型來描述精密的數據與實驗結果。在線上活動設計方面，學生須於本週內自主登入學校教學平台，觀看教師預先錄製的工程文法要訣與常見錯誤解析教學影片，並閱讀指定的科技短文進行文法句型的對照與拆解。此外，為了進一步訓練學生的進階聽力與語感理解能力，

syllabi.outline:
This doctoral seminar aims to equip PhD students with advanced knowledge and practical skills to develop, write, submit, and publish high-quality academic articles in international journals. The course covers the complete publication process, including introduction development, literature review and theory building, hypothesis development, research design, theoretical and managerial implications, journal submission strategies, reviewer response techniques, and interactions with leading scholars. Through hands-on exercises and case analyses, students will learn how to produce publishable research and navigate the peer-review process effectively.

本課程旨在培養博士生具備撰寫、投稿與發表高品質國際學術期刊論文之能力。課程內容涵蓋論文撰寫與發表之完整歷程，包括前言撰寫、文獻回顧與理論建構、假說發展、研究方法設計、理論與實務意涵撰寫、投稿策略、審稿回覆技巧，以及與國內外學者之交流分享。透過案例分析與實作演練，協助學生發展具發表潛力之研究成果。

description.zh: 本課程主要在研討傳統的結構化語言的編譯技術。課程所所涵蓋的內容包括有： - 語句上的分析、語句分析器的製作 - 由上而下的組譯器製作 - 由下而上的組譯器製作 - 語意分析 - 機器碼之產生與暫存器之配置 - 資料流分析的理論與應用 - 程式碼最佳化處理。課程的實施，將以基本編譯技術為主，作深入的介紹。學習所得的觀念與技術，將利用一個實驗性語言編譯器的實作來貫穿。因此，程式規畫實作，將在這個課程中，佔有相當大的比重。
description.en: This course discusses issues in the compilation of conventional block-structured languages, as listed below. - lexical analysis, scanner generators; - top-down parsing, LL(1) parsers; - bottom-up parsing SLR, LALR, LR(1) parsers, parser generators; - semantic analysis; - code generation and register allocation, code generator generators; - dataflow analysis: theory and practice; - code optimization. There will be a significant programming component to the course

description.en:
This course aims to introduce security technologies for industrial Internet of Things and principles of industrial cyber security. The course focuses on practical exercises on using detection tools, such as packet sniffer, etc., The exercises will be performed based on the CDX cloud service environments and exercising on security attack/defense practices. Practical exercises allow students to better understand the practical applications of security technologies for industrial IoT applications. The course contents including:

●Introduction to IoT technologies 
●IoT vulnerabilities and risks
●Security testing for IoT applications
●Vulnerability detection
●Intrusion detection
●Anomaly detection

syllabi.outline:
This course will introduce Google Cloud Computing related technologies and provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Google Cloud platform, architecture, services, and programming through the application of machine learning and IoT in railway systems. The course content includes: 1. Google cloud system architecture, storage network and virtualization technology, 2. Google cloud storage technology, 3. Google cloud scheduling technology, performance and security, 4. Google virtualized data center construction, 5. Google cloud services and enterprise applications, 6. Introduction to IoT technology 7. IoT standards and applications 8. Introduction to Industrial IoT network 9. IoT security and privacy protection 10. IoT internship courses and special projects. Therefore, before the midterm exam, we will mainly introduce the Google cloud system architecture. After the midterm exam, we will start to introduce the Internet of Things and its development trends. In the 11th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security issues and trends. In the 12th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology. In the 13th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 14th week. In the 15th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 16th week. In the 17th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology and practice. In the 18th week, we will make a special topic report at the end.

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出之方式，介紹與機器學習之相關技術及演算法，目標是修習本課程之學生具有閱讀機器學習相關文獻之基本知識，並能從事相關之實務或電腦模擬實驗之工作，因此本課程著重在廣泛介紹各類之演算法之應用，而非深究少數演算法之深奧數學原理．本課程涵蓋之演算法，包含：最佳化基本知識，隨機最佳化演算法，隨機搜尋，決策樹，隨機森林，類神經網路及深度學習相關演算法，基因演算法，貝氏定理及應用，高斯混合模型，隱藏式馬可夫鍊(及訓練演算法，支援向量機，線性及邏輯回歸，分群方法，降維方法，提升方法，決策融合技巧，及增強式學習等．
description.en: This introductory course covers most of the techniques and algorithms related to the current trend in the machine learning field. The goal of this course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, this course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. The algorithms covered in this course include: foundations of optiminizations, random search, decision tree,  random decision forests, neural networks and deep learning, genetic algorithm, Bayes' theorem and its applications, Gauss mixture model, hidden Markov model (with its training algorithm), support vector machine, linear and logistic regressions, clustering algorithms, dimension reduction techniques (LDA, PCA, ICA, FA), boosting methods, decision

name.zh: 邊緣運算與智慧網路系統
name.en: Edge Computing and Intelligent Network Systems

description.zh: 本課程探討邊緣運算（Edge Computing）於現代分散式系統與智慧網路中的核心角色，強調從傳統雲端架構轉向「雲–邊–端協同（Cloud–Edge–Device Continuum）」之設計思維。課程內容涵蓋邊緣架構設計、資源配置與任務卸載（offloading）、邊緣人工智慧（Edge AI）、以及與5G/6G通訊系統之整合。此外，課程將深入探討低延遲應用（如智慧製造、AR/VR、自駕車）、邊緣資料分析、隱私保護與安全機制，並介紹容器化（containerization）、微服務（microservices）與邊緣原生（edge-native）系統設計。透過論文文獻研讀與專題實作，使學生具備設計與實現新世代邊緣智慧系統之能力。
description.en: This course explores the principles and emerging trends of edge computing in modern distributed and intelligent network systems. It focuses on the paradigm shift from centralized cloud computing to the Cloud–Edge–Device continuum, enabling low-latency, real-time, and context-aware services. Topics include edge architecture design, resource management, task offloading, edge AI, federated learning, and integration with 5G/6G networks. The course also covers edge analytics, security and privacy, and cloud-native technologies such as containers and microservices. Students will engage in paper reading and hands-on projects to develop advanced edge-enabled intelligent systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討邊緣運算（Edge Computing）於現代分散式系統與智慧網路中的核心角色，強調從傳統雲端架構轉向「雲–邊–端協同（Cloud–Edge–Device Continuum）」之設計思維。課程內容涵蓋邊緣架構設計、資源配置與任務卸載（offloading）、邊緣人工智慧（Edge AI）、以及與5G/6G通訊系統之整合。此外，課程將深入探討低延遲應用（如智慧製造、AR/VR、自駕車）、邊緣資料分析、隱私保護與安全機制，並介紹容器化（containerization）、微服務（microservices）與邊緣原生（edge-native）系統設計。透過論文文獻研讀與專題實作，使學生具備設計與實現新世代邊緣智慧系統之能力。
This course explores the principles and emerging trends of edge computing in modern distributed and intelligent network systems. It focuses on the paradigm shift from centralized cloud computing to the Cloud–Edge–Device continuum, enabling low-latency, real-time, and context-aware services. Topics include edge architecture design, resource management, task offloading, edge AI, federated learning, and integration with 5G/6G networks. The course also covers edge analytics, security and privacy, and cloud-native technologies such as containers and microservices. Students will engage in paper reading and hands-on projects to develop advanced edge-enabled intelligent systems.

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出之方式，介紹與機器學習之相關技術及演算法，目標是修習本課程之學生具有閱讀機器學習相關文獻之基本知識，並能從事相關之實務或電腦模擬實驗之工作，因此本課程著重在廣泛介紹各類之演算法之應用，而非深究少數演算法之深奧數學原理．本課程涵蓋之演算法，包含：最佳化基本知識，隨機最佳化演算法，隨機搜尋，決策樹，隨機森林，類神經網路及深度學習相關演算法，基因演算法，貝氏定理及應用，高斯混合模型，隱藏式馬可夫鍊(及訓練演算法)，支援向量機，線性及邏輯回歸，分群方法，降維方法，提升方法，決策融合技巧，及增強式學習等。
description.en: This course covers most of the techniques and algorithms related to the current trend in the machine learning field. The goal of the course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, the course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. The algorithms covered in this course include: foundations of optimizations, random search, decision tree, random decision forests, neural networks and deep learning, genetic algorithm, Bayes' theorem and its applications, Gauss mixture model, hidden Markov model, support vector machine, linear and logistic regressions, clustering algorithms, dimension reduction techniques, boosting methods, decision level fusion techniques, and reinforcement learning.

name.zh: 顧客關係管理與商業智慧
name.en: Customer Relationship Management and Business Intelligence

description.zh: 顧客關係管理主要目的是了解企業與顧客之關係，促使顧客滿意及忠誠回應而產生終身價值，進而提昇企業獲利，其內容包括顧客關係管理的概念與本質、顧客行為、顧客資料探勘、顧客關係管理系統、顧客關係管理專案之規劃與管理、顧客關係管理的績效衡量、顧客關係管理實務研討。商業智慧(Business Intelligence, BI)，是企業利用現代資訊技術收集、管理和分析結構化與非結構化的企業資料與資訊，創造和累積企業知識與見解，以改善企業決策品質與採取有效的企業行動，進而提升企業各方面績效。由基本現場管理(Shop Floor Control)需求談起，然後介紹製造資訊分類與收集技術（包括RFID），也將包括資料庫與資料倉儲觀念，最後介紹BI於顧客關係管理之應用。課堂中也將輔以目前市面上商用BI套裝軟體，並將其專業上相關資訊在此系統上實際應用，體驗BI對企業之重要性。
description.en: The objectives of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) are to study the relationship between corporation and customer, to increase the profit by customer lifetime value through customer satisfaction and royalty. The topics of this course includes concepts and context of CRM, consumer behavior, customer data mining, CRM system, planning and management of CRM projects, performance measurement of CRM. Business intelligence (BI) systems refer to applications and technologies which gather and analyze data about company operations. It then provides a comprehensive correlation of those factors, such as metrics on sales, production, internal operations, and helps managers to make better business decisions. This course focuses on applications of BI in CRM, with the introduction of shop floor control concepts and data collection techniques such as RFID, along with database and data warehouse concepts. Hands-on experience in BI software implementation is also emphasized.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以工業工程與管理領域學生為主要對象，旨在培養學生整合運用商業智慧、顧客關係管理、資料分析及人工智慧技術，解決企業營運與顧客管理問題的能力。課程內容涵蓋顧客資料管理、顧客分群、RFM分析、顧客價值與流失分析、銷售與營運分析、關鍵績效指標設計、商業智慧儀表板建置，以及AI輔助資料分析。學生將學習如何將顧客、銷售與營運資料轉化為具管理價值的資訊與決策建議。課程將運用商業智慧軟體、生成式AI及AI Vibe Coding工具，透過自然語言指令與AI協作，進行資料整理、分析、視覺化、儀表板設計及系統原型開發。並藉由企業案例與專題實作，培養學生的資料分析、AI應用、系統整合及管理決策能力。修習本課程後，學生應能：
一、理解CRM、BI、資料分析與AI在企業管理中的功能及整合應用。
二、運用BI工具、生成式AI及AI Vibe Coding進行資料整理、分析與視覺化。
三、完成顧客分群、RFM、顧客價值、顧客流失及銷售績效分析。
四、整合銷售與營運資料，完成分析型CRM應用或系統原型，並提出具體管理決策建議。

This course is designed primarily for students in industrial engineering and management. It aims to develop students’ ability to integrate Business Intelligence (BI), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), data analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to solve practical problems in business operations and customer management.
The course covers customer data management, customer segmentation, RFM analysis, customer value and churn analysis, sales and operational analysis, key performance indicator design, business intelligence dashboard development, and AI-assisted data analytics. Students will learn how to transform customer, sales, and operational data into meaningful managerial information and actionable decision insights.
The course incorporates business intelligence software, generative AI, and AI Vibe Coding tools. Through natural-language instructions and AI-assisted collaboration, students will conduct data preparation, analysis, visualization, dashboard design, and system prototype development. Enterprise cases and project-based learning will be used to strengthen students’ capabilities in data analysis, AI application, system integration, and managerial decision-making.
Upon completion of the course, students will be able to:
1.Understand the roles and integrated applications of CRM, BI, data analytics, and AI in business management.
2.Apply BI tools, generative AI, and AI Vibe Coding to data preparation, analysis, and visualization.
3.Conduct customer segmentation, RFM, customer value, customer churn, and sales performance analyses, and develop management dashboards.
4.Integrate customer, sales, and operational data to develop an analytical CRM application or system prototype and provide actionable managerial recommendations.
