description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

6. Design of new energy system modules with ecology considerations.

學習目標： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，運用 AI 工具輔助延伸議題探索及編寫計算程式，完成指定主題之數值計算或系統模擬，並進行物理量/邏輯合理性驗證。

1. 主題選定與 AI 提問設計： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，利用 AI（如 ChatGPT、Claude 、Gemini等）進行延伸議題探索，並構思程式架構。

● AI 輔助學習與工具應用(AI-assisted learning and tool application)

學習目標： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，運用 AI 工具輔助延伸議題探索及編寫計算程式，完成指定主題之數值計算或系統模擬，並進行物理量/邏輯合理性驗證。

1. 主題選定與 AI 提問設計： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，利用 AI（如 ChatGPT、Claude 、Gemini等）進行延伸議題探索，並構思程式架構。

2. AI 輔助程式撰寫： 指導 AI 產出 Python計算程式（如冷庫負荷、冷媒循環、熱交換器等）。

3. 成果驗證與除錯（Sanity Check & Debugging）： 學生須以課堂所學之基礎理論（如手算基準值、極限條件測試、物理合理性界限）檢核 AI 產出之程式碼與計算結果，並記錄 AI 出錯與修正過程。
extra.學習成果:
在繳交報告時，必須包含以下 5 個核心章節：

1. 問題定義與理論基礎： 說明選擇前 16 週何種概念，以AI進行延伸議題探索及其欲透過程式解決的具體問題。

2. AI 提示工程與程式碼架構： 展現如何下達 Prompt 讓 AI 寫出程式，以及程式的核心演算邏輯。

3. 驗證與除錯紀錄（最重要）：

(1) 基準驗證： 用手算、經典公式或既有文獻數據與程式輸出進行對比。

(2) AI 除錯紀錄： 列出 AI 寫出的 Code 在哪裡出現邏輯漏洞，自己是如何發現並更正的。

4. 分析結果與延伸討論： 呈現程式產出的圖表（如動態趨勢圖、參數敏感度分析），並說明其工程/學理意義。

5. 錄製 3–5 分鐘程式執行與驗證影片： 展示程式運作、關鍵參數修改及結果圖表繪製過程。

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生實務能力，學生利用整學期至各相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: This course, off-campus practice, aims to provide practical training for undergraduate students through working in enterprise environments. During one semester, students go to enterprises or organization related to energy, air-conditioning and refrigerating industries and learn application-oriented skills. After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.zh: 室內氣候、室外氣候、熱環境、空氣環境－汙染物、換新與通風、音環境、人體舒適度、室內空氣品質控制、潔淨室之規劃設計。
description.en: Indoor and outside air conditions, thermal environment, air pollutants, fresh air and ventilation, noise level, human confort, indoor air quality control, design of clean room.

description.zh: 本課程著重冷凍系統和空調系統能源的分析，探討構成系統的主要元件－壓縮機、蒸發器和冷凝器的耗能，和各泵、冰水盤管、空調箱及風／水管路系統的能源耗損，進而對整個系統運轉時的效率予以檢討。最後提出各種改善方法，節約能源和減少電力契約容量的技術，以使學生具有節能省電的正確理論觀念和實務技術。
description.en:
This lesson is focused on the energy analyses of refrigeration systems and air-conditioning systems. The operating defects of compressors, evaporators and
condensers are to be investigated. Also the energy consumption's of pumps, fan coils air-handling units and duct/water systems are studied. The over all performance of the entire system is thus discussed. Several methods to improve the shortages and the techniques to energy conservation and electricity demand cut-down will be proposed.
The students should understand correctly the theory of energy conservation and the
technology to improve the systems.

description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本課程內容包括邏輯閘的特性與功能測試，能利用積體電路完成各種基礎邏輯電路的組裝及設計，並能利用電子儀器進行量測、檢修。探討最佳化組合邏輯之演算法，可規劃邏輯元件，組合邏輯之VLSI設計，使用MSI與標準電路元件設計多層邏輯，使用閘陣列設計，循序邏輯之元件，循序邏輯之分析與合成，VLSI之設計與測試技巧，各種CAD軟體工具介紹。基礎邏輯閘實驗、組合邏輯實驗、加法器及減法器實驗、組合邏輯應用實驗、正反器邏輯實驗、循序邏輯電路應用實驗。

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 計算機系統之基礎觀念介紹及應用。主要內容包括：計算機系統簡介,，資料的表示法、數字系統、邏輯，周邊裝置及儲存體，程式語言與程式設計，作業系統，檔案與資料庫。本課程引入程式設計的觀念與方法，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入進階程式語言。著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en: This introductory course covers the fundamentals and applications of computers, including: introduction to computer systems, data representation, number systems, and logic, peripherals and storage,  programming languages and programming, operating systems, files and database systems. 計算機系統之基礎觀念介紹及應用。主要內容包括：計算機系統簡介,，資料的表示法、數字系統、邏輯，周邊裝置及儲存體，程式語言與程式設計，作業系統，檔案與資料庫。本課程引入程式設計的觀念與方法，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入進階程式語言。著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
This introductory course covers the fundamentals and applications of computers, including: introduction to computer systems, data representation, number systems, and logic, peripherals and storage,  programming languages and programming, operating systems, files and database systems. description.zh: 由介紹基本熱傳有關現象，配合熱力守恆有關公式之應用，討論各種熱交換環境下應考慮之因素，分析熱傳導、熱對流、熱輻射及相變熱傳之計算方法。並將要更深入地探討在各不同熱傳導系統內所可能形成之熱力分佈現象，以期學習者能以淺入深地對相關熱傳導系統工程設計上培養出最佳能力。
description.en: Introduction of basic heat transfer phenomena, using thermodynamic conservation equations to discuss the parameters under different heat exchange circumstances, heat conduction, heat convection, heat radiation and phase change are analyzed, discussion in depth on the heat transfer problems in application to cultivate heat transfer design capability.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 瞭解計算機之硬体組織與資料結構等基本原理及其應用，並介紹各種程式語言特性，內容包括：1.計算機簡介：介紹計算機之演進及計算機之種類與特性，2.計算機系統簡介：介紹計算機系統的組成及軟硬体系統所含概之內容，3.資料的表示法與數字系統：介紹數系及文數字表示法，4.輸出入裝置及儲存体：介紹各種輸出入設備及資料儲存体，5.程式語言與程式設計：介紹各種程式語言結構，及撰寫之方法，6.資料結構：介紹資料在記憶体內之各種排列方法以節省記憶空間及提高存取效率，7.作業系統：介紹各種管理電腦資源的系統軟体及其作業方式，8.檔案與資料庫：介紹各種檔案的類型及資料庫之基本架構，9.資料通訊與計算機網路：介紹資料通訊之種種特性及電腦網路之結構與類別，10.人工智慧：介紹人工智慧基本概念及基本功能。

syllabi.outline:
本課程以 Rust 程式語言作為主要實作工具，帶領學生從 Windows 應用程式開發出發，逐步理解電腦系統與作業系統的基本運作原理。課程內容涵蓋資料表示、檔案系統、磁碟管理、行程與執行緒、記憶體管理、網路通訊、Windows API、系統服務、事件紀錄、簡易圖形化介面，以及輸入輔助與裝置互動概念。
不同於傳統以語法或理論為主的計算機概論，本課程強調「透過實作理解系統」。學生將使用 Rust 撰寫 Windows 系統工具，例如系統資訊查詢程式、磁碟空間監控工具、行程與記憶體監控程式、TCP/UDP 網路通訊程式、背景服務程式與簡易 GUI 工具。透過這些實作，學生能理解應用程式如何與作業系統互動，並建立後續學習作業系統、嵌入式 Linux porting、驅動程式與系統軟體開發的基礎。

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
第1週：課程導入：Rust、Windows與系統程式設計。說明本課程以Rust作為主要實作語言，透過Windows應用程式與系統工具開發，理解計算機系統與作業系統的基本運作方式。實作內容包含安裝Rust、VS Code、Windows開發工具，並建立第一個Rust專案。
第2週：Rust基礎語法與CLI程式設計。介紹變數、型別、控制流程、函式、模組與Cargo專案結構，使學生能撰寫基本命令列程式。實作內容為完成一個簡單的CLI工具。
第3週：資料表示與位元運算。介紹二進位、十六進位、補數、位元遮罩、旗標設計與資料編碼方式，使學生理解電腦如何表示數字與狀態。實作內容為設計bit mask與flag處理程式。
第4週：Windows檔案系統與路徑管理。介紹檔案、目錄、路徑、檔案屬性、時間戳記與副檔名等概念。實作內容為撰寫檔案掃描器，讀取檔案大小、修改時間與副檔名。
第5週：磁碟與儲存裝置管理。介紹磁碟分割、volume、檔案配置、儲存容量與檔案系統基本概念。實作內容為撰寫磁碟空間查詢工具，顯示可用空間、總容量與使用比例。
第6週：行程概念、Process Viewer與執行緒基礎。介紹process、PID、執行狀態、user space、thread、concurrency與作業系統資源分配。實作內容為列出目前執行中的process，顯示PID、名稱與基本狀態，並以Rust thread完成簡易並行任務。
第7週：記憶體管理基礎與期中作品規格說明。介紹virtual memory、physical memory、working set、heap、stack與process address space。實作內容為撰寫記憶體使用量監控工具，觀察系統與指定行程的記憶體狀態。課堂後段說明期中作品規格、繳交格式與評分標準。
第8週：期中作品製作週。本週不安排正式授課，保留時間讓學生完成期中作品。學生需整合前半學期內容，完成一個Windows system information CLI tool，功能至少包含基本系統資訊、磁碟資訊、行程資訊與記憶體資訊，並準備簡短作品說明。
第9週：期中作品繳交、展示與評分。學生於當週課堂繳交期中作品，由授課教師現場檢查程式執行結果、原始碼完整性與功能完成度，並依評分規準完成期中成績評定。學生需能說明其作品對應的作業系統概念，例如檔案系統、磁碟管理、行程管理與記憶體管理。
第10週：Windows API與系統呼叫概念。介紹Windows API、user space、kernel space、system call與應用程式和作業系統之間的介面。實作內容為使用Rust呼叫Windows API取得系統資訊。
第11週：Registry與系統設定。介紹Windows Registry的用途、系統設定儲存方式、key/value結構與應用程式設定管理。實作內容為讀取指定registry key並顯示相關系統設定。
第12週：Windows Service與背景程式。介紹service lifecycle、背景常駐程式、啟動類型、權限與系統管理工具。實作內容為建立簡易背景服務或服務模擬程式，理解Windows服務的運作方式。
第13週：Event Log、系統紀錄與診斷。介紹系統紀錄、事件診斷、log level、錯誤追蹤與維運觀念。實作內容為撰寫log輸出工具，記錄程式執行狀態與錯誤訊息。
第14週：TCP/UDP網路通訊。介紹IP、port、socket、TCP、UDP、client/server架構與基本網路通訊模型。實作內容為使用Rust撰寫TCP client/server或簡易區域網路訊息工具。
第15週：GUI應用程式入門。介紹Windows圖形化應用程式、事件驅動模型、視窗、按鈕、文字顯示與使用者互動。實作內容為製作簡單Windows utility GUI，用於顯示系統資訊、磁碟資訊、行程資訊或記憶體資訊。
第16週：輸入輔助、Hotkey、裝置互動概念與期末作品規格說明。介紹global hotkey、文字輸入輔助、IME概念、HID裝置、user-mode device interaction與driver model基礎。實作內容為完成簡化版hotkey或text helper工具，並說明其與輸入法、裝置互動及驅動程式之間的關係。課堂後段說明期末作品規格、繳交格式、展示方式與評分標準。
第17週：期末作品製作週。本週不安排正式授課，保留時間讓學生完成期末作品。學生需以分組方式整合前述功能，完成一個Rust Windows System Utility，可選擇system monitor、disk monitor、process viewer、memory monitor、network tool、GUI dashboard、Windows service、input helper或user-mode device simulator等方向進行實作。
第18週：期末作品繳交、展示與評分。學生於當週課堂繳交期末作品，由授課教師現場檢查程式執行結果、原始碼、功能完成度、系統概念說明與展示表現，並完成期末成績評定。各組需說明作品使用的Rust技術、對應的Windows系統機制與作業系統原理，並銜接後續作業系統課程中Banana Pi M2U、Embedded Linux porting、kernel、device tree、root filesystem與systemd service等內容。

description.zh: 這個課程設計的目的，在於讓學生熟悉專業人員應具備的相關倫理與法律議題，學生不僅將重新思索在專業職涯與生活中倫理所扮演的主要角色，並且探索專業人員在面對道德與人際關係兩難時的倫理運用與法律原則。

description.zh: 本課程品質管理之目的為：使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念、原理、領域。品管部門的組織、功能，如何管理產品或服務的品質，品管的工具、方法，如何持續改善品質的方法，品質表示法，如何評估品質管理成效，相關法令，品質管理未來趨勢。

syllabi.notes:
goo第 17 週：工程口說表達與專業簡報技巧
教學重點聚焦於科技與工程領域的實用口說用語，由教師引導學生學習如何運用精準的語意轉折詞與工程專業核心字彙，在數位環境中進行流暢的技術簡報與小組專案討論。在線上活動的規劃上，教師將透過遠距視訊軟體進行即時互動式教學，現場示範國際工程簡報常用的句型結構與講述邏輯。隨後，課堂將安排學生進行線上即時分組，每位學生須針對特定的工程主題或科技趨勢進行 3 分鐘的英文口說演練。教師隨即在同步課堂中，針對學生的發音清晰度、演說語調、專業用詞準確性以及邏輯組織能力，給予即時且具體的口頭回饋與修正建議，藉此建立學生在國際專業群體中以英語進行技術交流的自信心。

第 18 週：科技論文文法結構與聽力深化
本週的教學核心在於深化學生對於科技論文語法與嚴謹結構的分析能力，包含工程文獻中高頻率出現的被動語態運用技巧，以及如何用精準的英文句型來描述精密的數據與實驗結果。在線上活動設計方面，學生須於本週內自主登入學校教學平台，觀看教師預先錄製的工程文法要訣與常見錯誤解析教學影片，並閱讀指定的科技短文進行文法句型的對照與拆解。此外，為了進一步訓練學生的進階聽力與語感理解能力，

description.zh: 1. 瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含： (1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件， (2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等， (3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應， (4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域， (5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。 2. 瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含： (1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路， (2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析， (3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換， (4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數， (5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用， (6)Laplace轉換及應用。

Kirchhoff laws, 4. Thevenin and Norton theorem, 5. First and second order circuit, 6. Node and loop analysis, 7. Steady state response and analysis, 8. SPICE tool, 9.AC circuit :AC steady-state analysis, phasor analysis, 10. Three phase circuits, 11. Transformer circuits, 12. Frequency response, 13. Fourier series, Fourier transformation and application, 14. Laplace transformation and application.

description.en: The second law of thermodynamics, Entropy generation, power cycles, refrigeration cycles and heat pump cycles.

syllabi.outline:
本課程內容著重熱力性質、狀態、過程、和循環之說明與應用。並從熱力學第零定律引導，說明各定律之內容與重要性。
應用端將以濕空氣性質、空氣調節、冷凍循環和能源流向計算為主軸，詳細說明熱力學如何應用於能源系統規劃與分析。
This course focuses on the explanation and application of thermodynamic properties, states, processes, and cycles. Starting with the zeroth law of thermodynamics, fully explains the content and importance of each law.
To instruct the application of thermodynamics, the course focuses on the properties of moist air, air conditioning, the refrigeration cycle, and energy balance analysis, detailing how it can be applied to energy system planning and analysis.

第1週:introduction, objects, important issues of power system
quality.
第2週:overview of existent power system crital power quality
problems and affections.  
第3週:power outage problem survey , related indices evalutations
and affection factors and import parameters determinations.
第4週:causes and classification of power outage, improved
strategies and practical feasible measures for reducing power
outage.
第5週:fundamental theory of voltage variations on power system, root
causes to produce voltage variations, classification of
voltage variations. 
第6週:definitions for various indices of voltage variations and
their calculation.
第7週:analysis and simulation method for voltage variation with
respect to various types of voltage variations. affections
evaluations.  
第8週:study of phase unbalance problems (fundamental theory, causes
and classification).
第9週:Review and midterm examination and report (期中考試) 
第10週:study of phase unbalance problems (analysis and simulation
methods, and indices definitions).
第11週:study of phase unbalance problems (affections assessment and
improved strategies). 
第12週:survey on waveform distortion problems: fundamental theory,
indices definitions, causes and analysis methods.
第13週:affections of power harmonics, transient and other type of
distortions of voltage and current waveforms.
第14週:local and international standard of power harmonics,
improved strategies and practical case studies.
第15週:planning and design of harmonic filters of practical
problems.
第16週:frequency variation issue on power system: causes study and
affections assessments.  
第17週:the frequency control methods in utility and customer and
their availbility and investment evaluations.
第18週:Final examination and report (期末考)

name.en: Principles and Practices of  Cloud Computing

description.zh: 課程介紹雲端資訊計算與運用相關技術，使學生對雲端平台、架構、服務有全面性瞭解。課程內容包括： 1.雲端運算發展近況及基本概念2.資源虛擬化之基本概念與技術，3.雲端運算相關技術、效能與安全，4.虛擬化資料中心建置-虛擬計算、儲存、網路與應用，6.雲端服務規劃，7.雲端之基礎設施服務、平台服務、軟體服務介紹，8.專題討論。
description.en:
Cloud Computing, either private, public or hybrid, is dramatically transforming every aspect of IT. Now it has become ubiquitous these days, and is the key foundation for developing technologies of Big Data and Internet of Things (IoT). Its deployment starts delivering applications with more benefits than the existing legacy infrastructure.

Because the terms are broadly quoted and adopted, then by this course, the Cloud Computing core technologies and the associated below will be well introduced:
1.Cloud Computing Basic Concept 
2.Resources Virtualization & Software Defined Data Center (SDDC)
3.Cloud Computing Security 
4.Cloud Technologies
5.Cloud Service Planning and Deployment 
6.Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
7.Platform as a Service (PaaS)
8.Software as a Services (SaaS)
9.Cloud Service Operations 
10.Case Studies and presentation

description.zh: 可穿戴式應用已成了全球科技產業的新寵兒之一。因此，漸漸地，穿戴式裝置已成為人們生活用品的一部分。本課程討論可穿戴式系統導論、無線感測網路導論、生醫資訊模組設計、可穿戴式教學平台之設計、情境感知遠距監控與定位救援手仗之設計、非視覺型之不穩步態偵測分析設計、自行車玩家生醫資訊守護神設計、遠距醫療照護系統設計、與客製化谷歌智慧型眼鏡設計。本課程主要達成跨領域的高度整合應用訓練課程。
description.en: Wearable applications have been become one new darling of the global technology industries. Hence, gradually, the wearable devices have become part of people's daily necessities. This course will discuss the topics of “Introduction of wearable system, Introduction of wireless sensor network, Design of Bio-information module, Design of wearable teaching platform, Design of Context-Aware Tele-monitor and Position-rescue Staff, Detection Analysis and Design for Unstable Gait with Non-vision Base, Bicycler-Player Bio-information Guardian, Design of Tele-Medicine care system, and Design of customized Google Smart-glass”. This course is highly integrated applications to achieve interdisciplinary training.

name.zh: 人工智慧在資通訊技術應用實務
name.en: Artificial Intelligence in Information and Communication Technology Applications

description.zh:
課程主要為介紹人工智慧概念和基本原理，學習DNN/CNN/LSTM的神經網路架構和學習方法，並舉資通訊技術應用實例說明，進而在雲端或非雲端平台實作人工智慧。
課程內容包括：
1.人工智慧概念和基本原理
2.DNN與深度學習
3.DNN應用實例:5G無線資源分配
4.CNN
5.LSTM 
6.LSTM應用實例: 5G極化碼解碼和Federated Learning
7.Attention神經網路
8.CNN和Attention應用實例:影片場景分段
9.學習方法:監督式，非監督式，強化學習
10.Amazon雲端平台
11.Amazon DeepLens智慧鏡頭平台
12.Amazon Alexsa智慧音箱平台
13.分組實作
description.en:
The goal of this course is to introduce ideas and principles behind artificial intelligence. We will teach the structure of DNN/CNN/LSTM neural network structure and learning methods, and implement artificial intelligence in cloud or non-cloud platforms.
 The course content includes:
1.Ideas and principles of artificial intelligence
2.DNN and deep learning
3.DNN example: 5G wireless resource allocation
4.CNN
5.RNN/LSTM
6.LSTM example: 5G Polar code decoder and Federated Learning
7.Attention neural network
8.CNN and attention example: video scene boundary detection
9.Learning methods: supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement
10.Amazon cloud platform
11.Amazon DeepLens
12.Amazon Alexsa
13.Project implementation

description.zh: 銲接冶金課程深入研究金屬銲接技術與冶金過程，培養學生在材料處理和銲接技術方面的專業能力。課程包括銲接方法、銲材選擇、熱影響、金屬結構與性能及銲接缺陷等內容，並結合實際案例，使學生能理解並應用於工程實務。
description.en: The welding metallurgy course in the graduate program delves into metal welding techniques and metallurgical processes, cultivating students' expertise in material handling and welding technologies. The curriculum covers welding methods, selection of welding materials, heat-affected zones, metal structures and properties, welding defects, and incorporates real-world cases to enable students to comprehend and apply them in engineering practice.

syllabi.outline:
銲接冶金課程深入研究金屬銲接技術與冶金過程，培養學生在材料處理和銲接技術方面的專業能力。課程包括銲接方法、銲材選擇、熱影響、金屬結構與性能及銲接缺陷等內容，並結合實際案例，使學生能理解並應用於工程實務。
The welding metallurgy course in the graduate program delves into metal welding techniques and metallurgical processes, cultivating students' expertise in material handling and welding technologies. The curriculum covers welding methods, selection of welding materials, heat-affected zones, metal structures and properties, welding defects, and incorporates real-world cases to enable students to comprehend and apply them in engineering practice.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意
介紹雷射加工之理論及實務，注重製程參數之研究，教導學生如何掌握製程，以達到精密製造的要求。內容包括雷射輔助製造程序、雷射加工設備、雷射加工原理、系統分析、實驗設計、雷射加工實例。
description.en: Introducing theory and practice of laser material processing. Emphasizing the study of manufacturing factors. Letting the students know how to control manufacturing process, and fulfill the demand of precision manufacturing. The course content is : laser assisted manufacturing processes, facilities for laser material processing, the principles of laser material processing, system analysis, examples of laser material processing.

syllabi.outline: 本課程涵蓋的範圍包括基礎的雷射加工物理、雷射光束的傳播、高斯雷射光束、脈衝雷射特性、雷射冷、熱加工分析等等。內容包含：1. 基本雷射物理  2.雷射加工基本原理  3.各種雷射介紹  4.雷射加工動態特性  5. 雷射加工的應用

name.en: Special Topics on Clean Power System

description.zh: 介紹各種潔淨且高效率的先進車輛動力系統的型式及其工作原理並分析技巧。項目包含車輛能源所面臨的一些問題及可能的解決方案、優良動力源的特性、電動系統、複合電動系統、複合氣動系統、氫燃料電池動力系統、金屬燃料電池動力系統、各種替代性燃料的特性及優缺點、太陽光電輔助動力系統等。
description.en: This course introduces various kinds of clean and high-efficiency vehicular power systems, their operation principles, and analytical skills.  Topics include: problems and possible solutions the vehicular power system faces, characteristics of a good vehicular power system, electric power system, hybrid electric power system, hybrid pneumatic power system, fuel cell power system, metallic fuel-cell power system, substitutive fuels, and solar-energy auxiliary power system.

syllabi.outline:
電池分類，電池化學，電池功能及表現，電池之製造，電池使用注意事項，電池檢驗及測試，電池選擇及安裝，燃料電池，電動車使用之電池未來高級電池之介紹。
Battery Classification，Battery Chemistry，Battery Function and Performance，Battery Manufacturing，Battery service Precautions，Battery Inspection and Testing，Battery Selection and Installation，Fuel Battery， Battery for the Electric Vehicle，Introduction to the Advanced Future Battery.

name.zh: 教育訓練實施與績效評鑑

description.zh: 為了使訓練資源的更有效運用，本課程希望讓學生了解，企業內部在實施訓練之前，應客觀、嚴謹的加以評估，並追蹤其實施後的成效，以正確評估訓練的效益。
description.en: To make better use of the training resources, the curriculum expects to make students understand that any enterprise should objectively and carefully evaluate the training program before its employment, and keep track of its effect after its employment to make sure the effectiveness of the training program.

syllabi.outline: 在本課程中，我們將探討教育訓練的各種實施方法，並系統性介紹不同的績效評鑑模型與其理論基礎。學生將學會如何判斷是否需要進行績效評鑑、應該在哪些階段進行評鑑，以及如何將評鑑結果連結至組織的整體策略目標與學習需求。課程強調理論與實務的結合，透過案例分析與實作練習，協助學生建立教育訓練規劃與成效評估的整體觀點。完成本課程後，學生將具備應用教育訓練實施策略與績效評鑑工具於實際工作場域的知識與能力。

description.zh:
本課程主要探討高分子在溶液及固態時的物理化學現象及其應用。內容包括輔G熱力學?高分子的微結構及定性。
輔G熱力學探討統計熱力學、晶格理論、Flory-Huggin理論、Flory-Krigbaum理論、相分離、θ-溫度、滲透壓、GPC測分子量、高分子膠體。
?高分子之微結構包括有高分子之形狀、自由旋轉分子鏈距離、光散射、中子散射、排拒體積、碎形、霍氏光譜及核磁共振儀在高分子微結構之分析。
description.en:
The course is to investigate the physical phenomena of macromolecules in the solution and solid state. It includes the solution thermodynamics and chemical microstructure of polymer chains.
The solution thermodynamics is to study lattice theory, statistical thermodynamics, Flory-Huggin theory, Flory-Krigbaum theory, phase separation, θ-temperature, Osmometry, GPC, and polymer gels.
Light scattering and Neutron scattering are used to characterize the polymer microstructure. Polymer radius of gyration, freely rotating chains, excluded volume, fractal, and scaling are also discussed. Finally, spectroscopy methods are used to study polymerization models and microstructure.

name.en: Analysis and Identification of Organic Materials

description.zh: 本課程包含材料的結構鑑定和材料的性質分析。材料的結構鑑定方法有：元素分析、吸收光譜法、振動光譜法、核磁共振光譜法、質譜法、x-射線光譜法和電子顯微鏡法。材料的性質分析包含：材料熱性質(DSC, TGA, TMA,DMA)和材料機械性質(伸張、壓縮、剪力強度等)。
description.en: The materials of the course include structure identification and property analysis of materials. Methods of structure identification  of materials are : elemental analysis, absorption spectroscopy, vibration spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, x-ray spectroscopy and electron microscopy. Metheds of property analysis of materials are : thermal properties of materials (DSC,TGA,TMA,DMA) and mechanical properties of materials (tensile, compression and shear strengths).

syllabi.outline: 本課程具體介紹各式有機材分析技術。內容有紫外線/可見光光譜、螢光/磷光光譜、紅外線光譜、拉曼光譜、核磁共振儀、質譜儀、層析、熱分析、光學顯微鏡影像分析、電子顯微鏡影像分析及原子力顯微鏡等。並透過多項實驗證與闡述分析技術於各種有機材之運用，包含能源、先進材等相關領域。修習本課程的學生可系統性地建立各式有機材分析的理論架構，有助於未來研究與就業方面之發展。

description.zh: 本課程主要探討各種高分子之聚合方法及動力學之研究，如逐步聚合、遊離基連鎖聚合、乳化聚合、離子連鎖聚合、連鎖共聚合反應、開環聚合、立體規則高分子之合成，未終止的游離基聚合方法。從分子量的分佈，結構物性之關係，作高分子聚合之最佳化設計，並且探討這些聚合方法如何應用在最新的科技上，如光電材料、複合材料。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the polymer synthesis and Kinetics studies. The synthesis includes step polymerization, free radical chain polymerization, emulsion polymerization, ionic chain polymerization, chain copolymerization, ring opening polymerization, sterospecific polymerization and living free radical polymerization. The synthesis scheme is optimized with the structure-properties relationship and molecular design. The potential application of these methods in high-tech materials, such as optoelectronics, and composites, will be elucidated.

description.en:
This course is mainly to discuss the role of planning as a form of intervention in the development process, and introduce the role of planning in the allocation and management of a sustainable environment. Thus the course including:
    1. Planning, planners and plans
    2. The origins: urban growth from 1800 to 1940
    3. The seers: pioneer thinkers in urban planning, from        1880 to 1945
    4. The creation of the postwar planning machine, from        1940 to 1952
    5. National/regional planning from 1945 to 1990
    6. Planning for cities and city regions from 1945 to        1990
    7. Planning in Western Europe, United States since 1945
    8. Settlements into the 21st century

name.en: Special topics in Taiwan Traditional Architecture

description.zh: 台灣傳統建築史的研究已歷多年發展，累積了相當豐富的研究成果。本課程擬由傳統閩客建築類型所屬之空間文化進行研討，透過"環境與構造"、"儀式與空間"、"政治與建築"等進階專題研討，期待引領修課同學進入並體驗台灣傳統建築的深層特色與意涵，過程中除了相關文獻的閱讀，案例調查報告外，並由田野實地參觀，帶領同學感受台灣傳統閩客建築的獨特環境與空間文化。
description.en: The research of the history of Taiwanese traditional architecture has got a great achievement after many years of development. This course is focus on the spatial culture of different types of traditional Hakka and Fujian architecture. I hopes that every students could understand and experience the deep social cultural meanings and features through the study of following three issues :"environment and construction", "rite and space" and "politics and architecture".  This course would not only be proceeded by the reading of related documents and the reporting of different case, it also combined the field visiting and investment to lead students to enjoy the very special cultural heritage.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為台灣傳統建築文化系列課程之一，其主旨在介紹台灣傳統建築的理論與原則，藉由各建築類型的歷史文本，及已有的研究案例成果，使同學能擴展其對台灣傳統建築研究的視界，並就傳統建築中特定建築類型，就空間文化議題進行研討，除了經由地方志等文獻的解讀，以了解建築所屬的特殊空間文化意涵外，並由同學進行特定建築的實地調查，以供印證。本課程期使修課同學除了對傳統建築的意義有所瞭解外，亦對特定建築類型的社會文化意義有所體認。

description.zh: 為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第一階段之系列課程，其內容包括： 一.健康環境概念：說明何謂「病態建築」，探討室內空氣與健康之關係。 二.建築物污染源：探討來自各建築材料的化學物質逸散及其對人體健康之影響，並提出室內污染物質濃度減低對策。 三.生物性污染源：探討黴菌、蹣、白蟻及寵物等帶來的室內空氣污染。 四.診斷技術：說明室內空氣品質診斷方法及病態建築改善之專業技術，配合案例介紹探討新、舊建築物室內環境品質的設計預防、診斷改善技術。
description.en: The main goal of this class is to pursue sustainable development and human health. In order to enhance the quality of residential and living environment in both existing and new-build dwellings, the course will cover important principles and topics in sick building environment, including medical, regulation, and architecture, chemical and biological. Specific contents include: (1)Conception of healthy environment: To explain the "sick building" and explore the association between indoor air and health.(2)Pollution source from buildings: To investigate the chemicals emission from building materials and their effect on human health, and get the countermeasures on reduce the indoor pollutants.(3)Pollution source from Biological: To investigate the indoor air pollution that cause by the mold, mites, termites, and pets.(4)Diagnostic techniques: To improved indoor air quality and sick building by diagnostic methods, with the case studies to prevent indoor environmental quality on new and old

syllabi.outline: 健康建築環境與設計方式，透過建築設計達成永續發展目標(SDGs)與永續報告書(ESG)之健康福祉。課程包含探討國際發展健康建築認證系統與項目，關鍵影響人員健康之環境因子：空氣、水、熱舒適、光、聲學、水、材料、運動、營養、心靈、互動等項目，從中探討健康建築與人之健康關連，並具體呈現於設計規範策略，作為深度研究議題，滿足學生學習核心能力。

name.en: Special Topics on Epidemic Prevention  Architecture

description.zh: 防疫型建築專題課程主要針對COVID-19後疫情時代，防疫理念如何融入建築領域，結合病毒控制技術理論和防制病毒擴散的設計方法，分析國內外建築案例，探討病毒特性、學習抗病毒材料與設備、壓差控制技術、通風換氣效益、行政管理措施等相關技術應用，系統性地探討如何在建築設計、材料選擇與建築全生命周期管理中，實現日常生活建築如何建構防疫應急的關聯措施，並運用環境評估工具量化建築的防疫效益，引導學生多元領域學習，在建築設計中提出因應疫情的創新設計思維，兼具環境、社會與經濟平衡之構想，以及建築設計的防疫解決方案，最終培養其在人居健康環境下的永續建築設計能力。
description.en: The specialized course on epidemic prevention architecture focuses on how to incorporate epidemic prevention concepts into the field of architecture in the post-COVID-19 era. It integrates theories of virus control technologies with design strategies aimed at preventing the spread of infectious diseases. Through the analysis of domestic and international architectural cases, the course examines the characteristics of viruses and explores the application of antiviral materials and equipment, pressure differential control, ventilation efficiency, and administrative management measures.It systematically investigates how epidemic prevention and emergency response strategies can be embedded into architectural design, material selection, and the entire building lifecycle. Students will learn to utilize environmental assessment tools to quantify the epidemic prevention performance of buildings, and will be guided to engage in interdisciplinary learning. description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 本課程將引領學生將閱讀及寫作技巧運用到課堂中的文字研究。學生可藉本課程獨力完成知識性創意、評論式及論證式的文體，並可藉此學習其中批判式閱讀及思考的應用及價值。
description.en: In this course students will learn to apply their reading and writing skills to the study of texts from a variety of sources. The course is geared to teach the student the use and value of critical reading and thinking in the production their own independent, intellectually creative, and critically structured and argued essays intended for an educated audience.

syllabi.outline:
「研究成果具有足以影響意見和行動的力量，因此有責任感的作者會以謹慎細心的態度撰寫之」。(MLA Handbook for the Writers of Research Papers, xiv).
本課程以人文學科領域通用的MLA系統為基礎，加強學生對論文撰寫規範的認識，並經由研究過程的實踐和論文的撰寫體認學術研究的目的及價值。課程開始時學生須選擇一較為廣泛的主題，學習如何抽絲剝繭，找出核心的問題，進一步釐清研究的重點所在，然後經過仔細研究搜尋，最後以論文報告呈現成果。透過此一過程，學生將體認到學術研究有嚴謹明確的規範，需經過一步一步的印證，方能寫出合乎專業水準的研究論文或報告。

description.en: This course is designed to engage students in intensive study and analysis of selected issues and problems in second language acquisition. The topics covered in this course include, but are not limited to, the following: language aptitude, cross-linguistic influences, personality, motivation, leaning styles, learning strategies, language anxiety, and learners' beliefs.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Graduate Seminar on Second Language Acquisition 
Credit Hours:		3 
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw 
Term Offered:		Fall, 2026
Office Hours:     By appointment 
Course Description: This course will look at the process of acquiring / learning and using a second language. It provides theoretical and experimental insights to examine the phenomenon of language development from multi-disciplinary perspectives.  
Course Objectives:  This course aims to help in-service teachers / graduate students to
			(1) understand the principles and processes governing L1 & L2 
               acquisition and learning
			(2) examine how non-native language ability develops
            (3) become familiar with SLA theories to account for many aspects of non-native discourse 
            (4) conduct SLA-based research studies
Course Requirements: Students will be required to give several presentations on the topics of SLA. Topics will be assigned.
syllabi.assessment:
Evaluation Procedures and Grading System

1. Attendance  – 20%
Leave requests must be submitted through Google Classroom by Friday noon. One approved absence is allowed without penalty; each additional absence results in a 5-point deduction from the final grade.

2. Individual Presentation – 30%
Students will give an individual presentation on an assigned chapter or SLA-related topic.

3. Response Essays – 30%
Students will submit three response essays, tentatively around Week 5, Week 10, and Week 15. Each essay should be approximately 1,000–1,200 words and focus on topics covered during the relevant course period.

4. Final SLA Inquiry Project – 20%
Students will complete a brief inquiry project on an SLA-related topic, identifying a focused issue, question, or working claim and connecting it to relevant SLA theories or concepts. Data collection is not required.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹英語全球化、全球英語，以及英語作為國際語言的發展與相關論述，並針對英語在全球擴散的現象，檢視相關的概念與理論。本課程將探討因英語全球化所造成，在社會語言學、文化、政治經濟與教育等方面的重要議題，以及與全球英語相關的議題與爭論。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with an overview of the spread of the English language around the world, the emergence of English varieties, and the development of the popularization of English as a lingua franca. It examines the various concepts and theories developed in academia to account for the unprecedented global expansion of English. Through readings and class discussion, this course will look at key sociolinguistic, cultural, politico-economic and educational issues arising from the spread of English as well as the current issues and debates surrounding Global Englishes. Students will be encouraged to conduct original research on or detailed analysis of the implications of English as the international language.

This course aims to provide students with an overview of the spread of the English language around the world, the emergence of World Englishes/ Global Englishes, and the development of the popularization of English as a world lingua franca. It examines the various concepts and theories developed in academia to account for the unprecedented global expansion of English. Through readings and class discussion, this course will look at key sociolinguistic, cultural, politico-economic and educational issues arising from the spread of English as well as the current issues and debates surrounding World Englishes/ Global Englishes. Students will be encouraged to conduct original research on or detailed analysis of the implications of English as the international language.

description.zh: 莎翁與通俗文化有什麼關係呢？莎翁的作品不是難以理解嗎？欣賞莎翁的作品不需要特別的訓練、時間、與長期的投資嗎？這些問題的答案可以同時是肯定和否定的。不論您喜歡與否，在當代的文化裡，莎翁無所不在。Paul Prescott已經指出：「莎翁的蹤影並不局限於教室、大學、劇場等正式場合，而是在電影、電視、新聞小報、電玩、流行音樂、連環漫畫、及廣告等大眾媒體上到處可見。」確實，莎翁早已是無可迴避的圖像。他的語言文字、人物、劇本情節已經在通俗的大眾媒體上受到廣泛的挪用。「通俗文化中的莎士比亞」是為了有意於為了各種目的而挪用莎翁作品內容之學生，包括以「通俗莎士比亞」作為英語文教材之中小學教師，而設計之英文課程。為了瞭解，甚至挪用莎翁作品內容的複雜性與其中蘊含之永恆不變、舉世皆然的真理，我們將透過電影、科幻故事、與肥皂劇等媒介，以異於傳統的反向方式間接研習莎翁作品的珍貴特質與內容，以瞭解社會大眾為了有效達成商業、文化、及政治的目的，是如何挪用莎翁作品。修習本課程的學生亦可推薦有助於未來透過通俗莎翁進行英語文教學之電影、科幻故事、與肥皂劇，作為上課教材。
description.en: What has Shakespeare to do with popular culture? Are his writings not difficult and more or less inaccessible? Does it not require special training, time and long-term investment to appreciate Shakespeare? Well, the answer might be yes and no. Like it or not, Shakespeare is everywhere in contemporary culture. As Paul Prescott has pointed out, “His presence is not confined to the ‘official’ locations of classrooms, universities and theatres, but permeates popular mass media such as cinema, television, tabloid journalism, computer games, pop music, comics and advertisements.” Indeed, Shakespeare has long been an inescapable icon. His words, characters, and plots have been widely appropriated to appear across a range of popular mass media. This course is designed to introduce Shakespeare to those who are interested in appropriating Shakespeare for various purposes, including teaching and learning English through what Douglas Lanier has called “Shakespop.” To appreciate the complexit

syllabi.outline:
在世界頂尖藝術家和作家的匯聚——高雅文化領域——沒有哪位英國作家比莎士比亞更重要。受過教育的人——不僅在西方，而且在世界各地——都會閱讀和研究莎士比亞的作品。莎士比亞至今仍享有盛名且廣受歡迎的原因之一，在於他的故事和人物影響了其他與高雅文化和通俗文化相關的藝術家——包括被視為偉大藝術家的畫家、作家、詩人、古典音樂作曲家；以及因流行文化而聲名鵲起的電影製作人、電視劇編劇、漫畫家和流行歌曲作詞人。本課程將向學生介紹莎士比亞原作中一些最重要的故事、人物和引語，並著重探討這些作品如何被其他藝術家和流行文化（包括西方和亞洲）改編和重新詮釋，例如現代舞台劇以及不同類型的新作品（電影、音樂劇、流行歌曲、動漫）。

In high culture – the collection of the world’s greatest artists and writers – there is no more important English writer than Shakespeare.  Educated people – not just in the West, but all over the world – read and study Shakespeare.  But one reason that Shakespeare remains today not only famous but popular is that his stories and characters have influenced other artists associated with both high and low culture –  painters, writers, poets, and classical composers regarded as great artists themselves; and film makers, tv show writers, comic book artists, and pop song lyricists whose fame comes from the world of popular culture.  This class will introduce students to some of the most important stories, characters, quotations in Shakespeare’s original plays – but with an eye toward how those works have been adapted and re-imagined by other artists and in popular culture (in the West and in Asia), as modern staged plays but also as new works in different genres (movies, musicals, pop songs, anime).

表面現象, 介面反應等與近代高科技技術, 如鍍膜工程,表面處理, 腐蝕, 磨潤, 微機電, 感測器, 半導體技術等息息相關, 且日益重要。表面分析是原子層次的相關研究, 它包括振動, 電子或離子頻譜分析, 微技術等之應用。主要的項目包含, 表面形貌觀察( SEM, BSEM, AFM ), 成份分析( 光譜分析, 質譜分析, EDX ), 結構分析( XRD, AES, ESCA, XPS ), 鍵結分析( Raman光譜, FTIR ), 表面粗糙度, 膜厚, 附著力, 內應力等膜之特性分析。
description.en:
Surface phenomena and processes occurring at interface are becoming increasingly important in a wide variety of industrial applications including the areas of films coating surface treatments, conclusion, triobology, microelectronics, sensors and semi-conductor technologies.  Accompanying this is an ever-growing need for surface characterization allowing better definition of processes occurring at a microscopic level.
Surface analysis is the use of vibration, electron or ion spectroscopic and microscopic techniques for the study of material at the atomic level, it includesSEM, AFM, XRD, EDX, ESCA, XPS, AES, Raman Spectrum, and FTIR analysis.

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。
description.en: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc.

本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

description.zh: 資訊科技是整合策略，使用者和組織系統，幫助高階主管達成組織目標，以及了解資訊科技。本課程學習主題：透過資訊系統獲取策略優勢，透過資訊系統應用，支援管理和執行資訊科技應用，獲得競爭優勢。全課程以哈佛個案研討方式進行。
description.en: The need for information-based support for managers is increasing as the modern management imperatives of reach and to meet their organization's goals. Information management function provides information to support operations, management analysis, and decision- making functions in an organization. We will also look at the role in formation play in helping managers meet goals by examining the characteristics of information systems that make managers' job easier. Topic of learning: Acquiring strategic advantage through information systems. Supporting managers and executives through IS applications. Managing the risk inherent in developing and using IS applications. Attaining and practicing technological leadership. This course is taught by HBS cases.

description.zh: 本課程包含2大部份，服務與創新管理及智慧財產權與科技法律。 服務與創新管理旨在了解服務與創新管理之意義、方法與現況，內容包含服務之本質、創新之意義、服務與創新管理之方法、科技之應用、服務與創新管理現況介紹等。智慧財產權與科技法律旨在了解如何以智慧財產權來保護科技研發成果，內容包括智慧財產權法規介紹與專利運用策略實務。
description.en: This course contains two major parts, service and innovation management and Intellectual property and technology law. Service and innovation management is to demonstrate the definition, the methodologies and the state of the art of service and innovation management, including the nature of service, innovation, the tools for service and innovation management, technology application and current development of service and innovation management. Intellectual property and technology law is to demonstrate understanding how to protect R & D achievements with intellectual property rights. This course includes intellectual property laws and patent strategies practice.

syllabi.outline:
科技管理有別於一般管理，主要以科技產業、科技領域、科技組織、科技人才為層面，探討各項管理技巧，管理科學的應用，其主要內容包含（1）導論（2）技術資源與能力（3）科技與產業（4）技術策略（5）科技規劃（6）技術預測（7）新產品開發管理（8）策略聯盟（9）台灣高科技產業之策略與管理（10）ICT產業之創新服務與應用（11）淨零碳排下之因應等。
本課程將結合理論與產業科技實務進行將以深入淺出方式導引許多有趣與重要的科技管理課題與熱門議題。使同學可以清楚了解組織自研究發展,新產品開發,到商品化行銷這一過程所涉及到所有經營管理面的問題.另並針對我國產業政策制定方式、趨式、產業競爭力之管理與產業在發展過程面臨議題與管理做實務分析

description.zh: 設計是造就其所處時代和文化下的產物。它是社會共有的價值觀體現，但設計的思考過程也用於代表特定的概念，鼓勵某些活動，從而影響社會和文化。本課程介紹現代和後現代設計的時代精神，涉及的重要發展包括建築、平面設計、產品設計、家具設計、室內設計、數字設計，甚至商業設計。本課程提供理解設計史上的精彩作品，透過政治、宗教、技術、文化、氣候和地理因素影響下的背景梳理。
description.en: Design is a product of the period and culture in which it is created. It is a representation of values shared by society but also used to represent specific ideals, encourage certain activities, and thus influence society and culture. This course provides an introduction to the zeitgeist of Modern and Postmodern Design. It deals with the most important developments including architecture, graphic design, product design, furniture design, interior design, digital design, and even business design. This course provides the background needed for understanding the rich heritage of historical design in the arts, as influenced by political, religious, technological, cultural, climatic and geographic factors.

name.en: Special Topics on Nano- Technology and Environment

description.zh: 這門課著重在探討奈米科技之基本原理與應用範疇，以及環境應用與安全相關主題，內容包含奈米之基本特性、各種量測方法、結構控制、以及"納米"對環境應用與安全問題。此外並包含奈米微粒之產生、收集、測量以及微粒動力學等主題。
description.en: This course will investigate the definition and theories of nanotechnology. Including basic properties, measuring methods, structural control, environmental, and safety issues of "Nano-". Topics about generation, collection, measurement and dynamics of nano-particle will also be covered.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在教授學生奈米科技於環境之應用及挑戰，包括奈米科技發展、奈米材料合成與分析技術、奈米科技於環境污染處理、奈米顆粒之環境、健康與安全影響及評估等課題。此外，本課程亦將包含近年相關奈米材料於環境工程、淨零減碳等應用主題。
syllabi.assessment: 期中口頭測驗(20%)、期末報告及討論(40%)、課堂參與及出席 (40%)

3. Maohong Fan, C.P. Huang, Alan Bland, Zhonglin Wang, Rachid Slimane, Ian Wright, “Environanotechnology”, Elsevier, Netherlands, 2010

name.en: Environmental Economics and Environmental Policies Analysis

description.zh: 政策研究能檢視理論和實務的切合程度。本課程將帶領大家認識環境政策的經濟分析方法，學習經濟的思維觀點，以及如何運用經濟方法瞭解解決環境問題。除此之外上課內容並與法律結合，探討環境法的經濟分析觀點和傳統思維有何不同，尤其是對環境行為上之改變效果。希望學生能夠具體瞭解經濟分析方法幫助政府解決環境問題及規劃環境政策時所扮演的角色。
description.en: There is a significant trade-off between economic growth and environmental quality.  From this course, students will learn fundamental concepts in Environmental Economics and how to analyze environmental policy issues by using economic tools.  In additions, this course combines economic analysis to law, especially shows students how regulations affect people's behavior.  After this class, students not only know how economic approaches help the government deal with environmental issues and the differences between theory and practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程由微觀經濟學角度出發，分析各種環境問題，並介紹各種經濟誘因行政策工具，以補足傳統環境工程教育偏重工程面之不足。
This course applies theories in micro economics to analyze environmental problems. Policy tools that are often applied in solving environmental problems are further introduced and being evaluated using micro economic principals.

description.zh: 風險評估、風險管理及風險政策等工具已成為現代社會管理人類活動和產品造成的環境及健康問題。本課程的目的為培育跨領域了解環境風險及利用自然科學及社會科學的觀點和方法進行管理。同時包含探討環境風險評估管理所用的方法、相關理論和假設，並了解其作用。
description.en: Risk, assessment, risk management and risk governance have become key concepts in modern society's attempts to manage environmental and health problems connected with human activities and products. The object of this course is to train an integrated interdisciplinary understanding of environmental risks and their management by perspectives and approaches from natural and social sciences. This course also critically examines the role of risk assessment in environmental management by checking the methods used, as well as the underlying theories and assumptions.

Risk, assessment, risk management and risk governance have become key concepts in modern society's attempts to manage environmental and health problems connected with human activities and products. The object of this course is to train an integrated interdisciplinary understanding of environmental risks and their management by perspectives and approaches from natural and social sciences. description.zh: 本課程目的為使學生認識資源處理之各種物理選別及濕式冶金技術，包括破碎、粉碎、篩分、比重選別、浮游選別、磁力選別等物理選別技術，以及吸附、離子交換、溶媒萃取、晶析、沉澱分離等濕式冶金技術，並熟悉其理論基礎與使用時機，進而活用各種技術於實際之資源回收再生工作上。

description.zh: 本課程說明如何利用質量及動量守恆建立可以描述速度、應力及壓力等流體系統物理量間關係之統制方程式。其內容包括：線及角動量守衡、應力張量、平滑近似理論、非穩態流動、邊界層近似法、線性穩定度理論及紊流系統。
description.en:
We will learn how fundamental principles such as conservation of mass and momentum lead to equations that govern or describe the interrelationships of velocity, stress, pressure, and so on. Content includes macroscopic balance for linear and angular momentum, the stress tensor, 
lubrication approximation, unsteady flow、the boundary layer approximation, linear stability theory, and turbulent flows.

syllabi.outline: This course surveys the principal concepts of fluid dynamics. Topics include mass and momentum conservation, the Navier-Stokes equation for viscous flows, as well as dimensional analysis. Emphasis is placed on being able to utilize the concepts to solve the real problems encountered during conducting research

description.zh: 反應工程是在商業規模之考慮下對化學反應開發利用之相關工程活動。其目的在成功的設計和操作化學反應器，並使化學工程在工程專業中成為一個獨特的支系。此高等反應工程是延續大學部己學習在均相中有關之簡單觀念及理論，並推展到非均相較複雜系統之設計及操作上。學生在修習此課後，對於較複雜之反應器有清晰及整體之概念。
description.en: Under commercial scale consideration, chemical reaction engineering is that engineering concerning the exploitiaton of chemical reactions Its goal is the successful design and operation of chemical reactors and it sets chemical engineering apart as a distinct branch of the engineering profession. This aduanced chemical reaction engineering is a continuative study of simple idea and principle for homogeneous systems and extended to heterogeneous and more complex systems for design and operation. After study in this course, the student can obtain clear and unified coucept of complex reactor systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在於使學生瞭解化學反應工程之原理以及訓練學生能夠應用此些原理於設計，分析或操作化學反應器。此課程首先複習大學部已學習在均相中動力學之基礎理論，再推廣至非均相較複雜之系統。

In this course, a structure is developed that allows the student to solve reaction engineering problems through reasoning rather than through memorization and recall of numerous equations, restrictions and conditions under which each equation applies. A special emphasis on bioreaction engineering and more industrial chemistry with real reactors and real reactions will be covered and wide range of applications to which chemical reaction engineering principles will be applied.

name.en: Application of Rare Earths in Chemical Industry and Biotechnology

description.zh: 稀土是高科技產品必備元素且應用廣泛。本課程主要介紹稀土元素在化工、生物科技、生醫工程、綠色能源、光電半導體、奈米科技、環境工程等諸多領域中的應用。除此，並探討台灣發展稀土產業因應對策。
description.en: Rare earths are essential elements in high-tech products and are widely used. This course mainly introduces the application of rare earth elements in chemical industry, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, green energy, optoelectronic semiconductor, nanotechnology, environmental engineering and many other fields. In addition, countermeasures for the development of Taiwan's rare earth industry will also be discussed.

name.en: Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model (I)

description.zh: 本課程上學期將以智慧財產局頒佈之「專利審查基準」為藍本，依「先程式後實體」原則先就「程式審查」部分介紹專利申請之程式，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明專利說明書暨圖式之構成、可專利類型、產業利用性、新穎性、進步性等專利要件。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the procedure for patent application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Firstly, in the "formality examination" section, topics such as the constitution of a patent specification and drawings, the allowable subject matter for patents, utility, novelty, inventiveness and other patent elements, the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, and the priority of an patent application, will be sequentially discussed.

description.zh: 本課程規劃的目標為以互動設計的理論為基礎，實務導向為原則，使學習者能將學術界的理論與產業界的實務加以結合以充實對於互動設計具有全面性的了解。學習的內容包含互動設計系統構成要素、理論與實務基礎、互動設計方法與技術、科技支援與應用、認知心理、情境設計以及電腦支援協同合作等單元，各單元並包含不同互動設計個案的研討，使理論能與實務進行驗證。課程亦安排至相關領域業界的參訪，以加深對於互動設計實務的印象與了解。
description.en: The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. Course also incorporates case studies and company visits to enhance the understanding of integrating theory and practice.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, inter92tive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and pr92tice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct multi-disciplines learning environment which perform a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate an interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by working with the form of case study or design creation.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹使用者經驗設計之理論與研究方法。藉由本課程的學習，學生能習得互動設計過程中所需要之關鍵概念 - 以使用者經驗為中心之設計。課程以人-機-境之架構為基礎進行相關知識之講授，並透過相關研究案例之研討、方法之操作以及設計研究之進行了解其原理。課程內容包含人物誌、使用者經驗與需求、互動環境、使用者研究以及認知心理基礎等。教學將以課堂講授、文獻閱讀以及研究方法操作等方式進行，並以報告繳交、分組討論與發表為評量方式。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theories and research methods of User Experience Design (UXD). In this course, students can understand the key element, UX, of interactive design. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory, and executed through research case studies, method simulation and design research. The contents include personas, user experience and requirements, interactive scenario, user research and cognitive psychology. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, literature review and research conducting. Students are evaluated by reports, group discussion and presentation.

description.zh: 資料科學為最熱門的職業之一，各行各業對於數據分析的人才需求正在蓬勃發展，本課程在於培育從事資料科學或機器學習的人員來發展相關知識和技能。課程內容以線性代數、機率、統計學等工程數學為理論學習基礎，操作Python作為資料科學的實作工具，包括其相關Python基礎語法、各種資料型態、數據 可視化、開源工具等。接著學習利用Python取得數據資料，進而操作各種迴歸 分析來手動分析數據資料，並實作梯度遞減，決策樹等最佳化演算方法。最後則是介紹機器學習、深度學習等最新的AI演算方法來分析大數據並輔助決策。
description.en: Data Science has been ranked as one of the hottest professions and the demand for data practitioners is booming. This course is designed to develop people engaged in data science or machine learning to develop relevant knowledge and skills. You will understand how data science works based on mathematics, such as linear algebra, probability and statistics. Python is the best tool to learn how to conduct data science analyze data. Learn the basic language skills, common data types, visualization tools and extended modules for data grabbing and regression analysis. Gradient decent and decision tree for optimization will be covered. Finally, AI algorithm, machine learning, and deep learning, are introduced how data help in decision making.

name.en: Advanced Management Practice and Integrated Management Case Studies

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
description.en: This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

description.en: With the development of cloud computing services and internet services, the ability to store big data and transform into applicable knowledge is critical. description.zh: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。
description.en: The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助製造業與服務業高階管理者作決策。一般而言，這門課程主要協助學員們具有策略思維與整合能力。學員可在策略管理學習過程活學活用，更能融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課也採用適當的製造業與服務業個案研討來幫助學員學習、研讀與熟悉策略管理的運作，以達成此門課的目標。授課主題包括研討策略管理的本質與整體架構，瞭解組織所處環境 ， 分析外部環境之時機和危機， 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 ， 探討企業不同層次之應對策略，整合策略的執行與治理等。
description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making in manufacturing and service industry at the top management level. Generally, this course provides students with strategic thinking and knowledge integration. With case studies in manufacturing and service industry, this course also helps students learn, study, and understand the process of strategic management well to achieve the goals of the course. Topics in this course include the essence and whole framework of strategic management, in what circumstances an organization has been, analyses on the opportunities and threats of external environment, the strengths and weaknesses of internal organization, application strategies of companies at different levels, implantation on integration strategies and so forth.

name.en: A Lean and Mean Business and Global Quality Management

description.zh: 本課程教導學生對製造業與服務業進行精實化管理的策略與技巧。課程內容包含：造成大型企業倒閉的商務環境改變與組織內的問題；科技提昇與電子化管理對企業的衝擊；精實化企業中有效及具競爭力營運管理的要素；精實化管理的發展策略與技巧。探討競爭優勢與生產服務系統模式、經營模式之關連，包括大量客製化、競爭優勢階段性、 發展競爭優勢作為、 豐富顧客價值。本課程將使學員熟習各項品質管理的理論基礎與發展趨勢，強化理論研究與實務應用能力。首先，課程涵蓋基礎統計使學員具備研究方法與分析技術能力，了解收集、統整和分析資料。其次，討論量化的六標準差管理相關工具及專案推行流程，以系統化思維探討問題並提出有效可行的解決對策，持續提升品質及客戶滿意。最後，介紹制度面及組織管理面的全球品管概念，闡述創造魅力品質之重要理論模型及影響服務品質關鍵因素。
description.en: This course covers the strategies and techniques of managing a lean business in manufacturing and in service. The linkages between competitive advantages and production systems, competitive advantages and business models will be discussed first. Then, topics include mass customization, competitive advantage stages, developing competitive capability and maximize customer value. This class will help students familiarize themselves with the trend of theoretical basis of the quality management and strengthen their ability in both theoretical research and practical application. First, the course covers basic statistics so that students will be acquainted with research methods and analysis techniques. Second, the six sigma management tools will be reviewed and the process for its implementation will also be addressed. Finally, the system- and the organization-level quality as well as the Kano Model for attractive quality will be discussed.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教導學生對製造業與服務業進行精實化管理的策略與技巧。課程內容包含：造成大型企業倒閉的商務環境改變與組織內的問題；科技提昇與電子化管理對企業的衝擊；精實化企業中有效及具競爭力營運管理的要素；精實化管理的發展策略與技巧。探討競爭優勢與生產服務系統模式、經營模式之關連，包括大量客製化、競爭優勢階段性、 發展競爭優勢作為、 豐富顧客價值。本課程將使學員熟習各項品質管理的理論基礎與發展趨勢，強化理論研究與實務應用能力。首先，課程涵蓋基礎統計使學員具備研究方法與分析技術能力，了解收集、統整和分析資料。其次，討論量化的六標準差管理相關工具及專案推行流程，以系統化思維探討問題並提出有效可行的解決對策，持續提升品質及客戶滿意。最後，介紹制度面及組織管理面的全球品管概念，闡述創造魅力品質之重要理論模型及影響服務品質關鍵因素。
This course covers the strategies and techniques of managing a lean business in manufacturing and in service. The linkages between competitive advantages and production systems, competitive advantages and business models will be discussed first. Then, topics include mass customization, competitive advantage stages, developing competitive capability and maximize customer value. This class will help students familiarize themselves with the trend of theoretical basis of the quality management and strengthen their ability in both theoretical research and practical application. First, the course covers basic statistics so that students will be acquainted with research methods and analysis techniques. Second, the six sigma management tools will be reviewed and the process for its implementation will also be addressed. Finally, the system- and the organization-level quality as well as the Kano Model for attractive quality will be discussed.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在教導學生理解製造業與服務業精實化管理之策略與技巧。在品質管理與持續改善方面，本課程將介紹 Sigma 的意涵、六標準差管理工具與專案推行流程，使學生能以系統化思維進行問題定義、資料分析、改善對策擬定與品質績效提升。課程亦涵蓋基礎統計、量測系統分析、管制圖、製程能力分析、田口品質工程等方法，使學生具備資料蒐集、統整、分析與製程改善之能力，進一步強化品質穩定性與顧客滿意度。此外，課程將結合現代品質管理與產品開發工具，包括二維品質模型、品質機能展開、失效模式及效應分析、產品可靠度設計與分析等，使學生了解如何從顧客需求、產品設計、潛在失效風險與可靠度角度進行品質規劃與改善。同時，課程亦導入層級分析法、資料探勘、機器學習與大數據分析等方法，探討其在智慧製造、決策支援與品質管理中的應用。透過理論學習與案例分析，學生將能熟悉品質管理之理論基礎、發展趨勢與應用工具，進而提升其在製造與服務系統中進行精實化管理、品質改善與智慧決策之能力。 

This course helps students understand lean management strategies and techniques in manufacturing and service industries. It introduces Sigma, Six Sigma tools, and project processes to help students define problems, analyze data, propose improvements, and improve quality performance. The course also covers basic statistics, measurement system analysis, control charts, process capability analysis, and Taguchi quality engineering. These methods help students collect and analyze data, improve processes, and enhance quality stability and customer satisfaction. In addition, the course includes modern quality and product development tools, such as the Kano Model, QFD, FMEA, and product reliability analysis. Students will learn how to improve quality from the perspectives of customer needs, product design, failure risks, and reliability. The course also introduces AHP, data mining, machine learning, and big data analytics, and discusses their applications in smart manufacturing, decision support, and quality management. Through theories and case studies, students will develop the ability to apply lean management, quality improvement, and intelligent decision-making in manufacturing and service systems.

name.zh: 永續發展與綠色金融管理
name.en: Sustainable Development and Green Banking Management

description.zh: 這門課程將深入探討ESG概念及其在國際趨勢中的地位，包括CBAM、CCA、TCFD等法規，亦將闡述國際評比、CSRD、IFRS S1/S2等要求，以及國內主管機關的法規，尤其關於公司治理藍圖的要求。透過工作坊形式，我們將聚焦氣候變遷和財務相關揭露的重點，並以案例分享產業實務。從國際法規如SB253、CBAM到國際標準ISO 20400，我們也將討論供應鏈管理和永續採購的趨勢。此外，將涵蓋人權相關議題，如TIFD和DEI，以及永續報告書撰寫注意事項。最後，我們將介紹永續金融和責任投融資，並討論金融業永續法規對企業的影響。
description.en: This course explores ESG concepts and global trends like CBAM, CCA, and TCFD. We'll cover international ratings, CSRD, IFRS S1/S2, and domestic regulatory requirements, focusing on corporate governance. Through workshops and case studies, we'll highlight climate change and financial disclosures. We'll discuss supply chain management trends, ISO 20400, and human rights issues like TIFD and DEI. Additionally, we'll cover sustainability reporting guidelines and introduce sustainable finance and responsible investment, examining their impact on businesses and financial regulations.

name.zh: 全球組織經營策略暨領導決策
name.en: Global Organization's Management Strategies and Leadership Decision

description.zh: 本課程專注在探討全球組織經營策略與領導決策之關鍵議題，聚焦在不同時空的國際經營環境中，企業經營者如何因應政府的政策與財經情勢改變，能夠快速回應與彈性應變的領導思維與決策。透過本課程將能夠理解高階主管面對政經環境的調整能有效因應變化，並且提升領導才能與創造市場優勢之創新能力。
description.en: The course focuses investigate the global organization's management strategies and leadership decision of the key issues. It is focusing in the different time frames and fierce international environment, how changes in policy of governments and situation of economic. Business executives will be able to quick to respond with the elastic strain of the global strategy perspective and leadership thinking. This course will be able to understand top managers can achieve the decision making of leadership, and improve the leadership knowledge and innovation capabilities in market competition.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹人力資源與組織管理的進階理論與實務，內容包括了(但不限於)人才任用、訓練與發展、績效評估、薪酬管理、組織設計、領導、工作激勵、以及工作團隊運作等等重要議題。課堂上並討論上述理論對於管理實務上的意涵。
description.en: This course introduces many advanced topics of human resource management, organization theory, and organization behavior. Topics include (but not limited to) staffing, training and development, performance appraisal, compensation, organization design, leadership, work motivation, workgroup functioning. Implications for managerial practice will be discussed in this class.

description.en: Due to the change of industry environment and the speed of technological innovation, the business models of enterprise are impacted. The purpose of this course will study the transform of business model and the impact of Industry 4.0 on the ecosystem of industry. In the course, besides the theory will be included, the business practices case will be also covered.

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"突破創新"以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解?錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解?法(TRIZ)為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM或OEM製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下:完整詳實闡述TRIZ理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明TRIZ概念、工程TRIZ實務案例10餘個與TRIZ工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約800餘個，管理實務案例20餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程TRIZ研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使"突破創新"輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管(經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場(或未來進入職場)解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。

description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。
本國語文課程以《世說新語》為主要文本，這部由南朝劉義慶編撰的經典筆記小說，內容涵蓋魏晉南北朝時期的逸聞軼事與人物風貌。通過閱讀、分析和討論，學生將深入了解魏晉風度、清談文化以及個人與社會價值觀的演變，並認識《世說新語》的文學價值及其對後世的影響，並從人物性格，理解個人生命發展。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

extra.彈性學習(17-18週):
第17週｜彈性學習內容
配合第16章「溫度與熱」及第17章「物質的熱反應」，透過生活情境與簡易實驗探討溫度、熱量、比熱與熱傳遞現象，並觀察物質受熱後的熱膨脹、熔化、汽化等變化。引導學生運用圖表與數據分析熱現象，理解微觀粒子運動與巨觀溫度變化的關聯，培養實驗觀察、資料判讀與科學解釋能力。
第18週｜彈性學習內容
配合第18章「熱、功與熱力學第一定律」及第19章「熱力學第二定律」，以熱機、冰箱及日常能源利用為例，探討熱、功與內能之間的轉換及能量守恆。進一步認識熱傳遞的方向性、熱機效率與熵的基本概念，透過問題討論與生活案例，引導學生理解能源轉換的限制，建立節能與永續能源的科學素養。

extra.學習成果:
第17週｜預期學習成果
學生能完成「溫度與熱、物質的熱反應」主題學習報告，整理溫度、熱量、比熱、熱傳遞及物態變化等重要概念，並能運用生活實例或實驗觀察加以說明。透過小組討論與心得分享，學生能表達對熱現象的理解，並反思熱學知識與日常生活的關聯。

第18週｜預期學習成果
學生能完成「熱力學第一定律與第二定律」主題報告，說明熱、功、內能、能量守恆及熱傳遞方向等基本概念，並以熱機、冰箱或能源利用等實例進行分析。透過小組討論及學習心得撰寫，學生能整理個人觀點，討論能源轉換效率與節能議題，展現科學思考及表達能力。

description.zh:
瞭解組合邏輯與序向邏輯電路之分析，設計及簡化之方法，內容包含：
１.數系：數位系統所使用之各種數系及其轉換之方法
２.布氏代數：了解布氏代數的基本運算法和定律，及認識基本邏輯   及邏輯閘
３.布氏代數之簡化：介紹各種布氏代數之簡化方法
４.組合邏輯：據布氏代數及邏輯閘，計分析各種組合邏輯電路
５.可程式邏輯陣列：介紹ＰＬＡ，ＰＡＬ，ＦＰＧＡ等之設計方法
６.正反器：介紹各種正反器電路及了解其基特性
７.同步與非同步序向電路：介紹各種同步與非同步序向電路分析與   設計之方法 
８.遞迴網路：介紹遞迴網路之設計方法
９.ＶＨＤＬ：介紹如何使用ＶＨＤＬ語言設計數位電路

description.zh: 瞭解程式語言的基本結構，並以C語言為主要實習對象，其內容包含：1. 程式語言簡介：介紹各種程式語言及其特性，並對C語言之發展沿革架構及持點詳加討論，2. 資料型態：介紹C語言之資料型態及各種運算子，3. 基本輸入：介紹各種輸出入函數及輸出入實習，4. 流程控制：介紹指定指述，選擇敘述及迴圈敘述，並做實習，5. 前置處理：介紹前置處理觀念及程式實作，6. 函式：介紹主副程式及實作，7. 陣列與字串：介紹各種陣列之特性及字串與陣列之關係，並做實習，8. 結構型態：介紹結構，列舉及同位資料型態及應用實習，9. 指標：介紹指標之觀念及應用實習，10. 位元運算：介紹位元運算及應用實習，11. 檔案處理：各種檔案之介紹及檔案輸出入函數，12. 鍵盤與游標控制：介紹鍵盤、游標之控制及字元之特性，並作相關實習，13. 繪圖與音樂：介紹文字模式及繪圖模式函數，並作實習，14. C語言與物件導向：介紹C++與物件導向之關係，及物件與類別之基本定義，並作相關實習。
description.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages. C language is used for the practice. The course includes: 1. Introduction to programming languages: introduce various programming languages as well as their properties and discuss the history, the structure and advantages of C language. 2. Data types: introduce the data types and operators of C language. 3. Basic Input and Output: introduce various input and output functions and work on their practices. 4. Processes Control: introduce assignments, select statements and loop statements and work on their practices. 5. Preprocess: introduce the concept of the preprocess and work on the programming practice. 6. Functions: introduce the main program and subroutines. 7. Array and strings: introduce the properties of various arrays as well as the relations between strings and arrays and work on their practices. 8. Structure data types: introduce structure data types and work on the practices. 9. Pointers: introduce the concept of pointe

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 讓學生瞭解木材機器加工原理及最新工業用木工機器之種類，並使學生熟悉家具製造技術，特別是製造家具需要用到的各種設備之加工能力，及其作業特性和刀具要件等方面之知識與實務。 介紹家具製造過程中所需之各種機器設備之種類及其加工性能。不論及機器本身之設計問題，而側重於機械之應用；不研究一種機器所能做出之各種巧妙的加工方法，而在討論量產作業時，如何利用最合適之機器及加工方法所應採用之標準操作方式。
description.en: Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. The course is directed toward the efficient use of equipment in the production of large lots. In addition, the course does not concern itself with ingenious ways to do a maximum variety of operations on one machine; however, it is interested in presenting the best machine and method for standard production operations.

This course is for students, researchers, and practitioners who design or evaluate products for their target user. It covers evaluation methodology for supporting human factor design for products, human-machine systems, software applications, games, and specialized appliances intended to be used by people. This field contains a substantial body of knowledge with regard to human factor design and the more narrowly scoped field of usability engineering (UE). Within these areas of practice, and the related research field of HCI, a host of methods are available for evaluating interactive products for user. This course provides an overview of a new and vibrant research field and exposes gaps in current methodologies that future research must address. We also hope it conveys our enthusiasm for this research area, where so much interesting work is taking place and so much still needs to be done.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.en: This course discusses the industry trends of new energy vehicles and helps students understand the basics of the core systems of new energy vehicles. Through progressive topics, students can understand electric vehicle batteries, motors, charging systems, etc., and then master the essentials of maintenance.

History of electric vehicles, current status and future development of electric vehicles, introduction to batteries and battery management systems, on-board chargers for electric vehicles, DC-DC converters, motor drive control.
