description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.en: Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. Engineers must perform under a standard of professional behavior that require adherence to the highest principles of ethical conduct. description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:

10.量測實驗
11.小型量測儀器之專題製作

description.zh: 本課程介紹X射線特性、繞射原理及X射線繞射在材料科學上之應用。內容包括X射線之產生，X射線之性質，X射線之繞射理論，材料之晶體結構與繞射條件。在X射線繞射方法方面則介紹Laue照相法，粉末法，繞射儀及光譜儀等。應用方面則包括晶體結構之鑑定，晶格常數之量測，相圖測定，序化一非序化轉換及化學成分分析等。

description.zh: 介紹電機、電子以及電機機械的基礎概念。內容包括(1)電機工程介紹，(2)電子電路基本原則：電荷、電流、電壓、功率、科希荷夫定律、歐姆定律，(3)電阻性網路分析：節點電壓和網目電流、重疊定理、戴維寧和諾頓等效電路，(4)交流網路分析：介紹儲能元件並分析由正弦電壓及電流所驅動的電路，(5)暫態分析：探討在不同穩態條件下，電壓及電流的行為，(6)交流電源：簡單交流電源的計算，以及電力的產生及分配。
description.en: Introduce to the principles of electrical, electronic, and electromechanical engineering. The context contains: (1) Introduction to electrical engineering, (2) Fundamentals of electric circuits: electric, current, voltage, power, and Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws, (3)Resistive network analysis: node analysis, mesh analysis, the principle of superposition, Thevenie and Norton equivalent circuits, (4)AC network analysis: energy storage circuit elements and the analysis of AC circuits excited by sinusoidal voltages and currents, (5)Transient analysis: describe the behavior of a voltage or a current between two distinct steady-state conditions, (6)AC power: simple AC power calculations and the generation and distribution of electric power.

syllabi.outline:
隨著材料科技的進步，材料的應用也逐步擴展到微精密電子元件、3C光電元件、生醫電子元件等範疇。因此在從事相關技術的發展前提下， 了解電子及電路的基本原理有助於強化與提升相關技術的應用與開發能力。
本課程介紹電機、電子以及電機機械的基礎概念。內容包括(1)電機工程介紹，(2)電子電路基本原則：電荷、電流、電壓、功率、科希荷夫定律、歐姆定律，(3)電阻性網路分析：節點電壓和網目電流、重疊定理、戴維寧和諾頓等效電路，(4)交流網路分析：介紹儲能元件並分析由正弦電壓及電流所驅動的電路，(5)暫態分析：探討在不同穩態條件下，電壓及電流的行為，(6)交流電源：簡單交流電源的計算，以及電力的產生及分配。

description.zh: 本課程從電化學概念，電極電位，及腐蝕原理中建立學生腐蝕技術，包括DC極化法，AC阻抗法，諧波法，ER測試，ERR敏化測試高溫水溶液，應力腐蝕測試等，另外腐蝕壽命評估，材料腐蝕管理系統，核能電廠材料，地下緊密電位量測，水溶液腐蝕抑制效果，鋼筋混泥土結構防蝕效果評估均在本課程中一一介紹。
description.en: 1.Electrochemical mechanisms 2.Corrosion tendency and Electrode Potentials 3.Polarization and Corrosion Rates 4.Theories of Passivity 5.Corrosion Prevention 6.Eight forms of Corrosion 7.High Temprature Corrosion

1.電化學機構─腐蝕電化學原理，法拉第定律

6.八大類濕式腐蝕形態
7.高溫腐蝕

description.zh: 電化學工程特論的領域眾多，舉凡腐蝕現象與電泳作用的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了介紹基本的電化學原理外，另將著重於電化學分析方法在能源與生醫系統研究上的應用。
description.en: Special topics in the field of electrochemistry include many different phenomena (e.g., corrosion and electrophoresis, electro analytical sensors and batteries devices, and the electroplating of metals and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine technologies……). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on the application of electro-analytical methods to the study of energy and biomedical systems.

description.zh: 本課程介紹如何應用數值分析理論求解工程問題。包含數值方法基本觀念，數值方法之誤差及穩定性，非線性代數方程式之數值解法，聯立代數方程式之數值解法，矩陣特徵值求法，非線性聯立方程式之數值解法，多項式插值法及曲線嵌合，數值微分與積分，常微分方程式及偏微分方程式之數值解法 。
description.en: Introduction of using numerical methods to solve practical engineering problems. Topics include Solving nonlinear equations, Solving sets of equations, interpolation and curve fitting, numerical differentiation and integration, numerical solution of ODE and PDE.

syllabi.outline:

This course is to teach you how to apply computational methodologies to solve engineering problems when no analytical solution exists. 
Emphasis will be placed on understanding the basic concepts behind the various numerical methods.

description.zh:
全球遊戲產業包含電腦、遊戲主機、手機遊戲等，市場產值高達上百億美元。虛擬實境和擴增實境的應用更從遊戲、影音娛樂及廣告行銷多元發展與推廣。Unity是一套支援多平台的遊戲開發工具，其強大的功能與豐富的資源，使得任何人都可以快速的進入遊戲開發的世界，更為目前各大遊戲公司所採用之遊戲開發工具。比起早期的開發方式，Unity之強大功能與易上手特性更能節省開發時間與成本。學生想要創業製作遊戲也不再是夢想。 
此課程內容會教授同學如何使用Unity遊戲引擎來開發實作遊戲。從最基礎的認識介面編輯器，到如何套用物理模擬效果，以及創建場景及調配燈光皆會依不同單元慢慢教授。課程將以每周一個Unity開發單元搭配一個小作業的方式進行。課程並包含目前最熱門的虛擬實境和擴增實境的應用程式之製作，讓同學可以在一學期內開發出完整的遊戲。
(修課須具備基礎：物件導向程式設計能力）
description.en:
This course teaches the core skills for Game Development in Unity 3D. This game development course from Infinite Skills introduces you to the fundamentals of 3D game design with the Unity engine. This tutorial is designed with the absolute beginner in mind; no prior experience with Unity is required.

You will start by exploring the Unity interface, and learning how to manipulate objects in the editor. Throughout this course, you will learn how to develop 2D/3D games, augmented reality and virtual reality applications.
You will learn how to import assets for the game, apply physics to objects in the game, and how to combine assets to create complex objects. You will add animation and manage lighting for the game. Finally you will render and build the game for distribution.
Once you have completed this course, you will have a strong grasp of the fundamentals needed to build a functional game using the Unity 3D engine.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助高階管理階層作決策。一般而言，這門課為商學課程中的課程主要協助學員們具有整合能力。學員不只是在策略管理中應活學活用，也融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課將幫助您學習、研讀個案和討論，這是此門課的目標。 1. 瞭解組織所處環境 2. 分析外部環境之時機和危機 3. 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 4. 探討企業不同層次之應對策略。
description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making at the top management level. Traditionally, this course has been the capstone course in the business program and is taught at the last year of study so that students can integrate functional area knowledge into a coherent one. Students are expected not only to learn a body of knowledge on strategic management, but also to synthesize economics, accounting, and marketing as an aid top management level decisions. We will use a combination of readings, case studies, and lectures to achieve the goals of the course.

In the current market-lead and ubiquitous technology driven world, the Corporate Leadership role is not just the corporate internal management concerning but also needs a broad range of issues, such as cross-cultural knowledge and strategic thinking on business development, communication skills with innovative ideas, and management techniques for the long-term business goals. description.zh: 本課程分為兩部分：（1）英文文法觀念的溫故知新，並引導學生將正確的文法觀念運用在閱讀與寫作上，學生可加強基本句型練習、句子改正及句型修正。相關討論包括直述句、引述句、句型變化與修飾;（2）英語修辭法：聽講溝通的有效原理原則。課堂討論主題包括：指稱、一致、倒裝等修辭觀念。修習本課後，學生對出現在相同邏輯意義語境中， 利用不同表達方式以凸顯各種語意的方式與內涵，當有更進一步的體認。
description.en: This course is divided into two parts: (a) The first part is designed for the students to  familiarize themselves with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing. A review of grammatical ideas at high level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors, and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures. The main subjects include English sentence structures, verbal usages, conjunctions, and sequences. Related topics for class discussion cover direct and indirect speech, sentence transformation and modification of sentences; (b) The second half of the course focuses on English rhetoric--principles of effective written and spoken communication. Topics for class discussion include reference, coherence, reverse structures and some related rhetorical concepts. It is hoped that the students will know better the significance brought about by the variations of different expressions that occur in the similar linguistic contexts.

syllabi.outline: This course focuses on thematic spoken interaction and aims to develop students’ ability to engage in meaningful, structured, and sustained communication in English. Emphasizing communication across both everyday and more formal contexts, students will learn to express ideas, respond to others, ask follow-up questions, extend discussions, and connect viewpoints around a topic or theme. Through pair interaction, small-group discussions, topic-based speaking tasks, and individual/group thematic speaking projects, students will develop greater confidence and fluency in participating in coherent and extended spoken exchanges in English. The course also serves as preparation for future coursework in professional English presentations and communication.

description.zh: 本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
description.en: This course aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers.  Its main purpose is to familiarize students with methods, procedures, and techniques that are applicable to quantitative and qualitative research as well as to improve their ability to write research papers.  The main topics for instruction include: the research process; major research methods; and the structure of a research paper.  The research methods primarily studied include the experimental method, descriptive research, ethnography, case study, observation, survey research (questionnaire and interviews), content analysis/documentary analysis, and critical approaches to literature.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
This course is primarily designed for students interested in working on a senior project in literature, film, popular culture, or cultural studies, but most of the material can be generally applied, so students who are uncertain whether their final project will be in literature/cultural studies or linguistics can benefit from the course. (And some students planning on a linguistics topic choose it because the course guides you through your proposal, allows you to compile your sources for your senior project, and provides advice for managing a long-term project.) It aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers. The main topics for instruction include the research process, major research methods, approaches to literary and cultural studies criticism, and the structure of a research paper. Students will learn how to come up with a high-quality research question, best practices for evaluating source material, how to make use of the electronic and hard-copy sources that are available (including subscription and open-access sources), AI uses and pitfalls, and how to carry out a long-term research project, with the goal of avoiding the pitfalls that first-time research project students and writers may fall into. Students will also learn the circumstances under which MLA style is the best style to use, to use it correctly, and to distinguish it from APA style. This course is designed for English majors: while students from other disciplines may sign up, they must be prepared to do assignments designed for English majors preparing for their senior projects and to meet the same expectations.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Public Speaking and Debates
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Term Offered:		Fall, 2026
Course Description
This course is designed to advance English-major students' communication competence through public speaking and debating in English. While most students at this level demonstrate fluency in English, many struggle to structure their ideas and thoughts in a logical and persuasive manner. This course teaches students to organize information and materials, analyze critically, and restructure ideas to engage in effective communication that delivers meaningful results. The topics and issues adopted for speeches are thought-provoking and require critical thinking that reflects intellectual value transcending subject matter through multiple perspectives. In addition, it is important to note that the purpose of learning activities designed is to practice constructing a persuasive, evidence-based argument for a proposed solution to an issue of concern. All speeches must be grounded in academic rigor and supported by verifiable data, not personal or political bias, as this is solely for training in critical debate and social awareness.
1. Attendance
	Attendance will be recorded by the Teaching Assistant (TA).
	Students are required to attend all class sessions.
	Each absence results in a 10% deduction from the final semester grade (based on a 100% scale).
	Tardiness incurs a 5% deduction.
	Exceptions will only be made in cases of extreme circumstances.
2. Speech and Debate Assignments
Each student is expected to deliver three individual speeches and participate in one policy debate using a hybrid Cross-Examination (CX) / congressional format. Students will work in groups for debates.
Speech Requirements:
	All speeches must be 4-6 minutes in duration (ideal range).
	Speeches shorter than 3 minutes or longer than 6 minutes will result in zero points.
	All speech sessions must be video-recorded.
	Make-up speeches are allowed only for official leave permission or extreme circumstances.
	It is essential to comply with prescriptive requirements for each speech type. Failure to follow requirements will result in disqualification and receive zero points.
3. Required in-Class Submissions
For each speech, students must submit to the instructor:
•	Speech outline following the specified format (see Appendix 3)
•	Complete speech script with proper citations and references
•	Instructor evaluation sheet (see Appendix 1)
•	Students who do not have these materials ready or fail to comply with outline format requirements forfeit the right to deliver their speech and receive zero points.
4. Digital Submissions of Speech and Debate Materials 
Student speakers are required to upload the following materials to the designated assignment section on Google Classroom, with each file clearly labeled according to the specified naming convention as instructed.
All files must be uploaded by the specified deadline. Failure to follow t or submit incomplete materials will result in point deductions.
5. Video Portfolio
Students will use their own recording devices for in-class speeches. A complete portfolio including all recordings is required for submission at semester's end.
6. Delivery Requirements
	No scripts or notes are permitted during speech delivery
	Outlines may be displayed via poster or screen
	Using a full script during delivery will result in zero points
Grading Policy
Academic Integrity: Academic honesty is prioritized in this class. Plagiarism will not be tolerated. Students will fail the course immediately upon identification of any plagiarism in submitted writing or presented speeches.
Originality: Students are required to develop their own original, individualized speech topics based on the assigned topic areas.

name.zh: 永磁同步電動機之理論與控制
name.en: Theory and Control of Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Motor

description.zh: 1.永磁電機理論 2.控制法則分析與模擬 3.動態特性分析 4.近代應用介紹
description.en: 1.Basic theory of operation 2. Control strategies analysis and simulation 3. Dynamic performance analysis 4. Introduction to recent applications of the PMSM.

syllabi.outline:
無刷直流及永磁同步電動機具有高效率、高功率-質量比，在家電、工業設備、及電動車輛產業都已被廣泛的應用，為目前最主要的動力馬達。本課程從基本的磁路分析及永久磁鐵開始，首先介紹無刷直流的運轉原理及控制方法，然後探討永磁同步電動機之控制理論，及驅動電路技術，最後說明控制系統實現及無轉軸位置感測器控制的方法。
Brushless dc and permanent-magnet synchronous motor have higher efficiency and energy to mass ratio in comparison to the other motors. They are gradually replacing induction motor and widely used in industry. This course begins with the theory of basic electromagnetic energy conversion, followed by the modeling and vector control theory for permanent-magnet synchronous motor, design and control of brushless dc motors, and the driving circuit design for these motors. Finally, sensorless PM machine control techniques are introduced.

description.en:
This course provides thefundamental theories and architectures for baseband wireless communications. It is concerned that how reliable communication can be achieved and what is the capacity a channel can provide. Much attention will be focused on the newly developed technology, referred to as multiple-inputmultiple-output (MIMO) transmission.
Course outline:
1.The Wireless Channel 
2.Diversity
3.Capacity of Wireless Channels
4.MIMO I: Spatial Multiplexing 
5.MIMO II: Capacity and Multiplexing Architectures
6.MIMO III: Diversity-Multiplexing Tradeoff
7.MIMO IV: Multiuser Communication

description.zh: 本研究所課程從認知語用學視角，探知語言如何造成框架效應(framing effects)影響人們對事件的感知、詮釋與決策。課程內容含括概念隱喻	(conceptual metaphor)、詞彙選擇(lexical selection)、文體結構(discourse structure)等核心語言學議題，並檢視這些語言要素如何影響個人與社會對概念的建構。語料分析涉及廣告、政治語言及日常溝通中的框架現象，探討語言如何被用來說服受眾、強化意識形態、塑造公眾輿論。課程關注框架背後的基本認知機制,包括心理模型(mental	models)與語言理解偏誤	(biases)。透過開放式討論、實證案例研究與話語分析實作，本課程將幫助學生深入理解語言與認知如何交互作用，進而影響人們對現實的建構與詮釋。本課程適合對語言學、認知科學、傳播學及媒體(廣告)語言分析感興趣的同學。
description.en:

Students will analyze framing effects in advertising, political discourse, media narratives, and everyday communication, investigating how language is used to 
persuade, reinforce ideologies, and shape public opinion. The course also considers the cognitive mechanisms behind framing, including mental models and biases in language comprehension. Through open discussions, empirical case studies, and hands-on discourse analysis, students will develop a deeper understanding of how language interacts with cognition to frame reality. Cognitive Pragmatics in Media Communication is a graduate course that examines how language shapes perception, interpretation, and decision-making through framing effects, drawing insights from cognitive pragmatics. It explores how linguistic choices—such as conceptual metaphor, lexical selection, and discourse structure—influence how individuals and societies construct meaning. Students will analyze framing effects in advertising, political discourse, media narratives, and everyday communication, investigating how language is used to persuade, reinforce ideologies, and shape public opinion. The course also considers the cognitive mechanisms behind framing, including mental models and biases in language comprehension. Through open discussions, empirical case studies, and hands-on discourse analysis, students will develop a deeper understanding of how language interacts with cognition to frame reality. This course is ideal for students in linguistics, cognitive science, communication studies, and media analysis.

name.en: Computer Methods for Electrical Control Technology

description.zh: 電控技術在現代工業應用中扮演著不可或缺的角色。因此，本課程的目的在使學生了解電控技術，其內容包括Matlab/Simulink軟體平台介紹、電控系統建模、分析與設計。
description.en: Electrical control technology plays an important role in modern industrial applications. Therefore, the purpose of this course is to introduce the technology to the students. The content includes Matlab/Simulink software platform, and electrical control system modeling, analysis and design.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為數值分析技術應用課程, 主要針對在職碩士專班以上之學生而設計。電控技術在現代工業應用中扮演著不可或缺的角色，但以往較專注於PLC程式或介面程式撰寫。因此，本課程的目的在使學生了解電控技術背後所需的數學方法與理論背景，其內容包括Matlab/Simulink軟體平台介紹、數值方法、類神經網路分析與設計。

description.zh: 本課程介紹工程相關之主要數值分析方法及其於大地工程之應用，如有限差分法及有限元素法。透過實例問題之解析，使學生除了具有理論的基礎外，同時有能力藉著數值分析方法來分析大地工程問題。
description.en: This course introduces two representative numerical methods, i.e.  finite difference method and finite element method, and their application to geotechnical engineering.  Practical engineering problem are illustrated and simulated by numerical methods in the courses.  It aims to train the students to be familiar with either the theorem of numerical analysis or the application to engineering practices.

syllabi.outline: This is the first course in numerical analysis for graduate students. The objectives of the course include: (1) Development and applications of numerical methods when analytical techniques are not available; (2) Numerical differentiation and integration; (3) Numerical solution of ODEs and PDEs; (4) To get familiar with different types of commercial software.

name.zh: 文化轉譯策略與跨域創新
name.en: Strategic Cultural Transcreation and cross-disciplinary Innovation

description.zh:
本課程聚焦文化轉譯在當代文化事業中的策略應用，探討如何將文化內容轉化為可被理解、感知，並具再創造潛力的創意資源，透過將文化、知識、符號轉化為新載體，作為推動跨域創新的基礎。課程強調文化轉譯作為連結文化價值與創意應用的重要機制，並引導學生理解其在不同產業語境中的實作可能。
本課程同時關注跨域創新的行動實踐，透過多元個案的探討，讓學生學習如何在文化內容、產業需求與社會語境之間展開對話，設計具策略性與文化敏感度的創新提案。學生將從實務導向的練習中，發展將文化內容轉譯為創意與應用性高的專案能力。課程內容涵蓋文化轉譯的理論基礎、語境共融策略、跨文化再現倫理，並延伸至創意商品開發、展覽設計、跨界合作模式與公共參與實踐等領域。
description.en:
This course focuses on the strategic application of cultural transcreation within the contemporary creative industries. It explores how cultural content can be transformed into creative resources that are understandable, perceptible, and capable of inspiring new forms of creation. Through the transformation of culture, knowledge, and symbols into new carriers, cultural transcreation is positioned as a foundational mechanism for driving cross-disciplinary innovation.
Emphasizing the role of cultural translation as a bridge between cultural values and creative applications, the course guides students to understand how such processes can be practiced across diverse industry contexts. In addition to theoretical exploration, the course highlights the practical dimension of cross-disciplinary innovation. Through a range of case studies, students will examine how to navigate between cultural content, industry demands, and social contexts to develop culturally sensitive and strategically soun

syllabi.outline: 本課程聚焦文化轉譯在當代文化創意實踐中的策略應用，探討如何將文化內容轉化為具有敘事力與再創造潛能的創意資源，進而作為推動跨域創新的核心基礎。本課程強調文化轉譯不僅為語言或形式的再現，更是在不同產業語境中橋接文化價值與創新實踐的思考架構。本課程將帶領同學理解文化轉譯的理論基礎與策略操作，並透過美學觀點、文化知識、品牌發展、物件語意等面向，讓同學實作練習文化內容的轉譯技巧，並逐步建構跨域創新的行動思維，課程並重理論與實務銜接，培養學生從策略分析到實作呈現的綜合能力。

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

syllabi.outline:
*EMI Course (全英語授課)
This course introduces the fundamentals of storytelling and script planning. By exploring narrative structures and the design thinking process, students will gain hands-on experience in developing an interactive script—from initial planning and analysis to the creation of a finalized visual narrative. Active in-class participation, including brainstorming sessions and discussions, will be evaluated. 
For the final group project, students will collaborate to produce a short video based on their original scripts.

description.zh: 隨著生成式AI與大型語言模型迅速融入設計流程與數位產品開發，互動設計者需具備整合AI技術與人機介面設計的跨域素養。本課程旨在探討人工智慧技術於人機互動設計中的應用，培養學生設計與開發智慧互動系統的核心能力。課程內容涵蓋人機互動及互動設計之基本概念、語意理解與回應機制、以及AI驅動之使用者體驗創新。教學上將透過講述法和工作坊建立基礎觀念，搭配上機實作強化技術操作能力，並以專題導向學習形式，引導學生完成從構思到原型開發之完整設計流程。
description.en: As generative AI and large language models (LLMs) reshape design processes, interaction designers must integrate AI technologies with human-computer interface design to enhance the user experience. This course explores the application of AI in human-computer interaction (HCI), focusing on essential skills for developing intelligent interactive systems. Topics include HCI fundamentals, semantic understanding and response mechanisms, and AI-driven innovations in user experience. Lectures build theoretical foundations, hands-on practice strengthens technical skills, and project-based learning guides students from ideation to prototyping.

description.zh:
以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。
教學目標為：
1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。
2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。
3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en:
This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.
The objectives are:
1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

syllabi.outline:
Seeing is a creative process that involves our eyes and mind to transform what we see into what we know, but sometimes the process is reversed—we rely on what we know to interpret what we are seeing. To draw what we see can, therefore, be a process of the interaction of seeing and understanding. The goal of this course will focus on this seeing, thinking, and drawing interaction while drawing architecture on location. This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.

1. Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2. Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3. Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

syllabi.outline: To understand how Life Cycle Thinking and Life Cycle Management can solve environmental problems. Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), one of the most essential tools for analyzing and assessing environmental issues, will be taught during the semester. Students will also learn about the popular LCA software SimaPro. Various applications related to LCA, such as circular economy, net zero, carbon footprinting, carbon labeling, waste management, and eco-design, will also be practiced in the class.

description.zh: 校務研究（Institutional Research，以下簡稱IR）可說是針對校務所進行的各項研究，透過資料蒐集、分析、報告，以及教職員行動，以促進高等教育機構的運作與決定。同時IR的發展和大學評鑑的發展脈絡息息相關，最終的目的就是要提升學校辦學品質，促進學校良善發展。本課程主要希望加強同學對IR的了解及發展實作能力。
description.en: Institutional research is a broad category of work done at schools, colleges and universities to inform campus decision-making and planning in areas such as admissions, financial aid, curriculum, enrollment management, staffing, student life, finance, facilities, athletics, and alumni relations. Its mission is to foster a culture of evidence by facilitating the management, analysis, and reporting of institutional data and information in support of planning and decision-making. This curriculum is expected to provide all students understand the theory and practice of IR.

syllabi.outline:
The mission of Institutional Research is to support the evidence-based decision-making in education institutions. Therefore, in this course, the classmates would be asked to learn the programming language to deal with the real data and provide solid evidence to the leadership. You would be asked to fully engage in the data analysis during this semester. By the end of this course, you should be able to conduct complicated data analysis with confidence. Meanwhile, you should be able to provide productive suggestions for your supervisor's consideration.
This course not only prepare you as a qualified IR officers. It also lead you as a professional data analytician.

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛設計分析」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計能力之人員，本課程初期將從規範面瞭解車輛設計要求，進而從結構面進行車輛設計與分析，過程中將引導學生採用主流分析軟體進行車輛穩定性與行車舒適度探討。最後將探討與台灣既有鐵道系統的相容性，進行駕駛室與機電設備配置等設計。期望透過本課程，能培植鐵道車輛設計分析人才，厚植本土鐵道車輛設計能力。
description.en: This aim of the course of "Railway Vehicle Design and Analysis" is to cultivate personnel on railway vehicle field. At the beginning of this course, the design requirement and criteria will be given as basic knowledge. Then students will be ask to perform structural design and analysis for railway vehicles. Passenger comfortable index and vehicle dynamic response will be taken into consideration during the process of design and analysis. Finally, the compatibility of the new design with the existing railway system will be discussed.

description.zh: 以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。 教學目標為： 1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。 2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。 3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en: This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching. The objectives are: 1) Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 2) Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 3) Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

syllabi.outline:
Seeing is a creative process that involves our eyes and mind to transform what we see into what we know, but sometimes the process is reversed—we rely on what we know to interpret what we are seeing. To draw what we see can, therefore, be a process of the interaction of seeing and understanding. The goal of this course will focus on this seeing, thinking, and drawing interaction while drawing architecture on location. This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.

1. Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2. Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3. Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材(富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料(二硫化鉬與金屬化)等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

syllabi.outline:
奈米科技與半導體製程技術在近年來受到極大的重視，因此在本課程將介紹半導體基礎與最新的奈米技術，內容包含有基礎電子電路學與半導體製程，以及奈米材料(如奈米碳管、石墨烯、二維奈米材料等)，期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與半導體相關之科技知識。

Nanotechnology and semiconductor manufacturing processes have received significant attention in recent years. Therefore, this course will introduce the fundamentals of semiconductors and the latest nanotechnology. The content includes basic electronic circuitry and semiconductor manufacturing processes, as well as nanomaterials such as carbon nanotubes, graphene, and two-dimensional nanomaterials. The aim is to provide students with the latest knowledge in nanotechnology and semiconductor-related technologies.

description.zh: 本課程著重在材料製程中所發生的輸送現象為探討目標,並使用《Transport Phenomena in Materials Processing》做為教材，旨在建立研究生對動量、能量與質量傳輸之系統性理解。課程將從基本守恆原理出發，理解並掌握流體動力學方程式、熱傳方程與擴散模型，並深入探討其在金屬凝固、熱處理、半導體擴散及材料加工製程中的工程應用。課程特別強調問題定義、尺度分析與物理意義詮釋，培養學生由理論模型連結至實際製程現象之能力，為後續高階製程模擬、數值分析與研究論文撰寫奠定紮實基礎。
description.en:
This course studies transport phenomena in materials processing, and the primary textbook for this graduate-level course was selected as “Transport Phenomena in Materials Processing”. Topics include laminar and turbulent flow, heat conduction and convection, radiation, diffusion in solids, solidification, and interphase mass transfer, all with strong engineering relevance. extra.課程進度(1-16週):
**Part I: Momentum Transport (Fluid Flow)**
*   **Week 1: Viscous Properties of Fluids (Chapter 1)**
    Focus your 2 hours on introducing Newtonian and non-Newtonian fluids, laminar versus turbulent flow, and Newton's law of viscosity. 
*   **Week 2: Laminar Flow and the Momentum Equation (Chapter 2)**
    Cover momentum balances and the development of the Navier-Stokes equation. Use the 2 hours to walk through classic laminar flow models: falling films, flow between parallel plates, and flow through circular tubes.
*   **Week 3: Turbulent and Complex Flows (Chapter 3)**
    Transition into empirical turbulent flow models and friction factors. Dedicate the second hour to complex materials processing flows, such as flow through porous media (Darcy's Law) and fluidized beds.
*   **Week 4: Energy Balance Applications in Fluid Flow (Chapter 4)**
    Discuss the macroscopic mechanical energy equation and Bernoulli's equation. Apply these to practical metallurgical operations, such as sudden enlargements/contractions, flow from ladles, and piping networks.
*   **Week 5: Flow and Vacuum Production (Chapter 5)**
    Introduce vacuum technology, which is crucial for materials processes like thin-film deposition and melt refinement. Cover the characteristics of pumps, fans, blowers, and molecular/Knudsen flow.

**Part II: Energy Transport (Heat Transfer)**
*   **Week 6: Fourier's Law and Thermal Conductivity (Chapter 6)**
    Introduce conduction and Fourier's Law. Spend the lecture exploring how thermal conductivity behaves in gases, liquids, and multi-phase solids.
*   **Week 7: Heat Transfer and the Energy Equation (Chapter 7)**
    Develop the general energy equation. Focus on heat transfer coupled with laminar forced convection in tubes and over flat plates, as well as natural convection using the Boussinesq approximation.
*   **Week 8: Correlations and Data for Heat Transfer Coefficients (Chapter 8)**
    Teach dimensional analysis (Buckingham's pi theorem) to introduce the Nusselt, Prandtl, and Reynolds numbers. Review correlations for forced convection, natural convection, and complex quenching operations.
*   **Week 9: Conduction of Heat in Solids (Chapter 9)**
    Cover steady-state and transient heat conduction in infinite, semi-infinite, and finite solids. Spend time on moving heat sources, which are highly relevant for laser processing and welding.
*   **Week 10: Solidification of Metals (Chapter 10)**
    Apply heat transfer principles to practical processing: solidification in sand and metal molds (Chvorinov's rule). Dedicate the second hour to continuous casting and Czochralski crystal growth.
*   **Week 11: Radiation Heat Transfer (Chapter 11)**
    Lecture on black body radiation, the Stefan-Boltzmann equation, and emissivity. Cover view factors, electric circuit analogs for radiation, and radiation combined with convection in furnace enclosures.
**Part III: Mass Transport**
*   **Week 12: Fick's Law and Diffusivity of Materials (Chapter 12)**
    Introduce mass transport, Fick's first and second laws, and the definition of fluxes. Explain Darken's equations and the mechanisms of diffusion in solids, liquids, and gases.
*   **Week 13: Diffusion in Solids (Chapter 13)**
    Cover steady-state and transient diffusion in solids. Focus on practical applications like the Matano interface, microelectronic diffusion (predeposition and drive-in steps), and homogenization of microsegregation.
*   **Week 14: Mass Transfer in Fluid Systems (Chapter 14)**
    Introduce the general equation of diffusion with convection. Teach the Sherwood and Schmidt numbers, and apply mass transfer coefficients to falling films and Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) processes.
*   **Week 15: Interphase Mass Transfer (Chapter 15)**
    Discuss the two-resistance mass transfer theory for fluids in contact. Apply this to mixed-control gas-solid reactions (like carburization and silicon oxidation) and mass transfer during vaporization.

學習目標： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，運用 AI 工具輔助延伸議題探索及編寫計算程式，完成指定主題之數值計算或系統模擬，並進行物理量/邏輯合理性驗證。

1. 主題選定與 AI 提問設計： 從前 16 週課程內容中挑選一核心主題，利用 AI（如 ChatGPT、Claude 、Gemini等）進行延伸議題探索，並構思程式架構。

2. AI 輔助程式撰寫： 指導 AI 產出 Python計算程式（如空調負荷、濕空氣線圖、管路設計等）。

3. 成果驗證與除錯（Sanity Check & Debugging）： 學生須以課堂所學之基礎理論（如手算基準值、極限條件測試、物理合理性界限）檢核 AI 產出之程式碼與計算結果，並記錄 AI 出錯與修正過程。
extra.學習成果:
在繳交報告時，必須包含以下 5 個核心章節：

1. 問題定義與理論基礎： 說明選擇前 16 週何種概念，以AI進行延伸議題探索及其欲透過程式解決的具體問題。

2. AI 提示工程與程式碼架構： 展現如何下達 Prompt 讓 AI 寫出程式，以及程式的核心演算邏輯。

3. 驗證與除錯紀錄（最重要）：

(1) 基準驗證： 用手算、經典公式或既有文獻數據與程式輸出進行對比。

(2) AI 除錯紀錄： 列出 AI 寫出的 Code 在哪裡出現邏輯漏洞，自己是如何發現並更正的。

4. 分析結果與延伸討論： 呈現程式產出的圖表（如動態趨勢圖、參數敏感度分析），並說明其工程/學理意義。

5. 錄製 3–5 分鐘程式執行與驗證影片： 展示程式運作、關鍵參數修改及結果圖表繪製過程。

description.zh: 本課程之目的為訓練學生有關電子設備散熱設計之相關原理與技術。介紹各項電子元件之發熱量、溫度與元件穩定性之關係，熱對流、熱輻射等熱傳原理在電子設備散熱之的應用法則；解說電子設備散熱器之演進與設計原理，如：熱管之原理與演進、小型風散之特性與設計原則等。探討電子設備的熱阻抗分析、溫度計算、熱應力分析，並介紹相關電腦輔助分析軟體。
description.en: This course introduces principles and techniques of thermal management and cooling design of electronic equipments.  Subjects of this course include: thermal and physical properties of electronic components, thermo-fluid phenomena and principles of thermal management for electronic devices, and the evolution of cooling devices such as heat pipes and micro fans, discussion of analysis methodologies and computer software of thermal management problems including thermal resistances, temperature gradient, and thermal stress.

description.en: The contents of this course include the first law of thermodynamics, the second law of thermodynamics, the two laws combined in analysis: the destruction of exergy, single-phase systems, exergy analysis, multiphase systems, refrigeration, thermodynamic optimization, and irreversible thermodynamics.

description.zh:
本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。
理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。
description.en:
This course aims to develop students’ competencies and action capabilities in addressing global sustainability issues. Integrating theory and practice, it enhances their sense of civic responsibility and social awareness. Based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the course adopts an interdisciplinary approach to explore the connections among environmental sustainability, social equity, and civic engagement.
The course introduces key concepts of sustainable development, civic participation, and social innovation to strengthen students’ analytical and critical thinking skills. Through action-based projects and community engagement, students apply their knowledge to real-world sustainability challenges. Emphasizing “learning by doing” and reflective learning, the course also fosters teamwork, communication, and interdisciplinary integration, preparing students to become responsible and action-oriented global citizens.

我國國家發展委員會「臺灣永續發展目標」(Taiwan Sustainable Development Goals) 相關政策白皮書與指南。

2. 參考書目與延伸閱讀 (Reference Books & Extended Readings)
(可依據三大維度與設計思考方法論，建議學生延伸閱讀)

環境維度： 循環經濟、淨零排放、氣候變遷相關實務書籍或企業永續報告書 (ESG Reports)。

社會維度： 多元共融 (DEI)、社會企業運作、非營利組織影響力相關書籍。

經濟與治理維度： 綠色金融、企業社會責任 (CSR) 相關論述與產業創新案例。

行動發想： 《設計思考》(Design Thinking) 相關實作手冊，用於第11週輔助學生產出 Action Plan。

3. 線上數位學習資源 (Online Digital Learning Resources)

搭配第17-18週彈性學習，指定之國內外開放式課程平台資源，如：Coursera、edX、各大學磨課師 (MOOCs) 平台之永續發展相關指定影音教材。

4. 評估與測量工具 (Assessment Tools)

Assessing Sustainability Knowledge (ASK) 量表相關學術文獻與施測說明（用於第1週與第16週之學習成效追蹤）。

description.zh:
本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。
理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。
description.en:
This course aims to develop students’ competencies and action capabilities in addressing global sustainability issues. Integrating theory and practice, it enhances their sense of civic responsibility and social awareness. Based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the course adopts an interdisciplinary approach to explore the connections among environmental sustainability, social equity, and civic engagement.
The course introduces key concepts of sustainable development, civic participation, and social innovation to strengthen students’ analytical and critical thinking skills. Through action-based projects and community engagement, students apply their knowledge to real-world sustainability challenges. Emphasizing “learning by doing” and reflective learning, the course also fosters teamwork, communication, and interdisciplinary integration, preparing students to become responsible and action-oriented global citizens.

syllabi.materials:
1. 指定教材與官方指南 (Required Materials & Official Guidelines)

聯合國永續發展目標官方資源 (UN Sustainable Development Goals Official Website)

我國國家發展委員會「臺灣永續發展目標」(Taiwan Sustainable Development Goals) 相關政策白皮書與指南。

授課教師與外聘業師提供之自編講義、個案研究 (Case Studies) 及實務數據資料。

2. 參考書目與延伸閱讀 (Reference Books & Extended Readings)
(可依據三大維度與設計思考方法論，建議學生延伸閱讀)

環境維度： 循環經濟、淨零排放、氣候變遷相關實務書籍或企業永續報告書 (ESG Reports)。

社會維度： 多元共融 (DEI)、社會企業運作、非營利組織影響力相關書籍。

經濟與治理維度： 綠色金融、企業社會責任 (CSR) 相關論述與產業創新案例。

行動發想： 《設計思考》(Design Thinking) 相關實作手冊，用於第11週輔助學生產出 Action Plan。

3. 線上數位學習資源 (Online Digital Learning Resources)

搭配第17-18週彈性學習，指定之國內外開放式課程平台資源，如：Coursera、edX、各大學磨課師 (MOOCs) 平台之永續發展相關指定影音教材。

4. 評估與測量工具 (Assessment Tools)

Assessing Sustainability Knowledge (ASK) 量表相關學術文獻與施測說明（用於第1週與第16週之學習成效追蹤）。

description.zh:
本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。
理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。
description.en:
This course aims to develop students’ competencies and action capabilities in addressing global sustainability issues. Integrating theory and practice, it enhances their sense of civic responsibility and social awareness. Based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the course adopts an interdisciplinary approach to explore the connections among environmental sustainability, social equity, and civic engagement.
The course introduces key concepts of sustainable development, civic participation, and social innovation to strengthen students’ analytical and critical thinking skills. Through action-based projects and community engagement, students apply their knowledge to real-world sustainability challenges. Emphasizing “learning by doing” and reflective learning, the course also fosters teamwork, communication, and interdisciplinary integration, preparing students to become responsible and action-oriented global citizens.

description.zh:
本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。
理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。
description.en:
This course aims to develop students’ competencies and action capabilities in addressing global sustainability issues. Integrating theory and practice, it enhances their sense of civic responsibility and social awareness. Based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the course adopts an interdisciplinary approach to explore the connections among environmental sustainability, social equity, and civic engagement.
The course introduces key concepts of sustainable development, civic participation, and social innovation to strengthen students’ analytical and critical thinking skills. Through action-based projects and community engagement, students apply their knowledge to real-world sustainability challenges. Emphasizing “learning by doing” and reflective learning, the course also fosters teamwork, communication, and interdisciplinary integration, preparing students to become responsible and action-oriented global citizens.

syllabi.outline: The goal of this course is to give students a broad overview of state-of-the-art deep learning algorithms, and teach students how to develop deep learning applications by hands-on coding examples. Most examples taught in this class are based on the TensorFlow framework. We will cover many different fields including image classification, object detection, natural language processing, reinforcement learning and generative adversarial networks.

description.en: This course provides introduction to both database system theory and application. These are the following : o 1. Database System Concepts and Architecture -2. Data Modeling Using the Entity-Relationship Model --3. Record Storage and Primary File Organizations -4. -The Relational Data Model -5. SQL -6. ER- and ERR-to Relational Mapping -7. Functional Dependencies and Normalization for Relational Databases -8. Query Processing and Optimization -9. Transaction Processing Concepts

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹資料庫系統之基本理論與實務技術，使學生了解資料建模、資料庫設計、及現代資料庫技術之核心概念。課程內容涵蓋實體關係模式（Entity-Relationship Model）、關聯模式（Relational Model）、正規化（Normalization）、結構化查詢語言（SQL）、資料庫應用程式開發，以及NoSQL、分散式資料庫與雲端資料庫等新興技術。透過課堂實作與專題開發，培養學生分析、設計及建置資料庫系統之能力。
This course aims to introduce the fundamental theories and practical techniques of database systems. Students will gain an understanding of core concepts, including data modeling, database design, and modern database technologies. The course covers topics such as the Entity-Relationship (ER) Model, the Relational Model, Normalization, Structured Query Language (SQL), database application development, as well as emerging technologies, including NoSQL databases, distributed databases, and cloud databases. Through hands-on exercises and project-based learning, students will develop the ability to analyze, design, and implement database systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在深入講解常微分方程（ODEs）的基本理論與應用，涵蓋一階、二階及高階常微分方程，並介紹拉普拉斯變換、線性代數、傅立葉級數及積分與偏微分方程式的基本概念和應用。課程將幫助學生理解和解決複雜的微分方程，並掌握應用這些數學工具進行工程與科學問題的分析。
This course aims to provide an in-depth explanation of the basic theory and applications of ordinary differential equations (ODEs), covering first-order, second-order, and higher-order ODEs. It also introduces the basic concepts and applications of Laplace transforms, linear algebra, Fourier series and integrals, and partial differential equations. The course will help students understand and solve complex differential equations and master the use of these mathematical tools for analyzing engineering and scientific problems.

syllabi.outline: 寶石業為台灣傳統的工業之一，更是許多新科技和產業的交點。寶石學集地質學、礦物學、結晶學、切割技術、商業行為及藝術美感於一門學問，包含了寶石礦物的物理及化學性質和鑑定，寶石礦物的生成和產狀及其地理公布，如何加工，銷售行為如何進行，珠寶的設計方式及製造。寶石礦物之顏色分類，內含物之特色，光學現象之表現。本課程主要涉及四個方面的內容：一、總論，主要介紹寶玉石的概念、分類與特性、評價標準、物性、來源等; 二、講述寶石的特點與品鑒，其中包括鑽石、紅/藍寶石、祖母綠、金綠寶、海藍寶石、石榴子石、尖晶石、碧璽、水晶、橄欖石以及其它寶石等特點與評價; 三、介紹翡翠、軟玉、歐泊、石英質玉、獨山玉、蛇紋石玉、綠松石（土耳其玉）以及印章石等特點與評價; 四、有機寶石，如珍珠、象牙、珊瑚、琥珀等的鑒定與評價。 通過本課程學習，全面瞭解寶玉石的分類與特性、評價標準與來源，掌握寶石、玉石和有機寶石的化學組成、結晶學特徵、物理性質、典型的鑒定特徵，懂得利用常見寶玉石的鑒別方法品鑒寶石、玉石和有機寶石，瞭解各種寶玉石的佩戴習俗和保養方法。 讓學生理解自然界與思想、文化、科學之間的相互關係，擴大學生想像思維，培養學生的理論與現實結合能力。

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意
本課程將深入的討論製程中材料之性質。尤其是在材料行為的理論推導方面。所涵蓋的主題包括有：塑性加工、顯微結構、強化機構、破壞力學、潛變與疲勞、材料之熱膨脹、熱傳導、電化學性質、擴散理論、相變化動力學、化學性質、以及材料之熱力學性質。
description.en: The properties of materials in service will be discussed in detail.  Special focus will be on the theoretically discussion of the behavior of materials.  Topics covered include plastic deformation、strengthening mechanisms、fracture、creep and fatigue、heat capacity、thermal expansion、thermal conductivity、the law of electrolysis、electrolytic conductance and transport, and ionic activity、reversible electrode potentials、Irreversible electrode processes、electrochemical measurements、kinetics of phase transformation、diffusion、kirkendall effect、thermodynamic properties of alloy systems、thermodynamics of surfaces and interfaces

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to provide an in-depth understanding of the various mechanical properties of engineering materials. Content covers the behavior of materials under different loading and environmental conditions, including elastic deformation, plastic deformation, hardness, impact toughness, fatigue, and creep. Students will learn the principles and methods for testing these properties and will gain hands-on experience through laboratory sessions. The course emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, enabling students to apply knowledge of material mechanical properties to engineering design and material selection. Specific teaching weeks will include laboratory sessions, online teaching, and open-book exams, requiring active student participation, data collection, and discussion.

Important Course Notes

International Student Friendly: This course is designed to be welcoming and supportive for international students.

Language of Instruction and Assessment: For all students (domestic and international), all questions, presentations, and examinations must be completed in English.

Laboratory Requirement: This course includes several laboratory sessions. Experimental results and reports will be discussed in class and will form an important basis for continuous assessment.

Open-Book Exam Procedure: For open-book exams, students must come to the classroom to collect the exam paper, then may proceed to the library to research and answer the questions. Answers and findings will be discussed collectively at the end of the relevant class session.

Online Teaching Weeks: Specific teaching weeks will be conducted online. Please check the Microsoft Teams for access details and materials.


本課程旨在深入探討工程材料的各種機械性質。內容涵蓋材料在不同負載與環境條件下的行為，包括彈性變形、塑性變形、硬度、衝擊韌性、疲勞與潛變等。學生將學習這些性質的測試原理與方法，並透過實驗課實際操作相關測試。課程強調理論與實務結合，使學生能將材料機械性質的知識應用於工程設計與材料選用。特定教學週將包含實驗課程、線上教學及開書考試，要求學生主動參與並進行資料搜集與研討。

國際學生友善課程： 本課程致力於為國際學生營造一個友善且具支持性的學習環境。

授課與評量語言： 所有學生（含本地生及國際學生）的課堂提問、口頭報告及所有考試均需使用英文完成。

實驗課程要求： 本課程包含多次實驗課。實驗結果與報告將於課堂中討論，並作為平時考核之重要依據。

開書考試程序： 開書考試時，學生須至教室領取試題，隨後可至圖書館查詢資料以完成作答。答案及研討成果將於該次課程結束前進行討論。

線上教學週： 特定教學週將採線上教學。請留意Microsoft Teams以獲取登入詳情及教材。

本課程時程將視競賽訓練與活動彈性調整；課綱內容得依授課需要滾動修正。

Weekly Plan (English) — Front-loaded for Week 9 deadline

Week 1 — Intro & SEYI Cup Kickoff
Syllabus; safety; team formation (3–4); topic & KPI draft; toolchain (MATLAB/Python/FE I/O).

Week 2 — Servo Stamping Fundamentals
Mechanics/controls; motion profiles (dwell/pendulum/trapezoid); energy & tonnage; Project M1: Problem statement + KPI + data needs.

Week 3 — Computer Coding Class #1
Motion-profile scripting; load–stroke data structures; plotting; In-Class Assignment #1: baseline motion set + visualization.

Week 4 (Online) — Forming Basics w/ Servo Motion
Yield criteria, FLD, tribology; Deliverable: literature review outline + baseline plan.

Week 5 — Open-Book Exam #1 & In-Class Assignment #2
Open-book (short). Assignment #2: parameter sweep (5 profiles) with energy/peak-tonnage estimates; critique session.

Week 6 — Data & Quick Simulation Sprint
Signal processing; quick load–stroke sim; pre/post templates; M2 Checkpoint: methods draft + initial results (2–3 figures).

Week 7 — In-Class Assignment #3 (Optimization Mini-Sprint)
Tune profiles vs thinning/energy; prepare 5-slide interim deck; peer review.

Week 8 (Online) — Submission Rehearsal
Full report/code/slides peer review; freeze list; compliance check; M3: near-final package.

Week 9 — SEYI Cup Submission & Demo (HARD DEADLINE)
Submit final package; in-class dry demo if required by organizer.

Midterm moved to Week 10 (was Week 9).

Week 10 — Midterm Examination (moved)
Reflection on competition outcomes; gap analysis.

Week 11 — Process Modeling for Stamping (On-line teaching線上教學)
Plane-stress plasticity; constitutive laws; contact/friction/heat; FE setup for servo motion.

Week 12 — In-Class Assignment #4
Case analysis (cup drawing): compare motion profiles using provided results; draw-in/thinning/wrinkle risks; recommendation memo.

Week 13 (Online) — Coding Workflows
Batch runs; FLD checks; parameter studies; reporting templates.

Week 14 — Open-Book Exam #2 & Optimization Loops
Multi-objective trade-offs; simple optimizers.

Week 15 — Advanced Subroutine Validation
Predicted vs measured tonnage; friction calibration; uncertainty notes.

Week 16 — Advanced Subroutines & Digital Twin
Implementation + alignment.

Week 17 — Course Summary & Review
Patterns, checklists, code hygiene.

Week 18 — Final Examination

description.zh: 「數據啟發設計思考（Data-informed Design Thinking）」課程旨在結合數據分析與設計思考，通過實踐項目提升學生在現代設計環境中的問題解決能力。本課程將引導學生掌握如何從數據中提取關鍵洞察，並結合設計思考中的使用者需求、創意思考與解決方案原型的開發。學生將學習如何有效地應用數據，來支持設計決策與創新。課程以Project-Based Learning為教學模式，學生將在實際設計項目中探索如何將數據與設計思考相結合，最終交付一個完整的數據驅動設計解決方案與數據視覺化。這門課不僅培養學生的技術技能，還強調協作、反思與迭代改進的設計思考過程，幫助學生為未來數據密集型的設計環境做好準備。
description.en: The "Data-informed Design Thinking" course aims to combine data analysis and design thinking to improve students' problem-solving abilities in modern design environments through practical projects. This course will guide students in how to extract key insights from data, combining user needs, creative thinking and solution prototype development in design thinking. Students will learn how to effectively apply data to support design decisions and innovation. The course uses Project-Based Learning as the teaching model. Students will explore how to combine data with design thinking in actual design projects, and ultimately deliver a complete data-driven design solution and data visualization. This course not only cultivates students' technical skills, but also emphasizes the design thinking process of collaboration, reflection and iterative improvement, helping students prepare for the data-intensive design environment of the future.

syllabi.outline:
The "Data-informed Design Thinking" course aims to combine data analysis and design thinking to improve students' problem-solving abilities in modern design environments through practical projects. This course will guide students in how to extract key insights from data, combining user needs, creative thinking and solution prototype development in design thinking. Students will learn how to effectively apply data to support design decisions and innovation. The course uses Project-Based Learning as the teaching model. Students will explore how to combine data with design thinking in actual design projects, and ultimately deliver a complete data-driven design solution and data visualization. The course will use selected communities in Taipei City as the research site. Through open data, it will explore the challenges faced by urban communities and propose innovative and practical solutions. Students will learn how to use data-driven design methods to develop futuristic and feasible design concepts, and communicate with experts and industry representatives.

「數據啟發設計思考（Data-informed Design Thinking）」課程旨在結合數據分析與設計思考，通過實踐項目提升學生在現代設計環境中的問題解決能力。本課程將引導學生掌握如何從數據中提取關鍵洞察，並結合設計思考中的使用者需求、創意思考與解決方案原型的開發。學生將學習如何有效地應用數據，來支持設計決策與創新。課程以 Project-Based Learning 為教學模式，學生將在實際設計項目中探索如何將數據與設計思考相結合，最終交付一個完整的數據驅動設計解決方案與數據視覺化。課程將以臺北市選定的社區為研究場域，透過開放數據，探索都市社區面臨的挑戰，並提出創新且實際的解決方案。學生將學習如何運用數據啟發的設計方法，發展出具未來性與可行性的設計概念，並與專家及業界代表交流。

name.zh: 設計與生活型態研究(三)

description.zh: 本課程以「現代化與全球化時代」為主軸：聚焦於19世紀至20世紀的現代化與全球化進程，探討社會變遷、消費文化與科技發展如何塑造人類生活型態與設計模式。內容涵蓋現代主義設計運動(如包浩斯、裝飾藝術、國際風格)、後現代主義與在地文化的融合、消費社會與品牌形象的崛起、數位科技對生活的影響等。學生將研究工業化生產如何影響日常用品的設計、都市規劃與環境規劃，並透過案例分析全球化如何改變設計的語言與價值觀。課程將引導學生批判性地思考現代社會的生活方式，並探討如何透過設計回應環保議題、文化認同與社會公平等現代挑戰。
description.en: This course centers on the theme "The Era of Modernization and Globalization," focusing on the processes of modernization and globalization from the 19th to the 20th century. It examines how social change, consumer culture, and technological advancements have shaped human lifestyles and design practices. Topics include modernist design movements(such as Bauhaus, Art Deco, and the International Style), the integration of postmodernism with local cultures, the rise of consumer society and brand identity, and the impact of digital technology on daily life. Students will explore how industrial production has influenced the design of everyday products, urban planning, and environmental planning, while analyzing how globalization has transformed the language and values of design. The course encourages students to critically reflect on modern lifestyles and consider how design can address contemporary challenges such as environmental sustainability, cultural identity, and social equity.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以《全球通史：從史前史到21世紀》為主要教材，以西元500年至1500年間的世界文明發展為主軸，探討中世紀時期不同地區人類生活型態的形成與演變。課程將涵蓋歐洲封建社會、拜占庭帝國、伊斯蘭文明、中國唐宋元時期，以及歐亞貿易網絡的發展，分析宗教信仰、政治制度、商業活動與技術進步如何影響人們的居住方式、生產模式、交通運輸、飲食文化與日常生活。

透過歷史案例的討論，學生將理解不同文明如何因應自然環境與社會需求而發展出各具特色的生活型態與物質文化，並進一步探討建築、器物、服飾、城市與公共空間等設計形式背後所反映的文化價值與社會結構。課程亦將引導學生從跨文化比較的角度思考中世紀世界的交流與互動，並反思其對現代生活與設計發展的影響。

description.zh: 本課程通過理論介紹使用者經驗設計（UX Design）的概念，然後將UX Design方法導入實踐和操作與完成研究工作。課程目的是訓練學生在研究端的流程，諸如素描、框架結構、UI可視化、原型設計、以及用戶測試和優化等能力。最終學生可基於這些能力來利用解決UX的實際設計問題。
description.en: The course via the theories to have an introduction on the concepts of user experience designs (UX Design), and then import the UX Design method to practice and operation. The purposes are training students' ability of user research, sketch, framework structure, UI visualization, prototype design, and user test and refine et al. Moreover, students can base on these ability to utilize on solving the practical design problems of UX.

The object of this course is to introduce the educational psychology to the students who are receiving teacher education. 本課程包含「職業教育與訓練」及「生涯規劃」兩大主題。在「職業教育與訓練」部份，針對職業教育與訓練做整體性介紹，促使學生瞭解我國技職教育重要政策與特色、認識我國技職教育之設置群科、建立學生從事技職教育教學之基礎。在「生涯規劃」部份，針對除了加強學生自我覺察與職涯規劃，也增進學生未來任教時，協助自己的學生進行職涯探索與規劃的能力。

This course involves "Vocational Education and Training" and "Career Planning" two main topics. The "Vocational Education and Training" topic offers an introduction about vocational education and training, such as (a) flexible adjustment the system of vocational education and training in Taiwan; (b) emphasizing vocation education and training system; (c) establish solid theoretical foundation of the vocational education and training. The "Career Planning" topic offers an introduction to the concept of career to not only enhance students' self-awareness and the skills of career planning, but also use those skills to assist their future students to prepare their career planning.

description.zh:
「輔導工作是所有教育工作者的責任」。任何人都會遭遇問題，成長中的學生尤其有各式各樣的問題。身為人師，在教學過程中應輔導學生解決問題，以培養健康進取，有能力解決問題，適應環境的學生為己任。在本課程的目標即在透過對青春期挫折徵候的了瞭以及學者心理分析輔導法、個體心理輔導法、存在主義輔導法、理情輔導法、認知輔導法、溝通分析輔導法、行為輔導法等輔導理論，並配合實例分析使未來之教育工作人員獲得工作時的輔導知能以及培養輔導工作的志趣。 
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The teachers should keep in mind the duty to guide students to overcome the frustration or to solve difficult problems as to nurture students to be healthy, positive, with their own abilities to overcome difficulties and to be apt to the environment. The object of this subject is to help students with the willingness to be teachers get the knowledge and abilities of guidance on their teaching in the future, and develop willingness and interests of guidance. This course presents students with the units including  understanding the symptom of adolescent frustration, the method of person-center approach, the method of rational-emotive therapy, the method of cognitive therapy, the method of behavior therapy. In addition, this course also introduces many practical cases so that students can  effectively study the relevant theories. 
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

【彈性教學週規劃】

學生觀看教師指定之英語教學演示影片、公開授課或教師專業研習課程，完成教學觀察紀錄與心得回饋，分析教學目標、教材設計、教學策略及班級經營方式，提升教學設計與反思能力。

第18週：同儕教案觀摩與教學反思（2小時）
學生觀摩同儕教案設計與教學成果，分析教材內容、教學流程、活動設計及評量方式，完成教案分析與反思回饋，並提出可應用於未來英語教學之改進建議，以培養教材設計能力與專業反思素養。
**評分方式：**教案分析與反思報告，占總成績10%。

description.zh: 本課程探討人工智慧（AI）如何整合並提升語言學習與教學。學生將學習第二語言習得理論，如互動理論與社會文化理論，並連結這些理論與AI輔助語言學習工具。透過實作與專題討論，學生將實際操作AI工具，並從學習者與教師的角度設計有效且具倫理意識的AI語言學習任務。課程旨在培養學生的AI素養，使其能夠批判性地評估與應用AI技術，以因應課堂內外多元的語言學習與教學需求。
description.en: This course explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can be integrated and enhance language learning and teaching. Students will examine key SLA theories—such as interactionist and sociocultural approaches—and connect them to AI-supported learning tools. Through hands-on practice and discussion, students will explore AI tools and have opportunities to design effective, ethical AI-integrated language tasks from both learner and teacher perspectives. The course aims to build students’ AI literacy, enabling them to critically evaluate and apply AI technologies to support diverse language learning needs in both classroom and self-directed contexts.

syllabi.outline: This course is designed for students who are curious about how artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming language learning and teaching. The course is organized around progressive microlearning tasks completed in small groups. Students will first explore and evaluate existing AI tools for language learning. They will then design AI-powered language learning activities, build simple AI conversation partners using role prompts, and finally create multimodal learning experiences that combine AI-generated text, images, audio, or video. Each task combines hands-on practice with critical reflection. Students will not only create learning materials with AI but also evaluate whether their work is accurate, inclusive, pedagogically appropriate, and ethically sound. Alongside these practical tasks, the course introduces key principles from language learning research to help students understand why certain AI-enhanced activities are effective and how they can be designed more thoughtfully. Students will examine how generative AI can support specific language skills, including vocabulary acquisition, grammar practice, speaking fluency, and writing development. By the end of the course, students will have gained hands-on experience with a range of AI tools, developed a portfolio of collaboratively designed language learning activities, and strengthened their critical awareness of how to use AI responsibly in diverse educational contexts.

description.en: This current course emphasizes a holistic view of business communication in a global context.  Given that business communication across from fields of business activities is now made possible by the English language, the course thus aims to develop the ability to use critical skills essential to successful communication in English, with particular emphases on forms of formal communications that are highly visible within and outside business organizations, including writing of business correspondence and reports, presentations and meetings. Informal communication skills are also incorporated to address workplace situations to identify the relevant communication needs.

description.en: This course aims to help students build up the basic knowledge of news trans-editing and develop students’ trans-editing skills through practical training. The course covers the following areas: (1) an introduction to news trans-editing (e.g. the current state of the news trans-editing field, the production workflow, professional qualifications and personal traits of news translators); (2) strategies and skills of news trans-editing (e.g. the strategies of deletion, restructuring, abridgement and synthesis); (3) practical training of news trans-editing in a simulated or real environment.

syllabi.outline:
一、教學目標
本課程旨在讓學生具備國際新聞編譯之相關知識，並透過實務演練培養新聞編譯之能力。課程內容主要含括(一)國際新聞編譯之介紹（如新聞編譯現況、製作流程、專業條件與譯者相關知能）；（二）新聞編譯之策略與技巧（如刪除、重組、整合新聞訊息）；（三）新聞編譯之模擬與實務練習。
本課程提供閱讀新聞英語的練習機會，藉著閱讀報紙、雜誌英文新聞報導、評論、專欄、社論等，了解其中新聞字彙、文體，訓練閱讀新聞。
促使學生透過媒體識讀教學過程、瞭解新聞編採實務、國際現勢、配合原本的英文能力利基，強化國際觀，落實並活用英文。
本課程重要目標並包含著重加強應用英文系學生對國際新聞編譯實務的能力，培養學生敏銳的觀察力及組織力、並訓練學生對國際時事的新聞陳述與課堂討論，達到不同觀點的看法。有系統引導學生閱讀國際新聞，述說新國際聞編譯之寫作方式與要點，以及編譯技巧，培養未來可能於新聞職場服務的專業能力。

I. Teaching Objectives

This course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the theories, principles, and practices of international news translation and editing, while cultivating their professional competencies through practical training and experiential learning. Through a systematic integration of conceptual instruction and applied exercises, students will develop essential skills in news translation, information processing, and cross-cultural communication within the context of international journalism.

The course content encompasses three major areas. First, it introduces the fundamental concepts and contemporary practices of international news translation and editing, including the current landscape of the news translation industry, news production procedures, professional requirements, and the knowledge base and competencies expected of translators and editors. Second, the course explores strategies and techniques employed in news translation and editing, such as information omission, restructuring, adaptation, and integration, with particular emphasis on the effective organization and presentation of news information across linguistic and cultural boundaries. Third, simulation-based activities and practical exercises are incorporated to familiarize students with authentic news translation and editing processes and to enhance their practical abilities.

In addition, the course provides opportunities for students to develop proficiency in reading journalistic English through exposure to English-language newspapers, magazines, news reports, commentaries, columns, and editorials. By engaging with diverse forms of journalistic discourse, students will acquire familiarity with news-related vocabulary, stylistic conventions, and textual structures, thereby strengthening their reading comprehension and analytical skills in journalistic contexts.

The course further incorporates media literacy education as a pedagogical framework to help students understand the practical operations of news gathering, reporting, and editorial decision-making, while deepening their awareness of international affairs and contemporary global issues. Building upon students’ existing English-language competencies, the course seeks to broaden their global perspectives and intercultural understanding while enhancing the practical application of English in professional and international contexts.

Another major objective of this course is to strengthen Applied English students’ professional competencies in international news translation and editing. Emphasis is placed on cultivating students’ observational sensitivity, organizational abilities, and critical thinking skills. Students will also be encouraged to engage in news presentations and classroom discussions concerning international current events, enabling them to examine issues from multiple perspectives. Through systematic guidance in reading international news, understanding journalistic writing conventions, and applying translation and editing techniques, students will develop the professional expertise and practical capabilities necessary for future careers in journalism, international communication, and related fields.

III. Assessment and Evaluation Criteria

Student performance in this course will be assessed through a combination of continuous coursework, classroom engagement, examinations, and project-based learning activities. The evaluation framework is designed to measure students’ academic achievement, critical thinking abilities, participation in collaborative learning, and practical competencies in international news translation and editing.

Weekly Assignments and Attendance (15%)
Students are expected to complete assigned weekly coursework and maintain regular attendance. This component evaluates students’ consistency in learning engagement, preparation, and active participation throughout the semester.
Class Participation, Discussion, and Inquiry (20%)
Assessment will be based on students’ active involvement in classroom activities, including participation in discussions, contribution of ideas, critical questioning, and engagement in collaborative learning processes.
Midterm Examination (20%)
The midterm examination is intended to assess students’ understanding of the theoretical concepts, analytical frameworks, and practical techniques introduced during the first half of the course.
Final Project Presentation (45%)
Students will complete a final group project designed to demonstrate their ability to integrate theoretical knowledge with practical application. Assessment will focus on analytical depth, organization, presentation effectiveness, collaborative performance, and the application of international news translation and editing competencies.

name.zh: 文化研究與跨文化溝通

description.zh: 文化研究以文學，社會批評，通俗文化，人類學、科學、女性主義和種族批評等觀點，對文化現象做深入的觀察、思考、及批判。本課程著重應用文化研究之豐碩成果，啟發學生認識文化問題，並培養其觀察，思考，及批判能力。不僅能因之促成社會進步，更重要的是能藉由對本國及異國文化差異及價值觀的深入瞭解，將知識應用在跨文化溝通上，協助本國企業成功地國際化。
description.en: Cultural studies is emerging as one of the most inspiring and exciting fields in and out of the academy.  Drawing its energies from literary and social criticism, popular culture, anthropology and the sciences, feminism and critiques of race, cultural studies involves an infinite number of ingenious, politically contingent, and often popularly amusing subjects.  Hopefully, students taking this course are trained to become independent, critical thinkers who are able to observe, analyze, criticize, and ameliorate culture.  By addressing diverse cultural issues, students can not only deepen their understanding of different cultural values but also apply this knowledge to improve cross-cultural communication.  One of the practical purposes of this course is to enable students to help local enterprises boost their business on the global stage of commerce.

syllabi.outline: As an all-encompassing term, the word culture has multiple meanings. Anything involving human activity can be included in the domain of culture. Most importantly, culture is deeply connected with our sense of identity; our culture defines who we are. And culturally-determined identification can a blessing that empowers our subjectivity, but it can also be a confinement that we strive to be free from. In this course, we will approach important topics in cultural studies from the perspectives of important theories such as psychoanalysis, gender studies (including feminism and queer theory), postcolonialism, etc. to address issues related to gender and sexuality, race and cross-cultural encounters, which are most intrinsically connected to identity. To achieve this, we will read and discuss theoretical works and critical essays and view related films as cultural texts for in-depth analysis. Ideally, the course will familiarize students with key concepts in cultural studies and cultivate their critical thinking. Furthermore, the instructor hopes that the course can help students identify potential topics of their senior projects (should you wish to work on literary/cultural studies) and establish valid approaches.

description.zh: 此進階翻譯課程旨在培養學生整合AI工具至翻譯流程的能力。透過結合線上翻譯計畫與先進AI科技，學生將於實際翻譯計畫中，學習如何運用科技來提升翻譯能力與效率。本課程著重三大主軸：（1）發展後設認知技能；（2）增強工具使用能力；（3）提升機器翻譯譯後編輯技巧。學生將參與翻譯計畫（包括維基百科、全球之聲、TED），並運用ChatGPT和Claude等AI工具進行批判性思考，以分析並解決翻譯過程所遇到之問題。本課程還將運用AI驅動工具（例如柏拉圖譜系統），來增強學生搜尋和整合翻譯資源的能力，並訓練學生如何對AI生成之譯文進行人工譯後編輯，以提高翻譯質量。
description.en: This advanced translation course aims to equip students with the skills necessary to integrate AI tools into their translation workflows. Through merging online translation projects with cutting-edge AI technologies, students will gain hands-on experience in using technology to improve their translation proficiency and efficiency. The course focuses on three main areas: (1) developing metacognitive skills, (2) enhancing instrumental competence, and (3) refining machine translation post-editing techniques. By engaging in online translation projects, including Wikipedia, Global Voices Lingua, and TED, students will employ AI tools, such as ChatGPT and Claude, to critically evaluate and enhance their problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Additionally, this course will bolster students’ resource-searching abilities through AI-driven tools (e.g., Platograph) and train them in manually editing AI-generated translations to enhance quality.

syllabi.outline: This course develops students’ human-centered GenAI literacy through authentic translation projects on the Global Voices Lingua platform. Students use Custom GPTs and Dify as complementary tools for responsible AI-assisted translation rather than as automatic translation engines. Custom GPTs support translation reasoning by helping students ask questions, identify problems, compare wording options, and reflect on decisions. Dify supports workflow awareness by helping students organize the translation process, follow review checkpoints, record AI support, and document human decisions. Across three project cycles—political and social affairs, science and the environment, and culture and diverse voices—students use and gradually adapt instructor-designed Custom GPTs and a reusable Dify workflow template. By the end of the course, students will be able to use AI tools critically, adapt human-AI translation workflows, and maintain responsibility for final translation decisions.

description.zh: 本課程使學生熟悉混凝土之材料組成、物理及力學性質，以及混凝土之配比及其近代發展。課程中亦包含混凝土之非線性分析，如潛變、乾縮及斷裂行為等。
description.en: This course provides students with material composition, physical and mechanical properties of concrete, concrete proportion and its modern development. Courses will also be included in the nonlinear analysis of concrete, creep, shrinkage and the failure theory and so on.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為研究混凝土複合材料之進階課程，主要採以專題討論方式進行，課程著重於水泥漿體之物理及化學特性，並探討混凝土之基本性質與行為。亦針對特殊混凝土之高性能混凝土性質、試驗等進行研討。

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在土木與營建專案中進行風險與防災管理的分析與決策能力，課程內容涵蓋風險管理理論、量化分析方法、防災減災概念、法規制度、專案合約風險分攤、施工安全，以及環境與氣候韌性議題。
description.en: This course aims to equip civil engineering students with the ability to analyze and manage risk and disaster prevention throughout the lifecycle of construction and infrastructure projects. The course covers risk management theories, quantitative analysis methods, disaster mitigation principles, regulatory frameworks, contractual risk allocation, construction safety, and issues related to environmental and climate resilience.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在培養學生於土木與營建專案中進行風險辨識、評估與管理之能力。課程重點包含專案風險管理流程、成本與工期不確定性、風險導向估價、量化風險分析、風險因應策略，以及專題導向之實務應用。
This course aims to equip civil engineering students with the ability to identify, assess, and manage risks in construction and infrastructure projects. The course emphasizes project risk management processes, cost and schedule uncertainty, risk based estimation, quantitative risk analysis, risk response planning, and practical applications through project based learning.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹有關材料反應動力學的基礎理論與技術。
description.en: The course describes the basic concept and confines its attention to those features of kinetics that seem to be most important for students in the field of Material Sciences and Engineering. The course covers a range from several points of view; the half life of a reactant, the time taken for half of the reactant to be consumed. Relevant of the branches of Materials Sciences, such as Biology, Chemical engineering, Electrochemistry, Inorganic chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, Pharmacology, and physics are also mentioned in macroscopic kinetics investigations.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將討論材料熱力學與動力學之間的差異與擴散理論。課程最後會介紹動力學在工業界的應用實例：金屬熱處理與粉末燒結理論。
This lecture will discuss the differences between Thermodynamics and Kinetics and also discuss the Diffusion Theory. At the end of this lecture, we will introduce the applications of Kinetics in industry cases: Metal Heat Treatment and Theory of Sintering.
