description.zh: 注重環境永續、社會責任與公司治理的ESG原則，已成全球風潮，更是決定企業未來是否能順利接到訂單之關鍵，也是維繫企業在產業鏈永續發展之命脈。換言之，落實ESG原則，將帶動企業高成長、創造更多的社會福祉。 本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動ESG之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析ESG如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。本課程也會讓學生藉由規劃與實施一項公益活動，以實踐企業倫理與社會責任，並藉以思考在推展企業倫理、企業社會責任與公司治理等理念時，如何能落實於企業的體制之中，以建立一個永續發展的企業價值體系。
description.en: ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being. This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability. This course is also designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在介紹ESG與企業倫理。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

第一天
上午

上課個案介紹
個案分析工具介紹
Case Accor 9-315-138（寰騰匯個案競賽說明）

第二天
早上
策略管理
商業模式介紹

第二組Case2  AMAZON VS WALMART：Clash of Business Models(001SMU)
1.	Amazon 線上與Walmart supercenter在行銷策略上有何差異(目標市場、價值組成、行銷組合)?
2.	Amazon與Walmart的商業模式有何差異?兩家的核心能力各為何?
3.	Amazon的全通路策略為何?會遇到什麼困難?特別是在雜貨部分有何困難?
4.	請評估Walmart的全通路策略，他會遇到什麼挑戰?

視訊
體驗行銷
第四組Case4 百威英博百威啤酒的全球品牌管理Global Brand Management of Anheuser Busch InBev's Budweiser（9-518-105）
1.百威需要一個全球統一的品牌嗎？Perkins是否可以繼續管理在不同地區的兩個或更多不同的品牌形象？為什麼？
2.當百威準備擴展至非洲，Perkins應該採用哪個品牌形象在肯尼亞、尼日利亞、喀麥隆和南非推出品牌並建立顧客價值主張？為什麼？
3.百威品牌有多大的價值？這個價值在北美、中國、肯尼亞、尼日利亞、喀麥隆和南非有何不同？在每個市場它的品牌價值源於何處？在每個市場它在功能上和象徵意義上是否傳遞了消費者所需的品牌價值？
4.你對北美的品牌重塑計劃（新的品牌故事、高端化努力、美國瓶、禁酒令珍藏版和淡啤酒計劃）怎麼看？它們如何影響北美的銷售和品牌資產？在其它地區呢？你認為品牌中更積極和更消極的地方在哪？
5.為百威設計一個2018年世界杯的品牌戰略。你想講述怎樣的故事？你會針對什麼樣的群體講故事？

syllabi.outline:
注重環境永續、社會責任與公司治理的ESG原則，已成全球風潮，更是決定企業未來是否能順利接到訂單之關鍵，也是維繫企業在產業鏈永續發展之命脈。換言之，落實ESG原則，將帶動企業高成長、創造更多的社會福祉。 本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動ESG之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析ESG如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。本課程也會讓學生藉由規劃與實施一項公益活動，以實踐企業倫理與社會責任，並藉以思考在推展企業倫理、企業社會責任與公司治理等理念時，如何能落實於企業的體制之中，以建立一個永續發展的企業價值體系。
ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being. This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability. This course is also designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.

It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being. This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability. This course is also designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.

syllabi.notes:
彈性學習說明
(1)類別
 遠距教學

(2)內容
透過遠距教學平台進行適應體育相關知識學習，教師提供線上教材、教學影片及相關閱讀資料，內容包含適應體育理念、身心障礙者運動參與、運動安全、體適能促進及個別化運動設計等主題。學生透過線上課程、討論及作業活動，了解不同身心條件者參與運動的需求與方法，培養尊重多元及運動平權的觀念。

(3)時數（小時）
4小時

(4)學習成果
學生能了解適應體育的基本理念與實務應用，認識不同身心條件者的運動需求及參與方式，並具備規劃安全運動活動的基本能力。透過課程學習，培養關懷、尊重與包容的態度，提升運動參與及健康促進相關知能。

(5)評量比例
彈性學習週之學習成果占課程總成績10%，評量方式包含線上課程參與、出席紀錄、主題討論及心得報告等，依學生學習表現與完成情形進行評分。

description.zh: 本課程包含用於移植、非移植和體外的材料。移植的材料包含縫線、人工血管、人工心臟、人工骨頭、韌帶、藥物徐放裝置、人工皮膚、人工肝臟等。非移植的材料有醫療用衣服、繃帶、注射器材、診療用材料等。體外的材料包含透析膜、人工肺、人工導管等。
description.en: The material in this course covers implantable, nonimplantable, and extracorporeal materials. Implantables include sutures, vascular grafts, artificial heart, artificial bones and ligaments, drug delivery device, artificial tissues, artificial liver,etc. Nonimplantable materials are : cloths in medical uses,  surgical dressings and gauze, injection device, diagonsis materials, etc. Extracorporeal materials are : dialysis fibers, artificial lung, catheters, etc.

description.zh: 課程內容主要介紹無機化學研究過程中﹐所使用的各種物理方法。首先介紹光譜學之基本原理。隨後將較深入的探討應用在無機化學與固體材料上的各種光譜技術。包括：各種吸收光譜、核磁共振光譜、電子順磁共振光譜、Ｘ光吸收光譜及Ｘ光繞射等應用於化學之常用分析技術﹐也都包括在課程討論範圍之內。
description.en: I.                  General Introduction to SpectroscopyII.                 Group Theory III.               Absorption Spectroscopies --- UV-Vis, IR, Raman IV.               X-ray crystallography V.                 Bonding models in inorganic chemistryVI.               The structure and reactivity of moleculesVII.                    solid state

syllabi.outline: The course content mainly introduces various physical methods used in the research process of inorganic chemistry. First, the basic principles of spectroscopy are introduced. The various spectroscopic techniques applied to inorganic chemistry and solid materials will then be discussed in more depth. Including: various absorption spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy, X-ray absorption spectroscopy and X-ray diffraction and other commonly used analytical techniques in chemistry are also included in the course discussion. The content includes chemical bonds, molecular vibrations, electronic spectra of transition metal compounds, atomic cluster compounds and crystal structures.

name.zh: 半導體材料檢測技術及原理

description.zh: 本課程將探討半導體材料之表面化學性質之分析技巧、以及界面和分子間引力之量測方法、表面形態分析、晶相結構分析以及電磁性質量測之技術和其原理。並配合半導體旋轉塗佈機和濺鍍機所備製之薄膜﹐實際操作FTIR顯微鏡、原子力顯微鏡、微量材料流變儀。
description.en: This course will present the techniques and their corresponding theories on the surface property measurements including chemical information, stress analysis, morphology, crystalline structure and intermolecular forces between interfaces. The course also includes a practical training on the FTIR microscope, atomic force microscope, reology meter on the semiconductor materials.

name.en: Special Topics of Materials Science and Engineering

description.zh: 本課程主要針對非材料系背景之研究生開設， 對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質）.
description.en: Special topics in 1.The structure of crystalline solids. 2.Imperfections in solids. 3.Phase transformation and phase equilibrium. 4.Strengthening mechanism of materials. 5.Metal alloys 6.Ceramics 7.Polymers

syllabi.outline:
This course is aimed for, but not limited to, graduate students who are lack of background in Materials Science and Engineering. The topics will include: 1.The structure of crystalline solids, 2. imperfections in solids, 3. phase transformation and phase diagram,  4. properties, process and applications of metallic alloys, ceramics, and polymers.

本課程主要針對非材料系背景之研究生開設， 對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質）。

name.zh: 電子材料與元件技術特論
name.en: Special Topics in Electronic Materials and Devices

description.zh: 本課程探討電子材料性質、固態物理基礎、元件物理等相關內容，強化電子材料與半導體元件技術之關聯性，藉由剖析材料結構與元件電性，深入探討電子元件在實際應用時可能遭遇之材料議題。本課程將介紹多種半導體元件技術應用，內容包括p-n接面、發光二極體與太陽能電池等。
description.en: This course will introduce the material properties, the basics of solid-state physics, and semiconductor devices and physics to provide knowledge of electronic materials and modern semiconductor devices. To assess the material and device issues of electronics for practical use, analysis of the material structure and electrical performance are essential. The content will include various semiconductor device technologies, such as p-n junction, light emitted diodes (LEDs), and solar cells.

syllabi.outline:
This course facilitates students' comprehension of fundamental concepts in electronic materials, semiconductor physics and devices, and the modern theory of solids. Additionally, it encompasses the introduction to basic electronic devices and semiconductor processing technology employed in the contemporary semiconductor industry.
(Course taught in English)

description.zh: 生質能源(bioenergy)指的是儲存在現有(活著或剛失去生命)的動植物體的能量。生質能源的來源，主要是植物將太陽能經由光合作用轉換成葡萄糖，在進一步合生物高分子衍生物(如多醣體(polysaccharides)) 。新一代生質能源技術強調環保技術，整合跨領域之技術，包含應用分子生物技術所發展出之基因轉殖、醱酵控制及生物觸媒技術-利用生物酵素進行催化化學反應達成環保及高效率與節能之目的。本課程將介紹動植物的多醣體種類及如何運用新興生物系統學的技術開發生質能源。
description.en: Bioenergy is referred to the energy stored in living or recently living biological organisms, such as animals, plants and microbes. The source of bioenergy can be traced back from plants harvesting the sunlight and converting it to glucose, then to other biopolymers such as polysaccharides. The technologies for developing bioenergy, with an emphasis on environmentally compatible, consist of gene cloning technology from molecular biology and enzymatic control and catalytic chemistry (i.e. green chemistry).  The course is an introduction course on the types of polysaccharides in animals and plants, how scientist use system biology to develop bioengergy.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則(IFRS)，內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對IFRS有全面整體了解及運用之能力。亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。
description.en: This course is an advanced course for financial accounting. It is to teach the financial accounting theory, concept, method and procedure for students with some basic accounting knowledge. The course covers all the materials to understand financial accounting based on IFRS. The course will help students for preparing advanced license examinations for accounting.

description.zh: 人工智慧物聯網課程將物聯網的感測器與感測網路、邊緣閘道、雲端服務與存取裝置，結合機器學習、深度學習及智慧分析技術，協同建構從端到端的智慧應用，涵蓋無人商店與智慧支付、遠距醫療與照護、智慧製造與智慧家庭等多元場景。本課程著重於人工智慧在裝置與服務設計中的關鍵角色，並透過實務案例與專題討論，培養學生規劃並開發創新智慧物聯網解決方案的能力。
description.en: The AIoT course integrates sensors and sensor networks, edge gateways, cloud services, and user access devices with machine learning, deep learning, and intelligent analytics to jointly build end-to-end smart applications. These applications cover a variety of domains such as Unmanned stores and smart payment, remote healthcare and telemedicine, smart manufacturing, and smart home systems. This course emphasizes the pivotal role of AI in device and service design, and through practical case studies and project discussions, aims to equip students with the ability to plan and develop innovative intelligent IoT solutions.

description.zh: 本課程主要是在於介紹一些駭客常用的攻擊方法和可能使用工具，並藉由這些技術的解說讓學生瞭解實際駭客的攻擊行為與思維模式，進而習得如何保護所管理的網路或資訊系統免於被攻擊成功。課程中將輔以實機操作，教導您如何利用現有電腦資源掃描及測試系統的安全問題，藉以保護系統安全，課程中將加強實際的上機操作，藉由上課所模擬的網路環境中，讓同學能夠實際感受攻擊的可能實況
description.en: This course is mainly to introduce network and system attack methods and security assessment tools used by hackers, and to explain the attack behavior and thinking strategy of hackers through the explanation of these technologies. In addition, this course teaches students learn how to protect the managed network or information system to against from being compromised successfully. The course will be supplemented by practices, and teaching students how to use the existing tools to scan and test the security of the system. In order to protect the security of the system, the course will focus on the system and network practices, which can let the students feel the possible network and system attacks.

description.zh: 本課程說明如何利用質量及動量守恆建立可以描述速度、應力及壓力等流體系統物理量間關係之統制方程式。其內容包括：線及角動量守衡、應力張量、平滑近似理論、非穩態流動、邊界層近似法、線性穩定度理論及紊流系統。
description.en:
We will learn how fundamental principles such as conservation of mass and momentum lead to equations that govern or describe the interrelationships of velocity, stress, pressure, and so on. Content includes macroscopic balance for linear and angular momentum, the stress tensor, 
lubrication approximation, unsteady flow、the boundary layer approximation, linear stability theory, and turbulent flows.

syllabi.outline: This course surveys the principal concepts of fluid dynamics. Topics include mass and momentum conservation, the Navier-Stokes equation for viscous flows, as well as dimensional analysis. Emphasis is placed on being able to utilize the concepts to solve the real problems encountered during conducting research

description.zh: 本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
description.en: This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

syllabi.outline:
Robotics Lab (RLab) is offered with all experimental in-class projects, same as its previous version “Robotics and Automation Applications (RAA)”.  Compared with Robotics course, this Robotics Lab (RLab) course is https://aps.ntut.edu.tw/course/tw/Select.jsp?format=-1&code=366205 offered for undergraduate students with programming experience, but no particular prerequisites, such as Robotics, are required.  RLab focuses on projects in the areas of optical inspection, mobile robots, manipulators, visual servoing, and automation expanding the application of AI approaches.  本課程為全實驗課程，等同於原先「機器人與自動化應用」之新版課程。相較於「機器人學」基礎分析課程，機器人學實習(RLab)屬應用課程、適合具備基礎程式能力的大學生修習，並無機器人學等先修課程要求。課程專題聚焦於光學檢測、移動式機器人、機械手臂、視覺伺服與自動化並擴展運用人工智慧方法。 

The goals of the course can be summarized as below: [Projects will be arranged based on available equipment]
1.影像處理實驗：灰階分類，膨脹與侵蝕處理Image Processing: Gray-level Classification, Dilation, and Erosion Operations, 2. 影像處理實驗：斷開與閉合處理Image Processing: Opening and Closing Operations, 3.光學檢測實驗Optical Inspection, 4. 移動式機器人之眼在手與眼看手視覺控制實驗 Mobile Robot Control with Eye-in-Hand and Eye-to-Hand Vision, 5. Mobile Robot Mapping移動式機器人建圖, 6. Mobile Robot Navigation 移動式機器人導航, 7. 移動型機器人之 AI人體追蹤與跟隨實驗AI-Based Human Tracking and Following for Mobile Robot, 8. 機器臂模擬&實驗教學Tutorials on Simulation & Experiments for Manipulator, 9. 機器臂控制實驗:骨牌拾取與放置Manipulator Control Experiment: Domino Picking and Placing, 10. 機器臂控制實驗: 以骨牌拾取與放置完成河內塔任務	Manipulator Control Experiment: Tower of Hanoi by Domino Picking and Placing, and 11. 機器臂 AI 控制實驗: 視覺語言模型輔助物體拾取與放置Manipulator AI Control Experiment: Vision-Language-Model-Assisted Object Picking and Placing.

Course materials will be available via iStudy.  Homework needs to be submitted before each in-class experiment.  All experiments must be completed and evaluated in class under supervision of TA.  The final project is scheduled for last few weeks of the term. 本課程於每週課前公布講義於網路學園，作業必須在實驗進行前繳交，課堂期間學生進行團隊實驗並由助教驗收成果。使用設備時必須正確操作並注意安全，遇到問題務必通知助教尋求協助。本課程無法於課堂外時間進行，請於課堂結束前完成實驗以利考核。本課程之期末專題實作與展示規劃於期末進行。

name.en: Satellite Remote Sensing Applications and Lab

description.zh: 本課程將介紹衛星遙測技術基礎，包括衛星通訊軟體及硬體，以及在地球科學、環境管理、農業和城市規劃中的應用。透過理論講授、案例研究和實習，學生將了解衛星遙測技術原理及其在各領域的實際應用。課程強調實際應用和解決問題的能力，並提供實習機會，讓學生參與衛星遙測專案，培養操作技能和解決問題的能力。
description.en: This course will cover the basics of satellite remote sensing technology, including satellite communication software and hardware, as well as its applications in Earth sciences, environmental management, agriculture, and urban planning. Through theoretical lectures, case studies, and practical exercises, students will gain an understanding of the principles of satellite remote sensing technology and its practical applications in various fields. The course emphasizes practical applications and problem-solving skills, providing labs for students to participate in satellite remote sensing projects and cultivate their operational skills and problem-solving abilities.

description.zh: 為什麼要閱讀或研究莎士比亞? Catherine Belsey 回答道：是為了莎翁的獨特性。如她所言：「莎士比亞不僅是英語世界上流社會文化的精華，亦為其整體文化的精髓。」因為莎劇的辭彙，迄今仍通用於英語世界，並已融入日常生活之結構中。這現象不僅發生在現在的英國，自莎翁的時代開始，莎翁的語彙在全世界就從未停止流通過。何況，莎翁震撼人心的詩歌和劇場藝術，無人出其右的人性掌握，以及非凡的人生哲學思維與洞見，向來受到世人的珍愛。如世人常謂：莎士比亞的語言可觸發我們的想像力，為我們在人生的各個層面(包括職業層面)提升溝通效率。為了這些重要的理由，本課程將引導學生欣賞莎士比亞的若干劇作。
description.en: Why Shakespeare? Catherine Belsey answers that it is because of his singularity. As she observes, "Shakespeare is part and parcel of English-speaking culture, and not only high culture." For "phrases from the plays are still current, woven into the fabric of everyday life" in Britain now and have, in fact, been circulated in the world since the early modern era. Besides, Shakespeare has been cherished for his powerful poetry and stagecraft, his nonpareil grasp of human nature, and his remarkable philosophical insights into life. As people often observe, Shakespeare may trigger our imagination with his language and promote effective communication in every aspect of our life, including that of our careers. For these important reasons, this course aims to guide students to appreciate Shakespeare by focusing on a number of his plays.

syllabi.outline:
如果英語作為第二語言（ESL）的學生要學習一位西方作家，那麼這位作家應該是莎士比亞。他是極少數既具有文化意義又自去世以來幾乎每個十年都廣受歡迎的作家之一。在二十一世紀，了解一些莎士比亞仍然是受過良好教育的標誌；這
不僅適用於西方人，也適用於世界公民（因為莎士比亞是世界文化的一部分，而不僅僅是英國或西方文化的一部分）。因此，除了為學生提供一些關於莎士比亞及其時代的基本背景知識外，本課程還將深入探討莎士比亞一些最著名戲劇中最著名的段落（例如，《羅密歐與茱麗葉》、《哈姆雷特》、《仲夏夜之夢》）。我們將探討莎士比亞在當今文化中的地位，既作為高雅文化的象徵，也作為流行文化（電影、電視、流行音樂）的常見素材來源。

If ESL students are going to study one Western author, then that author should be Shakespeare. He is one of the few writers who has been both culturally significant and also popular in virtually every decade since his death.  In the twenty-first century, knowing something about Shakespeare is still a sign that a person is well-educated; that is true not just of Westerners, but of citizens of the world (because Shakespeare is a part of world culture, not just British or Western culture).  So, in addition to providing students some basic background on Shakespeare and his times, this class will examine closely some of the most famous passages from some of the most well-known plays of Shakespeare (for example, Romeo and Juliet, Hamlet, A Midsummer Night’s Dream).  We will consider Shakespeare’s place in our culture today, both as a symbol of high culture and as a frequent source of material for popular culture (movies, tv, pop music).

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

syllabi.outline:
本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。

syllabi.outline:
本課程目標旨在提供學習者具有特殊教育概念，使能激起原有動機，願意獻身予特殊教育學生。
一、學習敏銳覺察社會環境對學生的學習影響，以利教育機會均等。
二、瞭解特殊需求學生的特質與鑑定歷程，以提供適切的教育與支持。
三、瞭解我國特殊教育的發展與趨勢，以及特殊教育相關法規。
四、能依據特殊需求學生學習特質，調整與設計課程教學內容。
五、能依據特殊需求學生學習特質，調整學生學習評量的方式。
六、能依據不同類型之特殊需求學生，提供適當的支持與輔導。
七、能遵照性別平等教育之教育原則，提供特殊需求學生適當課程內容。

授課方式:
一、課堂講授：講述基礎理論，並輔以教學現況的實例說明，增進理論理解。
二、課堂討論與分享：以問題導向學習法為教學方式，將實際教學的情況為主題，請學生以理論基礎設法提出解決方法。
三、分組報告與討論：以小組方式報告各組分配內容，報告後，由老師再詳加說明並請學生討論。
評量標準:
平時成績(含出席狀況)30%、分組報告30%、期末個人報告40%。

description.zh:
本課程的目標在培養學生瞭解教育與社會關係，從而能自教育的社會基礎理論觀點來從事教育決策，分析教育制度，探求教學原則，解決教育問題。 
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The object of this course is to introduce the students the understanding of the relationship between education and society. It presents the students with the relation between education and the main sociological theories, such as socialization, social structure, social change. It also offers students with the social condition of schools, the teacher's role, the teacher groups and the teacher's social status. After finishing this course, the students can use the knowledge learned from this course to make educational decision, analyze educational systems, study the instructional principles and solve educational problems in view of the basic theories of sociology of education, and thus lead to achieve the educational goal.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在協助學生探究教育社會學的理論與實務，探討主題包含:社會化、社會階層、教育機會均等、技職教育與社會發展等，並期學生運用相關論點對當前技職教育問題提出建議。

本課程擬培養之教師專業素養指標： 
1-2敏銳覺察社會環境對學生學習影響，以利教育機會均等。
2-1了解並尊重學生身心發展、社經及文化背景的差異，以作為教學與輔導的依據。
syllabi.assessment:
1.平時小考、課堂討論成績佔40﹪
2.教育社會學分組主題口頭及書面報告，佔60﹪。
3.依本校學則規定，未達出席次數不予通過。
syllabi.materials:
1.跨國灰姑娘：當東南亞幫傭遇上臺灣新富家庭。藍佩嘉，行人出版社。
2.窮忙族：新貧階級時代的來臨。門倉貴史，聯經。
3.發明疾病的人- 現代醫療產業如何賣掉我們的健康。Jorg Blech著。左岸。
4.三代同堂:迷思與陷阱。胡幼慧。高雄復文。
5.社區如何動起來？：黑珍珠之鄉的派系、在地師傅與社區總體營造。楊弘任，左岸文化。
6.有閒階級論。Thorstein Veblen箸。左岸文化。
7.嘉年華的誕生：慶典、舞會、演唱會、運動會如何翻轉全世界。左岸文化。
8.如果房子會說話：家居生活如何改變世界。左岸文化。
9.我在底層的生活：當專欄作家化身為女服務生。左岸文化。
10.失控的正向思考。左岸文化。
11.學校敢勇於建立新的社會秩序嗎？聯經。
12.意外多重奏：STS如何重組真相。行人出版社。
13.肯定多樣性-社會政治情境下的多元文化教育。Sonia Nieto著，濤石。
14. 父酬者：姓氏、階級與社會不流動。Gregory Clark著，時報。
15. 食物的全球經濟學：從一片披薩講起。衛城。
陸、主要閱讀資料
1.現代教育社會學。陳奎主編，師大書苑
2.教育社會學。台灣教育社會學學會主編，巨流。
3.批判的教育社會學研究。張建成著，學富出版社。
4.教育社會學：人物與思想。陳奎、張建成著。高等教育。
5.教育社會學。譚光鼎著。學富出版社。
6.巷仔口社會學。王宏仁等著。大家出版社。
7.老師提供之隨堂講義
柒、其他參考文獻
1.朱敬一講社會科學：社會科學的源起背景。時報。 
2.見樹又見林-社會學作為一種生活、實踐與承諾（Allen  G. Johnson著，成令方等譯）。群學。
3.社會學動動腦（Thinking Sociologically）（Zygmunt Bauman著，朱道凱譯），群學。
4.科技渴望社會。吳嘉苓、傅大為、雷祥麟主編。群學。
5.科技渴望性別。顧彩璿譯，吳嘉苓、傅大為、雷祥麟主編。群學。
6.人間社會學：24則關於溫拿、魯蛇、大小確幸的生命故事。群學。
7.社會階層、社會網絡與主觀意識。黃毅志著，巨流。
8.意識、權力與教育-教育社會學理論導讀。蘇峰山著，南華教社所出版。
9.社會學與台灣社會（精簡本）。瞿海源、王振寰主編。巨流。
10.社會資本（林南著），弘智出版社。
11.社會學大有用。葉欣怡箸，國立編譯館。
12.基督新教的倫理與資本主義的精神。M.Weber著。張漢裕譯。臺北：協志工業叢書
13.自殺論。Emile Durkheim箸。臺北:五南。 
14.資本社會中的社會流動與學校體系—批判教育社會學的分析，薑添輝著，高等教育出版社。
15.Sadovnik, Alan .R. (EDT) (2010). Sociology of Education. Taylor & Francis.
16.Ball, S. J. (Editor) (2001）.Sociology of Education: Major Themes. London: Rutledge Falmer.
17.Ballantine, J.H. (2001).The Sociology of Education (5th edition). New Jersey:Prentice-Hall.
18.Brian Simon（1991）. Education and the Social Order, 1940-1990. New York: St. Martin's Press.
19.Apple, M.W.（1990）.Ideology and Curriculum. New York：Routledge.
20.Bowles, S., & Guntis, H.（1976）.Schooling in Capitalist America. London：Routledge & Kegan Paul.（有中譯本）
21.Freire,P.(2004). EPZ pedagogy of hope: Reliving pedagogy of the oppressed . Bloomsbury USA Academic. （有中譯本）
22..Giroux, H. A.(1981).I deology Culture & the Process of Schooling. Temple University Press.
期刊類-台灣教育社會學（TSSCI）、教育與社會研究（南華大學）、台灣社會學刊（TSSCI）、台灣社會研究（TSSCI）

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline: This course is specifically designed for international students with no prior knowledge of Chinese. It aims to enhance students' listening, speaking, reading, and writing abilities in Chinese, enabling them to meet basic communication needs in daily life. The course begins with the Pinyin and Zhuyin systems to help students learn accurate pronunciation, gradually building practical vocabulary and sentence patterns for use in various conversational contexts. Additionally, the course incorporates a variety of activities to strengthen Chinese language skills, foster an understanding of and interest in Chinese culture, and lay a solid foundation for further Chinese learning.

description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.

2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

name.en: Introduction and lab of Electrical Equipment

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹常見電機設備與家用電器之基本構造、運作原理與系統架構，內容涵蓋電氣控制、馬達驅動、加熱元件、冷凍循環、電源轉換與基本保護機制等核心技術。透過理論講授與實例分析，使學生能將電路學、電子學與電機機械等基礎知識，應用於實際設備之功能解析與運作理解。課程將以常見電機設備（如電風扇、電鍋、吹風機、冰箱與分離式冷氣…等）為案例，說明其電氣系統構成與控制邏輯，並介紹常見故障型態與基本診斷概念，使學生建立設備系統化分析能力與安全操作觀念。本課程強調工程應用層面的設備理解與系統思維，培養學生對電機設備之整體認識與實務判讀能力，為未來從事設備維護、能源應用或機電整合相關領域奠定基礎。
description.en: This course introduces the fundamental structure, operating principles, and system architecture of common electrical appliances and electromechanical equipment. Topics include electrical control circuits, motor drives, heating elements, refrigeration cycles, power conversion, and basic protection mechanisms. Through lectures and case-based analysis, students will apply prior knowledge from Circuit Theory, Electronics, and Electrical Machinery to understand the functional operation and system integration of practical equipment. Representative appliances—such as electric fans, rice cookers, hair dryers, refrigerators, and split-type air conditioners—are used as study cases to illustrate electrical system configuration and control logic. The course also introduces common failure modes and fundamental diagnostic concepts, enabling students to develop systematic equipment analysis skills and safe operation awareness. Emphasizing engineering-oriented application and system-level thinking,

syllabi.outline:
隨著各類電機設備廣泛應用於家庭與產業環境，具備基本設備判讀與維修能力已成為電機工程學生的重要實務素養。本課程以常見電機設備為核心，結合理論基礎與實務操作，培養學生理解設備運作原理並進行基礎維修與故障診斷之能力。課程內容涵蓋電機設備基本構造與工作原理、電源與控制電路解析、常見馬達與驅動方式、加熱元件與溫控系統、冷凍循環基本概念、保護裝置與安全機制等主題。透過設備拆解示範、量測實習與案例分析，使學生能將電路學、電子學與電機機械之理論知識應用於實際設備判讀與維修實作。學生將學習使用基本量測工具（如三用電表、鉤錶等）進行導通測試、電壓量測與元件檢查，並理解常見故障型態（如電容失效、馬達異常、接點燒損、溫控失靈等）之判斷流程。課程強調安全操作規範與風險意識，使學生建立正確的工程實務態度。修習完成後，學生應具備分析常見電機設備運作機制、判讀基本故障原因與執行初階維修之能力，為未來從事設備維護、機電整合或技術服務工作奠定實務基礎。
With the widespread use of electrical appliances in both residential and industrial environments, possessing fundamental skills in equipment interpretation and maintenance has become an essential practical competency for electrical engineering students. This course focuses on common electrical appliances and integrates theoretical knowledge with hands-on practice to develop students’ abilities in understanding operational principles, performing basic maintenance, and conducting fault diagnosis. Course topics include appliance structure and operating principles, power supply and control circuit analysis, common motor types and drive methods, heating elements and temperature control systems, fundamentals of refrigeration cycles, and safety and protection mechanisms. Through equipment disassembly demonstrations, measurement exercises, and case-based analysis, students will apply knowledge from Circuit Theory, Electronics, and Electrical Machinery to practical equipment troubleshooting and repair tasks. Students will learn to use basic diagnostic tools such as multimeters and clamp meters to perform continuity tests, voltage measurements, and component inspections. Common failure modes—such as capacitor degradation, motor malfunction, contact damage, and thermostat failure—will be systematically analyzed. The course emphasizes safe operation practices and risk awareness to cultivate proper engineering professionalism. Upon completion, students are expected to be capable of analyzing the operational mechanisms of common electrical appliances, identifying basic fault causes, and performing entry-level maintenance tasks, thereby establishing a practical foundation for careers in equipment maintenance, mechatronics, or technical service engineering.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。 理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。
description.en:
This course aims to develop students’ competencies and action capabilities in addressing global sustainability issues. Integrating theory and practice, it enhances their sense of civic responsibility and social awareness. Based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the course adopts an interdisciplinary approach to explore the connections among environmental sustainability, social equity, and civic engagement. The course introduces key concepts of sustainable development, civic participation, and social innovation to strengthen students’ analytical and critical thinking skills. Through action-based projects and community engagement, students apply their knowledge to real-world sustainability challenges. Emphasizing “learning by doing” and reflective learning, the course also fosters teamwork, communication, and interdisciplinary integration, preparing students to become responsible and action-oriented global citizens.

name.en: Seminar on Monographic Study on Trade Secret Act and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 本課程主要以公平交易法與營業秘密法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；深入分析公平交易法與營業秘密法之內涵，進而個別探討公平交易法與營業秘密法等之智財權利行使的課題。
description.en: This course majors in the purpose, evolution, and development trend of legislation on the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, with an attempt to differentiate between the two Acts in respect of objects, approaches, and choice of law that the Acts apply to.  In this course, analyses are also made, in depth, on the essence of the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, together with discussion, respectively, on implementation of Intellectual Property Rights involved in the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act.

syllabi.outline: 本課程從中美貿易戰美方指控中國竊取營業秘密及強制技術移轉談起，再以我國營業秘密法與公平交易法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；除重視營業秘密法與公平交易法之基礎內涵外，將以國際比較法的視野，論述二法律與智權行使密切相關的課題，並輔以專題探討或案例分析的方式進行之。

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
第1週：介紹授課理念、課程綱要、上課方式與評分標準，並依多數同學需求進行調整---從中美貿易戰至台積電赴美、日設廠談營業秘密保護與強制技術授權及合作技術移轉。
第2週：營業秘密法與公平交易法的立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢。
第3週：營業秘密法的法理基礎。
第4週：營業秘密的標的、歸屬與應用（特以共同研究契約為例）。
第5週：營業秘密的侵害、保全程序、救濟與保護（台積電海外投資合作案之營秘保護、區塊鏈與營秘保護等）。
第6週：營業秘密與競業禁止（台積電跳巢案、美光科技挖角案、台積電2奈米技術外洩東京威力科創案）。
第7週：侵害營業秘密之刑事處罰（穩懋半導體公司營秘遭竊案、英業達公司營秘案、美光控訴聯電及中國晉華竊取半導體DRAM營秘案）。
第8週：侵害營業秘密之損害賠償（先進光賠償大立光15.22億元案）。
第9週：侵害營業秘密案件的審理與秘密保持命令。
第10週：公平交易法與智慧財產權法規範的對象、方法及競合。
第11週：公平交易法對獨占、結合及聯合行為之規範。
第12週：公平交易法對不公平競爭行為之規範。
第13週：違反公平交易法之民事、刑事及行政責任。
第14週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（警告函、高通案、維修權爭議）。
第15週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（標準必要專利〈SEP〉、公平及合理非歧視條款〈FRAND〉）。
第16週：公平交易法與商標權之行使（攀附著名商標、仿冒商標〈表徵〉）。
第17週：公平交易法與著作權之行使（資料庫保護、大數據分析、ChatGPT、生成式AI）。
第18週：兩岸及國際公平交易法與營業秘密之保護（資訊安全、ChatGPT使用、生成式AI應用、AI代理〈AI Agent〉及養龍蝦〈Open Claw〉）。

name.en: Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model (III)

description.zh: 本課程以我國智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為教材，介紹電腦軟體、醫藥、生物、中草藥之專利申請審查，以及新型專利形式審查和舉發審查。
description.en: The textbook of this course is "Patent Examination Guidelines" which is issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office. We will introduce the examination practice for special patent cases, such as computer software, medicine, biology, and Chinese herbal medicine. In addition, the examination of utility model patent and patent invalidation will also be discussed in this course.

name.zh: 科技發展與法律策略:案例研析二
name.en: Technology Development and Legal Strategy: Case Study(II)

description.zh: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
description.en: In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.

syllabi.outline:
In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play a vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore, this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 30% and in Chinese 70%, and the class materials are mainly in Chinese.

在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。事實上，本課程之進行，30%以英文講授、70%以中文講授，而且課堂教材以中文為主。

name.zh: 高科技專利取得與攻防
name.en: High Tech Patent Applications and Protections

description.zh: 高科技產業的專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出數十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利申請策略開始，告訴同學專利申請上常見的錯誤，如何以較低的成本取得、維護我國專利，並利用我國專利進行全球專利佈局。
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the high-tech industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent filing strategy, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

syllabi.outline: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用分析。

name.zh: 營業秘密法與公平交易法專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Monographic Study on Trade Secret Act and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 本課程主要以公平交易法與營業秘密法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；深入分析公平交易法與營業秘密法之內涵，進而個別探討公平交易法與營業秘密法等之智財權利行使的課題。
description.en: This course majors in the purpose, evolution, and development trend of legislation on the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, with an attempt to differentiate between the two Acts in respect of objects, approaches, and choice of law that the Acts apply to.  In this course, analyses are also made, in depth, on the essence of the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, together with discussion, respectively, on implementation of Intellectual Property Rights involved in the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act.

syllabi.outline: 本課程從中美貿易戰美方指控中國竊取營業秘密及強制技術移轉談起，再以我國營業秘密法與公平交易法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；除重視營業秘密法與公平交易法之基礎內涵外，將以國際比較法的視野，論述二法律與智權行使密切相關的課題，並輔以專題探討或案例分析的方式進行之。
syllabi.assessment:
平時成績(含出席率、提問及參與報告、討論之綜合表現)50％、期末報告50％

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
第1週：介紹授課理念、課程綱要、上課方式與評分標準，並依多數同學需求進行調整---從中美貿易戰至台積電赴美、日設廠談營業秘密保護與強制技術授權及合作技術移轉。
第2週：營業秘密法與公平交易法的立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢。
第3週：營業秘密法的法理基礎。
第4週：營業秘密的標的、歸屬與應用（特以共同研究契約為例）。
第5週：營業秘密的侵害、保全程序、救濟與保護（台積電海外投資合作案之營秘保護、區塊鏈與營秘保護等）。
第6週：營業秘密與競業禁止（台積電跳巢案、美光科技挖角案、台積電2奈米技術外洩東京威力科創案）。
第7週：侵害營業秘密之刑事處罰（穩懋半導體公司營秘遭竊案、英業達公司營秘案、美光控訴聯電及中國晉華竊取半導體DRAM營秘案）。
第8週：侵害營業秘密之損害賠償（先進光賠償大立光15.22億元案）。
第9週：侵害營業秘密案件的審理與秘密保持命令。
第10週：公平交易法與智慧財產權法規範的對象、方法及競合。
第11週：公平交易法對獨占、結合及聯合行為之規範。
第12週：公平交易法對不公平競爭行為之規範。
第13週：違反公平交易法之民事、刑事及行政責任。
第14週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（警告函、高通案、維修權爭議）。
第15週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（標準必要專利〈SEP〉、公平及合理非歧視條款〈FRAND〉）。
第16週：公平交易法與商標權之行使（攀附著名商標、仿冒商標〈表徵〉）。
第17週：公平交易法與著作權之行使（資料庫保護、大數據分析、ChatGPT、生成式AI）。
第18週：兩岸及國際公平交易法與營業秘密之保護（資訊安全、ChatGPT使用、生成式AI應用、AI代理〈AI Agent〉及養龍蝦〈Open Claw〉）。


※ 實際授課內容將依同學之興趣、程度，擇要或增修主題後進行之。

※ 本課程重視問題意識之引導及積極參與式的學習，1/2以上的主題將以案例探討及多元交流方式進行。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹專利檢索及專利地圖的觀念，課程包含以下兩部分：一、為什麼需要進行專利檢索以及如何有效率地找到相關前案，二、如何建構專利地圖及相關資訊的應用。
description.en: The concepts of patent search and patent map will be introduced in this course. The topics of the course includes: 1. Why it is important to do patent search. 2. How to find a related prior art efficiently, 3. How to construct a patent map and exploit related information.

description.zh: 本課程係接續美國專利法專題(I)之課程。本課程將以新近之美國專利爭訟案件為主，並佐以相關學者對於這些案件之觀點。修習完本課程之學生，除具分析美國專利案能力外，並具美國法律論文之閱讀與理解能力。
description.en: This course is the next course of the U.S. Patent Law Seminar (I). The content will focus on the recent issues on patents, as well as the scholars’ opinions on the issues. Students are expected to have the ability of analyzing of patent cases, as well as the reading of academic papers in law.

syllabi.outline: 本課程係接續美國專利法專題(I)之課程。除前一階段美國專利法的授予要件，於此階段課程將著重於專利侵權時的相關法規與案例。本階段課程，除仍需對美國專利案件閱讀外，並將增加對於外國學者的文獻閱讀。修習完本課程的同學，預計除可持續精進對美國專利案件的分析能力外，對於相關議題的學術文件，亦可於本學期中學習如何閱讀與撰寫學術討論報告之能力。修習本課程的同學，需於每次上課前，對於指定相關的案例與文獻自行閱讀，並於上課時參與問題之討論。

description.zh: 本課程旨在使學員掌握(1)併購法規架構、 (2)併購實務、 (3)併購英文，中長目標為：培育併購律師、法務長、財經法官。
description.en:
This course is to achieve the following purposes:
(1)	To understand the structure of M&A laws.
(2)	To be familiar with M&A practice.
(3)	To be fluent in M&A English
For the mid-long term goals, this course is to cultivate M&A lawyer, chief legal officer and financial-economic law judge.

syllabi.outline: This course provides a systematic study of the legal framework and professional practice of mergers and acquisitions (M&A). It examines the role of M&A in corporate growth, transaction structures and procedures, directors’ duties, hostile takeovers, takeover defenses, corporate control, tender offers, cross-border transactions, and post-acquisition issues.

description.zh: 系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
description.en: Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

name.en: Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering

description.zh: 衛星科技與工程導論的課程將介紹衛星系統及次系統基礎知識，以培養具有從事衛星任務設計之基礎能力。課程內容包括：衛星基本原理，衛星設計與製造，衛星運行與維護，衛星通訊與遙測應用，衛星發展趨勢。
description.en: The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" will introduce the basic knowledge of satellite systems and subsystems to cultivate the fundamental abilities needed for designing satellite missions. The course content includes: the basic principles of satellites, satellite design and manufacturing, satellite operation and maintenance, satellite communication and remote sensing applications, and satellite development trends.

syllabi.outline:
衛星科技與工程導論課程將介紹衛星系統及主要次系統的基礎知識，培養學生具備衛星任務設計與初步工程分析的能力。課程內容涵蓋：衛星基本原理、軌道力學、衛星結構與熱控設計、電源系統、遙測追蹤與控制（TT&C）系統、姿態決定與控制系統（ADCS）、小型衛星發展及未來衛星科技趨勢。
The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" introduces the basic knowledge of satellite systems and key subsystems to develop students' abilities in satellite mission design and preliminary engineering analysis. Course topics include: fundamental principles of satellites, orbital mechanics, satellite structure and thermal control design, power systems, Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) systems, Attitude Determination and Control Systems (ADCS), small satellite development, and future trends in satellite technology.
syllabi.assessment:
Class Activities	20%
Labs and Assignments	20%
Midterm Exam (Week 9)	30%

---
Class Activities
Include quizzes, in-class problem-solving, and participation in discussions.

Labs and Assignments
Are hands-on exercises based on TT&C and ADCS simulations as well as regular homework.

Midterm Exam
Will test theoretical knowledge and basic design/problem-solving skills.

Final Project Report
Will involve a comprehensive conceptual satellite system design, including subsystem selections, mission planning, and basic simulations.

課堂活動（Class Activities）
包含隨堂小考、課堂問題討論與解題練習，提升學生參與度與即時學習成效。

實驗與作業（Labs and Assignments）
涵蓋衛星遙測、追蹤與控制系統（TT&C）與姿態控制系統（ADCS）的模擬操作及定期作業，強化理論與實作能力。

期中考試（Midterm Exam）
評量學生對理論知識的掌握及基本設計與問題解決能力。

期末專題報告（Final Project Report）
要求學生完成一份全面性的概念衛星系統設計，內容包括次系統選擇、任務規劃及基礎模擬分析，培養系統整合與工程實踐能力。

name.zh: 深度學習與太空科技應用

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在介紹太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，並探討太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

description.zh: 本課程將包含使用者經驗設計的基礎，以及使用者研究量測的內涵及方法。本課程中，將透過課堂上課、討論、以及實習的方式，介紹使用者研究的實際案例、評估模式、團隊合作方法、設計與評估工具、實踐思維、挑戰、以及實際執行的程序。預期學生將於本課程中，透過分組獲得使用者經驗在互動設計、空間設計以及產品設計上，有關使用者研究的設計、評估、施行、以及質化與量化分析量測評估的知識與方法。
description.en: This course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design and product design individually.

syllabi.outline:
As the internet has grown and become pervasive in our lives, the world has gotten smaller. More and more, as consumers, we can share our experiences. For a company, great experiences can be a competitive advantage. They can keep your customers loyal and turn them into your biggest cheerleaders. On the flip side, terrible experiences can stop you in your tracks very quickly. No one wants to be that company being talked about for all the wrong reasons. Building great user experiences requires listening and empathy. In this course, you’ll learn the tools and techniques to make your design/products delightful for users.
This course is an introduction to User Experience with a focus on Space, Product, and Interaction Design. Students create a complete UX brief, from ideation to annotated wireframes that could be handed off to a developer to be built. They will also learn to conduct the research necessary and create all the supporting documentation required to defend their design decisions. There is a large focus on how to dissect and analyze common design patterns.
This class is an interdisciplinary integration course. The majority of students are design college students looking to transition their skills into digital, or product managers looking to improve their design skills. Other students often include engineers who want to learn how to make their design/products more usable and entrepreneurs looking to build out the user experience for their idea.
Overall, this course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models, and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing, and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing, and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design, and product design individually

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

syllabi.assessment:
1.	Attendance 20%
2.	Participation 30%
Each participant needs to prepare a brief introduction to the (non-architectural) social background of one cultural period of time. This will be the tuned in of the class of the day for 20 minutes.
(Week 02) Dutch and Spanish Empires in the 17th Century (relationship with the world)	(Week 02) 17th. C. to 19th. C. China (relationship with the rest of the world)
(Week 04) Japan before 1895 (westernization)	(Week 05) Japanese colonial power in Taiwan and China 
(Week 10) social background in the first half of the 20th-century China	(Week 11) ideology of Chinese origin before and after 1945 (1940s to 1960s in Taiwan)
(Week 12) global modernist architecture esp. after WWII 	(Week 13) Japanese architecture after WWII
(Week 14) global trends of architectural regionalism 	(Week 15) from postmodern architecture to Deconstructivism in the world
3.	Mid-term presentation: proposal for the final report 20%
In the first half of the courses, students have to outline their interests of Taiwanese architecture in specific approaches. They might be architectural styles (ex., Regionalism, modernism, etc.), structural systems, materials (ex., Brick, RC, etc.), particular types of architecture, one or two individual architects, etc. Students should present their plans for their final reports in the mid-term class for about 10 minutes in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and the class instructor for further development to achieve the final report.
4.	Research thesis 30%
One should present his/her research in 10 minutes on 12/24, and submit the thesis by 12/31 12:00 pm to Dr. Wu. The thesis should not be less than 5000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) with clear references of the contents instead of brief presentation format (powerpoint). The final report should present the development and influences from the past to the present (or particular period).

description.zh:
1. 授課目的：  現代都市計劃及都市設計作業內容中，必須考量都市永續環境生態之議題。本課程之目的即在於傳述都市之生態概念在規劃實務上之應用，並探討其作業技術內容及其行政程序，以培養學生永續都市及敷地計畫規劃能力。

2. 授課內容：  由基本永續都市中，思考生態環境、人類生活環境及建築之間的相互關係。綠建築、永續都市之內容。引介各項生態技術原理及其指標講授，進而指導實證操作技術實驗並撰寫論文，再而論證其都計管制規範。

3. 作業練習：  本學期藉由實驗操作、論文報告撰寫，特別著重研討式論辯，訓練學術思辯及技術應用規劃能力，以利學生認識都市生態技術及都計行政作業之整體關聯性，進而建立其全方位規劃思辯能力。

description.zh:
國際能源署(IEA)呼籲全球國家訂定淨零碳排路徑，國內也啟動淨零目標期程與行動方案，針對建築部門，建築能效評估系統(Building energy efficiency rating system, TBERS)為因應亞熱帶氣候與空間複合化、多樣化建築特性所量身訂做的簡易有效評估工具。為使學生培養永續淨零概念並具備建築能效評估計算、評分與標示之技術能力，具體目標如下:。
1.了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略
2.評估新建建築、既有建築能效等級
3.操作新建建築、既有建築之近零設計策略
4.綜合分析與歸納建築能效機制
description.en:
IEA (The International Energy Agency) proposes to set a global net carbon emission roadmap, and domestically launch a net target and action plan, targeting the building sector, the Building Energy Efficiency Rating System (TBERS) a simple and effective assessment tool tailored for subtropical climate and spatial complex and diverse building characteristics. This course aims at develop the concept of sustainable net zero and have the technical ability of building energy efficiency assessment calculation, scoring and marking, the specific goals are as follows:
1. Understand domestic and foreign net zero carbon emission path strategies
2. Evaluate the energy efficiency rating of new buildings and existing buildings
3. Operate the nearly-zero design strategy of new buildings and existing buildings
4. Conclude the analysis and induction of building energy efficiency mechanism

description.zh: 本課程以都市再生理念為中心，講述推動都市再生過程中面對相關文化資產保存議題之理論與實際操作架構。第一部份探討歷史文化保存相關理念手法。第二部份探討各國文化保存再生案例實踐之相關課題與借鏡，第三部份針對台灣本土都市更新過程中面臨歷史文化保存議題深入研討。
description.en:
This course regards urban revitalization as the central concept to discuss about the theory & implementation of history & culture conservation issues of urban revitalization. This course consisted of three parts. 
The first part is considered of relevant concepts & strategies of history and culture conservation. The second part is to survey different implemented examples of history and culture conservation of different country. The third part involves the regional issues by local-oriented issues of Taiwan. A few of cultural conservation topics are introduced to be further interpreted.

第18週：四人組成一組，製作一個7分鐘的簡報。簡報內容從每個人在基地裡面發現的環境問題與潛力為起點，思考可以達到環境修復、生態復育、生態保育等環境生態設計之可行方案。尋找國內外案例並進行分析，使用手繪、拼貼、或AI生成等任意方式來呈現概念性圖說，用於說明案例中的設計手法可以如何應用，以解決基地的問題或發揮其潛力。
extra.學習成果: 第16週以前繳交VLOG；第18週以前繳交簡報檔案。
extra.評量比例: 第17週VLOG：25%；第18週簡報：25%

description.zh: 聯合國教科文組織於1972年通過了《世界遺產公約》，旨在保護世界文化和自然遺產，並將保護和保存文化財產的概念連結起來。五十年來，世界遺產經歷多次變革，觀念與行動與時俱進，1992年，文化景觀概念正式確立，承認人與環境的相互作用和共生關係，縫合了長街以來自然和文化的割裂。2001年，全球文化多樣性宣言的通過，文化在不同時代和不同地方具有各種不同的表現形式，這種多樣性的具體表現，構成人類各群體和各社會具有的獨特性和多樣化。受此影響，文化景觀、無形遺產、水下遺產、產業遺產、文化路徑、聖山遺產、天文遺產紛紛出現。本課程屬建築保存應用課程，將介紹不同主題的世界遺產案例，其目的除了引領同學認識世界遺產觀念及思潮變遷外，亦對國內文化資產保存的學習有所啟發與反省。

Heritage is our legacy from the past, what we live with today, and what we pass on to future generations. Our cultural and natural heritage are both irreplaceable sources of life and inspiration. UNESCO adopted the World Heritage Convention in 1972 to protect world cultural and natural heritage and link the concepts of protection and preservation of cultural property. Over the past fifty years, World Heritage has undergone many changes, and concepts and actions have kept pace with the times. In 1992, the concept of cultural landscape was formally established, recognizing the interaction and symbiotic relationship between people and the environment, and sewing up the separation between nature and culture since the Long Street. In 2001, the Global Declaration on Cultural Diversity was adopted. Culture has different forms of expression in different times and places. The specific manifestations of this diversity constitute the uniqueness and diversity of various human groups and societies.

description.zh: 本課程主要為介紹與歷史建築與古蹟之保存與再利用相關的觀念、理論、技術與發展概況，授課採講演方式。
description.en: This module introduces primarily the involved concept, theory, technique and the general conditions of its development. Class will be conducted by lecturing.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為建築史專題的進階課程。上課方式以演講為主，輔以課後調查實作，與古蹟修復實例的參觀，藉由保存理論、實際案例的介紹，概述建築保存論述下的實踐課題。一方面介紹國外近年有關歷史建築的保存與再利用觀念，另一方面則以本地近期案例的討論，期使同學對建築史的理論與實踐有一初步的概念，並培養其對身處環境的關心與文化涵養。
syllabi.assessment:
1.平時分數：20﹪，每堂課自動簽到，超過三次未到，平實分數不計。
2.期中報告：40﹪，上課同學以一、二人分組，選擇一國內歷史建築案例（非指定古蹟與登錄之歷史建築），進行資料蒐集、整理與報告，加以價值鑑定、評估，並為其填寫歷史建築調查表格（表格請上文建會或各文化局網站下載）。
3.期末報告：40﹪，每位同學任選最近二年內，國內再利用建築案例進行實地參觀，並撰寫心得報告（切勿引用他人文章或擷取網頁圖片，違者零分計算）。
4.報告格式：電腦打字，A4（橫式書寫，不用製作封面，報告書於報告時一併繳交。請於第一頁清楚標示你的名字，另繳交電腦檔案。
5.成績計算：遲交一天（隔天PM6:00）分數90﹪，遲交二天分數80﹪，依此類推；遲交一週50﹪（隔週PM6:00），其餘不予計分。

description.zh: 本課程介紹自二十世紀開始重要建築事件與作品的演變。從現代主義、粗獷主義、後現代建築到各種回應時代性的的建築思潮的發展，每週選定一個主題說明之。
description.en: The course introduces critical architectural agendas, events, and projects after 1900, from modernism, brutalism, and postmodern architecture to the development of various architectural trends that respond to the times. Each week, the course will select one topic to explain and discuss.

description.zh: 本課程預計透過專題式學習與案例分析調研，帶領學生盤點社區議題並研擬對策，建構城鄉空間的形成與社會族群的關係，並進行城鄉空間再造的提案。
description.en: This course is aimed to involve the students into the project of University Social Responsibility. By means of inventory on issues in communities and through project-based learning, this course will provide students an opportunity to understand the relationship between formation of urban spaces and social groups, then to draft a social plan, a facility plan or even a strategic guidance for further execution. From urban space reconstruction to place-making (regional revitalization), the students are expected to explore the diverse values of architectural profession and to practice the social responsibility by applying their expertise to solve real-world problems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程預計結合本校USR大學社會責任實踐計畫，透過專題式學習與案例分析調研，帶領學生盤點社區議題並研擬對策，建構城鄉空間的形成與社會族群的關係，並進行城鄉空間再造的提案，包括：社會計畫、設施計畫、營造計畫、執行措施等階段工作內容，並著手進行計畫實踐之實務操作等。從城市中的空間變革到地方創生，強化學生對建築專業之社會實踐/社會責任的體認，以期培養學生博雅的品格，開拓生命視野。

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生提升對全球永續發展目標（SDGs）及當前全球性議題的理解，並能夠用英文進行有效的溝通與表達。學生將學會如何以英文探討全球性問題，如貧窮、氣候變遷、性別平等等，並能在學術、專業及公共討論中自信地發表意見。

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

syllabi.outline:
ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh: 本課程將從整體產業概況出發，引導學生了解該產業的發展脈絡、市場動態等，並探討產業內的核心專業術語與表達方式。本課程旨在引導學生深入探索特定產業領域的英語應用，使其不僅能掌握專業術語，更能靈活運用於實際職場情境中。學生將逐步提升閱讀、寫作、聽力及口語表達能力，並培養跨文化溝通的敏銳度，以期在未來的國際職場中，自信且流暢地運用英語進行專業交流。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the specific industry, starting with an overview of the industry's landscape, including its development history and market dynamics. It will also delve into the core professional terminology and expressions used within the industry. The primary goal is to guide students in applying English effectively within their chosen industry, ensuring they not only grasp the technical vocabulary but can also utilize it confidently in real-world professional contexts. Students will progressively enhance their reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills, while also developing a keen awareness of cross-cultural communication. name.en: Advanced English for Information Technology I

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調工程專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.
syllabi.assessment:
Attendance and participation: 20%. Students are expected to attend class regularly and participate actively in pair work, group discussion, textbook activities, BESTEP-style tasks, and speaking practice.

Vocabulary, reading, listening, and in-class exercises: 25%. Students will complete textbook-based vocabulary exercises, reading and listening tasks, grammar practice, and visual-information activities involving tables, charts, graphs, and diagrams.

Homework and preparation: 20%. Assignments may include vocabulary review, short reading responses, listening notes, data description practice, short recordings, paragraph writing, and preparation for discussions or presentations.

Midterm assessment: 15%. The midterm assessment will be based on Units 1–3 and may include reading comprehension, technology-related vocabulary, numerical data description, and a short oral or written task.

Final assessment: 20%. The final assessment may include a short presentation and a written response based on an information technology topic. Students will be evaluated on clarity, organization, accuracy, appropriate use of technology-related vocabulary, and ability to explain textual and visual information.

內容 Content: 第17至18週安排學生完成「英文口說影片期末呈現」之彈性學習任務。學生以小組為單位，透過線上討論進行主題確認、資料整理、內容分工、英文講稿撰寫與口說排練，並製作 annotated outline 與完整 script。學生可運用AI工具輔助主題發想、英文修訂、口說練習與簡報內容優化，但須保留個人與小組的原創表達。教師將以遠距方式提供任務說明、範例、檢核表與必要回饋。

時數 Hours: 4

學習成果 Learning Outcomes: 學生須繳交英文口說影片、annotated outline 及完整 script。學習成效將依據內容組織、英文表達、口說流暢度、主題掌握、AI工具使用情形、團隊分工與影片完成度進行評量。

評量比例 Assessment Percentage: 25%

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
The following schedule may be adjusted according to students’ learning needs, actual teaching progress, class performance, and the university calendar.

Week 1: Course orientation; introduction to professional English for information and new technology; diagnostic speaking and writing activity.

Week 2: Unit 1 Big Data — Introduction to big data, data use, and technology-related vocabulary; discussion: What is big data and how do we use it?

Week 3: Unit 1 — Reading and listening practice on types of big data and their uses; speaking task: explaining one example of data use in daily life or industry.

Week 4: BESTEP skill focus — posters, flyers, and maps; summarizing and responding to visual information in English.

Week 5: Unit 2 Artificial Intelligence — Human, animal, and non-biological intelligence; reading and discussion on artificial intelligence.

Week 6: Unit 2 — Uses of AI; speaking task: discussing an AI-driven technology; writing task: describing the benefits and risks of an AI application.

Week 7: BESTEP skill focus — tables and numerical data; reporting common numbers, describing data, and comparing figures in English.

Week 8: Unit 3 Robotics — Robotics and improving human life; reading and discussion on the history and development of robotics.

Week 9: Midterm Exam Week — Midterm assessment based on Units 1–3 and BESTEP-related skills, including reading comprehension, vocabulary, data description, and a short speaking or writing task.

Week 10: Unit 3 — Advances in robotics; listening and speaking task: explaining the function of a programmable robot or robotic system.

Week 11: BESTEP skill focus — pie charts and bar charts; presenting survey results, describing proportions, and comparing responses from different groups.

Week 12: Unit 4 Hackers and Internet Security — Introduction to internet security, hackers, ransomware, and online safety.

Week 13: Unit 4 — Good and bad hackers; discussion and writing task: explaining a computer security problem and proposing possible solutions.

Week 14: Unit 5 Problem Solving — Identifying and solving problems; reading and discussion on facing uncertainties and making positive changes.

Week 15: BESTEP skill focus — flowcharts and process description; explaining a problem-solving process step by step.

Week 16: Unit 6 DNA Testing and Family History — DNA research, DNA testing, and personal information; discussion: How important is a person’s DNA?

Week 17: Unit 6 — A DNA test; writing workshop: explaining advantages, disadvantages, and ethical concerns related to DNA testing or personal data.

Week 18: Final assessment — short oral presentation and written response based on an information technology topic with one visual aid, such as a table, chart, graph, diagram, or flowchart; course reflection.

name.en: English for Business Meetings and Presentations I

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
description.en: This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.

description.zh: 本課程將從整體產業概況出發，引導學生了解該產業的發展脈絡、市場動態等，並探討產業內的核心專業術語與表達方式。本課程旨在引導學生深入探索特定產業領域的英語應用，使其不僅能掌握專業術語，更能靈活運用於實際職場情境中。學生將逐步提升閱讀、寫作、聽力及口語表達能力，並培養跨文化溝通的敏銳度，以期在未來的國際職場中，自信且流暢地運用英語進行專業交流。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the specific industry, starting with an overview of the industry's landscape, including its development history and market dynamics. It will also delve into the core professional terminology and expressions used within the industry. The primary goal is to guide students in applying English effectively within their chosen industry, ensuring they not only grasp the technical vocabulary but can also utilize it confidently in real-world professional contexts. Students will progressively enhance their reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills, while also developing a keen awareness of cross-cultural communication. This will enable them to engage in professional exchanges confidently and fluently in future international workplaces.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調工程專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.
syllabi.assessment:
Attendance and participation: 20%. Students are expected to attend class regularly and participate actively in pair work, group discussion, textbook activities, BESTEP-style tasks, and speaking practice.

Vocabulary, reading, listening, and in-class exercises: 25%. Students will complete textbook-based vocabulary exercises, reading and listening tasks, grammar practice, and visual-information activities involving tables, charts, graphs, and diagrams.

Homework and preparation: 20%. Assignments may include vocabulary review, short reading responses, listening notes, data description practice, short recordings, paragraph writing, and preparation for discussions or presentations.

Midterm assessment: 15%. The midterm assessment will be based on Units 1–3 and may include reading comprehension, technology-related vocabulary, numerical data description, and a short oral or written task.

Final assessment: 20%. The final assessment may include a short presentation and a written response based on an information technology topic. Students will be evaluated on clarity, organization, accuracy, appropriate use of technology-related vocabulary, and ability to explain textual and visual information.

Supplementary materials may include instructor-designed worksheets, vocabulary lists, speaking task sheets, writing templates, chart-description exercises, short readings, assessment rubrics, and selected online or classroom materials.

內容 Content: 第17至18週安排學生完成「英文口說影片期末呈現」之彈性學習任務。學生以小組為單位，透過線上討論進行主題確認、資料整理、內容分工、英文講稿撰寫與口說排練，並製作 annotated outline 與完整 script。學生可運用AI工具輔助主題發想、英文修訂、口說練習與簡報內容優化，但須保留個人與小組的原創表達。教師將以遠距方式提供任務說明、範例、檢核表與必要回饋。

時數 Hours: 4

學習成果 Learning Outcomes: 學生須繳交英文口說影片、annotated outline 及完整 script。學習成效將依據內容組織、英文表達、口說流暢度、主題掌握、AI工具使用情形、團隊分工與影片完成度進行評量。

評量比例 Assessment Percentage: 25%

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
The following schedule may be adjusted according to students’ learning needs, actual teaching progress, class performance, and the university calendar.

Week 1: Course orientation; introduction to professional English for information and new technology; diagnostic speaking and writing activity.

Week 2: Unit 1 Big Data — Introduction to big data, data use, and technology-related vocabulary; discussion: What is big data and how do we use it?

Week 3: Unit 1 — Reading and listening practice on types of big data and their uses; speaking task: explaining one example of data use in daily life or industry.

Week 4: BESTEP skill focus — posters, flyers, and maps; summarizing and responding to visual information in English.

Week 5: Unit 2 Artificial Intelligence — Human, animal, and non-biological intelligence; reading and discussion on artificial intelligence.

Week 6: Unit 2 — Uses of AI; speaking task: discussing an AI-driven technology; writing task: describing the benefits and risks of an AI application.

Week 7: BESTEP skill focus — tables and numerical data; reporting common numbers, describing data, and comparing figures in English.

Week 8: Unit 3 Robotics — Robotics and improving human life; reading and discussion on the history and development of robotics.

Week 9: Midterm Exam Week — Midterm assessment based on Units 1–3 and BESTEP-related skills, including reading comprehension, vocabulary, data description, and a short speaking or writing task.

Week 10: Unit 3 — Advances in robotics; listening and speaking task: explaining the function of a programmable robot or robotic system.

Week 11: BESTEP skill focus — pie charts and bar charts; presenting survey results, describing proportions, and comparing responses from different groups.

Week 12: Unit 4 Hackers and Internet Security — Introduction to internet security, hackers, ransomware, and online safety.

Week 13: Unit 4 — Good and bad hackers; discussion and writing task: explaining a computer security problem and proposing possible solutions.

Week 14: Unit 5 Problem Solving — Identifying and solving problems; reading and discussion on facing uncertainties and making positive changes.

Week 15: BESTEP skill focus — flowcharts and process description; explaining a problem-solving process step by step.

Week 16: Unit 6 DNA Testing and Family History — DNA research, DNA testing, and personal information; discussion: How important is a person’s DNA?

Week 17: Unit 6 — A DNA test; writing workshop: explaining advantages, disadvantages, and ethical concerns related to DNA testing or personal data.

Week 18: Final assessment — short oral presentation and written response based on an information technology topic with one visual aid, such as a table, chart, graph, diagram, or flowchart; course reflection.

name.en: Advanced English for Academic Oral Reports and Presentations I

description.zh: 本課程旨在進一步提升學生於學術會議與研討場合中以英語進行口頭報告、簡報發表及互動應對之能力。課程聚焦學術會議常見之發表形式，包括論文口頭發表、海報發表、研究摘要說明、短講及問答交流，並著重學術口語論述之組織、研究重點之清楚傳達、論點整合、聽眾互動與現場應答技巧。透過會議情境模擬、口頭報告、海報發表演練與回應活動，學生將強化其學術英語口語表達、簡報呈現與會議溝通能力，並建立參與國際學術交流之實務基礎。
description.en: This course aims to further develop students’ ability to deliver oral reports, conference presentations, and academic briefings in English in conference and seminar settings. It focuses on common forms of academic conference communication, including paper presentations, poster sessions, research summaries, short talks, and question-and-answer exchanges. Special emphasis is placed on organizing academic oral discourse, presenting research clearly, integrating key arguments, engaging with audiences, and responding effectively in live academic settings. Through conference simulations, oral presentation practice, poster presentation tasks, and response activities, students will strengthen their spoken academic English, presentation delivery, and conference communication skills, building a practical foundation for participation in international academic events.

name.en: Advanced English for Popular Culture I

description.zh: 本課程旨在進一步提升學生以英語分析、比較與討論流行文化議題之能力，並深化其對當代文化產業與跨文化傳播的理解。課程內容涵蓋全球流行趨勢、影視與數位媒體、運動與娛樂文化、粉絲文化、名人與網紅現象、品牌與消費文化，以及青年文化與社群互動等主題，並探討流行文化與身分認同、媒體再現、商業化及全球文化流動之關聯。透過議題討論、案例分析、口頭報告、比較評論與主題簡報等活動，學生將提升英語分析與論述能力，並培養對流行文化現象之批判思考與跨文化視野。
description.en: This course further develops students’ ability to analyze, compare, and discuss issues in popular culture in English while deepening their understanding of contemporary cultural industries and cross-cultural communication. Topics include global popular trends, film and digital media, sports and entertainment culture, fan culture, celebrity and influence culture, branding and consumer culture, and youth culture in online and social spaces. Students will also explore the relationship between popular culture and identity, media representation, commercialization, and global cultural flows. Through issue-based discussion, case analysis, oral reports, comparative commentary, and thematic presentations, students will strengthen their English analytical and expressive abilities while developing critical perspectives on popular culture and its broader social and cultural impact.

syllabi.outline:
與科學、經濟學和文學等高雅文化學科相比，流行文化（電影、電視節目、流行歌曲）似乎不那麼重要。但流行文化是教育和常識的重要組成部分，尤其對於那些希望成為世界公民、與外國人交流並環遊世界的第二語言學習者更是如此。對於英語作為第二語言（ESL）的學生來說，了解大眾文化並能自如地談論成年人喜歡談論的話題至關重要，而不僅限於研究實驗室和商務會議室。在本課程中，學生將透過閱讀有關流行文化的新聞文章和嚴肅探討流行文化的學術論文，培養批判性思維，並練習基本的英語技能和詞彙；當然，他們還將深入研究各種流行文化文本（例如電影、電視節目和流行歌曲）。

Compared to high culture subjects like science, economics, and literature, popular culture (movies, tv shows, pop songs) may seem less important.  But pop culture is a significant part of education and general knowledge, especially for second-language students who want to be citizens of the world, interacting with foreigners and traveling around the world.  It is important for ESL students to know about general culture and be comfortable talking about topics that adults like to talk about, outside of research labs and business meeting rooms.  In this class students will develop their critical thinking and will practice their basic English skills and vocabulary by reading news articles about popular culture and academic essays that take popular culture seriously; as well as, of course, by studying closely a variety of pop cultural texts (such as movies, tv shows, and pop songs).

description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生閱讀理解、字彙建構、以及語言解析能力。教材著重於科學、科技以及工程方面的文章，並藉由課堂延展活動增進學生於科學、科技以及工程領域的英語能力。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. description.zh: 本課程將從整體產業概況出發，引導學生了解該產業的發展脈絡、市場動態等，並探討產業內的核心專業術語與表達方式。本課程旨在引導學生深入探索特定產業領域的英語應用，使其不僅能掌握專業術語，更能靈活運用於實際職場情境中。學生將逐步提升閱讀、寫作、聽力及口語表達能力，並培養跨文化溝通的敏銳度，以期在未來的國際職場中，自信且流暢地運用英語進行專業交流。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the specific industry, starting with an overview of the industry's landscape, including its development history and market dynamics. It will also delve into the core professional terminology and expressions used within the industry. The primary goal is to guide students in applying English effectively within their chosen industry, ensuring they not only grasp the technical vocabulary but can also utilize it confidently in real-world professional contexts. Students will progressively enhance their reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills, while also developing a keen awareness of cross-cultural communication. This will enable them to engage in professional exchanges confidently and fluently in future international workplaces.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

name.zh: 商業英文會議與簡報(一)
name.en: English for Business Meetings and Presentations I

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
description.en: This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.
