description.zh: 以案例解析為主的方式，探究我國著作權法的重要課題，藉以協助同學了解審判實務適用法律的依據、判準或論證等，並適時補充國外相關學理、判決及著名案例等，以增進同學對國內外相關重要著作權案例之思辨及評析的能力。
description.en: This is a course focused on case analyses, in studying important issues relating to Taiwanese Copyright Act. Graduate students joining this course may find help on comprehension of the basis, rules or argumentation to the laws applied in trial practice.  Together with timely supplementation of relevant foreign academic interpretations, adjudications and noted cases, students may improve their ability of contemplation and analysis on related and significant copyright cases home and abroad.

syllabi.outline: 為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，促進國家文化發展，國家特制定著作權法；本課程重心在於介紹我國著作權法之內涵，包含該法所保護之「著作」範圍、權利人及著作權範圍、著作權管理及權利侵害之救濟等，除講授理論外，同時搭配案例解析，以期讓同學對著作權法有最完整之了解。
syllabi.assessment:
本課程除由教師講解著作權法基本觀念之外.主要採取以下上課方式：1.分組挑選各行業運用著作權之案例報告2.指定文獻閱讀討論(中文及英文)3.個案討論（法院判決.行政含釋.新聞時事）等方式就著作權法相關重要議題進行綜合研討.並需於期末繳交教師指定研究主題之書面報告.

description.zh: 組織行為是採用分析的方法，了解研究解個體行為在個人、團體、組織三個層次中的行為表現，並應用相關學理知識提高組織效能，尤其將焦點放在如何提高員工的生產力、降低離職率與曠職率，增加滿意度等四個變項上。
description.en: Organizational behavior (OB) is a field of research that investigates the impact that individuals, groups, and structure have on behavior within an organization, and then it applies that knowledge to make organizations work more effectively.  Specifically, OB focuses on how to improve productivity, reduce absenteeism and turnover, and increase employee citizenship and job satisfaction.

name.zh: 教育訓練實施與績效評鑑

description.zh: 為了使訓練資源的更有效運用，本課程希望讓學生了解，企業內部在實施訓練之前，應客觀、嚴謹的加以評估，並追蹤其實施後的成效，以正確評估訓練的效益。
description.en: To make better use of the training resources, the curriculum expects to make students understand that any enterprise should objectively and carefully evaluate the training program before its employment, and keep track of its effect after its employment to make sure the effectiveness of the training program.

syllabi.outline: In this course, students will gain a conceptual and practical understanding of program evaluation as a problem of causal inference under measurement error. Because every evaluation makes a causal claim about a construct that is not directly observed—knowledge, skill, transfer, performance—students will learn why measurement error is the central threat to a credible evaluation and how the latent-variable (structural equation modeling) framework addresses it. The first half builds the measurement and structural machinery; the second half re-examines the standard impact-evaluation designs (randomized assignment, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, difference-in-differences, matching) as special cases of a structural model, making explicit where each one assumes the outcome is measured without error and what to do when it is not. Students will gain practical experience specifying, estimating, and interpreting these models, and judging what an evaluation's findings can and cannot support.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Overview of the course; program evaluation as a causal claim about an unobserved construct

Week 2: Causality and causal models

Week 3: Structural models with observed variables: regression and path analysis

Week 4: The consequences of measurement error: attenuation, bias, and reliability

Week 5: Measurement models: the relation between latent and observed variables 

Week 6: Confirmatory factor analysis

Week 7: Measurement invariance across groups and over time

Week 8: The general model: measurement and structure combined

Week 9: Mid-term

Week 10: Causal inference and counterfactuals (I): potential outcomes and structural causal models

Week 11: Causal inference and counterfactuals (II): confounding and latent confounders

Week 12: Randomized assignment (I): the RCT benchmark and the latent outcome

Week 13: Randomized assignment (II): pre/post designs and latent change models

Week 14: Instrumental variables and model-implied instrumental variables (MIIV-2SLS)

Week 15: Regression discontinuity design with measurement error in the running variable

Week 16: Difference-in-differences and longitudinal measurement invariance

Week 17: Matching and propensity scores with error-laden covariates

Week 18: Final

本課程以週期化訓練為核心概念，結合理論講授與實務操作，並透過課程週次的負荷調整與運動內容變化進行教學與運動訓練。本課程要求學生具有健身的熱誠，並能夠配合課堂要求在高度運動參與的情境中，實際體驗訓練刺激、適應與調整的運動。
This course is centered on the concept of periodized training, integrating theoretical instruction with practical application. Teaching and training are conducted through systematic adjustments of training load and variations in exercise content across the course schedule. Students enrolled in this course are expected to demonstrate a strong interest in fitness training and to actively engage in high levels of physical participation. Through this immersive training environment, students will directly experience the processes of training stimulus, physiological adaptation, and planned adjustment.

本課程旨在協助學生學習撞球各項基本技巧，並學習球場禮儀及比賽規則。且在有效的學習過程中獲得成就感，同時達到鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
教學目標：
1. 學習正確撞球基本技巧，避動作錯誤造成運動傷害。 
2. 學會欣賞撞球運動賽事，提升對於此項目之興趣。
3. 了解撞球運動的基本規則與禮儀。
4. 培養規律運動習慣，進而達到強身體魄之效果。
5. 培養團隊合作與運動家的精神。

name.zh: 機器學習與量化交易實務
name.en: Machine Learning and Quantitative Trading Practices

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生深入探討機器學習在量化交易與系統性投資策略中的應用。課程內容以嚴謹的數據工程為基礎，教授學生如何處理高頻市場數據（Market Data）與另類數據（Alternative Data，如新聞情緒與社群文本），並從中萃取具備預測力的Alpha 因子。課程前期將著重於特徵工程（Feature Engineering）與金融時間序列的交叉驗證方法（如 Purged Cross-Validation），確保模型在時間序列上的穩健性。中期將系統性地介紹多種預測模型，包含樹狀集成模型（Random Forest, LightGBM）以及深度學習架構（CNN, RNN/LSTM），並探討其在資產定價與波動率預測上的應用。後期則著重於投資組合最佳化與嚴格的策略回測，引導學生使用 Python 生態系（如 Zipline, Alphalens, Pyfolio）評估策略的風險調整後報酬（例如夏普比率與最大回撤）。期末專題要求學生分組實作一個完整的端到端（End-to-End）量化交易策略。
description.en: This course explores the application of machine learning in algorithmic trading and systematic investment strategies. Grounded in rigorous data engineering, it teaches students to process market and alternative data (e.g., news sentiment) to extract predictive Alpha factors.The first half focuses on feature engineering and financial time-series cross-validation (e.g., Purged CV) to ensure model robustness. The second half systematically introduces various predictive models, including tree-based ensembles (Random Forest, LightGBM) and deep learning architectures (CNN, RNN/LSTM), applied to asset pricing and volatility prediction. Finally, the course covers portfolio optimization and rigorous backtesting. Students will use the Python ecosystem (Zipline, Alphalens, Pyfolio) to evaluate risk-adjusted performance metrics. The course culminates in a final project where students develop an end-to-end quantitative trading strategy.

syllabi.assessment:
課堂參與 / Class Participation (20%) 包含出席率、課堂互動探討與問答表現。 Includes attendance, active participation in class discussions, and engagement in Q&A sessions.

期中專題提案 / Midterm Proposal (20%) 配合第 8 週的進度，各組需上台報告並繳交書面提案，確認期末將進行回測分析的「機器學習與演算法交易策略」主題方向。 Scheduled for Week 8. Groups will give a presentation and submit a written proposal defining the direction of the machine learning model and algorithmic trading strategy they plan to backtest for the final project.

期末專題報告 / Final Project (40%) 配合第 16 週的進度，各組需上台報告並繳交期末書面報告。內容須結合前 15 週學到的模型與技術，呈現「完整策略回測與績效分析」的實作結果。 Scheduled for Week 16. Groups will present and submit a comprehensive final written report that integrates the models and techniques learned throughout the course to demonstrate complete strategy backtesting and performance analysis.

課外報告（彈性學習週） / Extracurricular Report (Flexible Learning) (20%) 作為第 17-18 週「自主延伸學習（學術文獻研讀）」的學習成果考核。各組須於課外研讀與課程相關之國際學術論文，並於第 18 週繳交「文獻研讀書面摘要報告」列入總成績計算
。 Serving as the learning outcome assessment for the Flexible Learning weeks (Weeks 17-18). Groups will conduct self-directed reading of relevant academic literature outside of class and submit a "Literature Review Written Summary Report" by Week 18, which is factored into the final grade.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
Week 01 : Machine Learning for Trading - The evolution of algorithmic strategies, the emergence of machine learning and alternative data, and designing ML-driven trading strategies.

Week 02 : Market and Fundamental Data - Market microstructure, high-frequency data processing, and using Python to access various market and fundamental data sources.

Week 03 : Alternative Data and Applications - Evaluating the signal content of alternative data (e.g., social sentiment, satellite data) and using web scraping for data extraction.

Week 04 : Financial Feature Engineering and Alpha Factors - Transforming data into signals, measuring momentum and sentiment factors, and evaluating volatility and size anomalies.

Week 05 : Portfolio Optimization and Performance Evaluation - Measuring portfolio risk and return, mean-variance optimization, and evaluating backtest performance.

Week 06 : The Machine Learning Process - Supervised and unsupervised learning, designing and tuning models, managing the bias-variance trade-off, and time-series cross-validation.

Week 07 : Linear Models and Strategy Backtesting Workflow - Building linear regression models to predict stock prices, understanding and avoiding backtesting pitfalls, and simulating trades using Zipline and backtrader.

Week 08 : Midterm Proposal Presentation - Students give group presentations on their midterm proposals.

Week 09 : Time-Series Models and Statistical Arbitrage - Univariate and multivariate time-series models (ARIMA, VAR), volatility forecasting, and cointegration for pairs trading.

Week 10 : Random Forests and Boosting Methods - Nonlinear tree-based models, Random Forests, XGBoost, and LightGBM ensemble algorithms.

Week 11 : Unsupervised Learning and Asset Allocation - Dimensionality reduction (PCA, ICA), clustering algorithms, and hierarchical risk parity (HRP).

Week 12 : Text Data, Sentiment Analysis, and Topic Modeling - The NLP workflow, Naive Bayes for sentiment analysis, and Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) for financial news.

Week 13 : Word Embeddings and Deep Learning Applications - Training custom word vectors using word2vec, neural network architecture design, and model tuning.

Week 14 : Convolutional & Recurrent Neural Networks (CNN & RNN) - CNN applications for financial time series and satellite images, and RNN/LSTM architectures for multivariate time-series forecasting.

Week 15 : Autoencoders & Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) - Extracting data-driven risk factors using Autoencoders, and generating synthetic financial data using TimeGAN.

Week 16 : Final Report Presentation - Students give group presentations on their complete strategy backtesting and analysis.

Week 17 : Flexible Learning: Self-directed Extension Learning (Academic Literature Review) Groups conduct self-directed learning, searching for and reviewing international academic journals or conference papers related to "Machine Learning for Algorithmic Trading"
.
Week 18 : Flexible Learning: Paper Reading Report Submission Based on the literature reviewed in Week 17, groups compile their findings to summarize model architectures and backtesting methodologies, submitting a "Literature Review Written Summary Report" as their final learning outcome without an in-class presentation

This event adheres to the spirit of "Xuan Zang Road", advocates the concept of "idealism, action, persistence, and transcendence" to achieve personal spiritual breakthrough through immersive physical and mental experience and teamwork; Gobi challenge also promotes teamwork by encouraging all participants to support each other, to advance and retreat together, and be positive, never give up!

name.zh: 機器學習與量化交易實務
name.en: Machine Learning and Quantitative Trading Practices

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生深入探討機器學習在量化交易與系統性投資策略中的應用。課程內容以嚴謹的數據工程為基礎，教授學生如何處理高頻市場數據（Market Data）與另類數據（Alternative Data，如新聞情緒與社群文本），並從中萃取具備預測力的 Alpha 因子。課程前期將著重於特徵工程（Feature Engineering）與金融時間序列的交叉驗證方法（如 Purged Cross-Validation），確保模型在時間序列上的穩健性。中期將系統性地介紹多種預測模型，包含樹狀集成模型（Random Forest, LightGBM）以及深度學習架構（CNN, RNN/LSTM），並探討其在資產定價與波動率預測上的應用。後期則著重於投資組合最佳化與嚴格的策略回測，引導學生使用 Python 生態系（如 Zipline, Alphalens, Pyfolio）評估策略的風險調整後報酬（例如夏普比率與最大回撤）。期末專題要求學生分組實作一個完整的端到端（End-to-End）量化交易策略。
description.en: This course explores the application of machine learning in algorithmic trading and systematic investment strategies. Grounded in rigorous data engineering, it teaches students to process market and alternative data (e.g., news sentiment) to extract predictive Alpha factors.The first half focuses on feature engineering and financial time-series cross-validation (e.g., Purged CV) to ensure model robustness. The second half systematically introduces various predictive models, including tree-based ensembles (Random Forest, LightGBM) and deep learning architectures (CNN, RNN/LSTM), applied to asset pricing and volatility prediction. Finally, the course covers portfolio optimization and rigorous backtesting. Students will use the Python ecosystem (Zipline, Alphalens, Pyfolio) to evaluate risk-adjusted performance metrics. The course culminates in a final project where students develop an end-to-end quantitative trading strategy.

syllabi.assessment:
課堂參與 / Class Participation (20%) 包含出席率、課堂互動探討與問答表現。 Includes attendance, active participation in class discussions, and engagement in Q&A sessions.

期中專題提案 / Midterm Proposal (20%) 配合第 8 週的進度，各組需上台報告並繳交書面提案，確認期末將進行回測分析的「機器學習與演算法交易策略」主題方向。 Scheduled for Week 8. Groups will give a presentation and submit a written proposal defining the direction of the machine learning model and algorithmic trading strategy they plan to backtest for the final project.

期末專題報告 / Final Project (40%) 配合第 16 週的進度，各組需上台報告並繳交期末書面報告。內容須結合前 15 週學到的模型與技術，呈現「完整策略回測與績效分析」的實作結果。 Scheduled for Week 16. Groups will present and submit a comprehensive final written report that integrates the models and techniques learned throughout the course to demonstrate complete strategy backtesting and performance analysis.

課外報告（彈性學習週） / Extracurricular Report (Flexible Learning) (20%) 作為第 17-18 週「自主延伸學習（學術文獻研讀）」的學習成果考核。各組須於課外研讀與課程相關之國際學術論文，並於第 18 週繳交「文獻研讀書面摘要報告」列入總成績計算
。 Serving as the learning outcome assessment for the Flexible Learning weeks (Weeks 17-18). Groups will conduct self-directed reading of relevant academic literature outside of class and submit a "Literature Review Written Summary Report" by Week 18, which is factored into the final grade.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
Week 01 : Machine Learning for Trading - The evolution of algorithmic strategies, the emergence of machine learning and alternative data, and designing ML-driven trading strategies.

Week 02 : Market and Fundamental Data - Market microstructure, high-frequency data processing, and using Python to access various market and fundamental data sources.

Week 03 : Alternative Data and Applications - Evaluating the signal content of alternative data (e.g., social sentiment, satellite data) and using web scraping for data extraction.

Week 04 : Financial Feature Engineering and Alpha Factors - Transforming data into signals, measuring momentum and sentiment factors, and evaluating volatility and size anomalies.

Week 05 : Portfolio Optimization and Performance Evaluation - Measuring portfolio risk and return, mean-variance optimization, and evaluating backtest performance.

Week 06 : The Machine Learning Process - Supervised and unsupervised learning, designing and tuning models, managing the bias-variance trade-off, and time-series cross-validation.

Week 07 : Linear Models and Strategy Backtesting Workflow - Building linear regression models to predict stock prices, understanding and avoiding backtesting pitfalls, and simulating trades using Zipline and backtrader.

Week 08 : Midterm Proposal Presentation - Students give group presentations on their midterm proposals.

Week 09 : Time-Series Models and Statistical Arbitrage - Univariate and multivariate time-series models (ARIMA, VAR), volatility forecasting, and cointegration for pairs trading.

Week 10 : Random Forests and Boosting Methods - Nonlinear tree-based models, Random Forests, XGBoost, and LightGBM ensemble algorithms.

Week 11 : Unsupervised Learning and Asset Allocation - Dimensionality reduction (PCA, ICA), clustering algorithms, and hierarchical risk parity (HRP).

Week 12 : Text Data, Sentiment Analysis, and Topic Modeling - The NLP workflow, Naive Bayes for sentiment analysis, and Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) for financial news.

Week 13 : Word Embeddings and Deep Learning Applications - Training custom word vectors using word2vec, neural network architecture design, and model tuning.

Week 14 : Convolutional & Recurrent Neural Networks (CNN & RNN) - CNN applications for financial time series and satellite images, and RNN/LSTM architectures for multivariate time-series forecasting.

Week 15 : Autoencoders & Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) - Extracting data-driven risk factors using Autoencoders, and generating synthetic financial data using TimeGAN.

Week 16 : Final Report Presentation - Students give group presentations on their complete strategy backtesting and analysis.

Week 17 : Flexible Learning: Self-directed Extension Learning (Academic Literature Review) Groups conduct self-directed learning, searching for and reviewing international academic journals or conference papers related to "Machine Learning for Algorithmic Trading"
.
Week 18 : Flexible Learning: Paper Reading Report Submission Based on the literature reviewed in Week 17, groups compile their findings to summarize model architectures and backtesting methodologies, submitting a "Literature Review Written Summary Report" as their final learning outcome without an in-class presentation

description.en: This course provides an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory and their applications on the real-world decision problems. Students will learn about the problem identification and modeling, the modeling and estimation of the associated uncertainty, and modeling and evaluation of the utility function.

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於研究設計練習，並以建築與都市設計領域為範疇。課程將引導學生進行研究早期階段事務之形成或轉型： (1) 研究問題； (2) 研究認識論 / 思考架構； (3) 設計研究流程； (4) 研究計畫書； (5) 研究計畫書與進度之溝通與呈現； (6) 現場、簡報、海報發表之實務。
description.en: This course focus on the practice of the research design of architecture and urban design. It is to guide the graduate students on the formation or transformation of the issues of early phase of research: (1) Research question; (2) Research problematics / structure of thinking; (3) Design of research procedure; (4) Draft of research proposal; (5) Communications and presentation of research proposal and progress; (6) Practice of on-stage, slide and poster presentation.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主旨使修課學生能實際了解粉末燒結之相關理論及技術，內容含括固態燒結(solid-state sintering)、液態燒結(liquid phase sintering)、熱壓(hot pressing)、熱均壓(hot isostatic pressing)、電漿火花燒結(spark plasma sintering)、反應燒結(reaction sintering)、活化燒結(activated sintering)等，並將介紹燒結體量測所需使用的各式儀器及其原理、燒結相關設備、燒結實務等主題。

name.en: Philosophy of Technological and Vocational Education

description.zh: 本課程在探究技職教育的本質、目標、歷史發展及相關哲學思潮，期培養學生發展批判思考能力分析技職教育相關議題。
description.en: This course is designed to investigate the purpose, essence, history,    and related philosophical thinking of Vocational and Technological Technical Education (VTE)；to develop students forming critical thinking to analyze the current issues in VTE.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹技職教育之歷史發展與相關哲學思潮，綜採行歷史學、社會學、哲學與比較教育學的觀點，以專題討論的方式進行。期達成以下目標-
一、使學生瞭解技職教育的歷史發展與哲學理念
二、使學生瞭解台灣技職教育的變遷
三、使學生能比較及分析國內外技職教育之差異
四、使學生能以宏觀的視野與脈絡來透視技職教育問題並提出改革建議。
syllabi.assessment:
一、平時成績：每週指定文獻閱讀及討論40%
二、專題口頭報告30％
1.學生搜集整理及導讀指定主題之相關文獻（博士生須自行負責單一子題，碩士生得2人一組），並請以ppt檔呈現。
2.針對該主題對「技職教育」影響主持討論活動。
三、期末書面報告30%，依據期中口頭報告增刪，將修正後將電子檔寄給老師

name.en: Philosophy of Technological and Vocational Education

description.zh: 本課程在探究技職教育的本質、目標、歷史發展及相關哲學思潮，期培養學生發展批判思考能力分析技職教育相關議題。
description.en: This course is designed to investigate the purpose, essence, history,    and related philosophical thinking of Vocational and Technological Technical Education (VTE)；to develop students forming critical thinking to analyze the current issues in VTE.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹技職教育之歷史發展與相關哲學思潮，綜採行歷史學、社會學、哲學與比較教育學的觀點，以專題討論的方式進行。期達成以下目標-
一、使學生瞭解技職教育的歷史發展與哲學理念
二、使學生瞭解台灣技職教育的變遷
三、使學生能比較及分析國內外技職教育之差異
四、使學生能以宏觀的視野與脈絡來透視技職教育問題並提出改革建議。
syllabi.assessment:
一、平時成績：每週指定文獻閱讀及討論40%
二、專題口頭報告30％
1.學生搜集整理及導讀指定主題之相關文獻（博士生須自行負責單一子題，碩士生得2人一組），並請以ppt檔呈現。
2.針對該主題對「技職教育」影響主持討論活動。
三、期末書面報告30%，依據期中口頭報告增刪，將修正後將電子檔寄給老師

description.zh: 藉由國內外設計競賽主題與產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、商品分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒，在產學合作中習得實務經驗並獲致產業界肯定。因此本課程旨在以實際演練達成兼具創新性與商品化專業設計能力養成。
description.en: Advanced Product Design (I) educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment.  Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas.  Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues.  There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

description.zh:
鑑於當代建築已不僅限於物質構築的實踐，更是設計論述在跨地域系譜間的流動與翻轉。特定設計哲學如何透過理論遞衍與對話，在在地特有的都市環境與技術體系中產生異質轉譯，成為理解建築知識生產路徑中不可或缺的環節。
基於此，本課程期望透過「設計論述對標」與「環境資訊轉譯」雙軌路徑，提供一個整合思辨與實證的操作框架。課程前半段聚焦於剖析核心設計論述與在地建築實踐間的對話系譜，旨在探討設計意圖如何透過文本與案例的互文（intertextuality），於在地情境中重新定位其立場。後半段則轉向空間資訊的採集實踐，強調透過多重尺度（multi-scalar）的觀測，將紛雜的環境線索重組為具備論述能量的視覺圖面。課程架構從微觀的構築細部延伸至宏觀的城市敘事，訓練將抽象的理論辯證落實為嚴謹的論述性製圖，進而培養在面對複雜環境資訊時，建構具備學術厚度與空間精度的個人論述。
description.en:
Recognising that architectural production extends beyond physical construction into the transnational flow of discourse, this programme examines the heterogenous translation of design philosophies within local urban systems.
Through the dual-track framework of Architectural Genealogy Alignment and Environmental Translation, the course integrates critical speculation with empirical practice. The first stage deconstructs the genealogical dialogue between core theories and local practices, exploring how design intent is re-contextualised through intertextuality. The second stage employs multi-scalar observation to reconfigure environmental cues into discursive mapping. From tectonic details to urban narratives, the curriculum grounds theoretical debate within rigorous visual representation, enabling the construction of personal narratives with both academic depth and spatial precision.

description.zh: 了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略、具備建築物生命週期的整體流程概念、具備建築碳足跡計算操作能力。課程講述建築生命週期碳足跡的評估法，藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響，具備評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡，並提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。
description.en:
This course evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's life
cycle. Through standardized and transparent building
information, the impact of various stages of the building life
cycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. This
course not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entire
building life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspots
and provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

syllabi.outline: 國際能源署(IEA)呼籲全球國家訂定淨零碳排路徑，國內也發佈「台灣 2050 淨零路徑及策略」，具體宣告了淨零碳排的目標期程與行動方案，針對建築部門納入低碳(低蘊含碳)建築評估(Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System, LBERS)，藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊來剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響，以培養永續淨零概念並具備評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡、甚進一步提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略、具備建築物生命週期的整體流程概念、具備建築碳足跡計算操作能力。

description.zh: 表現法課程主要目的在訓練學生建築設計手繪之能力，起始為建築素描點線、面，體的基礎訓練，進而了解基本設計之理論，進而訓練建築手繪之草圖設計訓練，基本之建築平面、立面，剖面及透視圖之實作繪製，從而培養學生手繪設計之能力，及因應建築師考試快速設計之訓練，也配合未來AI之運用達到手繪與電繪之結合，此為本課程之訓練主要目標。
description.en:
"The objective of this architectural presentation drawing course is rooted in architectural design sketching and the fundamental design theories of point, line, plane, and mass. Through rigorous training in these sketching techniques, the second stage focuses on the mastery of architectural plans, elevations, sections, and perspective drawings.
Furthermore, the curriculum is specifically designed to align with the Rapid Design requirements of the Architectural Licensing Examination. To meet future marketing demands, the integration of AI applications is also a key learning objective of this course."

description.zh:
從「材料」的角度看設計，始終是一個充滿啟發且值得深入探討的位置。當前，建築產業對環境造成的衝擊尤為顯著，包含營運與隱含碳排放、大量廢棄物污染、熱島效應等問題，皆反映快速開發對自然環境所帶來的劇烈破壞。因此，「設計階段決定建物 80% 環境影響」的觀點逐漸受到重視，而將「材料視為設計過程固有部分」的「材料系統（Material System）」概念，也再次使忠於材料本質與特性的精神回歸設計核心。
本課程將聚焦於「木框架／實木」、「竹」、「稻草」、「軟木」、「夯土」、「磚」、「石材」等植物基與低碳材料，探討其於當代建築與空間設計中的應用可能。課程將從封閉式材料循環（Closed-Loop Material Cycles）與永續設計觀點出發，透過國內外案例分析，說明不同材料之構造系統、材料細節與製造邏輯，並進一步探討其與場域脈絡、地方文化及永續經濟性之間的關聯，建立同學對於材料、構築與環境之整合性理解。
description.en:
Viewing design through the lens of “materials” has always been an inspiring and meaningful position for exploration (Chris Lefteri, 2014). Today, the architecture industry has caused significant environmental impacts, including operational and embodied carbon emissions, large amounts of construction waste, and urban heat island effects, all of which reflect the rapid environmental degradation brought about by intensive development. As a result, the idea that “the design phase determines 80% of a building’s environmental impact” has become increasingly important. At the same time, the concept of “Material Systems,” which considers materials as an inherent part of the design process, has brought renewed attention to the essence and integrity of materials within architectural design.

syllabi.assessment:
The course evaluation is mainly divided into two parts: "Lectures " and "Group Reports."

The course assessment consists of two main components: Lectures and Group Research Presentations & Reports.

．"Lectures." Each lecture will be accompanied by either an in-class exercise or a summary of an article reading.  (Grading criteria: Attendance – 20%; In-class Exercises and Reading Summaries – 20%.)

． "Group Research Presentation & Reports."Students will conduct research on the material, analyze related architectural case studies, and develop shop drawings. ( Grading criteria: Initial PPT Presentation & Report – 40%; Revised Report – 20%)
syllabi.materials:
1.《Cradle to Cradle: Remaking The Way We Make Things》 ，William McDonough & Michael Braungart，2002。
2.《Material Innovation: Architecture》， Andrew H. Dent & Leslie Sherr，2014。
3.《Transmaterial Next: A Catalog of Materials that Redefine Our Future》， Blaine Brownell，2017。
4.《Exploring Materials: Creative Design for Everyday Objects》（中譯：做設計的第一堂材料課）， Inna Alesina & Ellen Lupton，2020。
5.《Materials for Design》（中譯：設計師的材料學：創意 × 實驗 × 未來性），Chris Lefteri，2015。
6.《Manual of Biogenic House Sections》，Paul Lewis ＆ Marc Tsurumaki & David J. Lewis，2022。

description.zh:
本課程旨在引導建築系一年級學生理解當代生成式人工智慧（Generative AI）之基礎概念與應用方式，並建立面對未來設計環境所需之基本數位素養。課程內容將結合建築與設計領域之相關案例，介紹生成式 AI 於學習、設計發想、圖像生成與資訊整理等面向之應用。
課程將涵蓋生成式 AI 的基礎操作、提示詞（Prompt）撰寫與工具使用方法，以及 AI 於學術與教學場域中的倫理規範與使用原則。透過實際操作與討論，協助學生在建築設計學習初期，即建立對 AI 工具之基本理解與應用能力，並思考人工智慧於未來建築與設計領域中的角色與可能性。
description.en:
This course aims to guide first-year architecture students in understanding the foundational concepts and applications of contemporary Generative AI, while building the essential digital literacy needed for future design environments. The course will integrate relevant examples from the fields of architecture and design, introducing how generative AI can be applied in learning, design ideation, image generation, and information organization.
The course will cover fundamental operations of generative AI, prompt crafting and tool usage, along with ethical guidelines and principles for AI use in academic and teaching contexts. Through hands-on practice and discussions, students will develop a foundational understanding of AI tools at the beginning of their architectural education and reflect on the role and potential of AI in the future of architecture and design.

description.zh:
本課程以「如何觀看世界」作為核心，從日常生活中的物件、空間、影像與文化現象出發，引導學生建立對藝術、設計與美感的基礎感知能力。課程強調，美學並非設計之外的附屬條件，而是理解生活、文化與環境的重要基礎。因此，課程將培養學生的視覺觀察與分析能力，理解人、物件與空間之間的關係，並逐步建立自身的觀看方式與美感素養。課程亦將參考《Design as Art》所提出：「當我們日常使用的物件與生活的環境本身已成為藝術品，我們才能說達到了平衡的生活。」重新思考藝術、設計與日常生活之間的連結。
課程內容將涵蓋建築設計、視覺／平面設計、工業設計、研究設計等不同設計領域之賞析，並結合藝術、影像、日常器物與公共空間等案例進行討論。課程將透過觀看、觀察、閱讀、案例分析與簡易創作等方式，引導學生理解不同設計領域如何影響人們的感知、行為與文化生活，同時培養學生對於視覺、媒介、物件與環境之間關係的基本理解與表達能力。
description.en:
This course centers on the question of “how we perceive and understand the world,” guiding students to develop fundamental sensibilities toward art, design, and aesthetics through everyday objects, spaces, images, and cultural phenomena. The course emphasizes that aesthetics is not secondary to design, but rather a fundamental basis for understanding life, culture, and the environment. Therefore, the course aims to cultivate students’ abilities in visual observation and analytical thinking, helping them understand the relationships between people, objects, and space while gradually establishing their own ways of seeing and aesthetic awareness. The course also references the ideas presented in Design as Art: “When objects in daily use and the environment we live in become works of art themselves, then we may say we are living in a balanced life,” encouraging students to reconsider the relationship between art, design, and everyday life.

name.en: Special Topics on Geographical Information System

description.zh: 政府近年積極推動行政資訊化，應用資訊技術提昇行政的效率與品質，以達到便民及創新的效益。地理資訊系統(Geographical Information System，簡稱GIs)之開發與應用，即是提供各使用單位在處理大量圖籍與相關文字資料之管理與查詢的最佳解決方案；配合完整中文介面與印表技術，更可提高效率資訊服務。國內各重大工程在規劃設計時，正逐漸引用地理資訊系統。以其強大之資訊處理、整合、分析、及展示等功能輔助，如圖籍疊合與環框分析等，使工程規劃設計更為準確客觀，發揮工程最大效益。
description.en: To provide public service with better quality, the administration of government with information-based is widely established by adopting newly developed information technology.  Geographic Information System is one of the technology especially applicable when massive maps and attribute data are involved in management affairs.  It offers users a solution for information management and data query under a graphic environment with Chinese interface as well as output printing specification.  The planning and design of major construction projects in Taiwan were increasingly referred to GIS for the reason that efficiency can be maximized by the powerful data organization, integration, and display capability along with GIS.

syllabi.outline: 結構工程上的問題一般都會以微分方程式來表示，微分方程式的求解除了少數簡單及線性的結構系統能以解析的方法求解外，大都需要使用數值方法來求解。例如使用有限元素法來進行結構分析，其中就隱含相當多的數值分法，如微分方程式的離散化，函數插值法，非線性方程式的求解以及矩陣計算等等。

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，須考慮消費者對新創事業產品(新創產品)之瞭解及接受程度。如果能在創業之初對消費者進行新創產品之消費者行為調查，可使新創事業在成立之初即找出目標顧客群，並分析出目標顧客的消費偏好，例如：對新創產品的品質要求、功能偏好、購買可能金額、消費通路類別等，創業者可依所瞭解目標顧客的消費偏好，規劃適當的行銷方案，而提高創業成功的機會。
description.en: Entrepreneurs should consider consumers’ understanding and acceptance of new products (innovative products) in their new ventures. If a start-up company conducts consumer behavior survey in the beginning, the new business is able to identify the target customer base from the start, and analyze the target consumer preferences, including quality requirements, functional preferences, amount of possible purchase, types of consumer access. By understanding target consumer preferences, entrepreneurs can plan appropriate marketing programs, and improve business opportunities for success.

description.zh: 本課程名稱為 “環境與自然保育” 。它包括二大範疇：(1)自然環境和自然資源的保育，(2)自然環境的保存、維護、利用、復原及改良。它將教導學生下列主題：自然保育的基本概念（自然保育的定義、自然保育觀念的發展）、保育生物學（物種形成和滅絕、生物多樣性、物種保護的優先原則、生物入侵）、生態經濟學簡介（生態經濟學的原則、能量流與物質流分析）、自然保護區（自然保護區之概念、自然保護區的保護對象）、自然保育政策（國際自然保育策略、台灣的自然保育機構及相關法規）與自然保育運動（自然保育運動之發展、當前自然保育運動所關心的事）。整體而言, 本課程期盼提升公民生態意識和環境覺知, 使大家對環境保育做出更多貢獻。
description.en: The title of this course is “Environment and Nature Conservation”. It includes two categories: (1) conservation of the natural environment and natural resources, and (2) the preservation, maintenance, restoration and improvement of the natural environment. It will introduce to students the following themes: basic concepts of nature conservation, conservation biology, introduction to ecological economics, nature reservation, nature conservation policy, and nature conservation movement. As a whole, it aims to raise our citizens’ ecological consciousness and environmental awareness and thus enable them to make more contribution to the conservation of our environment.

syllabi.outline: 生態與自然保育是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解自然資源管理的架構，從而掌屋自然保育與生活品質的關係，再就台灣自然資源與環境管理問題，探究分析其根源，最後以自身潛力與未來方向為基礎，發想共同之願景。

description.zh: 中國文化博大精深，淵源流長，是以本課程講授內容在於介紹中國文化的特徵，如人類的起源、文化的演進、農業社會的產生、政治制度的發展、學術思想的演變、教育設施、科學與藝術的發展、工商業的發展，以及宗教信仰等，都是本課程所要探討的內容。藉此引導學生掌握古今之間的相關性，並探索中國傳統文化對台灣、東亞與世界的影響。
description.en: Chinese culture is broad and profound, so the course introduces the characteristics of it.  It includes the origin of Chinese races, the changes of the culture and the academic thoughts, the formation of the agricultural society, the developments on politics, sciences, arts, and religions……etc. The students are expected to understand the relationship between the ancient and modern China and then do further research about the influences of the traditional culture of China on Taiwan, the eastern Asia and the whole world.

description.zh: 本課程旨在欣賞篆竟藝術，認識我國歷代著名的篆竟家與優美的作品，由作品之中廣泛瞭解篆竟多樣化的美感表現與技法，並嘗試實現於創作。篆竟是我國特有的一種藝術形式，除了日常日信的實用功能之外，更普遍使用在書法或繪畫等藝術作品中。因此瞭解篆竟藝術之美，往往是面對其他藝術作品時所不可或缺的。篆竟創作必須在方寸微小的天地之內，專注構思，謹慎刻畫。如此苦心經營的體驗，同時也是十分可貴的精神陶冶。
description.en:
This course enlightens students on the art, the arlists and the masterworks of seal cutting. Form the appreciation of great works, students sharpen the understanding of the versatile beauty and skills exerted in seal cutting.
Seal cutting is a unique form of art in China. It is commonly applied in signets, and extensively connected with calligraphy and painting stampings and other artistic performance. Therefore, the understanding of seal cutting is supposed to be an inevitable way to unveil the curtain of Chinese art palace. Students are expected to work out the composition of seal cutting within centimeters;hence,their concentration and deliberation can be spontaneously molded.

syllabi.outline: 本課程以「欣賞與實作並重」為教學核心，課程內容涵蓋篆刻沿革、篆刻書體、印章形式、章法佈局、印文設計、篆刻工具、執刀運刀、印石藝術等多元面向主題。透過系統性的理論講授與實際篆刻習作，引導學生認識篆刻藝術的歷史發展、美學特色與當代意義，並且親自體驗篆刻創作的完整流程，逐步完成個人私印、收藏章、齋館印等篆刻作品，讓理論與實踐結合。

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:
課程大綱
1、課程簡介：憲法為一個之根本大法，實質的憲法精神更是法治國的體現。憲法一般雖定性為公法，惟其觸角及影響力更深入到每一個法律領域之中，不管是民法、刑法、行政法等領域，均與憲法息息相關，多需要透過憲法之角度來檢視其他法律的正當性與是否合憲性。故憲法之重要性，當然不言而喻。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺憲法於整個法律體系中之定位及地位。
側重近幾年來的重大憲法爭議，將從大法官會議解釋來探討同性婚之違憲與否、通姦除罪化之憲法觀點、罷權等之公民權行使、言論自由與憲法之保障及界線等等，建立法律學的嚴謹思維，培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。

description.zh: 人類從尚未有文字的歷史以來，就有各種不同規模的戰爭，戰爭很吊詭的以你死或我亡，相互毀滅之態勢，爭奪「活著」的條件。古今中外，爆發戰爭的因素或為爭奪領土、權位、或為族群之戰、為意識形態之戰、或為物質資源之爭奪。在視覺影像發達的今日社會，有關戰爭的歷史影像的紀錄片與劇情片數量龐大、並有許多可觀之處。本課程將利用這些描寫戰爭影像資料，帶領同學瞭解相關戰爭與戰役爆發的歷史及其經過。
description.en: Throughout human history, even prior to written record, various types of warfare and scales of battles have existed for various purposes of domination or survival by all means of cruelty and destruction. The arousal of violent conflicts might be an attempt at fighting for territorial dominion or material resources economically or altering another species ideologically. In today's modern societies, bountiful documentaries and films concerning historical warfare have been accumulated. This course will aim at giving students a broad understanding and profound knowledge of the causes, process, and effects of significant warfare in human history with the aid of visual images in different media.

description.zh:
法學概論，顧名思義是在介紹法律原理，以啟發學生法學研究的興趣。然而，法學涵蓋的層面甚廣，法學緒論的課程，只能大略介紹各種法律的共通原理，就繁駁的法律現象，作綜合的引說，俾使初學法律的人，不僅能粗知「實定法」的共通原則，還可藉此原則來培養法律見解和修養，執簡馭繁，因而體會法律的性質、內涵和理念。
有關本課程的教授方式，擬先介紹法律的基概念及原理，並以答問之方式訓練學生邏輯反思的能力，同時輔以日常屢見之法律實例問題。如此，學生不僅可以可以學習正確的法律觀念和知識，並可培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，以達保障並維護自己及他人權益之目的。
description.en: Introduction of Law is to introduce the theory of law and to promote students' interest to study law. Since the field of law is very broad but the time is limited, this course can briefly explain common principles of law, complex phenomena of law, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students catch the concept of common principles of "lex scripta."  Also, this course aims to promote students' knowledge about law, thus cultivating their spirit of abiding by law.  This course will introduce the basic concept and theory of law first. Then students will be given logical training through discussion.  Besides, the general cases and problems of law will be covered as well. Through this course, students can not only get correct concepts of law, but learn to protect their/others' right.

syllabi.outline:
一、課程概要：
法學概論，顧名思義是在介紹法律原理，以啟發學生法學研究的興趣。然而，法學涵蓋的層面甚廣，法學緒論的課程，只能大略介紹各種法律的共通原理，就繁駁的法律現象，作綜合的引說，俾使初學法律的人，不僅能粗知「實定法」的共通原則，還可藉此原則來培養法律見解和修養，執簡馭繁，因而體會法律的性質、內涵和理念。
有關本課程的教授方式，擬先介紹法律的基概念及原理，並以答問之方式訓練學生邏輯反思的能力，同時輔以日常屢見之法律實例問題。如此，學生不僅可以可以學習正確的法律觀念和知識，並可培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，以達保障並維護自己及他人權益之目的。
二、課程目標及授課方式：
?	期能讓同學以鳥瞰的解度一窺整個法律的架構內容。
?	從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來看穿法律的面貌。
?	建立法律學的嚴謹思維，避落入新聞式反射性的淺層粗糙判斷。
?	培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
?	建立同學生活法律問題的解決能力。
?	法律為一個理論與實務並重的科學，僅專注理論而忽略實務，如鳥無雙翼，缺少實用性，則法律的功效實難發生。老師為實務律師出身，故在介紹理論之外，也會側重實務案例的介紹分析，每堂課開始約會有十到三十分鐘針對當周的法律時事問題及律師執業經驗，從法學緒論的角度切入，在課堂上討論，以收學習之功效。
?	上課時老師不會點名同學回答問題，不用擔心。但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論。
?	因法律乃一門非常實用的學科，人的一生均會與法律產生關係，法律的學習對同學的人生應有相當的助益。
惟法律學難有生澀難懂之處，老師會盡量以生動的案例（如新聞事件、歷史事件，以及老師打過的官司來進行教學），以提高同學的學習興趣。
故本課程對於法律有興趣者，或者過去對法律很陌生也沒關係，若聽過老的課而對法律產生興趣的話，都非常歡迎來修本門課。惟若僅抱持勉強應付的心態、只為取得學分的同學，請勿選修本堂課。
?	同學均非法律本科，故老師不會吝於給分，最大的期望是同學能於本課堂上有所得！

Introduction of Law is to introduce the theory of law and to promote students' interest to study law. Since the field of law is very broad but the time is limited, this course can briefly explain common principles of law, complex phenomena of law, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students catch the concept of common principles of "lex scripta."  Also, this course aims to promote students' knowledge about law, thus cultivating their spirit of abiding by law.  This course will introduce the basic concept and theory of law first. Then students will be given logical training through discussion.  Besides, the general cases and problems of law will be covered as well. Through this course, students can not only get correct concepts of law, but learn to protect their/others' right.

description.zh: 本課程目標如下：（一）以心理學為基礎，探討人類生活各面向的知識；（二）建立學生生活行為的技能；（三）促使學生建立自己積極的價值體系。  本課程內容涵蓋人類的個體發展、學習方式、動機、情緒、態度、人格、兩性、愛情、家庭、育兒、健康管理、社會行為等生活面的相關行為。  本課程採學生中心教學法，以啟發法、小組討論、創造式發表等方式授課，藉以活潑學生的思考並增加學生上台練習的機會。
description.en: The objectives of this course are : (1)By basing on the psychology   to guide our students to discuss the variant facets of their lives. (2)To establish the students' good skills to deal with their own lives. (3)To found the students' positive value systems .  This course includes the human behaviors of individual development , learning strategies, motivations, emotion, attitudes, personality, social interaction, religious lives, love, bisexual interaction, family lives, children cultivation , and etc. This course uses the learner-centered instructing strategies. The methods of discovery learning, teams discussion, creative teaching , and etc. will be adopted, in order to excite the students to do deep thought and give them the opportunities to show their efforts and achievements themselves.

syllabi.outline:
心理與人生：心靈寫繪與敘事探尋~~自我梳理的心美學 (請耐心看完說明)

心靈書寫與塗繪，是一種描繪自我風景、梳理雜思，或是安頓情緒的安全好途徑！在敘事觀點中，我們深信「人是自己生命的專家」，而那些困頓、焦慮的經驗，往往只是我們被主流價值（單薄故事）所束縛。透過自由書寫，我們得以重新拉開與問題的距離，安頓情緒，進而改寫、重塑內在的生命腳本！
這趟學習旅程結合生活感知、表達性藝術創作，融合五感體驗，在寫、畫、攝影……中敘心也敘情。它很簡單，但要帶點探索的勇氣。藉由「我筆寫繪我心」，我們不只在探察、整理與自我對話，更在看似尋常的生活片段中，發掘那些被忽略的生命寶藏，長出豐厚的支線故事。而在課堂的相互分享與交流中，別輕看自己的力量，你寫畫下的某個片段、某句低語，在團體的溫柔見證下，興許就成了照亮別人生命的對話與光芒！
既是心靈寫繪，就不是作文，也不是美術課。我們不探討客觀的技巧好壞，而是看重主觀的生命體驗；它既不需好文筆，也不用起承轉合，亦無需繪畫技巧。在課堂裡，老師與夥伴將化身為「去中心化」的陪伴者，這裡沒有比較與評價，只有帶著生命尊重的鼓勵、支持與多元包容！

●溫馨提醒：
這門課提取部分心理學基礎概念，但非心理學知識性課程，亦非單向式講授，注重體驗互動，屬生活應用與實踐性質，課中將分組，並需與夥伴互動連結、團體敘說，採類工作坊模式進行，請審慎評估再選課；第一堂須出席。

◎選課重要提醒：
●如非課程需要，上課禁用3C。
●如非身體不適，上課禁止睡覺。
●每堂點名，整學期請假總計不超過3次為原則。
●第一堂即分組，若無法準時出席，請勿選課。
●本課程非一般寫作、美術課程，但需樂意書寫、塗繪者。
●課中多有表達性創作體驗，需樂意自備物材(如剪貼簿、粉蠟筆、剪刀、膠
  水、雜誌圖片、黏土、每組一張大書面紙等)。

SDGs
本課程核心對接三大永續發展指標，透過體驗式寫繪與敘事探尋，將其轉化為通識生命素養：
•3 良好健康與社會福利（著重在促進心理健康與福祉）：
對接週次： 第三週、第六週、第七週、第十一週、第十二週、第十三週、第十四週。 
• 4 優質教育（確保包容和公平的教育，促進終身學習）：
引導涵容學生的個體差異，提供多元體驗與開放式參與機會，指引學生相互尊重差異、欣賞彼此的生命亮點。 對接週次： 第二週、第五週、第十週、第十五週、第十七及十八週。 
• 5 性別平等（實現性別平等，並延伸至情感教育）：
本課程偏重於性別權力關係的解構與人際互動，並延伸至情感教育中的溝通協商、關係界限，以及處理情感挫折的心理韌性。 對接週次： 融入第三週與第五週進行體驗式深度學習。

 ⊙ 品德教育 6E 契合指標
本課程深度契合「啟發思辨、環境形塑、體驗反思、正向期許」之品德實踐：

description.zh:
經濟學重視邏輯與嚴謹推理的理性特質是其主要特色，此亦為理工科系人之專長優勢，然而僅偏重左腦訓練的人才往往讓人覺得生冷機械，對事物看法也常過於直接而缺乏人情，若能在不失理性效率之下，兼顧以人為本之社會人文感性關懷，則經濟學自無愧為社會科學之母，其訓練目標亦與通識教育的人格均衡發展目的一致！
為避免陷入一般經濟教學因理論工具比重過高而失焦，導致學生學習興趣驟減以致成效不彰，本課程重點在於先讓學生擁有強烈之學習動機，接著認知到"確立學習目的"的重要性，藉由生活實例直接帶領學生面對並感受問題，從而引導出經濟學切入問題的思維方式，並傳授其正確可行的學習態度與方法，同時提醒學生維持對專業知識批判的精神，在嚴謹訓練架構下督促其尋求感性的意涵，因而不致陷入經濟工具與名詞的浩瀚泥沼中，從而漸進體會出經濟學之精髓。
description.en:
The science of economics is characterized by logics and cautious reasoning-at which most of the students of natural science and technology are good at. It is also a fact that those who take better advantage of the right brain are very likely to be straightforward and thus seemingly more mechanical and unsympathetic. Economics can be seen as the mother of science under the condition that rational efficiency-as well as the socially humanity--are kept at the same time. As a matter of act, the economic trainings share the same goal as what is required by the General Education courses.
The first priority of the course is to highly motivate the students in the economic issues. We do our best to avoid too much weight generally put into teaching economics, leading to poor learning and teaching experience. Cases are studied in such a way that students will recognize the "real purpose of studying."  Real cases and examples are brought into discussion. We guide the students to"feel"the problems.

description.zh: 環境保護是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解環境與生活素質的關係，並了解環境問題的產生及其分類，再就台灣環境問題之所在分析其根源，最後了解台灣環境實施之現況後，並共同研究解決之道。
description.en: Introduction to Environmental Protection is a brand new issue of the 20th century; also, it is the biggest challenge of all human beings and our offspring. Because environmental protection is an international issue, everyone got to realize it's importance and take some action. This lesson is designed to help students understand: 1. the connection between our environment and our living condition; 2.the cause of environmental problems and their classification; 3.the cause of environmental problems in Taiwan; and 4.the solution to Taiwan's environmental problems.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

期中報告、期末報告（60%）、課堂參與（40%）

報告方式：8-10 分鐘的音樂作品解析口頭報告與簡報製作（每組至多 5 人），包含「期中前期企劃報告」，以及「期末口頭與書面報告」，期中、期末皆需需製作投影片簡報。報告的焦點可以包含：作曲家簡介、作品靈感來源或創作背景、作品的曲式、作品風格、樂器使用、個人心得、演奏版本比較、靜態或動態之音樂視覺化呈現（例如：https://youtu.be/71hNl_skTZQ) 等。

若修課人數較多時，期中報告會在 9-11 週。期末報告會在 16~18 週。原課程內容將配合同學們報告所佔用時間，做部分刪減與調整。

指標對應授課內容: 音樂自古以來就被公認為具有安撫心靈的作用。本課程全部內容引導學生學習欣賞音樂，故有助於學生透過音樂來抒發情感、或安定心神，能提升「健康福祉」。此外，本課程引到學生聆聽並分析古典音樂，能訓練學生同時以理性與感性進行音樂賞析，可提升學生的人文素養，並陶冶身心，進而提高「教育品質」。

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

description.zh: 近代以降，由於戰爭的影響，臺灣歷經不同的政權和政體，諸如大清帝國、日本帝國及中華民國等。國際局勢、殖民統治、捍衛國土等緣由引發各式各樣的戰爭，戰爭促進臺灣的政治、社會、經濟、文化等層面的變革。因此以戰爭為主軸，認知臺灣在世界地緣位置的重要性，及其引起的各種戰爭類型，呈現戰爭在近現代臺灣各時期的各種風貌。臺灣是個位於西太平洋海陸交接地區的島嶼，在世界局勢變動的潮流之中，塑造其特有的戰爭型式及內涵。再者，臺灣各地有諸多戰爭遺址，不乏國定古蹟，可以藉由戰爭史的脈絡得知戰爭遺址的歷史空間及其文化資產的重要性。
description.en: Since modern times, due to the influence of wars, Taiwan has experienced different regimes and political systems, such as the Qing Empire, the Japanese Empire, and the Republic of China. The international situation, colonial rule, and defense of the country have triggered various wars. Wars have promoted changes in Taiwan’s politics, society, economy, and culture. Therefore, taking war as the main core, understanding the importance of Taiwan's geopolitics in the world, and the types of wars it caused, presents the various features of wars. Taiwan is an island located in the land-sea junction of the Western Pacific Ocean. In the changing tide of the world situation, Taiwan has shaped its unique war style and connotation. Furthermore, there are many military relics throughout Taiwan, and there are many national historical sites. Students can learn about the historical space of military relics and the importance of their cultural assets through the context of war history.

description.zh: 本課程目標如下：（一）以心理學為基礎，探討人類生活各面向的知識；（二）建立學生生活行為的技能；（三）促使學生建立自己積極的價值體系。  本課程內容涵蓋人類的個體發展、學習方式、動機、情緒、態度、人格、兩性、愛情、家庭、育兒、健康管理、社會行為等生活面的相關行為。  本課程採學生中心教學法，以啟發法、小組討論、創造式發表等方式授課，藉以活潑學生的思考並增加學生上台練習的機會。
description.en: The objectives of this course are : (1)By basing on the psychology   to guide our students to discuss the variant facets of their lives. (2)To establish the students' good skills to deal with their own lives. (3)To found the students' positive value systems .  This course includes the human behaviors of individual development , learning strategies, motivations, emotion, attitudes, personality, social interaction, religious lives, love, bisexual interaction, family lives, children cultivation , and etc. This course uses the learner-centered instructing strategies. The methods of discovery learning, teams discussion, creative teaching , and etc. will be adopted, in order to excite the students to do deep thought and give them the opportunities to show their efforts and achievements themselves.

description.zh: 「社會心理學」主要探討的重點在於日常生活，社會刺激以及情境如何影響個人行為，它需要經過科學的方法進行研究，藉以預測一個人在某種情境下，可能會出現哪些行為。其涉及的學科相當廣泛，除了一般心理學的理論之外，尚包含社會科學哲學、文化人類學、倫理學、環境心理學、團體動力學等相關論述。課程強調理論與實務結合，提升學生參與社會的知能。
description.en: Social Psychology is focus on social stimuli and how situations affect individual behavior everyday life. In order to predict a person’s behavior in a situation, we need to research by scientific methods.  It covers a wide range of professional areas, not only the theories of social psychology but also philosophy of social science, cultural anthropology, ethics, environmental psychology, group dynamics. This course emphasizes the combination of theory and practice to enhance students’ abilities to participate in society.

syllabi.outline:
「社會心理學」主要探討的重點在於日常生活，社會群體刺激以及情境如何影響個人的認知, 態度及行為，它需要經過科學的方法進行研究，藉以預測一個人在某種情境下，可能會出現哪些行為。社會心理學主要是從社會學，群體的角度，探討個人的態度與行為如何受到社會價值以及群體的影響。該課程強調理論與實務結合，提供日常生活以及新聞案例，提升學生參與社會的知能。
Social psychology investigates how social stimulus and social environment affect people’s cognition, attitudes, and behavior. It requires scientific methods to research what people act in certain conditions. Social psychology takes sociological perspective to investigate how individuals’ attitudes and behavior affected by social values and group. The course emphasizes theories and practices, and provides news and events in daily life as examples to enhance students’ social participation.

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 新創公司財務規劃良窳往往決定一家公司能否走得長遠，公司財務管理制度不健全導致週轉不靈倒閉的案例比比皆是，其中更是不乏資質良好的公司。本課程首先介紹創新商業模式，再教授創業應注意之基本知識，最後指導同學新創企業財務管理。

description.zh: 本課程旨在闡明中國傳統思想之精義，疏通其中所涵蘊之問題，希望透過講授與討論，把握中國思想發展之大脈，並展望未來文化之發展。在課程設計方面，依序分先秦諸子、魏晉玄學、隋唐佛學、宋明學、近代思想五大綱領。深入淺出，直探本源，使學者領會中國歷代哲人之睿見，指引人生步上光明之大道。
description.en: This course deals mainly with the essence of Chinese traditional thought, trying to sovle the riddles lying behind the msytery of Asian philosophy. Through lectures and class discussion, students are expected to have a better command of the significant stream of thinking development for the Chinese people and look into the future cultural development. As for the course planning, this course consists of the following five topics: Pre-Chin philosophers, Taoism in Wei and Jin Dynasties, Buddism in Sui and Tang dynasties, Confucianism in Song and Ming Dynasties and modern philosophy. The course will be presented with simple approaches and lots of class discussions in the hope that  students will realize the wisdom explored by important philosophers throughout Chinese history, which will in returen provide students with much more promising and enrihed way of life.

syllabi.outline: This course deals mainly with the essence of Chinese traditional thought, trying to sovle the riddles lying behind the msytery of Asian philosophy. Through lectures and class discussion, students are expected to have a better command of the significant stream of thinking development for the Chinese people and look into the future cultural development. As for the course planning, this course consists of the following five topics: Pre-Chin philosophers, Taoism in Wei and Jin Dynasties, Buddism in Sui and Tang dynasties, Confucianism in Song and Ming Dynasties and modern philosophy. The course will be presented with simple approaches and lots of class discussions in the hope that  students will realize the wisdom explored by important philosophers throughout Chinese history, which will in returen provide students with much more promising and enrihed way of life.

description.zh:
本課程，擬引領修課同學們徜徉古今愛情文學作品；內容含括詩、詞、散文、小說、戲曲、視聽影像等，並以主題單元方式進行之。從中，仔細咀嚼或清澀曖昧、或清新動人、或可歌可泣、或刻骨銘心、或纏綿悱惻、或黯然銷魂的愛情文學作品；從中，與作品中所傳達的心情、心事、心聲產生共鳴，由此來發現：在塵世的繁華裡，情感的傳遞是沒有時空隔閡，是可以心心相映。
鑑於修課同學正值青春年華、正將展翅翱翔，因此本課程除了鑑賞、品味古今愛情文學作品，並欲與吾人現實人生作一連結，由此思考愛情、婚姻、兩性、家國、社會、政治等議題，由此尋求愛情的本質與真諦。

syllabi.notes:
*本課程為文本細讀與討論課，限定選課人數30人。不加簽，以系統選課學生為主。

一、課程對應指標：5性別平等
指標對應授課內容：第14,15週授課內容對應指標5性別平等中的「通過多元管道對民眾傳播性別平等觀念」

二、 第12、13、14、15週課程對應創新品德教育中6E的「啟發思辨（Explanation）」，相關學習成效將以「課堂參與及討論」檢視。

三、彈性學習說明
1.類別：參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查
2.內容 ：「與實體書店的邂逅」，請同學自行前往一家書店並挑選一本書籍閱讀，拍攝你與書店的合照、你挑選的書籍(封面或內頁)，並撰寫心得報告。

description.zh: 本課程的特色是希望藉由管弦樂音樂的播放，與實體樂器的展示、示範演出，互相結合，使同學在欣賞高水準的音樂之餘，更能實際接觸到平常接觸不到的實體樂器，實際的觀察樂器的構造，近距離的欣賞到樂器，能聽到實際上發出的聲音，從而對材料機械，科技與樂器聲響之間的關係，有一個真實而全新的認識，進而引發對音樂的認識以及興趣。
description.en: The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

description.zh: 東亞各國與台灣不僅在地理上有相近的距離，歷史亦有各種不同的互動。東亞包括東北亞與東南亞，早在東北亞的日本殖民台灣之前，位在東南亞的印尼就曾經以巴達維亞-荷蘭聯合東印度公司總部，和台灣有許多聯繫。本課程將介紹東亞-日、韓、越南、泰國、馬來西亞、新加坡、印尼等和台灣之間的歷史關聯。
description.en: The Eastern Asian countries are not only geographically close to--but they also have a lot historical interactions with Taiwan. Eastern Asia is actually made up of both northeaster and southeastern countries. The fact is: even before the "Northeastern" Japan begins colonizing Taiwan, the "Southeastern" Indonesia has been in prior contact with Taiwan in the name of BATAVIA: the Dutch East India Company. This course focuses on the historical connection between Taiwan and Eastern Asian countries, including Japan, Korea, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia.

description.zh: 本課程目標如下：（一）以心理學為基礎，探討人類生活各面向的知識；（二）建立學生生活行為的技能；（三）促使學生建立自己積極的價值體系。  本課程內容涵蓋人類的個體發展、學習方式、動機、情緒、態度、人格、兩性、愛情、家庭、育兒、健康管理、社會行為等生活面的相關行為。  本課程採學生中心教學法，以啟發法、小組討論、創造式發表等方式授課，藉以活潑學生的思考並增加學生上台練習的機會。
description.en: The objectives of this course are : (1)By basing on the psychology   to guide our students to discuss the variant facets of their lives. (2)To establish the students' good skills to deal with their own lives. (3)To found the students' positive value systems .  This course includes the human behaviors of individual development , learning strategies, motivations, emotion, attitudes, personality, social interaction, religious lives, love, bisexual interaction, family lives, children cultivation , and etc. This course uses the learner-centered instructing strategies. The methods of discovery learning, teams discussion, creative teaching , and etc. will be adopted, in order to excite the students to do deep thought and give them the opportunities to show their efforts and achievements themselves.

description.zh: 勞動法包括與勞動市場、個別勞動關係及集體勞動關係等方面有關勞工工作權益的法律規範，透過本課程可以學習正確的勞動法律觀念和知識，同時培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，來保障並維護自己或他人的職場權益。
description.en: The legal specialty called Labor Law can be define as “the legal regulation of the labor market , individual labor relations and collective employer-employee relations. “labor market” pertains to market in which employers and workers exchange labor . Through this course , students can not only get correct concepts of " Labor Law " , but learn to protect their / others' rights in work place.

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh: 以攝影來進行社會介入的創作作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成在社會學領域中越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。本課程主要分為兩大部分，第一部分將從攝影史發展脈絡，來談攝影的社會使用，第二部分則是探討在當代藝術中，如何將攝影作為一種社會實踐的方式。除課堂講解和集體討論外，本課程也將透過實作討論同學的攝影計畫和作品，期使讓同學對於攝影，可以產生新的社會性思考，並開始進行影像與社會介入的嘗試。
description.en: In the field of contemporary art, photography has been developing into a way of social intervention. This trend also contributes to triggering more dialogues concerning “photography and society” in the discipline of sociology. The course mainly includes two parts: photography history and the photography as a social practice. In the first section, along with the history of photography, the social usages of photography will be introduced. In the second section, how photography art can be a social practice and what kinds of practice have been explored will be . In addition to class lectures and group discussions, the course requires all students to complete their individual photo project in the end of semester and their works will be presented in class.

第 16 本：W. Eugene Smith & Aileen M. Smith《MINAMATA》
關連說明：經典紀實攝影，揭露日本水俁病（汞污染）對居民健康的毀滅性打擊。與 SDG 3.9（大幅減少因危險化學品、空氣、水和土壤污染所導致的死亡與疾病） 具高度關連。

第 6 本：唐景《顏姐》
關連說明：記錄二十世紀華南地區獨身女性勞動者（自梳女 / 媽姐）在香港幫傭的生命史。與 SDG 10.2（提升邊緣化群體的社會與經濟融入） 及 SDG 5（性別平等） 具高度關連。
第 18 本：星玄人《Nishinari》（西成）、第 19 本：梁丞佑《新宿迷子》
關連說明：拍攝大阪西成區日雇勞工、流浪者與新宿街頭邊緣人的生存百態。與 SDG 10.2（促進弱勢邊緣族群的社會融入） 與 SDG 1.2（減少貧窮） 具高度關連。
SDG 16 和平、正義與健全司法
第 1 本：中藤毅彥《香港 2019》、第 7 本：高仲明《港傷》
關連說明：記錄 2019 年香港反修例運動，紀實人民捍衛法治與自由的傷痕。與 SDG 16.3（促進國家與國際法治，確保所有人司法公正） 及 SDG 16.1（減少一切形式的暴力） 具高度關連。

SDG 3 良好健康與福祉
第 2 本：呂楠《被遺忘的人》（經典三部曲之一）
關連說明：深入記錄中國精神病患者的生存現狀，喚起大眾對精神健康與人權的關注。與 SDG 3.4（促進精神健康與福祉） 具高度關連。

關連說明：沿著黃河逆流而上，捕捉現代化工業擴張下，黃河流域景觀與自然生態的巨大改變。與 SDG 15.1（保護與復育河流及陸地生態系統） 具高度關連。

syllabi.notes:
Week 2《木棉的顏色 ─ 工殤顯影》、《行過幽谷》與【啟發思辨】有關。引導同學跳脫教條，思辨「勞動尊嚴」與「弱勢者人權」，並學習在現實社會的複雜情境中展現同理心與尊重。
《看見淡水河攝影專輯》與【環境形塑】有關。警示學生「環境倫理」與永續發展的重要，藉此形塑出關懷人與大地和諧共存的校園及社會生態文化。

Week 3《在夾縫中抵抗 ─ 大觀社區影像手記》與【體驗反思】有關。鼓勵學生踏出校園，將課堂影像轉化為實際的社會關懷與反思，進而培養關懷社會的責任感與親身助人的實踐力。

Week 6《MINAMATA》與【勸勉激勵】有關。激勵學生在面對巨大不公義時，能展現捍衛真理的道德勇氣，以及實踐生命關懷的正向動機。

Week 7《紅色新聞兵：一個攝影記者密藏底片中的文化大革命》與【典範學習】有關。李振盛為了對歷史負責而奮不顧身的精神，正是「誠實」與「專業責任」的英雄典範，發揮潛移默化之教育效果。

Week 11《Cocaine True Cocaine Blue》與【啟發思辨】有關。在全球最發達的國家中，何以產生如此巨大的不平等？又該如何看待毒品防制與弱勢扶助政策，以澄清和重構我們對於公義與關懷的內在價值系統。

description.zh:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。
新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。
課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 新創公司財務規劃良窳往往決定一家公司能否走得長遠，公司財務管理制度不健全導致週轉不靈倒閉的案例比比皆是，其中更是不乏資質良好的公司。本課程首先介紹創新商業模式，再教授創業應注意之基本知識，最後指導同學新創企業財務管理。

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

description.zh: 台灣與日本，在地理上是鄰居，在歷史上也有密切關係，在當代則是彼此經貿、文化、觀光等關係密切的鄰國。本課程主要介紹台灣與日本間的關係，其發展與變遷的過程，讓學生更了解台灣之外，也希望能培養學生觀察東亞世界各地域相互關係的視野。
description.en: Geographically and historically, Taiwan and Japan are neighbors. Today, they have close relationship with each other in view of trade & business, culture and touring. This course focuses on the mutual relationships between Taiwan and Japan as well as the transformational changes undergoing in the processes. We would like to have the students to have a clearer picture of Taiwan; additionally, it is our hope that the students could develop a wider vision on the geographically interactive positions existent in the Eastern Asia areas.

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:.  Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members.  This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright.  In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt.  In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

description.zh: 勞動法包括與勞動市場、個別勞動關係及集體勞動關係等方面有關勞工工作權益的法律規範，透過本課程可以學習正確的勞動法律觀念和知識，同時培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，來保障並維護自己或他人的職場權益。
description.en: The legal specialty called Labor Law can be define as “the legal regulation of the labor market , individual labor relations and collective employer-employee relations. “labor market” pertains to market in which employers and workers exchange labor . Through this course , students can not only get correct concepts of " Labor Law " , but learn to protect their / others' rights in work place.

description.zh: 以攝影來進行社會介入的創作作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成在社會學領域中越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。本課程主要分為兩大部分，第一部分將從攝影史發展脈絡，來談攝影的社會使用，第二部分則是探討在當代藝術中，如何將攝影作為一種社會實踐的方式。除課堂講解和集體討論外，本課程也將透過實作討論同學的攝影計畫和作品，期使讓同學對於攝影，可以產生新的社會性思考，並開始進行影像與社會介入的嘗試。
description.en: In the field of contemporary art, photography has been developing into a way of social intervention. This trend also contributes to triggering more dialogues concerning “photography and society” in the discipline of sociology. The course mainly includes two parts: photography history and the photography as a social practice. In the first section, along with the history of photography, the social usages of photography will be introduced. In the second section, how photography art can be a social practice and what kinds of practice have been explored will be . In addition to class lectures and group discussions, the course requires all students to complete their individual photo project in the end of semester and their works will be presented in class.

syllabi.notes:
Week 2《木棉的顏色 ─ 工殤顯影》、《行過幽谷》與【啟發思辨】有關。引導同學跳脫教條，思辨「勞動尊嚴」與「弱勢者人權」，並學習在現實社會的複雜情境中展現同理心與尊重。
《看見淡水河攝影專輯》與【環境形塑】有關。警示學生「環境倫理」與永續發展的重要，藉此形塑出關懷人與大地和諧共存的校園及社會生態文化。

Week 3《在夾縫中抵抗 ─ 大觀社區影像手記》與【體驗反思】有關。鼓勵學生踏出校園，將課堂影像轉化為實際的社會關懷與反思，進而培養關懷社會的責任感與親身助人的實踐力。

Week 6《MINAMATA》與【勸勉激勵】有關。激勵學生在面對巨大不公義時，能展現捍衛真理的道德勇氣，以及實踐生命關懷的正向動機。

Week 7《紅色新聞兵：一個攝影記者密藏底片中的文化大革命》與【典範學習】有關。李振盛為了對歷史負責而奮不顧身的精神，正是「誠實」與「專業責任」的英雄典範，發揮潛移默化之教育效果。

Week 11《Cocaine True Cocaine Blue》與【啟發思辨】有關。在全球最發達的國家中，何以產生如此巨大的不平等？又該如何看待毒品防制與弱勢扶助政策，以澄清和重構我們對於公義與關懷的內在價值系統。

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

syllabi.outline:
膳食是生活上一件非常重要的事， 所謂「 You are what you eat.」，「今日的飲食造就明日的細胞組成」，都明白闡述出飲食習慣對個人健康具有直接的影響力。現代人生活上還面臨著各項挑戰，例如我們經常要面對各式各樣的壓力，以及生活環境遭受污染充斥著各種毒素等問題，因此我們必須先瞭解如何避食品毒物，再藉由選擇正確的食物與良好的飲食習慣來維持身體的健康。
本課程前半部先探討近期台灣近期發生的食品安全事件，藉由事件來瞭解如何避開毒物；後半部介紹食物內各種營養素的功能，再進一步探討如何選擇有益的食物來調整身體機能，並促進健康。

description.zh:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。
新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。
課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

description.zh: 本課程是為非專業學生所設計的哲學概論，介紹西洋哲學的起源、西洋哲學的問題，以及哲學與人生的關係。哲學的問題意識起自人類的自覺，人類意圖認識自己，為宇宙人生尋求解答，哲學的發生本自人類天賦的求知欲，即其本性中對於智慧的追求與愛慕。這種愛慕智慧的精神是希臘文明留給西方世界的遺產，對於知識能持客觀批判的精神，對於真理能存認真熱切的態度，對於人生能有超克苦難的修持。在國際化的世代，我們對西方的認識應更深入其精神層面，此乃本課程規劃的初衷。
description.en: This course is designed for student who is not disciplined in philosophy. As an introduction, we begin at the origin of western philosophy, the philosophical questions and finally, the relationship of human life and philosophy. Philosophy takes place when human being thinking of himself. Man by nature desire to know himself as well as the external world. And due to this love of wisdom, men can be critical to knowledge and be passionate toward truth. Eventually, grasping the sprit of western philosophy , we can view our life in quite a different view. In our time, facing the world of international, we should better understand the western culture, which is rooted in philosophy.

description.zh:
本課程首先說明人在宇宙中的定位、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與天地萬物和諧相處和真愛的永不止息。
課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類共同的智慧，並安排數次的校外教學，以深入瞭解社會脈動，並運用多媒體影片教學以提升學習效果，學生每天做身心觀察學習紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。
description.en:
This course covers topics such as: the role of human beings in the universe, the dearness of life and the pursuit of life-long goals. We then discuss ways to train the students to become brave and to harmonize human beings with the nature, leading to an access to the discovery of true love.
The course is realized through activity involvement, experience sharing and lectures on human wisdom. We have some extramural visits in order to understand social pulses. Multimedia teaching materials are fully utilized to enhance the teaching and learning effects. We request that all the students take note of their mental and physical improvements on a daily basis so that they could examine the progressive path of life.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以「生命」為主軸，核心涵蓋「自我探索、人際互動、生死價值」三個面向的主題。藉由全面性的探討與體驗式的學習，引領學生接近生命的內在本質、探索生命的存在價值，以建立理解生命、尊重生命、體驗生命、珍惜生命、熱愛生命的觀念與態度，進而展開符合自他期待的人生與品格。
本課程期待能夠在以下三方面引導同學：
1. 情意方面：探索生命並建立正確的人生態度，找到自我的定位與價值；能夠熱愛自己的生命，也尊重其他的生命，並與他人建立良好的互動。
2. 認知方面：深刻了解「自我」的不同面向，以及「生死」的深層意義與存在價值。
3. 技能方面：熟悉人生主要問題的解決途徑，以及尋求支援的方法與管道，進而培養獨立思考、克服困難的資糧與能力。
syllabi.assessment:
1.個人平時成績55％：課堂參與30％、課堂練習25％。
2.小組平時成績15％：課堂小組活動與討論，預定全班分為10組，約6人一組。
3.個人期中報告15％：預定第8、9週於課堂進行個人口頭報告，每人3分鐘，題目為「我的生命小故事大啟示」，分享一個發生在自己身上的小故事，以及它所帶給你的啟示與收穫。成績當場評定，無須繳交檔案，但可攜帶輔助說明資料或工具。
4.小組期末報告15％：本項計畫預定於第12週於課堂擬訂，由組員依循邏輯思考選定目標，展開為期4–5週的微型習慣培養或戒除，其間除了進行每日實踐與紀錄，每週需與 AI 教練進行動態對話與策略調整。第16週於課堂進行期末報告說明與組內討論，激盪出組內彼此看見與發現的火花；第17、18週維持實體到校課堂進行，題目為「讓生命更美好」，各組須於第17、18週在課堂上進行實體課堂發表與組間回饋，每組繳交由每人一至四頁成果所彙整之小組報告（PDF格式）。報告內容必須包含：(1) 個人的每日執行紀錄、(2) 與 AI 對話的關鍵截圖或文字紀錄、(3) 組員間的回饋，以及 (4) 個人的反思與覺察。本報告旨在透過長期的實體與動態實踐，以培養自主管理、組員監督，以及 AI 輔助的三方面功效。最後兩週因故未能到校者，請提前一周以上申請，與教師討論後，當週得以替代方式進行。
※學習與討論態度優良者，給予加分。
※請大家帶著開放與尊重的心來參與，共學共好。

syllabi.notes:
第2-7、13-15週，引導學生認識自我身心，珍惜生命與環境，建立良好健康的生命態度。主題與「SDGs3：良好健康與社會福祉」有關。
第10-12週，引導學生了解自我的人際與社會關係，尊重並欣賞生命的個別差異，與他人真誠交流、合作成長。主題與「SDGs5：性別平等」及「SDGs17：夥伴關係」有關。

第4-5週主題內容與【勸勉激勵（Exhortation）】有關，透過了解理論與作業書寫，勉勵學生發現自我的美好、接納生命中的無奈與缺憾。
第6-7週主題內容與【正向期許（Expectation）】有關，透過活動體驗發現彼此的美好，共學共好。

description.zh: 主要目的在於透過認識不同時期、不同族群的臺灣海洋生活文化，以專題介紹與討論，帶領同學進入臺灣有趣而豐富多元的海洋文化歷史情境中，同時增進及擴展學生視野。
description.en: This course aims to introduce Taiwan’s marine life culture form different ethnic groups at different periods. This course will focus on the introduction and discussions. Hope can lead students to get to know more about Taiwan’s interesting and diverse marine cultural history, as well as enhance and widen student’s horizons.

syllabi.outline:

This course aims to introduce Taiwan’s marine life culture form different ethnic groups at different periods. This course will focus on the introduction and discussions. Hope can lead students to get to know more about Taiwan’s interesting and diverse marine cultural history, as well as enhance and widen student’s horizons.

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
1、民法是一切法律之基礎，更與生活息息相關, 人的一生，從出生到死亡，均與民法脫離不了關系，且民法為一切法律修習之基礎，其重要性可見一斑。
我國民法共分為：民法總則、債篇總論、債篇各論、物權、親屬、繼承等五篇，以及為數甚多的民事特別法，如公寓大廈管理條例，消費者保護法、土地法等等。
2、本課程除了廣泛介紹民法的相關重要概念外，期能法律理論與實務並重，並對於同學日常生活有可能遇到的相關法律問題, 含憲法、民法、刑法、行政法、智慧財產權法、法哲學、兩性平等（Gender Equality）、校園霸凌、藥物濫用等）亦為教學之重點，希望同學能在課堂上學習到解法律問題的能力，以期保護自身之權益。
另外，時事法律分析討論，以及老師律師執業經手有趣且重要的司法案件，都是上課教材，以期讓同學上課不會因法條枯橾而覺得無趣，能理論與實務相結合，而有所收益。
3、本課程鼓勵同學隨時發問，或回答問題（但均不會強迫點名哪位同學發言）。
4、本課程並相當重視同學的分組報告，以訓練同學搜尋資料、消化資料及報告、演說、論辯之能力（原則上會以分組報告取代期中、期末考。
