description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

description.zh: 大眾傳播與人類社會的關係，正隨科技的進步而日益擴大它的影響力。根據學者研究發現，人類的思想、態度與價值觀念受大眾傳播的影響日漸加深，大傳媒介不但塑造人的思想，同時也影響人們的行為及價值；然而從傳播的功能言，大眾傳播同時具有正面與負面的社會功能，故大眾傳播的發展與過程，殊值重視與探討。本課程兼顧理論與實例的探討，包括傳播特性與要素、大眾傳播的能及效果、新聞守門人理論等，並以實例分析新聞的公正客觀性、新聞自由與國家安全、媒體與選舉等傳播爭議性問題。修習本課程可培養學生閱讀新聞的正確性，不玫人云亦云，受媒體報導所擺佈；同時亦可增強學生人際溝通的技巧與能力。
description.en: With the advancement of technology, mass communication is enlarging its influence in human society.  According to  researches, the thoughts, attitudes and value judgements of humans are deeply affected by mass communication.  The media not only shape persons' thoughts, but also have an impact on their behavior and values.  Since mass communication has positive and negative social functions at the same time, its development and process are therefore worthy of paying much attention and exploration to us.  This course includes the study of the theory and practice of mass communication, such as characteristics and elements functions and effects, as well as the theory of the news gatekeepers.  It also uses stories to analyze disputed issues, for example, news objectivism, freedom of the press and national security, and media and election. description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在引介我國憲法的要義、探討憲政體制的運作、研析權利義務的實務及詮釋相關法律的適用等，期能使學生掌握國家憲政體制運作的實況、認識憲法與人權保障之間的關係，進而體現人權立國與人性尊嚴的價值。
This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

description.zh: 本課程的目標在培養學生具備有關健康的知識，以度過健康的一生。為達成此目標，本課程提供學生四方面內容。一、健康與人生概述，包括人生的意義，健康的境界，認識自己的身體；二、生理健康之道，包括健康的飲食門道，體重控制與運動處方，學習終身修練的功夫，用葯知識；三、心理健康之道，包括健康的人格發展，情緒管理，健康的人際關係，健康的性，健康的家庭生活，健康地面對老化與死亡；四、健康的生活環境，包括物理、化學與生物的環境，健康的職場生活，健康的休閒生活等。本課程除講授法外，並用影片、討論、個別習作等方式教學。

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在培養學生具備健康相關知識、正向健康態度與自我健康管理能力，協助學生建立健康生活型態，以提升健康素養並促進終身健康。藉由「健康與生活」課程，學生將學習如何促進自身健康、減輕生活壓力並提升生活品質，探索影響健康的各項生活型態因素，並規劃個人健康促進方案，同時學習與家人及朋友共同營造支持性的健康環境，以達成健康目標。課程內容涵蓋四大主軸：(一)健康與人生概述，包括人生的意義、健康的內涵及認識自己的身體；(二)生理健康之道，包括健康飲食、體重控制、運動促進及終身健康習慣；(三)心理健康之道，包括人格發展、情緒管理、人際關係，以及面對老化與死亡的健康調適；(四)健康生活環境，包括物理、化學與生物環境、健康職場及健康休閒生活等議題。課程採講授、影片欣賞、分組討論及個別習作等多元教學方式，引導學生將健康知識應用於日常生活，培養自主健康管理與健康促進能力。
This course aims to equip students with fundamental health knowledge, positive health attitudes, and self-management skills to promote lifelong health and well-being. Through Health and Life, students will learn how to improve their health, reduce stress, and enjoy a healthier and more fulfilling life. They will explore lifestyle factors that influence health, develop a personal health improvement plan, and learn how to build a supportive and healthy environment with family and friends to achieve their health goals. The course is organized into four major components: (1) Health and Life, including the meaning of life, concepts of health, and understanding one's own body; (2) Physical Health, including healthy nutrition, weight management, physical activity, and lifelong healthy habits; (3) Mental Health, including personality development, emotional management, interpersonal relationships, and healthy adaptation to aging and death; and (4) Healthy Living Environments, including physical, chemical, and biological environments, healthy workplaces, and healthy leisure lifestyles. Through lectures, multimedia learning, group discussions, and individual assignments, students will apply health knowledge in daily life and develop lifelong self-care and health promotion competencies.

透過資訊安全教育，本課程旨在培養學生的資安意識與技能，增進科技素養，建立防禦思維與實作能力，提升資訊應用中的安全性，並啟發其持續學習與探索資訊安全領域的興趣，以奠定終身學習與生涯發展的基礎。本課程之內容涵蓋十一項核心主題：一、資訊與網路安全簡介，二、安全與風險管理，三、存取控制概念，四、資訊安全作業，五、網路攻擊技術與防禦，六、安全操作系統與應用，七、網路安全管理與政策，八、資訊安全弱點與威脅，九、資安事件處理與應變，十、資通安全框架應用，以及十一、資訊安全檢測與弱點掃描簡介。

The course aims to lay the foundation for lifelong learning and career development. The course content covers eleven core topics: 1. Introduction to information and network security; 2. Security and risk management; 3. Concepts of access control; 4. Information security operations; 5. Network attack techniques and defenses; 6. Secure operating systems and applications; 7. Network security management and policies; 8. Information security vulnerabilities and threats; 9. Incident handling and response; 10. Applications of cybersecurity frameworks; and 11. Introduction to information security testing and vulnerability scanning.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提供學生對創業過程中智慧財產應用與商業模式設計的基礎理解。內容涵蓋創新研發與智慧財產權的關聯、商業模式構成要素、價值主張設計、以及智財行銷與授權策略。課程結合理論講授與案例討論，引導學生認識如何將創意構想轉化為具競爭力與保護力的營運模式，適合有志於創業、智慧財產管理或高科技產業實務應用的學生修習。
description.en: This course provides a foundational understanding of how intellectual property (IP) plays a strategic role in entrepreneurship and business model design. Students will explore key concepts such as innovation commercialization, IP protection and valuation, and the structure of business models that leverage IP assets. Through lectures, case studies, and project-based learning, students will gain insights into how to transform technical ideas into competitive and sustainable business strategies. The course is ideal for students interested in entrepreneurship, IP management, and innovation-driven industries.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

syllabi.outline:
課程結構與規劃：以藝術欣賞的形式為課程的主要架構，.內容包括中西名家繪畫與藝術品欣賞、中國文字之美、台灣美術欣賞、台灣生態、原住民藝術，建築與雕塑之美及國際性的藝術博覽會，如義大利威尼斯雙年展(La Biennale di Venezia)，香港的Art  Basel 等。課程內容規劃結合藝術欣賞與藝術概論，並融合藝術與生活、藝術與社會、藝術與歷史、藝術與宗教、藝術與人文關懷、藝術與設計和藝術與生態環境之間的交相連結所造成的多元關係。
課程目標與期許：
培養敏銳的觀察力及繪畫欣賞的素養和對藝術的喜愛及推廣；藉由報告及校外參觀的形式，提供「在旅行中發現文化、在旅行中發現藝術」的學習機會，親身經歷及探尋週遭的在地文化，認識和欣賞是關心和行動的開始，啟發關懷社會、關懷自然環境、愛鄉、愛國之情操。藝術不惟形而上只是少數人的範疇，應該走入社會、大眾化、生活化，並有啟示成教化、助人倫之功效，期望參與的學生能具有多元視野的藝術觀。

description.zh:
本課程首先說明人在宇宙中的定位、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與天地萬物和諧相處和真愛的永不止息。
課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類共同的智慧，並安排數次的校外教學，以深入瞭解社會脈動，並運用多媒體影片教學以提升學習效果，學生每天做身心觀察學習紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。
description.en:
This course covers topics such as: the role of human beings in the universe, the dearness of life and the pursuit of life-long goals. We then discuss ways to train the students to become brave and to harmonize human beings with the nature, leading to an access to the discovery of true love.
The course is realized through activity involvement, experience sharing and lectures on human wisdom. We have some extramural visits in order to understand social pulses. Multimedia teaching materials are fully utilized to enhance the teaching and learning effects. We request that all the students take note of their mental and physical improvements on a daily basis so that they could examine the progressive path of life.

syllabi.outline:
人為萬物之靈，你相信嗎?本課程開啟思考與論辯的交流，希望一起面對人類最重要的問題，一起尋求解方。從認識自己和在乎別人開始，尋找此生的定位，認識人性的尊嚴、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與別人對談連結，與萬事萬物和諧相處，讓真愛永不止息。

課程進行方式是透過體驗、辯論、交流分享和有次第的講授人類最精純的智慧，並安排人物訪談和分組活動，以深入瞭解別人的思維，運用多樣化教學以提升學習效果，學生每週做學習心得紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

description.zh: 婚姻是一般人所必經的過程，家庭是生活的場所，關係著人生的幸福與美滿。本課程強調美滿婚姻與幸福家庭是一門學問，因此，課程內容包括：對婚姻與家庭有正確的認知、積極的態度、完整的規劃，並培養有認真努力去實踐的方法與能力。如何追求真正的快樂與幸福？除了在婚姻與家庭中追求平等化、合理化、自由化、公平化外，自我成長、相互尊重都是本課程的學習目標，以協助學生思考婚姻與家庭的終生大事。
description.en: Marriage is a process that most people will go through.  Family is where you belong to, and where the satisfaction and happiness come from. We believe that it is a kind of scholarship to have a high-quality marriage and a wonderful family.  The contents of this course include having the correct understanding of marriage and family, cultivating positive attitude, developing complete plans, and realizing them with all efforts. This course will help students think totally about marriage and family, learn to pursue equality, reasonableness and liberty, keep growing and respect each other, so that we can obtain the real delight and happiness.

description.zh:
本課程由全球化框架來檢視兩岸關係的演進、現況、及發展趨勢。
由政治、經濟、乃至社會心理層面分析海峽兩岸錯綜複雜的互動關係。
並檢視國際政治經濟體系中，美國與日本兩大國對兩岸關係的影響。
description.en:
This introductory course on the complex cross-strait interactions will examine
Taiwan’s role in the intricate web of international power politics; as well as the structure of hegemonic power rivalry, particularly Sino-US-Japan triangle, and its impact on cross strait relations. The material will cover the evolution, status quo, and developmental path of the cross strait relations in a global framework.

description.zh: 本課程的目標在培養學生具備有關健康的知識，以度過健康的一生。為達成此目標，本課程提供學生四方面內容。一、健康與人生概述，包括人生的意義，健康的境界，認識自己的身體；二、生理健康之道，包括健康的飲食門道，體重控制與運動處方，學習終身修練的功夫，用葯知識；三、心理健康之道，包括健康的人格發展，情緒管理，健康的人際關係，健康的性，健康的家庭生活，健康地面對老化與死亡；四、健康的生活環境，包括物理、化學與生物的環境，健康的職場生活，健康的休閒生活等。本課程除講授法外，並用影片、討論、個別習作等方式教學。

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在培養學生具備健康相關知識、正向健康態度與自我健康管理能力，協助學生建立健康生活型態，以提升健康素養並促進終身健康。藉由「健康與生活」課程，學生將學習如何促進自身健康、減輕生活壓力並提升生活品質，探索影響健康的各項生活型態因素，並規劃個人健康促進方案，同時學習與家人及朋友共同營造支持性的健康環境，以達成健康目標。課程內容涵蓋四大主軸：(一)健康與人生概述，包括人生的意義、健康的內涵及認識自己的身體；(二)生理健康之道，包括健康飲食、體重控制、運動促進及終身健康習慣；(三)心理健康之道，包括人格發展、情緒管理、人際關係，以及面對老化與死亡的健康調適；(四)健康生活環境，包括物理、化學與生物環境、健康職場及健康休閒生活等議題。課程採講授、影片欣賞、分組討論及個別習作等多元教學方式，引導學生將健康知識應用於日常生活，培養自主健康管理與健康促進能力。
This course aims to equip students with fundamental health knowledge, positive health attitudes, and self-management skills to promote lifelong health and well-being. Through Health and Life, students will learn how to improve their health, reduce stress, and enjoy a healthier and more fulfilling life. They will explore lifestyle factors that influence health, develop a personal health improvement plan, and learn how to build a supportive and healthy environment with family and friends to achieve their health goals. The course is organized into four major components: (1) Health and Life, including the meaning of life, concepts of health, and understanding one's own body; (2) Physical Health, including healthy nutrition, weight management, physical activity, and lifelong healthy habits; (3) Mental Health, including personality development, emotional management, interpersonal relationships, and healthy adaptation to aging and death; and (4) Healthy Living Environments, including physical, chemical, and biological environments, healthy workplaces, and healthy leisure lifestyles. Through lectures, multimedia learning, group discussions, and individual assignments, students will apply health knowledge in daily life and develop lifelong self-care and health promotion competencies.

name.en: IP Management in Electronic Technology Industry

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹電子科技產業趨勢及智慧財產權管理策略，第一部分介紹電子科技產業發展趨勢；第二部分介紹智慧財產權管理策略與模式；第三部分以個案研討方式，帶領學生討論相關產業之智慧財產權管理實務，包含品牌管理、專利布局策略、商標申請與運用、著作權議題、營業秘密之保護等相關案例。
description.en: This course will introduce the industrial trends and IP management strategies, including the followings: 1. development trend of electronic technology industry, 2. IP management strategies and model of technology industry, 3. To discuss the intellectual property management practices of the related industries, including brand management, patent portfolio strategies, trademark application strategies, copyright issues, the protection of business secrets and other related cases.

description.zh:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。
新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。
課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

description.zh: 本課程透過專題式設計單元（Thematic Design Studio）的教學架構，引導學生將建築操作視為一種探詢當代文化、社會動態與空間現象的批判性媒介。課程鼓勵學生跳脫純粹的機能性與物理性思考，轉而關注建築如何回應並介入複雜的文化與環境脈絡。透過研究導向的設計過程，學生將探索空間形式與人類行為、歷史紋理或跨文化議題之間的對話關係，進而在多元的限制與情境中，發展出具備文化敏感度與深度的建築提案。
description.en: Structured around a thematic design studio, this module positions architectural operation as a critical apparatus for investigating contemporary culture, social dynamics, and spatial phenomena. Moving beyond mere functionalist and physical parameters, students are challenged to examine how architecture engages with and acts upon complex cultural and environmental contexts. Utilising a research-led design methodology, students will interrogate the dialogue between spatial form and human behaviour, historical strata, or cross-cultural conditions. This rigorous process will enable them to formulate architectural proposals of cultural sensitivity and depth, while negotiating a multiplicity of constraints and situations.

name.zh: 企業倫理與社會責任實踐
name.en: Corporate Ethics and Social Responsibility Practice

description.zh: 本課程主要在讓學生藉由規劃與實施一項公益活動，以實踐企業倫理與社會責任，並藉以思考在推展企業倫理、企業社會責任與公司治理等理念時，如何能落實於企業的體制之中，以建立一個永續發展的企業價值體系。
description.en: This course is designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.

name.en: Special Topics on Engineering Information Management

description.zh: 本課程將以工程資訊管理之觀點，介紹國內外工程資訊管理及營建自動化案例，包含資訊管理程式撰寫及探討資料庫之設計與實作，希望學生能夠由設計一個資訊系統開始，瞭解工程資訊管理系統之基本概念與應用，進而實際開發一個資訊管理系統，其內容包括：營建自動化應用，建築資訊模型應用，國內外工程資訊管理案例探討，工程資訊之分析與設計，資訊管理程式撰寫，資料庫系統之設計與實作，及系統分析與設計等方法。
description.en: This course will provide students with the application of engineering information management and the practice of construction management system, management information system concept, the introduction of database design, building information management application, web-based project management system development, integrate construction management information system's introduction, the introduction of construction automation application, the future of engineering information management and other special topics.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將以工程資訊管理之觀點，介紹國內外工程資訊管理及營建自動化案例，包含資訊管理程式撰寫及探討資料庫之設計與實作，希望學生能夠由設計一個資訊系統開始，瞭解工程資訊管理系統之基本概念與應用，進而實際開發一個資訊管理系統，其內容包括：營建自動化應用，建築資訊模型應用，國內外工程資訊管理案例探討，工程資訊之分析與設計，資訊管理程式撰寫，資料庫系統之設計與實作，及系統分析與設計等方法。
This course will provide students with the application of engineering information management (EIM) and the practice of construction management system, management information system concept, the introduction of database design, building information management application, web-based system for EIM, integrate construction management information system's introduction, the introduction of construction automation application, AI-based applications for EIM, the future of engineering information management and other special topics.

description.zh:
過去研究人類行為多聚焦在人類的缺陷和問題，包括攻擊性、精神疾病、非常態行為等。正向心理學開始集中在研究如何使人變得更快樂，以及生命的意義。
正向心理學的主要目標是強化人類的優勢，例如創造力、開心、心流，以及樂觀。我們應學習讓生活更正向，因為快樂會帶來更多好的工作與學業表現、社會關係，亦會使我們更長壽與健康。
description.en:
Most study of human behavior has focused mainly on what goes wrong in human affairs: aggression, mental disease, abnormal behavior, and so on. Positive psychology is centered on helping people become happier and making life most worth living.
Positive Psychology aims at enhancing human strengths such as creativity, joy, flow, and optimal performance. People have to learn how to make life more positive, because happiness leads to desirable outcomes at school and work, to fulfilling social relationships, and even to good health and long life.

description.zh:
「民事訴訟法」第一個部分，此部分旨在向修課同學作民事訴訟法之概括介紹，而此一介紹包含下列三個重點： 一、民事訴訟法之立法背景 二、民事訴訟法之理論 三、民事訴訟法之解釋方法 參與此部分乃理解民事訴訟法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
第二個部分，此部分會聚焦在民事訴訟法之細節上，尤其是下列三個重點：
一、對於民事訴訟法之進一步闡述
二、民事訴訟法於案例事實之適用
三、民法與民事訴訟法之結合
於此部分課程結束時，修課同學應有能力依據民事訴訟法來處理常見之民事法律問題。
description.en:
“Civil Procedure Law” the first part of this course, is aiming to give participants a general introduction to the Civil Procedure Law, and the introduction contains the following three points: 1. The legislative background of the Civil Procedure Law. 2. The theories of the Civil Procedure Law. 3. The interpretive methods of the Civil Procedure Law. Attending the part is the critical step to understanding the Civil Procedure Law and benefits participants a lot.
The second part of this course, is focusing on the details of the Civil Proce-dure Law, especially the following three points: 
1. Further elucidation of the Civil Procedure Law.
2. Application of the Civil Procedure Law to the facts.
3. Combination of the Civil Law and the Civil Procedure Law.
At the end of the part, participants are supposed to be able to deal with common civil legal problems according to the Civil Procedure Law.

syllabi.outline:
不論是一般之契約或車禍事件，或者是跨國之高科技侵權案件，我們生活中之大小事均與民事訴訟程序息息相關，無論是否從事法律業，皆有學習民事訴訟法之必要，以維護自己的權益。本課程即旨在以淺顯易懂之方式，介紹民事訴訟法之基礎理論及規範，並輔以案例來加以說明，俾使修課同學能對於民事訴訟建立基本之了解，並進而能作初步之實務應用。
本課程除了民事訴訟法的規定本身外，也會教授相關的民法規定，故即使無民法基礎的同學亦歡迎修課。

description.zh: 民主政治為法治政治，凡政府各項施政均需有法令依據。行政法，乃是國家各行政機關所適用之各種法令規章之總稱，其內容含蓋國家行政機關之組織、職權、作用、程序及爭訟等事項之法規，範圍至為廣泛，且與人民之權利、義務息息相關。本課程將以系統化、生動化，並輔以實例之方式講授，以啟發同學學習興趣。同學修習本課程，除可增進法治知能與素養外，並可對日常生活之權益維護有重大裨益。
description.en: Democracy is regarded as rule by law nowadays. All official policies that are implemented by government must be based on law. Administrative law is a general term of all kinds of regulations and laws that are suitable for administrative organizations. The content includes of administrative organization in this country. The course serves as extensive rules that are related to people is rights and obligations. The principle emphasis of the course is on the systematic instruction with specific examples enlighten students learning interest, furthermore not only promoting knowledge and professional training in law but also effective in daily life.

Administrative law is a general term of all kinds of regulations and laws that are suitable for administrative organizations. The content includes of administrative organization in this country. The course serves as extensive rules that are related to people is rights and obligations. The principle emphasis of the course is on the systematic instruction with specific examples enlighten students learning interest, furthermore not only promoting knowledge and professional training in law but also effective in daily life.

description.zh: 本課程以理論與實務之教學方式，來向所有修課同學作刑法之概括介紹，其中包含刑法總則及刑法分則。再者，此一介紹包括下列四個重點：一、刑法之背景及理論；二、刑法之解釋；三、刑法於案例事實之適用；四、刑法與刑事訴訟法之結合。參與本課程乃理解刑法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
description.en: This course tries to give students a general introduction to "Criminal Law", including "General Provisions" and "Specific Offenses" through teaching methods of theories and practices. Furthermore, the introduction contains the following four points: 1. Background and theories of Criminal Law. 2. Interpretation of Criminal Law. 3. Application of Criminal Law to the facts. 4. Combination of Criminal Law and Criminal Procedure Law. Attending this course is the critical step to understanding Criminal Law, and it benefits students a lot.

description.zh: 著作權法係為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，促進國家文化發展，所特別制定之法律。該法所稱著作包括：語文著作、音樂著作、戲劇、舞蹈著作、美術著作、攝影著作、圖形著作、視聽著作、錄音著作、建築著作、電腦程式著作等。著作權的保障內涵則包含因著作完成所生之著作人格權及著作財產權。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於著作權的瞭解。
description.en: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. "Works" of this act, include the following:1.Oral and literary works.2.Musical works.3.Dramatic and choreographic works.4.Artistic works.5.Photographic works.6.Pictorial and graphical works.7.Audiovisual works.8.Sound recordings.9.Architectural works.10.Computer programs. "Copyright" means the moral rights and economic rights subsisting in a completed work. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding of Copyright for the students.

syllabi.outline:
二十一世紀的「腦力經濟」最重要的戲規則就是「智慧財產權」，同時也是WTO會員必須遵守的重要規範之一；為配合本校為頂尖科技大學，有強調技術發展之傳統，課程內容以與技術特性最為相關的「專利法」為主軸，並於相應主題帶入著作權、商標權及營業秘密等重要智慧財產之觀念，以建構出智慧財權產之整體知識。

One of the most important rules in the 21st-century "knowledge economy" is intellectual property rights, which is also a crucial requirement for WTO members to comply with. To align with our university's emphasis on technological development as a top-tier technology institution, the course content focuses on "Patent Law," which is highly relevant to technology. Additionally, concepts related to copyright, trademark rights, and trade secrets, which are significant aspects of intellectual property, will be integrated into relevant topics to construct a comprehensive understanding of intellectual property rights.

name.en: Ethics and Law of Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討人工智慧 (AI) 快速發展所帶來的複雜倫理、法律和社會挑戰。我們將從理解 AI 的基本概念與能力出發，剖析其在偏見與公平性、透明度與可解釋性、責任歸屬、隱私保護、自主性以及對勞動市場和社會結構的影響等方面的倫理困境。課程中將檢視現有法律框架（如侵權、智慧財產權、反歧視、數據保護）如何適用於AI，並重點分析全球範圍內新興的 AI 專門法規與治理策略。學生將學習批判性地評估AI的應用、風險與效益，並探討創新的倫理準則、法律規範和政策工具。本課程適合對AI 技術、倫理、法律、公共政策或社會影響有興趣的學生。
description.en: This course aims to explore the complex ethical, legal, and social challenges brought about by the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Starting from an understanding of the fundamental concepts and capabilities of AI, we will analyze ethical dilemmas related to bias and fairness, transparency and explainability, accountability, privacy protection, autonomy, and the impact on labor markets and social structures. The course will examine how existing legal frameworks—such as tort law, intellectual property rights, anti-discrimination laws, and data protection—apply to AI, with a focus on emerging AI-specific regulations and governance strategies worldwide. Students will learn to critically evaluate the applications, risks, and benefits of AI, and explore innovative ethical guidelines, legal norms, and policy tools. This course is suitable for students interested in AI technology, ethics, law, public policy, or social impact.

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想學到對於不論是升學、創業或就業都有幫助的專業或技能，這堂課程一定能帶給你滿滿的收穫，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。
description.en: Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。
description.en: Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

syllabi.outline:
This is a history course of western classical music, of which the definition, according to The New Harvard Dictionary of Music and The Oxford Dictionary, is "art music” or "serious music", that written in a Western musical tradition, using an established form. "Classical music is generally considered to be serious and to have a lasting value.”
The styles of various periods will be introduced, from the Medieval, Renaissance, Classical, Romantic, to the Contemporary eras. The goal of this course is helping students to equip a general comprehension of Classical Music in terms of basic elements of musical art, technical theory, historical, social and cultural background extends to related arts and humanities. 
In addition, basic elements of music notation reading and theory will also be made known to the students.
Other genres such as Alternative Rock and related fields will be interlaced with the Classical Music. 

In order to pursue the most accurate references and info, the major key-points and terminology used in this course will be in English or original European text.
(There are requirements to fulfill this course such as Midterm & Final Exams, as well as in-class presentation or performance. If you're not interested in serious music genre, please DO NOT take this course.)

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe

2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture

3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music.

4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 

5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque

6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso

7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet

8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach

9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues.

10th week: Midterm Exam

11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage **Students' presentations begin**

12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette

13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 

14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period

15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music

16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period. The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music; comparison with other genres 

18th week: Final Exam

description.zh: 以視覺藝術為探討重點，研究藝術起源以及原始美術、民俗與大眾藝術分野。探究式覺元素和設計原理以及應用媒材、使用技巧，涵蓋素描、水彩、油畫、版畫、混合媒材、雕塑、建築，廣告、包裝、服裝設計、工業產品設計及攝影等。配合幻燈教學，使同學對於視覺藝術有整體性、概括性的認識，以奠定將來從事藝術鑑賞和研究創造之基礎。
description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

課程目標：
1. 各時期藝術的介紹與鑑賞
2. 培養學生藝文賞析的能力, 提升自身的美感經驗
3. 發現生活中的藝術之美

description.zh: 鋼琴擁有寬廣的音域，無論獨奏或合奏，鋼琴都能恰如其分地奏出悠揚音樂。這門課程將介紹鋼琴的起源與構造、各個時代的經典鋼琴作品與著名的鋼琴家，並且讓同學體驗彈奏鋼琴短曲的樂趣。期許能透過欣賞與實作，讓同學更深刻地理解鋼琴音樂之美，培養終身的興趣。
description.en: The piano possesses a broad tonal range, and whether in a solo or ensemble context, it adeptly delivers enchanting music. This course will provide an introduction to the piano's origins and construction, classic piano compositions spanning different periods, and celebrated pianists. Moreover, it will afford students the opportunity to relish the pleasure of playing short piano pieces. By engaging in both appreciation and hands-on practice, students are anticipated to enhance their comprehension of the beauty of piano music and develop a lifelong interest.

description.zh: 鋼琴擁有寬廣的音域，無論獨奏或合奏，鋼琴都能恰如其分地奏出悠揚音樂。這門課程將介紹鋼琴的起源與構造、各個時代的經典鋼琴作品與著名的鋼琴家，並且讓同學體驗彈奏鋼琴短曲的樂趣。期許能透過欣賞與實作，讓同學更深刻地理解鋼琴音樂之美，培養終身的興趣。
description.en: The piano possesses a broad tonal range, and whether in a solo or ensemble context, it adeptly delivers enchanting music. This course will provide an introduction to the piano's origins and construction, classic piano compositions spanning different periods, and celebrated pianists. Moreover, it will afford students the opportunity to relish the pleasure of playing short piano pieces. By engaging in both appreciation and hands-on practice, students are anticipated to enhance their comprehension of the beauty of piano music and develop a lifelong interest.

description.en: This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing the four basic language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) in order to cultivate your overall Japanese language ability to a level sufficient for various occasions and everyday life.In addition , using multimedia to introduce a variety of Japanese culture, history , and humanities. The students can learn more about Japan in many different perspectives, and effectively enhance interest in the learning process.

description.zh: 本課程專為初學西班牙文之學生設計，毋需任何西班牙文基礎。本課程著重在學習西班牙文發音及了解基礎文法架構。課程結束前，學生將可以閱讀基本的西班牙文文句、自我介紹及西班牙文的基礎對話。
description.en: This is course is designed for first time students of Spanish. No previous knowledge is required to enroll this course. The focus of this course is to provide a basic knowledge of the pronunciation and grammatical structures of Spanish at the beginner level. By the end of this course, the student will be able to read basic texts in Spanish, self-introduce himself and start a basic conversation.

name.zh: 多感官回饋技術應用與設計

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度,帶領同學進行多感官回饋技術的實作及實驗。從實作及實驗中學生將了解不同回饋技術在應用面上的可能性及其設計考量,並學習人機互動系統的啟發式評估、沉浸式量表、半結構式訪談,從而剖析及理解人機互動系統的表現(程式語言:C++)。此外本課程將以小組實習方式來進行,期望藉由合作學習和雛型製作來強化學生跨領域提案之創新能力。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to guide students to implement and experiment with multisensory feedback technologies from an application and design perspective. Through hands-on exercises and experiments, students will understand the capabilities of different feedback technologies in terms of application and design considerations, and learn heuristic evaluation, immersive scale, and semi-structured interviews of human-computer interaction systems to analyze and understand the performance of human-computer interaction systems (programming language: C++). In addition, this course will take the form of group exercises in the innovative ability to strengthen students' cross-field proposals through cooperative learning and prototyping skill.

Through hands-on exercises and experiments, students will understand the capabilities of different feedback technologies in terms of application and design considerations, and learn heuristic evaluation, immersive scale, and semi-structured interviews of human-computer interaction systems to analyze and understand the performance of human-computer interaction systems (programming language: C++). Through hands-on exercises and experiments, students will understand the capabilities of different feedback technologies in terms of application and design considerations, and learn heuristic evaluation, immersive scale, and semi-structured interviews of human-computer interaction systems to analyze and understand the performance of human-computer interaction systems (programming language: C++). In addition, this course will take the form of group exercises in the innovative ability to strengthen students' cross-field proposals through cooperative learning and prototyping skill.

description.zh: 本課程介紹以ARM CPU為核心之嵌入式系統。內容包含：ARM CPU基礎架構，ARM CPU指令集，ARM之C語言工具，ARM 發展環境，開發電路板，模擬器，Linux驅動程式之撰寫及安裝，分散式網路架構，以及應用實例。
description.en: This course introduces small single-board computers serving as embedded systems and explains the architecture of X86 and ARM CPUs. This lecture will present the history of the ARM development environment, emulators, distributed network architectures, and industrial applications of ARM architecture. In the course, students learn to install Linux on development boards and write software to communicate with ARM processors. The exercises involve setting commands for the ARM cores and receiving signals from our embedded systems using C language tools.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹完整的無人機系統架構，並引導學生組裝無人機和開發新應用。課程內容包括無人機原理、基本操作、硬體組裝、開源機載控制軟體(ArduPilot)、通訊協定(MAVLink)、地面控制站(Mission Planner)、影像傳輸等等。熟悉架構之後，將介紹進階應用。例如結合4G/5G網路控制多台無人機、使用3D列印改造機體、AI影像辨識等等。修課學生須具備基本電子電路知識、微處理機架構概念，並具備進階程式設計能力。
description.en: This course will introduce the complete Unmanned Aircraft Systems and lead students to assemble the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Students will learn the UAV theory, basic operations, hardware assembly, open-source embedded control software (ArduPilot), communication protocol (MAVLink), ground control station (Mission Planner), video transmission, etc. Additionally, we will introduce advanced topics and new applications, such as combining 4G/5G networks to control multiple drones, using 3D printing to customize the aircraft, installing AI models to do image recognition, etc. To take this course, students must have basic knowledge of electronic circuits and microprocessor architecture. Advanced programming capabilities is also necessary.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹基本無人機系統架構，與如何整合4G/5G網際網路來開發新的應用。課程內容包括無人機原理與基本操作、開源機載控制軟體(ArduPilot)、通訊協定(MAVLink)、地面控制站(Mission Planner)、飛行模擬與影像傳輸等、嵌入式AI影像辨識等。此外更將輔導學生考取無人機相關證照。
This course will the fundamentals of Unmanned Aircraft Systems, and how to integrate drones with 4G/5G network to create new applications. Students will learn UAV basic operations, open-source embedded control software (ArduPilot), communication protocol (MAVLink), ground control station (Mission Planner), VR simulation and video transmission, etc. Additionally, we will introduce advanced topics and new applications, such as combining 4G/5G networks to control multiple drones, training embedded AI models for object detection, etc.

name.zh: 科技政策與國家競爭力

description.zh: 本課程是針對高科技產業行銷管理的進階課程，目的是以行銷管理理論及案例討論方式，幫助學生熟悉高科技產業分析與行銷管理策略。關鍵概念包括傳統的行銷管理、高新技術產業B2B行銷管理、高科技導論、高科技企業之策略與企業文化、關係行銷、高科技企業之市場導向及研發與行銷的互動、高科技市場的行銷研究、了解高科技市場之顧客、高科技市場之後配銷通路與供應鏈管理、高科技市場之定價考量、高科技市場之廣告及促銷、及電子化企業及電子商務等研討。
description.en: This is an advanced course in marketing management for high-tech firms. The objective is to help students become familiar with industrial analysis and marketing management through marketing theories and cases. The key concepts include traditional marketing management, B2B Marketing Management, the introduction of high-tech Industry marketing, high-tech company's strategy and culture, relation marketing, marketing-R&D interaction, marketing research in high-tech markets, understanding high-tech customers, distribution channels and supply chain management, pricing consideration on high-tech marketing, advertising and promotion, E-business, case study, and term project.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.outline:
本課程的特色是希望藉由管弦樂音樂的播放，與實體樂器的展示、示範演出，互相結合，使同學在欣賞高水準的音樂之餘，更能實際接觸到平常接觸不到的實體樂器，實際的觀察樂器的構造，近距離的欣賞到樂器，能聽到實際上發出的聲音，從而對材料機械，科技與樂器聲響之間的關係，有一個真實而全新的認識，進而引發對音樂的認識以及興趣。
The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督/非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function多分類器, Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類, 分類正確率評估(Accuracy Assessments)及其他重要的應用，例如: 文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。
description.en: The course includes: Introduction to Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood & Bayesian Parameter Estimation, Non-Parametric Classification - Density Estimation, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Multi-Classifier - Positive Boolean Function, Linear Discriminant Functions, Pattern Recognition of High Dimensional Data Sets, Pattern Recognition for Remote Sensing Images, Biometric Certification, Video Surveillance, Accuracy Assessments and Other Related Topics.

description.zh:
本課程主要分為專利權的觀念建立，及並以自然語言處理（NLP）作為主要工具，專利權進行量化分析。
專利權部份：
壹、保護創新：1. 如何透過專利保護科技創新、2. 專利的迷思。
貳、專利與創新：1. 如何由需求或靈感取得創新、2. 如何使創新轉化為實質專利 3. 如何從專利撰寫演化出創新。
參、專利概念與規法：1. 我國專利體系介紹、2. 專利相關法規之介紹、3. 專利取得的流程、4. 發明專利實體審查基、5. 專利說明書及圖示的撰寫格式、6. 何謂發明單一性及優先權的使用。
肆、專利說明書搜尋及閱讀：1. 各國專利的搜尋引擎、2. 專利工具的使用、3. 閱讀專利說明書。
伍、專利說明書的撰寫與申請：1. 專利說明書撰寫之重要 2. 專利說明書之格式 3. 專利說明書之撰寫技巧。
陸、專利戰略與佈局：1. 商戰專利佈局模式、2. 專利舉發實務、3. 專利舉發方式、4. 專利舉發程序、5. 專利舉發策略運用、6. 舉發撤銷要件。
柒、專利侵害及訴訟實例：1. 從案例中學習專利侵害的攻防與法院訴訟的爭點、2.專家演講(法官，技審官，審查官，律師) 邀請領域的專家分享實務經驗。

專利權數據部份：
壹、專利數據收集：深入探討數據清理，篩選，確保學生能夠為分析準備適當的數據集

戰略管理使用綜合管理視角去解決相關的制定和實施企業和企業級戰略的問題。
該課程包括開發識別問題的能力，評估戰略選擇，並瞭解戰略的形成和執行的組織過程。它建立在功能區課程所獲得的知識，並使用案例研究和項目，以提高學生的分析和決策能力。前提：必須參與上學期的課程或與得到研究生導師的許可。
description.en: Strategic management uses a general management perspective in addressing issues related to the formulation and implementation of corporate and business level strategy. The course involves developing the ability to identify issues, evaluate strategic options and understand the organizational process by which strategies get formed and executed. It builds on the knowledge gained in functional area courses and uses case studies and projects to improve students' analytical and decision-making skills. Prerequisite: Must be taken in last semester or with permission of the Graduate Advisor.

description.zh: 國際商務市場行銷管理。包括在國際環境中的市場研究、定價、促銷和分銷。審查市場的問題出現不同程度的外資參與（出口，許可證，外國分公司）。先修課程：MARK5311市場行銷。
description.en: Management of marketing in international business. Includes marketing research, pricing, promotion, and distribution in the international environment. Examines marketing problems arising from various degrees of foreign involvement (exports, licensing, foreign subsidiaries). Prerequisite: MARK 5311 (MARKETING).

description.zh: 專注於戰略和機構的國際層面，並提供了一個框架，在日益複雜的全球經濟裡制定戰略。本課程旨在為學生提供對跨國公司經營裡的文化，政治，競爭，技術，法律和人口環境的理解。然後，它通過在國際背景下獲得成功的全球產業和戰略來探討全球競爭的性質。還涵蓋了跨國公司管理中的組織設計與戰略控制相關問題。
description.en: Focuses on the international dimensions of strategy and organization and provides a framework for formulating strategies in an increasingly complex global economy. The course seeks to provide students with an understanding of the cultural, political, competitive, technological, legal, and demographic environments in which multinational firms operate. It then examines the nature of global competition by exploring the characteristics of global industries and strategies that have been successful in an international context. Also covered are issues related to organizational design and strategic control in the management of multinational enterprises.

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出之方式，介紹與機器學習之相關技術及演算法，目標是修習本課程之學生具有閱讀機器學習相關文獻之基本知識，並能從事相關之實務或電腦模擬實驗之工作，因此本課程著重在廣泛介紹各類之演算法之應用，而非深究少數演算法之深奧數學原理．本課程涵蓋之演算法，包含：最佳化基本知識，隨機最佳化演算法，隨機搜尋，決策樹，隨機森林，類神經網路及深度學習相關演算法，基因演算法，貝氏定理及應用，高斯混合模型，隱藏式馬可夫鍊(及訓練演算法)，支援向量機，線性及邏輯迴歸，分群方法，降維方法，提升方法，決策融合技巧，及增強式學習等。
description.en: This introductory course covers most of the techniques and algorithms related to the current trend in the machine learning field. The goal of this course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, this course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. The algorithms covered in this course include: foundations of optiminizations, random search, decision tree, random decision forests, neural networks and deep learning, genetic algorithm, Bayes' theorem and its applications, Gauss mixture model, hidden Markov model (with its training algorithm), support vector machine, linear and logistic regressions, clustering algorithms, dimension reduction techniques (LDA, PCA, ICA, FA), boosting methods, decision.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces the concepts, techniques, and applications of machine learning. Topics mainly include Symbolists (e.g., Decision Tree), Connectionists (e.g., Artificial Neural Networks), Bayesians (e.g., Hidden Markov Model), Analogizers (e.g., kNN), and Evolutionaries (e.g., GA), Natural Language Processing and Speech Recognition. The lecture format will be a combination of slide presentation, chalk talk and computer demonstration. In addition to the theoretical study, students are guided to survey the related references, discuss and brainstorm by group, and conduct the practice projects, so that the capability of creativity and innovation can be developed during the course.

name.en: Risk Management and Tax Planning Strategies for Startups

description.zh: 本課程的主要目標為讓學生對新創事業創業經營風險與資本市場有一定的瞭解，並培養學生具備創業風險管理的能力、節稅規劃的基本認知與股票上市櫃的概念。課程內容包括對於公司法、財務報表、稅務規劃、資本市場以及擔任公司董監事的法律責任風險等探討。
description.en: The objective of this course is to enable students to understand the risks of starting a business and of investing in the capital market. In addition, the course cultivates the ability to manage entrepreneurial risks, basic knowledge of tax planning, and the concept of stock listings among participants. The course content includes discussions on company law, financial statements, tax planning, capital markets, and the legal responsibilities and risks of serving as a company director or supervisor.

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。本課程開授之目標，是希望修課學生能夠瞭解現今整個鐵道通訊及資訊系統與行控中心的架構、配置、功能及目標。前瞻資通訊技術（Information and Communication Technology, ICT）的發展與創新應用，將定義了整個鐵道產業的未來。由於鐵道通訊及資訊系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與資訊等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是針對選讀學程之學生，邀請鐵道通訊及資訊技術應用專家，以業師的身份共同參與授課。 本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊及資訊三部分提出通訊系統與行控中心之創新想法規劃與評估報告，並邀請學者與產業專家共同擔任評審及評比分數。
description.en: This course is the elective subject of Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is to provide the students an overall understanding of the structure, configuration, function, and the objective of the domestic railway industry and operation control center (OCC). The course will be composed with advanced development and innovative application of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and will dictate the future of railway industry. ICT of railway industry is interdisciplinary which involves management, communication, and information, etc. This intercollegiate course will invite industrial instructors, i.e. ICT experts from some relevant fields in intelligent railway industry to our course. In the final project and report, students are required to plan and assess the communication system and OCC focused on advanced management, communication, and information, and evaluated by qualified experts.

name.zh: 數位化設計與開發特論
name.en: Special Topics on e-Design and e-Development

description.zh: 如何藉由商務模型的分析，建置數位化協同產品設計與開發環境，並說明資料管理、構型管隨著網路時代的來臨，不但造成數位化協同產品設計與開發觀念的興起，也造成數位化協同平台技術逐漸成熟，並且將同步工程觀念的實現更往前邁進一大步。本課程是從數位化協同產品設計與開發概念之介紹開始，使學生明白數位化協同產品設計與開發在現代製造業中的重要性，接著介紹理與工作流程管理等相關實務應用觀念。
description.en: Information and network technologies have promoted the traditional concurrent engineering to the next generation. The collaborative e-design and e-development concept has been more popular in industries. This course is introduced from the concept of collaborative product design and development to help students understanding the importance of collaborative e-design and e-development in modern industries. Furthermore, the business model analysis method is provided to construct the collaborative environment of e-design and e-development. In addition, some real cases of data management, configuration management, and workflow management are mentioned.

name.zh: 拓凱永續科技人文專題講座
name.en: Topkey Lecture Series on Sustainability, Technology, and the Humanities

description.zh:
課程旨在引導學生在就學期間提前規劃未來的學習與發展方向，透過跨領域的專題演講與交流，學生將接觸最新的科技應用、理解永續發展的重要性，並在多元人文視野中培養創新與社會責任感。課程涵蓋：
 1. 永續願景：與國際接軌，使永續成為大學社會責任的行動。
 2. 科技與人文並進：透過跨領域講座，深化學生在科技與創新、智慧與文化間的連結度。
 3. 深耕跨領域人才培育：課程類型將包含，講座、工作坊、企業參訪、博物館走讀、合作研究等建構跨領域人才之行動策略。
description.en: This course equips students to shape their academic and professional careers by exploring the vital intersection of technology, humanities, and sustainable development. Through an interdisciplinary framework, students will be exposed to the latest technological applications, cultivate a strong sense of innovation, and integrate social responsibility grounded in diverse humanistic perspectives. Practical aspects, such as expert speeches, company visits, workshops, and projects, are included to cultivate workplace-ready, interdisciplinary talents.

name.zh: 氣候變遷與組織溫室氣體計算理論
name.en: Climate change and organization greenhouse gases accounting: theoretical approach

description.zh: 本課程從IPCC的氣候變遷評估報告出發，引導學生了解氣候變遷的重要性以及未來企業活動如何與氣候變遷結合，除著重介紹組織實體如何計算其營運活動的溫室氣體排放量外，亦介紹如何運用溫室氣體盤查數據設定組織轉型策略及淨零目標。本課程內容結合國際通用方法GHG Protocol與ISO 14064-1:2018、IPCC 2006與2019修訂之計算理論，並介紹我國環境部的計算要求以及與淨零目標設定、轉型風險相關之國際倡議，透過完整的計算理論與實務演練，來完成一份組織溫室氣體盤查與計算。
description.en: This course is based on the IPCC's Climate Change Assessment Report and aims to guide students in understanding the importance of climate change and how future cooperation activities can integrate with it. Apart from focusing on how organizations calculate the greenhouse gas emissions from operational activities, it also introduces how to utilize greenhouse gas inventory data to set transformation strategies and net-zero targets. The course integrates internationally recognized methods like the GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1:2018, as well as IPCC 2006 and 2019 revisions for calculation theories. It also covers national calculation requirements from Taiwan's Ministry of Environment (MOENV) and international initiatives related to setting net-zero goals and transformation risks. Through comprehensive theoretical approach and practical application, students will complete an organizational greenhouse gas inventory and calculation.

name.zh: 氣候變遷與組織溫室氣體計算理論
name.en: Climate change and organization greenhouse gases accounting: theoretical approach

description.zh: 本課程從IPCC的氣候變遷評估報告出發，引導學生了解氣候變遷的重要性以及未來企業活動如何與氣候變遷結合，除著重介紹組織實體如何計算其營運活動的溫室氣體排放量外，亦介紹如何運用溫室氣體盤查數據設定組織轉型策略及淨零目標。本課程內容結合國際通用方法GHG Protocol與ISO 14064-1:2018、IPCC 2006與2019修訂之計算理論，並介紹我國環境部的計算要求以及與淨零目標設定、轉型風險相關之國際倡議，透過完整的計算理論與實務演練，來完成一份組織溫室氣體盤查與計算。
description.en: This course is based on the IPCC's Climate Change Assessment Report and aims to guide students in understanding the importance of climate change and how future cooperation activities can integrate with it. Apart from focusing on how organizations calculate the greenhouse gas emissions from operational activities, it also introduces how to utilize greenhouse gas inventory data to set transformation strategies and net-zero targets. The course integrates internationally recognized methods like the GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1:2018, as well as IPCC 2006 and 2019 revisions for calculation theories. It also covers national calculation requirements from Taiwan's Ministry of Environment (MOENV) and international initiatives related to setting net-zero goals and transformation risks. Through comprehensive theoretical approach and practical application, students will complete an organizational greenhouse gas inventory and calculation.

name.en: Special Topics on Advanced Materials Chemistry

description.zh: 本課程為整合型課程，以多主題方式介紹當代與下世代先進材料化學技術，包含先進奈米合成技術、奈米微影科技、功能性催化材料化學、生醫材料化學、功能性高分子設計以及軟性元件製作等。本課程為跨系院課程，由多位教師共同授課，提供跨領域知識學習與培養學生跨領域思考。
description.en: This course is an integrated course that introduces emerging and next-generation advanced materials chemistry in a multi-topic approach, including advanced nanomaterials synthesis, nanolithography technology, catalytic materials chemistry, biomaterials chemistry, functional polymer design, and the production of soft electronic devices. It is an interdepartmental course, lectured by multiple teachers, and providing multidisciplinary knowledge learning.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提昇學生撰寫結構完整段落和短文之能力, 並著重如何重寫、摘要、 轉述、 陳述、筆記、編排、起草、修改等相關技巧。
description.en: This course is expected to expand students’ writing capacity and experience by helping them to formulate, organize, and present ideas clearly in well-formed paragraphs and compositions. Students will learn about rewriting, outlining, paraphrasing, synthesizing, documenting, note-taking, writing the draft and editing their own work.

syllabi.outline:
本課程幫助學生習得敘述、描寫、推論、議論、省思、說明等文體方面的寫作技巧，並指導學生從閱讀、圖片、日常生活事件，及課堂討論內容中取材，以加強邏輯思考和流暢寫作能力。
This course aims to develop and reinforce students’ strengths to create unified and coherent pieces of composition in a variety of styles--narrative, descriptive, argumentative, reflective, and expository. Students will be guided to write in response to readings, pictures, events in their daily lives, and discussions from the class. Thought-provoking topics dealing with current issues are used to stimulate and foster critical writing strategies. This course enables students to write and discuss logically and clearly; they also need to incorporate grammatically newly-built vocabulary into their writing.

syllabi.outline: Interaction design can be considered as an extension of the long-established fields of architectural, industrial, and graphical design. Regardless what types of the recent emerging field of interaction design such as UI, UX, responsive website, tangible interaction design, or smart environment, the image remains as the visual language for design ideation to realization. This course introduces the concept of digital pipeline which is mediated on wide range of image related digital technologies. Through those modularized technologies, we can form a working pipeline to create a prototype for an interaction design proposal.

description.zh: 此門課程主要在於瞭解社會學的意涵，並藉由跨領域的學習，讓不同學科能有對話的空間。課程涵蓋的範圍會兼顧理論與實用性，讓學生能思考當今的社會，理解到產生因素的多元性，並進而使個人眼界能更加開拓。期望學生於課程學習中能夠擁有更多對於整個社會的不同思維，以強化本身學科之所需，不但具有理論性深入的洞察力，也能引用到管理上實質的層面。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to understand sociology. It covers theory and practicability, and make students consider the current society, and understand the generated factors of diversity . Expect students' study can have more for the community as a whole different way of thinking, in order to strengthen their academic needs, not only has the theoretical depth of insight, but also on the substance applied to the management level.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description:
This course is designed to introduce students to the sociological way of thinking by encouraging them to "make the familiar strange and the strange familiar." Through a sociological lens, students will learn to examine the connections between individual experiences and broader social structures.

Sociology is a broad and diverse discipline encompassing a wide range of topics and research methods. The course is structured like a funnel: it begins with the most macro-level sociological theories, gradually moves toward the study of social institutions, and ultimately focuses on issues of identity, social roles, and gender inequality.

Course Objectives:
1. Develop the Sociological Imagination: Learn to apply sociological concepts to construct well-reasoned arguments and critically analyze contemporary social issues.

2. Master Social Research Methods: Gain an understanding of the theoretical frameworks and research approaches that social scientists use to observe, describe, and explain human behavior.

3. Enhance Academic Reading, Critical Thinking, and Collaborative Discussion Skills: Through reading scholarly journal articles (rather than relying solely on textbooks), students will learn to identify key arguments in sociological literature, exchange perspectives with peers in group discussions, and collaboratively develop well-supported conclusions.
syllabi.assessment:
Grading Criteria:
1.	Class Attendance & Participation (20%): Includes punctual attendance, asking questions in class, and the level of active engagement in relevant discussions.
2.	Reading Reflection Reports (40%): Choose any four weeks of reading texts to write summaries and critical responses.
3.	Group Project Oral Presentation (20%): Students (in groups) will apply one of the three major sociological paradigms—functionalism, conflict theory, or symbolic interactionism—to a chosen contemporary social issue.
4.	Individual Research Paper (20%): Students will submit a proposal for an original research project, including a defined research question, a brief literature review, and a proposed hypothesis.

Course Requirements:
1.	Writing Weekly Response: Submit a short memo elaborating on a notion/concept or a text quotation of the textbook.
2.	Attendance & Participation: Active engagement in discussions is mandatory.
3.	Academic Honesty: All work must be original and cited properly.
syllabi.materials: Required Reading: Conerly, T. R., Holmes, K., & Tamang, A. L. (2021). Introduction to Sociology (3rd ed.). OpenStax.

extra.課程進度(1-16週):
【18-Week Syllabus】
Part I: Sociological Lens and Approaches
(Sep. 10) Week 1 
•	Theme:
•	Defining Sociology: We will explore the systematic study of groups, societies, and social interactions at both the micro and macro levels.
•	The Sociological Imagination: Developing an awareness of the relationship between personal behavior and the wider culture.
•	Theoretical Paradigms: An introduction to structural functionalism, conflict theory, and symbolic interactionism.
•	Reading: 
•	CHAPTER 1: An Introduction to Sociology
(Sep. 17) Week 2 
•	Theme:
•	Defining Culture: Differentiating between material culture (tangible objects) and nonmaterial culture (ideas and beliefs).
•	Norms and Values: Understanding formal and informal norms, folkways, and mores that structure society.
•	Cultural Diversity: Examining subcultures, countercultures, and the impact of globalization.
•	Reading:
•	CHAPTER 3: Culture
(Sep. 24) Week 3 
•	Theme:
•	Types of Societies: Tracking societal evolution from preindustrial to postindustrial (information) societies.
•	Social Construction of Reality: Using the Thomas theorem and habitualization to understand how society is created by humans.
•	Roles and Status: Distinguishing between ascribed and achieved statuses, and analyzing role conflict and role strain.
•	Reading:
•	CHAPTER 4: Society and Social Interaction
(Oct. 1) Week 4 
•	Theme:
•	The Development of Self: Reviewing Mead’s "generalized other" and Cooley’s looking-glass self.
•	Agents of Socialization: The influence of family, peer groups, school, and mass media.
•	Resocialization: Exploring total institutions and the process of stripping and rebuilding identities.
•	Reading:
•	CHAPTER 5: Socialization
________________________________________
Part II: The (Re-)Making of the Stratifications and Inequalities
(Oct. 8) Week 5 
•	Theme:
•	Systems of Stratification: Comparing closed systems (caste) and open systems (class).
•	Social Mobility: Understanding upward, downward, and intergenerational mobility.
•	The American Class Structure: Analyzing the upper, middle, and lower classes and the phenomenon of the feminization of poverty.
•	Reading:
•	CHAPTER 9: Social Stratification in the United States
(Oct. 15) Week 6 
•	Theme:
•	Global Classification: Moving beyond "Third World" labels to World Bank classifications based on Gross National Income (GNI).
•	Global Wealth and Poverty: Differentiating between relative, extreme, and subjective poverty.
•	Global Perspectives: Comparing Modernization theory with Dependency theory.
•	Readings:
•	CHAPTER 10: Global Inequality
(Oct. 22) Week 7 
•	Theme:
•	Social Construction of Race: Understanding race as a grouping based on physical qualities that society deems significant.
•	Prejudice and Discrimination: Defining racism, colorism, and systemic racism within social institutions.
•	Intergroup Relations: Ranging from pluralism and assimilation to the extremes of expulsion and genocide.
•	Reading:
•	CHAPTER 11: Race and Ethnicity
(Oct. 29) Week 8 
•	Theme:
•	Sex vs. Gender: Distinguishing between biological distinctions and the social behaviors attributed to being male or female.
•	Socialization and Sexism: How the family and media reinforce gender roles and stereotypes.
•	Theoretical Perspectives: Viewing gender through feminist theory and radical feminism.
•	Reading:
•	CHAPTER 12: Gender, Sex, and Sexuality
(Nov. 5) Week 9 Midterm Assessment: Group Project Oral Presentation
•	Students (in groups) will apply one of the three major sociological paradigms—functionalism, conflict theory, or symbolic interactionism—to a chosen contemporary social issue.

description.zh: 互動設計可視為三大傳統設計領域：平面設計、工業設計，與建築設計的延伸。在許許多多延伸出來的新設計領域如 UI、UX、響應式網頁、互動產品、智慧空間等等，圖像依舊是所有設計在發想、討論，與實現設計上所仰賴的根本工具。本課程以圖像為設計語言的架構下，介紹由圖像所發展出來的數位生產線，以模組技術介紹互動設計在設計發想、原型製作，以至到設計討論與提案所需要之圖像技術，並鼓勵學生以一設計提案來總結課堂之所學。

syllabi.outline:
Physical AI refers to AI systems that can perceive, reason, and act within real-world environments—sensing through cameras, microphones, and other sensors, and interacting with the world via motors, robotic arms, wheels, or other actuators.
In this course, Physical AI serves as the central lens through which all projects and discussions are contextualized. Students will explore how modern AI models are integrated into real-world systems such as robots, smart homes, and autonomous vehicles, and how intelligence, embodiment, and environment jointly shape system behavior.
Intended Learning Outcomes:
1. Explain the definition, scope, and significance of Physical AI, and distinguish it from purely digital and agentic AI systems.
2. Describe the core concepts, system architectures, and key enabling technologies underlying Physical AI, including sensing, perception, reasoning, planning, and control.
3. Analyze and apply foundational Physical AI techniques to real-world problem settings, taking into account environmental dynamics, embodiment, and system constraints.
4. Identify and evaluate major application domains and representative use cases of Physical AI, such as robotics, smart environments, and autonomous systems.
5. Design, implement, and prototype a Physical AI solution that demonstrates the integrated use of perception, decision-making, and physical action.
syllabi.assessment:
Computer Assignment: 50%
- HW1: Coordinate Transformation
- HW2: 3D Scene Reconstruction and Mapping
- HW3: Path Planning
- HW4: Robotics Manipulation
- HW5: Ontology-based Data Quality Verification

Course Project : 40%
The Course Project is designed to provide students with hands-on experience across the full lifecycle of Physical AI—from real-world data collection, to policy learning, and ultimately to evaluation.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces fundamental statistical concepts and analytical tools for data-driven decision-making. Core topics cover descriptive statistics, data visualization, basic probability theory, random variable distributions, inferential statistics (hypothesis testing and confidence intervals for numerical and categorical data), and simple linear regression. The curriculum emphasizes building conceptual intuition and practical application in English. This course is offered under the Taiwan AI College Alliance (TAICA) program. Lectures are delivered asynchronously by NTU faculty via NTU COOL.
